local function addPicker(gb, id, cfg)
    if not gb then return nil end
    local ok, label = pcall(function() return gb:AddLabel(cfg.Title or id) end)
    if not ok or not label then
        sAdd(gb, "AddColorPicker", id, cfg)
        return nil
    end
    if type(label.AddColorPicker) == "function" then
        local ok2 = pcall(function() return label:AddColorPicker(id, cfg) end)
        if ok2 then return label end
    end
    return nil
end

-- ================= UNLOCK ALL =================
local UnlockAll = { Enabled = false }

local UnlockState = {
    Equipped = {},
    Favorites = {},
    LastUsedWeapon = nil,
    ViewingProfile = nil,
    ConstructingWeapon = nil,
    SaveFile = "unlockall/config.json",
    UNLOCK_WEAPONS = true,
    OVERRIDE_FINISHERS = true,
    Installed = false,
    Originals = {},
}

local function uaIsUnlockable(name, cosmetic)
    if not cosmetic then return false end
    local t = cosmetic.Type
    if t == "Skin" or t == "Charm" or t == "Dance" or t == "Emote" or t == "Wrap" or t == "Wrapping" or t == "Finisher" then
        return true
    end
    local n = name:lower()
    return (n:find("charm") or n:find("dance") or n:find("emote") or n:find("wrap") or n:find("finisher")) ~= nil
end

local function uaCloneCosmetic(CosmeticLibrary, EnumLibrary, name, cosmeticType, options)
    local base = CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[name]
    if not base and cosmeticType == "Finisher" then
        return { Name = name, Type = "Finisher", Seed = math.random(1, 1000000) }
    end
    if not base then return nil end
    local data = {}
    for key, value in pairs(base) do data[key] = value end
    data.Name = name
    data.Type = data.Type or cosmeticType
    data.Seed = data.Seed or math.random(1, 1000000)
    if EnumLibrary then
        local success, enumId = pcall(EnumLibrary.ToEnum, EnumLibrary, name)
        if success and enumId then data.Enum, data.ObjectID = enumId, data.ObjectID or enumId end
    end
    if options then
        if options.inverted ~= nil then data.Inverted = options.inverted end
        if options.favoritesOnly ~= nil then data.OnlyUseFavorites = options.favoritesOnly end
    end
    return data
end

local function uaSaveConfig()
    if not writefile then return end
    pcall(function()
        local config = {equipped = {}, favorites = UnlockState.Favorites}
        for weapon, cosmetics in pairs(UnlockState.Equipped) do
            config.equipped[weapon] = {}
            for cosmeticType, cosmeticData in pairs(cosmetics) do
                if cosmeticData and cosmeticData.Name then
                    config.equipped[weapon][cosmeticType] = {
                        name = cosmeticData.Name, seed = cosmeticData.Seed, inverted = cosmeticData.Inverted
                    }
                end
            end
        end
        if makefolder and (not isfolder or not isfolder("unlockall")) then makefolder("unlockall") end
        writefile(UnlockState.SaveFile, HttpService:JSONEncode(config))
    end)
end

local function uaLoadConfig(CosmeticLibrary, EnumLibrary)
    if not readfile or not isfile or not isfile(UnlockState.SaveFile) then return end
    pcall(function()
        local config = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(UnlockState.SaveFile))
        if config.equipped then
            for weapon, cosmetics in pairs(config.equipped) do
                UnlockState.Equipped[weapon] = {}
                for cosmeticType, cosmeticData in pairs(cosmetics) do
                    local cloned = uaCloneCosmetic(CosmeticLibrary, EnumLibrary, cosmeticData.name, cosmeticType, {inverted = cosmeticData.inverted})
                    if cloned then
                        cloned.Seed = cosmeticData.seed
                        UnlockState.Equipped[weapon][cosmeticType] = cloned
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        UnlockState.Favorites = config.favorites or {}
    end)
end

local function startUnlockAll()
    if UnlockAll.Enabled then return end
    UnlockAll.Enabled = true

    local _lp = LocalPlayer
    local _rs = ReplicatedStorage
    local _http = HttpService
    local _pscripts = _lp.PlayerScripts
    local _ctrl = _pscripts:WaitForChild("Controllers")

    local _mods = _rs:WaitForChild("Modules", 10)
    if not _mods then return end

    local EnumLibrary = require(_mods:WaitForChild("EnumLibrary", 10))
    if EnumLibrary and EnumLibrary.WaitForEnumBuilder then
        pcall(function() EnumLibrary:WaitForEnumBuilder() end)
    end
    local CosmeticLibrary = require(_mods:WaitForChild("CosmeticLibrary", 10))
    local ItemLibrary = require(_mods:WaitForChild("ItemLibrary", 10))
    local DataController = require(_ctrl:WaitForChild("PlayerDataController", 10))

    uaLoadConfig(CosmeticLibrary, EnumLibrary)

    local originalOwnsCosmetic = CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmetic
    CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmetic = function(self, inventory, name, weapon)
        if type(name) ~= "string" then
            return originalOwnsCosmetic(self, inventory, name, weapon)
        end
        if name:find("MISSING_") then
            return originalOwnsCosmetic(self, inventory, name, weapon)
        end
        if uaIsUnlockable(name, CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[name]) then return true end
        return originalOwnsCosmetic(self, inventory, name, weapon)
    end

    for _, fnName in ipairs({"OwnsCosmeticNormally", "OwnsCosmeticUniversally", "OwnsCosmeticForWeapon"}) do
        local original = CosmeticLibrary[fnName]
        CosmeticLibrary[fnName] = function(self, inventory, name, weapon)
            if type(name) == "string" and not name:find("MISSING_") and uaIsUnlockable(name, CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[name]) then
                return true
            end
            if original then return original(self, inventory, name, weapon) end
            return false
        end
    end

    local function getItemTable()
        return (type(ItemLibrary.Items) == "table" and ItemLibrary.Items)
            or (type(ItemLibrary.Weapons) == "table" and ItemLibrary.Weapons)
            or nil
    end

    local function isKnownWeapon(name)
        local items = getItemTable()
        return items ~= nil and items[name] ~= nil
    end

    local function stubWeapon(name)
        return {Name = name, Level = 1, XP = 0, Experience = 0, Kills = 0}
    end

    local invCache, invCacheFor, invCacheAt
    local originalGet = DataController.Get
    DataController.Get = function(self, key)
        local data = originalGet(self, key)
        if key == "CosmeticInventory" then
            if invCache and invCacheFor == data and os.clock() - invCacheAt < 0.25 then
                return invCache
            end
            local proxy = {}
            local sample
            if data then
                for k, v in pairs(data) do
                    if CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[k] then proxy[k] = v end
                    if sample == nil then sample = v end
                end
            end
            for name in pairs(CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics) do
                if proxy[name] == nil then
                    if type(sample) == "number" then proxy[name] = 1
                    elseif type(sample) == "table" then proxy[name] = {}
                    else proxy[name] = true end
                end
            end
            setmetatable(proxy, {__index = function(t, k)
                if CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[k] then return true end
                return nil
            end})
            invCache, invCacheFor, invCacheAt = proxy, data, os.clock()
            return proxy
        end
        if key == "FavoritedCosmetics" then
            local result = data and table.clone(data) or {}
            for weapon, favs in pairs(UnlockState.Favorites) do
                result[weapon] = result[weapon] or {}
                for name, isFav in pairs(favs) do
                    result[weapon][name] = isFav
                end
            end
            return result
        end
        if key == "WeaponInventory" and type(data) == "table" then
            local result = table.clone(data)
            local items = UnlockState.UNLOCK_WEAPONS and getItemTable()
            if items then
                for name in pairs(items) do
                    if type(name) == "string" and result[name] == nil then
                        result[name] = stubWeapon(name)
                    end
                end
            end
            for weaponName, cosmetics in pairs(UnlockState.Equipped) do
                local entry = result[weaponName]
                if weaponName ~= "Dances" and type(entry) == "table" then
                    local merged = table.clone(entry)
                    for cosmeticType, cosmeticData in pairs(cosmetics) do
                        merged[cosmeticType] = cosmeticData
                    end
                    result[weaponName] = merged
                end
            end
            return result
        end
        return data
    end

    local function reallyOwns(cosmeticName, weaponName)
        local ok, inventory = pcall(originalGet, DataController, "CosmeticInventory")
        if not ok or not inventory then return false end
        if rawget(inventory, cosmeticName) then return true end
        local ok2, owned = pcall(originalOwnsCosmetic, CosmeticLibrary, inventory, cosmeticName, weaponName)
        return ok2 and owned == true
    end

    local originalGetWeaponData = DataController.GetWeaponData
    DataController.GetWeaponData = function(self, weaponName)
        local data = originalGetWeaponData(self, weaponName)
        if not data then
            if UnlockState.UNLOCK_WEAPONS and isKnownWeapon(weaponName) then
                data = stubWeapon(weaponName)
            else
                return nil
            end
        end
        local merged = {}
        for key, value in pairs(data) do merged[key] = value end
        merged.Name = weaponName
        if UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName] then
            for cosmeticType, cosmeticData in pairs(UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName]) do
                merged[cosmeticType] = cosmeticData
            end
        end
        return merged
    end

    pcall(function()
        local LootLibrary = require(_mods:WaitForChild("LootLibrary", 10))
        local originalReward = LootLibrary.GetNextWeaponLevelReward
        if originalReward then
            LootLibrary.GetNextWeaponLevelReward = function(self, ...)
                local ok, result = pcall(originalReward, self, ...)
                if ok then return result end
                return nil
            end
        end
    end)

    local FighterController
    pcall(function() FighterController = require(_ctrl:WaitForChild("FighterController", 10)) end)

    if hookmetamethod then
        local remotes = _rs:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local dataRemotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Data")
        local equipRemote = dataRemotes and dataRemotes:FindFirstChild("EquipCosmetic")
        local favoriteRemote = dataRemotes and dataRemotes:FindFirstChild("FavoriteCosmetic")
        local replicationRemotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Replication")
        local fighterRemotes = replicationRemotes and replicationRemotes:FindFirstChild("Fighter")
        local useItemRemote = fighterRemotes and fighterRemotes:FindFirstChild("UseItem")
        if not useItemRemote and remotes then
            for _, descendant in ipairs(remotes:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant:IsA("BaseRemoteEvent") and descendant.Name:lower():find("useitem") then
                    useItemRemote = descendant
                    break
                end
            end
        end

        local oldNamecall
        oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
            if getnamecallmethod() ~= "FireServer" then return oldNamecall(self, ...) end
            local args = {...}

            if useItemRemote and self == useItemRemote then
                local objectID = args[1]
                if FighterController then
                    pcall(function()
                        local fighter = FighterController:GetFighter(_lp)
                        if fighter and fighter.Items then
                            for _, item in pairs(fighter.Items) do
                                if item:Get("ObjectID") == objectID then
                                    UnlockState.LastUsedWeapon = item.Name
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end

            if self == equipRemote then
                local weaponName, cosmeticType, cosmeticName, options = args[1], args[2], args[3], args[4] or {}
                local isNone = not cosmeticName or cosmeticName == "None" or cosmeticName == ""
                local isDance = cosmeticType ~= "Finisher" and (cosmeticType == "Dance" or cosmeticType == "Emote" or (not isNone and (cosmeticName:lower():find("dance") or cosmeticName:lower():find("emote"))))
                local overrideTable
                if isDance then
                    UnlockState.Equipped.Dances = UnlockState.Equipped.Dances or {}
                    overrideTable = UnlockState.Equipped.Dances
                else
                    UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName] = UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName] or {}
                    overrideTable = UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName]
                end

                if isNone then
                    overrideTable[cosmeticType] = nil
                    if isDance then
                        if not next(UnlockState.Equipped.Dances) then UnlockState.Equipped.Dances = nil end
                    elseif not next(UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName]) then
                        UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName] = nil
                    end
                    task.defer(uaSaveConfig)
                    return oldNamecall(self, ...)
                end

                local owned = reallyOwns(cosmeticName, weaponName)
                local cloned = uaCloneCosmetic(CosmeticLibrary, EnumLibrary, cosmeticName, cosmeticType, {inverted = options.IsInverted, favoritesOnly = options.OnlyUseFavorites})
                if cloned then overrideTable[cosmeticType] = cloned end

                task.defer(function()
                    pcall(function() DataController.CurrentData:Replicate(isDance and "CosmeticInventory" or "WeaponInventory") end)
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    uaSaveConfig()
                end)

                if owned then return oldNamecall(self, ...) end
                return
            end

            if self == favoriteRemote then
                local wName, cName, isFav = args[1], args[2], args[3]
                local cosmetic = CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[cName]
                if cosmetic then
                    UnlockState.Favorites[wName] = UnlockState.Favorites[wName] or {}
                    UnlockState.Favorites[wName][cName] = isFav or nil
                    uaSaveConfig()
                    task.spawn(function() pcall(function() DataController.CurrentData:Replicate("FavoritedCosmetics") end) end)
                end
                return
            end

            return oldNamecall(self, ...)
        end))
    end

    local ClientItem
    pcall(function() ClientItem = require(_pscripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem) end)
    if ClientItem and ClientItem._CreateViewModel then
        local originalCreateViewModel = ClientItem._CreateViewModel
        ClientItem._CreateViewModel = function(self, viewmodelRef)
            local weaponName = self.Name
            local weaponPlayer = self.ClientFighter and self.ClientFighter.Player
            UnlockState.ConstructingWeapon = (weaponPlayer == _lp) and weaponName or nil
            if weaponPlayer == _lp and UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName] and viewmodelRef then
                local dataKey = self:ToEnum("Data")
                local targetTable = viewmodelRef[dataKey] or viewmodelRef.Data
                if targetTable then
                    if UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Skin then
                        targetTable[self:ToEnum("Skin") or "Skin"] = UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Skin
                        targetTable[self:ToEnum("Name") or "Name"] = UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Skin.Name
                    end
                    if UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Charm then
                        targetTable[self:ToEnum("Charm") or "Charm"] = UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Charm
                    end
                    if UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Wrap then
                        targetTable[self:ToEnum("Wrap") or "Wrap"] = UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Wrap
                    end
                end
            end
            local result = originalCreateViewModel(self, viewmodelRef)
            UnlockState.ConstructingWeapon = nil
            return result
        end
    end

    local viewModelModule = _pscripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem:FindFirstChild("ClientViewModel")
    if viewModelModule then
        local ClientViewModel = require(viewModelModule)
        if ClientViewModel.GetCharm then
            local originalGetCharmFunc = ClientViewModel.GetCharm
            ClientViewModel.GetCharm = function(self)
                local weaponName = self.ClientItem and self.ClientItem.Name
                local weaponPlayer = self.ClientItem and self.ClientItem.ClientFighter and self.ClientItem.ClientFighter.Player
                if weaponName and weaponPlayer == _lp and UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName] and UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Charm then
                    return UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Charm
                end
                return originalGetCharmFunc(self)
            end
        end
        if ClientViewModel.GetWrap then
            local originalGetWrapFunc = ClientViewModel.GetWrap
            ClientViewModel.GetWrap = function(self)
                local weaponName = self.ClientItem and self.ClientItem.Name
                local weaponPlayer = self.ClientItem and self.ClientItem.ClientFighter and self.ClientItem.ClientFighter.Player
                if weaponName and weaponPlayer == _lp and UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName] and UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Wrap then
                    return UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Wrap
                end
                return originalGetWrapFunc(self)
            end
        end
        local originalNew = ClientViewModel.new
        ClientViewModel.new = function(replicatedData, clientItem)
            local weaponPlayer = clientItem.ClientFighter and clientItem.ClientFighter.Player
            local weaponName = UnlockState.ConstructingWeapon or clientItem.Name
            if weaponPlayer == _lp and UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName] then
                local ReplicatedClass = require(_rs.Modules.ReplicatedClass)
                local dataKey = ReplicatedClass:ToEnum("Data")
                replicatedData[dataKey] = replicatedData[dataKey] or {}
                local cosmetics = UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName]
                if cosmetics.Skin then replicatedData[dataKey][ReplicatedClass:ToEnum("Skin")] = cosmetics.Skin end
                if cosmetics.Charm then replicatedData[dataKey][ReplicatedClass:ToEnum("Charm")] = cosmetics.Charm end
                if cosmetics.Wrap then replicatedData[dataKey][ReplicatedClass:ToEnum("Wrap")] = cosmetics.Wrap end
            end
            local result = originalNew(replicatedData, clientItem)
            if weaponPlayer == _lp and UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName] and UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Wrap and result._UpdateWrap then
                result:_UpdateWrap()
                task.delay(0.1, function() if not result._destroyed then result:_UpdateWrap() end end)
            end
            return result
        end
    end

    ItemLibrary.GetViewModelImageFromWeaponData = function(self, weaponData, highRes)
        if not weaponData then return nil end
        local weaponName = weaponData.Name
        local shouldShowSkin = (weaponData.Skin and UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName] and weaponData.Skin == UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Skin)
            or (UnlockState.ViewingProfile == _lp and UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName] and UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Skin)
        if shouldShowSkin and UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName] and UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Skin then
            local skinInfo = self.ViewModels[UnlockState.Equipped[weaponName].Skin.Name]
            if skinInfo then return skinInfo[highRes and "ImageHighResolution" or "Image"] or skinInfo.Image end
        end
        return nil
    end

    pcall(function()
        local EmoteController = require(_ctrl:WaitForChild("EmoteController", 10))
        if EmoteController and EmoteController.GetEmotes then
            local originalGetEmotes = EmoteController.GetEmotes
            EmoteController.GetEmotes = function(self)
                local emotes = originalGetEmotes(self)
                for name, cosmetic in pairs(CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics) do
                    if cosmetic and (cosmetic.Type == "Dance" or cosmetic.Type == "Emote" or name:lower():find("dance") or name:lower():find("emote")) then
                        if not emotes[name] then
                            emotes[name] = { Name = name, Type = cosmetic.Type, ObjectID = cosmetic.ObjectID, Enum = cosmetic.Enum }
                        end
                    end
                end
                return emotes
            end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local ViewProfile = require(_pscripts.Modules.Pages.ViewProfile)
        if ViewProfile and ViewProfile.Fetch then
            local originalFetch = ViewProfile.Fetch
            ViewProfile.Fetch = function(self, targetPlayer)
                UnlockState.ViewingProfile = targetPlayer
                return originalFetch(self, targetPlayer)
            end
        end
    end)

    if UnlockState.OVERRIDE_FINISHERS then
        task.spawn(function()
            local finishersFolder = _mods:WaitForChild("Finishers", 10)
            if not finishersFolder then return end
            local originals = {}
            local suppress = false

            local function isLocalEliminator(eliminator)
                if eliminator == nil then return false end
                if eliminator == _lp then return true end
                local character = _lp.Character
                local t = typeof(eliminator)
                if t == "Instance" then
                    if character and (eliminator == character or eliminator:IsDescendantOf(character)) then return true end
                    if eliminator:IsA("Player") then return eliminator == _lp end
                    return false
                end
                if t == "number" then return eliminator == _lp.UserId end
                if t == "string" then return eliminator == _lp.Name end
                if t == "table" then
                    if eliminator.Player == _lp then return true end
                    local c = eliminator.Character
                    return character ~= nil and c == character
                end
                return false
            end

            local function getHeldWeapon()
                if not FighterController then return nil end
                local ok, fighter = pcall(FighterController.GetFighter, FighterController, _lp)
                if not ok or type(fighter) ~= "table" then return nil end
                local function nameOf(item)
                    if type(item) == "string" then return item end
                    if type(item) == "table" or typeof(item) == "Instance" then
                        local okName, itemName = pcall(function() return item.Name end)
                        if okName and type(itemName) == "string" then return itemName end
                    end
                    return nil
                end
                for _, key in ipairs({"EquippedItem", "CurrentItem", "ActiveItem", "SelectedItem", "HeldItem"}) do
                    local okKey, item = pcall(function() return fighter[key] end)
                    if okKey and item then
                        local n = nameOf(item)
                        if n then return n end
                    end
                end
                for _, method in ipairs({"GetEquippedItem", "GetCurrentItem", "GetActiveItem", "GetSelectedItem", "GetHeldItem"}) do
                    local okMethod, item = pcall(function() return fighter[method](fighter) end)
                    if okMethod and item then
                        local n = nameOf(item)
                        if n then return n end
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end

            local function pickTarget()
                local weapon = getHeldWeapon() or UnlockState.LastUsedWeapon
                local finisher = weapon and UnlockState.Equipped[weapon] and UnlockState.Equipped[weapon].Finisher
                if finisher and finisher.Name and originals[finisher.Name] then
                    return finisher.Name
                end
                return nil
            end

            local function build(name, ...)
                if name == "Every Finisher Ever" then
                    suppress = true
                    local ok, result = pcall(originals[name], ...)
                    suppress = false
                    if not ok then error(result, 0) end
                    return result
                end
                return originals[name](...)
            end

            for _, moduleScript in ipairs(finishersFolder:GetChildren()) do
                if moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                    local name = moduleScript.Name
                    local ok, class = pcall(require, moduleScript)
                    if ok and type(class) == "table" and type(class.new) == "function" then
                        originals[name] = class.new
                        class.new = function(subject, isFinal, eliminator, ...)
                            if suppress then
                                return originals[name](subject, isFinal, eliminator, ...)
                            end
                            if isLocalEliminator(eliminator) then
                                local target = pickTarget()
                                if target and target ~= name then
                                    local okBuild, object = pcall(build, target, subject, isFinal, eliminator, ...)
                                    if okBuild and object then return object end
                                end
                            end
                            return build(name, subject, isFinal, eliminator, ...)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end

local function stopUnlockAll()
    UnlockAll.Enabled = false
end

-- ================= FOV RINGS (aimbot + silent) =================
local AimFovCfg, SilentFovCfg, AimFov, SilentFov, fovSerialize, fovApply, FovUI
local FovAnchor = { Hooks = nil, Resolve = nil }   -- shared with the crosshair and muzzle hook below
do
    -- anchor modes: where a ring / crosshair sits on screen
    --   Center = viewport middle, Muzzle = gun muzzle projected, Enemy = nearest enemy head projected
    local FovAnchorHooks = { Muzzle = nil, Enemy = nil }
    FovAnchor.Hooks = FovAnchorHooks
    local function resolveAnchor(mode, dx, dy)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return Vector2.zero end
        local base
        if mode == "Muzzle" and FovAnchorHooks.Muzzle then
            local ok, w = pcall(FovAnchorHooks.Muzzle)
            if ok and typeof(w) == "Vector3" then
                local sp = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(w)
                if sp.Z > 0 then base = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) end
            end
        elseif mode == "Enemy" then
            local ok, v = pcall(function()
                local Plrs = game:GetService("Players")
                local lp = Plrs.LocalPlayer
                local mid = cam.ViewportSize * 0.5
                local best, bd = nil, math.huge
                for _, p in ipairs(Plrs:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= lp then
                        local c = p.Character
                        local h = c and c:FindFirstChild("Head")
                        local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if h and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                            local sp, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(h.Position)
                            if on and sp.Z > 0 then
                                local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - mid).Magnitude
                                if d < bd then bd = d; best = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return best
            end)
            if ok and typeof(v) == "Vector2" then base = v end
        end
        base = base or (cam.ViewportSize * 0.5)
        return base + Vector2.new(dx or 0, dy or 0)
    end
    FovAnchor.Resolve = resolveAnchor

    local FovRing = {}
    FovRing.__index = FovRing

    -- ---------- shapes ----------
    -- every shape is a polygon in unit space (x right, y down, bounds ~[-1,1]) scaled by cfg.Radius.
    -- the ring is DRAWN from this polygon and the aimbot / silent aim hit-test uses the SAME polygon
    -- (FovRing:Contains), so the visible shape is the real target area. Circle keeps the old UICorner frame.
    local FovShapes = {
        "Circle", "Square", "Rounded Square", "Rectangle Wide", "Rectangle Tall", "Ellipse Wide", "Ellipse Tall",
        "Diamond", "Triangle", "Triangle Down", "Pentagon", "Hexagon", "Octagon", "Polygon",
        "Star 4", "Star 5", "Star 6", "Star 8", "Star",
        "Cross", "X", "Heart", "Arrow", "Crescent", "Bolt", "Gear",
    }

    local function regular(n, offDeg)
        local t = {}
        for i = 0, n - 1 do
            local a = math.rad(-90 + (offDeg or 0) + i * 360 / n)
            t[#t + 1] = { math.cos(a), math.sin(a) }
        end
        return t
    end

    local function star(n, inner)
        local t = {}
        for i = 0, n * 2 - 1 do
            local a = math.rad(-90 + i * 180 / n)
            local r = (i % 2 == 0) and 1 or inner
            t[#t + 1] = { math.cos(a) * r, math.sin(a) * r }
        end
        return t
    end

    local function ellipse(ax, ay, steps)
        local t = {}
        for i = 0, steps - 1 do
            local a = i / steps * math.pi * 2
            t[#t + 1] = { math.cos(a) * ax, math.sin(a) * ay }
        end
        return t
    end

    local function rounded(r, steps)
        local t = {}
        local c = 1 - r
        local corners = { { c, -c, -90 }, { c, c, 0 }, { -c, c, 90 }, { -c, -c, 180 } }
        for _, k in ipairs(corners) do
            for i = 0, steps do
                local a = math.rad(k[3] + 90 * i / steps)
                t[#t + 1] = { k[1] + math.cos(a) * r, k[2] + math.sin(a) * r }
            end
        end
        return t
    end

    local function cross()
        local w = 0.33
        return {
            { -w, -1 }, { w, -1 }, { w, -w }, { 1, -w }, { 1, w }, { w, w },
            { w, 1 }, { -w, 1 }, { -w, w }, { -1, w }, { -1, -w }, { -w, -w },
        }
    end

    local function rotated(t, deg)
        local a = math.rad(deg)
        local ca, sa = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
        local o = {}
        for i = 1, #t do o[i] = { t[i][1] * ca - t[i][2] * sa, t[i][1] * sa + t[i][2] * ca } end
        return o
    end

    local ShapeBuild = {
        ["Square"]         = function() return { { -1, -1 }, { 1, -1 }, { 1, 1 }, { -1, 1 } } end,
        ["Rounded Square"] = function() return rounded(0.35, 6) end,
        ["Rectangle Wide"] = function() return { { -1, -0.6 }, { 1, -0.6 }, { 1, 0.6 }, { -1, 0.6 } } end,
        ["Rectangle Tall"] = function() return { { -0.6, -1 }, { 0.6, -1 }, { 0.6, 1 }, { -0.6, 1 } } end,
        ["Ellipse Wide"]   = function() return ellipse(1, 0.6, 48) end,
        ["Ellipse Tall"]   = function() return ellipse(0.6, 1, 48) end,
        ["Diamond"]        = function() return regular(4) end,
        ["Triangle"]       = function() return regular(3) end,
        ["Triangle Down"]  = function() return regular(3, 180) end,
        ["Pentagon"]       = function() return regular(5) end,
        ["Hexagon"]        = function() return regular(6) end,
        ["Octagon"]        = function() return regular(8, 22.5) end,
        ["Polygon"]        = function(c) return regular(math.max(3, math.floor(c.Sides or 6))) end,
        ["Star 4"]         = function() return star(4, 0.38) end,
        ["Star 5"]         = function() return star(5, 0.4) end,
        ["Star 6"]         = function() return star(6, 0.55) end,
        ["Star 8"]         = function() return star(8, 0.6) end,
        ["Star"]           = function(c) return star(math.max(3, math.floor(c.Sides or 6)), math.clamp(c.Inner or 0.45, 0.1, 0.9)) end,
        ["Cross"]          = function() return cross() end,
        ["X"]              = function() return rotated(cross(), 45) end,
        ["Arrow"]          = function() return { { 0, -1 }, { 1, 0 }, { 0.4, 0 }, { 0.4, 1 }, { -0.4, 1 }, { -0.4, 0 }, { -1, 0 } } end,
        ["Bolt"]           = function() return { { 0.25, -1 }, { -0.55, 0.15 }, { -0.08, 0.15 }, { -0.3, 1 }, { 0.55, -0.2 }, { 0.08, -0.2 } } end,
        ["Heart"] = function()
            local t = {}
            for i = 0, 47 do
                local a = i / 48 * math.pi * 2
                local hy = 13 * math.cos(a) - 5 * math.cos(2 * a) - 2 * math.cos(3 * a) - math.cos(4 * a)
                t[#t + 1] = { math.sin(a) ^ 3, -(hy + 2.55) / 16 }
            end
            return t
        end,
        ["Crescent"] = function()
            local t = {}
            local steps = 24
            for i = 0, steps do
                local a = math.rad(45.1 + (314.9 - 45.1) * i / steps)
                t[#t + 1] = { math.cos(a), math.sin(a) }
            end
            for i = 0, steps do
                local b = math.rad(294.6 + (65.4 - 294.6) * i / steps)
                t[#t + 1] = { 0.38 + math.cos(b) * 0.78, math.sin(b) * 0.78 }
            end
            return t
        end,
        ["Gear"] = function()
            local t, n = {}, 8
            local p = 360 / n
            for i = 0, n - 1 do
                local base = -90 + i * p
                local function add(deg, r)
                    local rad = math.rad(base + deg)
                    t[#t + 1] = { math.cos(rad) * r, math.sin(rad) * r }
                end
                add(-0.32 * p, 0.78); add(-0.2 * p, 1); add(0.2 * p, 1); add(0.32 * p, 0.78)
            end
            return t
        end,
    }

    local FovShapeSet = {}
    for _, n in ipairs(FovShapes) do FovShapeSet[n] = true end

    local function sampleGrad(c1, c2, c3, t)
        t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
        if t < 0.5 then return c1:Lerp(c2, t * 2) end
        return c2:Lerp(c3, (t - 0.5) * 2)
    end

    local function newBar(gui, z)
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        f.ZIndex = z
        f.Visible = false
        f.Parent = gui
        return f
    end

    local function fovParent()
        local ok, p = pcall(function() return gethui and gethui() end)
        if ok and typeof(p) == "Instance" then return p end
        return CoreGui
    end

    function FovRing.new(cfg, name)
        local self = setmetatable({ cfg = cfg, Center = nil, Rot = 0, Spin = 0, ShapeAngle = 0, Edges = {}, Strips = {}, Last = {}, Dirty = true, PolyOn = false }, FovRing)
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name = name
        gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        gui.DisplayOrder = 999
        gui.Parent = fovParent()

        local glow = Instance.new("Frame")
        glow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        glow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        glow.Visible = false
        glow.Parent = gui
        local glowCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        glowCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        glowCorner.Parent = glow
        local glowStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        glowStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        glowStroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        glowStroke.Parent = glow
        self.Glow, self.GlowStroke = glow, glowStroke
        self.GlowGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        self.GlowGrad.Parent = glowStroke

        local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        frame.Visible = false
        frame.Parent = gui

        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        corner.Parent = frame

        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        stroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        stroke.Parent = frame

        self.Gui, self.Frame, self.Stroke = gui, frame, stroke
        self.StrokeGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        self.StrokeGrad.Parent = stroke
        self.FillGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        self.FillGrad.Parent = frame
        self:Restyle()
        return self
    end

    -- call after any color / thickness / fill change
    function FovRing:Restyle()
        local c = self.cfg
        self.Stroke.Thickness = c.Thickness
        self.Stroke.Transparency = c.Transparency
        self.GlowStroke.Thickness = c.Thickness + (c.GlowSize or 8)
        self.GlowStroke.Transparency = c.GlowTransparency or 0.7
        self.StrokeGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, c.Color1),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, c.Color2),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c.Color3),
        })
        self.FillGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, c.FillColor1),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, c.FillColor2),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c.FillColor3),
        })
        self.Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        self.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = c.Fill and c.FillTransparency or 1
        self.Dirty = true
        self.GlowGrad.Color = self.StrokeGrad.Color
    end

    -- screen point the ring is centered on (viewport px, top-left origin)
    function FovRing:Point()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        return self.Center or (cam and cam.ViewportSize * 0.5) or Vector2.zero
    end

    function FovRing:IsCircle()
        local sh = self.cfg.Shape
        return sh == nil or sh == "Circle" or ShapeBuild[sh] == nil
    end

    -- polygon in px, relative to the ring center, unrotated (cached per shape / radius / sides / inner)
    function FovRing:Base()
        local c = self.cfg
        local key = tostring(c.Shape) .. "|" .. c.Radius .. "|" .. tostring(c.Sides) .. "|" .. tostring(c.Inner)
        if self.BaseKey == key then return self.BasePoly end
        local out = {}
        local build = ShapeBuild[c.Shape or ""]
        if build then
            local unit = build(c)
            local R = c.Radius
            for i = 1, #unit do out[i] = Vector2.new(unit[i][1] * R, unit[i][2] * R) end
        end
        self.BaseKey, self.BasePoly = key, out
        return out
    end

    -- is a viewport point inside the ring (any shape, honours shape rotation). used by aimbot + silent aim.
    function FovRing:Contains(pt)
        local c = self.cfg
        local d = pt - self:Point()
        if self:IsCircle() then return d.Magnitude <= c.Radius end
        local ang = -math.rad(self.ShapeAngle)
        local ca, sa = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
        local x, y = d.X * ca - d.Y * sa, d.X * sa + d.Y * ca
        local poly = self:Base()
        local inside = false
        local j = #poly
        for i = 1, #poly do
            local p, q = poly[i], poly[j]
            if (p.Y > y) ~= (q.Y > y) and x < (q.X - p.X) * (y - p.Y) / (q.Y - p.Y) + p.X then
                inside = not inside
            end
            j = i
        end
        return inside
    end

    function FovRing:HidePoly()
        for _, e in ipairs(self.Edges) do e.Visible = false end
        for _, s in ipairs(self.Strips) do s.F.Visible = false end
        self.PolyOn = false
    end

    -- draws the polygon outline (rotated bars) and the fill (scanline strips, gradient sampled per strip)
    function FovRing:Draw()
        local c = self.cfg
        local poly = self:Base()
        local n = #poly
        if n < 3 then return end
        local ang = math.rad(self.ShapeAngle)
        local ca, sa = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
        local R = math.max(c.Radius, 1)
        local cx, cy = self.Center.X, self.Center.Y
        local pts = {}
        for i = 1, n do
            local p = poly[i]
            pts[i] = Vector2.new(p.X * ca - p.Y * sa, p.X * sa + p.Y * ca)
        end
        -- gradient axis: same direction UIGradient.Rotation uses (0 = left to right, clockwise positive)
        local gr = math.rad(self.Rot)
        local gx, gy = math.cos(gr), math.sin(gr)
        local function tAt(x, y) return 0.5 + (x * gx + y * gy) / (2 * R) end

        local th = c.Thickness
        for i = 1, n do
            local p, q = pts[i], pts[i % n + 1]
            local dx, dy = q.X - p.X, q.Y - p.Y
            local e = self.Edges[i]
            if not e then e = newBar(self.Gui, 3); self.Edges[i] = e end
            e.Visible = true
            e.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + th, th)
            e.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + (p.X + q.X) * 0.5, cy + (p.Y + q.Y) * 0.5)
            e.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
            e.BackgroundTransparency = c.Transparency
            e.BackgroundColor3 = sampleGrad(c.Color1, c.Color2, c.Color3, tAt((p.X + q.X) * 0.5, (p.Y + q.Y) * 0.5))
        end
        for i = n + 1, #self.Edges do self.Edges[i].Visible = false end

        local used = 0
        if c.Fill then
            local minY, maxY = math.huge, -math.huge
            for i = 1, n do
                local y = pts[i].Y
                if y < minY then minY = y end
                if y > maxY then maxY = y end
            end
            local rows = math.clamp(math.floor((maxY - minY) / 3), 12, 240)
            local h = (maxY - minY) / rows
            for r = 1, rows do
                -- rows share exact pixel edges: the old 1px overlap doubled the transparency and drew seam lines
                local top = math.floor(minY + (r - 1) * h + 0.5)
                local bot = math.floor(minY + r * h + 0.5)
                local rowH = bot - top
                if rowH < 1 then continue end
                local y = (top + bot) * 0.5
                local xs = {}
                local j = n
                for i = 1, n do
                    local p, q = pts[i], pts[j]
                    if (p.Y > y) ~= (q.Y > y) then
                        xs[#xs + 1] = p.X + (y - p.Y) * (q.X - p.X) / (q.Y - p.Y)
                    end
                    j = i
                end
                table.sort(xs)
                for k = 1, #xs - 1, 2 do
                    local x0, x1 = xs[k], xs[k + 1]
                    if x1 - x0 >= 0.5 and used < 1200 then
                        used = used + 1
                        local s = self.Strips[used]
                        if not s then
                            local f = newBar(self.Gui, 1)
                            local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                            g.Parent = f
                            s = { F = f, G = g }
                            self.Strips[used] = s
                        end
                        s.F.Visible = true
                        s.F.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x1 - x0, rowH)
                        s.F.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + (x0 + x1) * 0.5, cy + y)
                        s.F.BackgroundTransparency = c.FillTransparency
                        s.G.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, sampleGrad(c.FillColor1, c.FillColor2, c.FillColor3, tAt(x0, y))),
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, sampleGrad(c.FillColor1, c.FillColor2, c.FillColor3, tAt((x0 + x1) * 0.5, y))),
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, sampleGrad(c.FillColor1, c.FillColor2, c.FillColor3, tAt(x1, y))),
                        })
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for i = used + 1, #self.Strips do self.Strips[i].F.Visible = false end
        self.PolyOn = true
    end

    function FovRing:Update(dt)
        local c = self.cfg
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        local target = resolveAnchor(c.Anchor, c.OffsetX, c.OffsetY)
        self.Center = self.Center and self.Center:Lerp(target, math.clamp(c.Smooth, 0.01, 1)) or target

        if c.Rotate then self.Rot = (self.Rot + c.RotSpeed * (dt or 0)) % 360 end
        if c.ShapeSpin then
            self.Spin = (self.Spin + (c.ShapeSpinSpeed or 90) * (dt or 0)) % 360
        else
            self.Spin = 0
        end
        self.ShapeAngle = ((c.ShapeRot or 0) + self.Spin) % 360

        if self:IsCircle() then
            if self.PolyOn then self:HidePoly() end
            self.Frame.Visible = c.Show
            self.Glow.Visible = false -- glow removed
            if not c.Show then return end
            local d = c.Radius * 2
            self.Frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
            self.Frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(self.Center.X, self.Center.Y)
            self.StrokeGrad.Rotation = self.Rot
            self.FillGrad.Rotation = self.Rot
            if false then -- glow removed
                local gd = d + 2 * (c.GlowSize or 8)
                self.Glow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(gd, gd)
                self.Glow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(self.Center.X, self.Center.Y)
                self.GlowGrad.Rotation = self.Rot
                self.GlowStroke.Transparency = math.clamp((c.GlowTransparency or 0.7) + 0.1 * math.sin(os.clock() * 2), 0, 1)
            end
            return
        end

        self.Frame.Visible = false
        self.Glow.Visible = false
        if not c.Show then
            if self.PolyOn then self:HidePoly() end
            return
        end
        self:Base()
        local L = self.Last
        local cx, cy = self.Center.X, self.Center.Y
        if self.Dirty or L.cx ~= cx or L.cy ~= cy or L.an ~= self.ShapeAngle or L.rot ~= self.Rot or L.bk ~= self.BaseKey then
            L.cx, L.cy, L.an, L.rot, L.bk = cx, cy, self.ShapeAngle, self.Rot, self.BaseKey
            self.Dirty = false
            self:Draw()
        end
    end

    local function defaultFovCfg(radius)
        return {
            Show = false, Limit = true, Radius = radius, Smooth = 1,
            Anchor = "Center", OffsetX = 0, OffsetY = 0,
            Thickness = 2, Transparency = 0.2,
            Rotate = true, RotSpeed = 90,
            Shape = "Circle", Sides = 6, Inner = 0.45, ShapeRot = 0, ShapeSpin = false, ShapeSpinSpeed = 90,
            Fill = false, FillTransparency = 0.6,
            Color1 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180),
            Color2 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180),
            FillColor1 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180),
            FillColor2 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            FillColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180),
            Glow = false, GlowSize = 8, GlowTransparency = 0.7,
        }
    end

    AimFovCfg    = defaultFovCfg(150)
    SilentFovCfg = defaultFovCfg(180)
    AimFov       = FovRing.new(AimFovCfg, "ArgonAimFOV")
    SilentFov    = FovRing.new(SilentFovCfg, "ArgonSilentFOV")

    RunService.PreRender:Connect(function(dt)
        AimFov:Update(dt)
        SilentFov:Update(dt)
    end)

    FovUI = function(host, prefix, cfg, ring, save)

                Callback = function(c) cfg.FillColor3 = c; ring:Restyle(); save() end })

    end

    local NUM_KEYS   = { "Radius", "Smooth", "Thickness", "Transparency", "RotSpeed", "FillTransparency", "OffsetX", "OffsetY", "Sides", "Inner", "ShapeRot", "ShapeSpinSpeed", "GlowSize", "GlowTransparency" }
    local BOOL_KEYS  = { "Show", "Limit", "Rotate", "Fill", "ShapeSpin", "Glow" }
    local COLOR_KEYS = { "Color1", "Color2", "Color3", "FillColor1", "FillColor2", "FillColor3" }

    fovSerialize = function(c)
        local d = {}
        for _, k in ipairs(NUM_KEYS) do d[k] = c[k] end
        d.Anchor = c.Anchor or "Center"
        d.Shape = c.Shape or "Circle"
        for _, k in ipairs(BOOL_KEYS) do d[k] = c[k] and true or false end
        for _, k in ipairs(COLOR_KEYS) do
            local col = c[k]
            d[k] = { math.floor(col.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(col.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(col.B * 255 + 0.5) }
        end
        return d
    end

    fovApply = function(c, d)
        if type(d) ~= "table" then return end
        if type(d.Anchor) == "string" then c.Anchor = d.Anchor end
        if type(d.Shape) == "string" and FovShapeSet[d.Shape] then c.Shape = d.Shape end
        for _, k in ipairs(NUM_KEYS) do if type(d[k]) == "number" then c[k] = d[k] end end
        for _, k in ipairs(BOOL_KEYS) do if type(d[k]) == "boolean" then c[k] = d[k] end end
        for _, k in ipairs(COLOR_KEYS) do
            local a = d[k]
            if type(a) == "table" and #a == 3 then c[k] = Color3.fromRGB(a[1], a[2], a[3]) end
        end
    end
end

-- ================= AIMBOT =================
local AimbotState = { Enabled=false, Smoothing=0.35, TeamCheck=true, Wallcheck=true, LockedTarget=nil }

local aimbotCameraCtrl
pcall(function() aimbotCameraCtrl = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.CameraController) end)

local AimbotRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
AimbotRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
AimbotRayParams.IgnoreWater = true

local AimbotPlayer = {}
do
    function AimbotPlayer:IsValid(Plr)
        if Plr == LocalPlayer then return false end
        local char = Plr.Character
        if not char then return false end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
        if AimbotState.TeamCheck then
            local myTeam = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID")
            local t = Plr:GetAttribute("TeamID")
            if myTeam ~= nil and t ~= nil and t == myTeam then return false end
        end
        return true
    end

    function AimbotPlayer:HasLOS(char)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return false end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not head then return false end
        local exclude = {}
        if LocalPlayer.Character then table.insert(exclude, LocalPlayer.Character) end
        if char then table.insert(exclude, char) end
        AimbotRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = exclude
        local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
        local dir = head.Position - origin
        return workspace:Raycast(origin, dir, AimbotRayParams) == nil
    end

    function AimbotPlayer:GetClosest()
        local Target, Closest = nil, math.huge
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return nil end
        local Center = AimFov:Point()
        for _, Plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
            if AimbotPlayer:IsValid(Plr) then
                local char = Plr.Character
                local Root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local Head = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Head") or Root)
                if Root and Head then
                    local ScreenPos, OnScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(Root.Position)
                    if OnScreen then
                        local Distance = (Vector2.new(ScreenPos.X, ScreenPos.Y) - Center).Magnitude
                        if AimFovCfg.Limit and not AimFov:Contains(Vector2.new(ScreenPos.X, ScreenPos.Y)) then continue end
                        if Distance < Closest then
                            if AimbotState.Wallcheck and not AimbotPlayer:HasLOS(char) then
                                continue
                            end
                            Closest = Distance
                            Target = Plr
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return Target
    end
end

RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
    if not AimbotState.Enabled then AimbotState.LockedTarget = nil; return end
    if not aimbotCameraCtrl then return end
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end

    if AimbotState.LockedTarget then
        if not AimbotPlayer:IsValid(AimbotState.LockedTarget) then
            AimbotState.LockedTarget = nil
        elseif AimbotState.Wallcheck then
            local c = AimbotState.LockedTarget.Character
            if not c or not AimbotPlayer:HasLOS(c) then AimbotState.LockedTarget = nil end
        end
    end

    if AimbotState.LockedTarget and AimFovCfg.Limit then
        local lc = AimbotState.LockedTarget.Character
        local lr = lc and lc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not lr then
            AimbotState.LockedTarget = nil
        else
            local sp, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(lr.Position)
            if not on or not AimFov:Contains(Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)) then
                AimbotState.LockedTarget = nil
            end
        end
    end

    local Closest = AimbotState.LockedTarget or AimbotPlayer:GetClosest()
    AimbotState.LockedTarget = Closest
    if not Closest then return end

    local char = Closest.Character
    local head = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    if not head then return end

    local targetCF = CFrame.new(cam.CFrame.Position, head.Position)
    local alpha = math.clamp(1 - AimbotState.Smoothing, 0.0001, 1)
    pcall(function() aimbotCameraCtrl:MimicRotation(cam.CFrame:Lerp(targetCF, alpha)) end)
end)

-- ================= GUN MODS =================
local GunMods = {
    Enabled=false, NoSpread=false, FastShoot=false, AlwaysBackstab=false, FireRate=100, Installed=false,
    RecoilPct=0, FireCdPct=100, MeleeCdPct=100, AutoFire=false,
    InfoCache=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"}),
    OriginalInput=nil, OriginalGunStartShooting=nil, OriginalMeleeStartShooting=nil, OriginalKnifeStartAiming=nil,
    GunItem=nil, MeleeItem=nil, KnifeItem=nil, ClientItem=nil,
    Utility=nil, CameraController=nil, UpdateCameraRotation=nil,
}

local function gmIsLocalItem(item)
    local fighter = item and item.ClientFighter
    if not fighter then return false end
    if fighter.IsLocalPlayer == true then return true end
    return fighter.Player == LocalPlayer
end

local function gmRememberInfo(info, key)
    if type(info) ~= "table" or info[key] == nil then return nil end
    local cache = GunMods.InfoCache[info]
    if not cache then cache = {}; GunMods.InfoCache[info] = cache end
    if cache[key] == nil then cache[key] = info[key] end
    return cache[key]
end

local function gmApplyInfoOptions(item)
    if not GunMods.Enabled then return end
    local info = item and item.Info
    if type(info) ~= "table" then return end
    local fireRate = math.max((GunMods.FireRate or 100) / 100, 0.01)
    local fs, ns = GunMods.FastShoot, GunMods.NoSpread
    local itemName = string.lower(tostring(item.Name or (item.Item and item.Item.Name) or info.Name or ""))
    local scytheOff = GunMods.NoScytheCd and string.find(itemName, "scythe", 1, true) ~= nil

    local recoil = gmRememberInfo(info, "ShootRecoil")
    if recoil ~= nil then info.ShootRecoil = (fs or ns) and 0 or recoil * (1 - math.clamp(GunMods.RecoilPct or 0, 0, 100) / 100) end
    local spread = gmRememberInfo(info, "ShootSpread")
    if spread ~= nil then info.ShootSpread = (fs or ns) and 0 or spread end
    local pSpeed = gmRememberInfo(info, "ProjectileSpeed")
    if pSpeed ~= nil then info.ProjectileSpeed = fs and 99999999 or pSpeed end

    for _, key in ipairs({"ShootCooldown","QuickShotCooldown","SpinCooldown","DashCooldown","Cooldown","BuildCooldown","AttackCooldown","HeavyAttackCooldown","BurstCooldown"}) do
        local original = gmRememberInfo(info, key)
        if original ~= nil then
            -- fire cooldown % applies to the shot cooldowns, melee cooldown % to AttackCooldown
            local pct = 100
            if key == "ShootCooldown" or key == "QuickShotCooldown" or key == "BurstCooldown" then pct = GunMods.FireCdPct or 100
            elseif key == "AttackCooldown" then pct = GunMods.MeleeCdPct or 100 end
            if fs or scytheOff then info[key] = 0
            elseif fireRate ~= 1 and (key == "ShootCooldown" or key == "QuickShotCooldown" or key == "BurstCooldown" or key == "AttackCooldown") then
                info[key] = original / fireRate * pct / 100
            else info[key] = original * pct / 100 end
        end
    end
end

local function gmRefreshCachedInfo()
    for info in pairs(GunMods.InfoCache) do gmApplyInfoOptions({Info = info}) end
end

local function gmRestoreInfo()
    for info, values in pairs(GunMods.InfoCache) do
        if type(info) == "table" then
            for key, value in pairs(values) do pcall(function() info[key] = value end) end
        end
    end
end

-- Sonata-style melee / knife backstab helpers + always-backstab
do
    local K0, K1, K2, K3 = utf8.char(0), utf8.char(1), utf8.char(2), utf8.char(3)
    local SHOOT_EYE = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
    local ENC_PELLET = { [K0] = 0, [K1] = 1, [K2] = 0, [K3] = 0, [utf8.char(4)] = 0, [utf8.char(5)] = 0 }
    local ENC_MEL_A_UP = { [K0] = -9e37, [K1] = 0, [K2] = 0, [K3] = -1.5707963267948966, [utf8.char(4)] = 3.141592653589793, [utf8.char(5)] = 3.141592653589793 }
    local ENC_MEL_B_UP = { [K0] = 0, [K1] = -90000000, [K2] = 0, [K3] = -1.5707963267948966, [utf8.char(4)] = 3.141592653589793, [utf8.char(5)] = 3.141592653589793 }
    local ENC_MEL_A_DN = { [K0] = -9e37, [K1] = 0, [K2] = 0, [K3] = 1.5707963267948966, [utf8.char(4)] = 3.141592653589793, [utf8.char(5)] = 3.141592653589793 }
    local ENC_MEL_B_DN = { [K0] = 0, [K1] = 90000000, [K2] = 0, [K3] = 1.5707963267948966, [utf8.char(4)] = 3.141592653589793, [utf8.char(5)] = 3.141592653589793 }

    local function withOrientation(src, pitch, yaw, roll)
        return {
            [K0] = src[K0], [K1] = src[K1], [K2] = src[K2],
            [K3] = pitch, [utf8.char(4)] = yaw, [utf8.char(5)] = roll,
        }
    end

    local function targetFacing(root)
        return root.CFrame.LookVector
    end

    local function behindTargetCF(root)
        local back = -targetFacing(root)
        local pos = root.Position + back * 2.2 + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
        return CFrame.lookAt(pos, root.Position)
    end

    local function knifeBackPoint(root, hitPart)
        local back = -targetFacing(root)
        return hitPart.Position + back * 0.35
    end

    local function resolveHitPart(root)
        local char = root.Parent
        local hit = char and char:FindFirstChild("HitboxHead")
        if not (hit and hit:IsA("BasePart")) then
            hit = char and char:FindFirstChild("HitboxBody")
        end
        if not (hit and hit:IsA("BasePart")) then
            hit = root
        end
        return hit
    end

    local function getUtilEnumRemote()
        local util, enums, useItem
        pcall(function()
            util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
            enums = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.EnumLibrary)
            useItem = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UseItem
        end)
        return util, enums, useItem
    end

    local function fireEncodedMelee(item, hitbox, below, knife)
        if type(item) ~= "table" then return false end
        local pitch, yaw, roll = 0, 0, 0
        pcall(function() pitch, yaw, roll = hitbox.CFrame:ToOrientation() end)
        local n33 = below and 1.5707963267948966 or -1.5707963267948966
        local srcA = below and ENC_MEL_A_DN or ENC_MEL_A_UP
        local srcB = below and ENC_MEL_B_DN or ENC_MEL_B_UP
        local a = withOrientation(srcA, n33, yaw, roll)
        local b = withOrientation(srcB, n33, yaw, roll)
        local ok = false
        if knife and type(item.HeavyAttackEncoded) == "function" then
            pcall(function() item:HeavyAttackEncoded(a, b, hitbox, ENC_PELLET); ok = true end)
            return ok
        end
        if type(item.AttackEncoded) == "function" then
            pcall(function() item:AttackEncoded(a, b, hitbox, ENC_PELLET); ok = true end)
        end
        return ok
    end

    local function sendKnifeCameraRotation(util, aim)
        pcall(function()
            local remote = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UpdateCameraRotation
            local pitch = select(1, aim:ToOrientation())
            local yaw = select(2, aim:ToOrientation())
            remote:FireServer(util:EncodeCameraRotation(Vector2.new(pitch, yaw)), nil)
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local h = getgenv and getgenv().SolCamHook
            if h and h.SendViewAngles then
                local p, y = aim:ToOrientation()
                h.SendViewAngles(math.deg(p), math.deg(y))
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Sonata fireKnifeBackstab
    local function fireKnifeBackstab(item, originCF, targetRoot, heavy)
        local hitPart = resolveHitPart(targetRoot)
        local below = originCF.Position.Y > targetRoot.Position.Y + 1.5
        if fireEncodedMelee(item, hitPart, below, true) then
            return true
        end
        local util, enums, useItem = getUtilEnumRemote()
        if not (util and enums and useItem) then return false end
        local partCF = hitPart.CFrame
        local hitPoint = knifeBackPoint(targetRoot, hitPart)
        local eye = originCF.Position + SHOOT_EYE
        if (eye - hitPoint).Magnitude < 0.1 then
            eye = hitPoint - targetFacing(targetRoot)
        end
        local aim = CFrame.lookAt(eye, hitPoint)
        sendKnifeCameraRotation(util, aim)
        local action = heavy and "StartAiming" or "StartShooting"
        local token
        pcall(function()
            local res = table.pack(item[action](item, true))
            token = res[1] and res[5] or nil
        end)
        if token == nil then
            pcall(function()
                token = enums:ToEnum(heavy and "HeavyAttack1" or "Attack1")
            end)
        end
        local ok = pcall(function()
            local objectId = item:Get("ObjectID")
            local actionEnum = enums:ToEnum(action)
            local encodedAim = util:EncodeCFrame(aim)
            useItem:FireServer(objectId, actionEnum, {
                [K1] = {
                    [K0] = encodedAim,
                    [K1] = encodedAim,
                    [K2] = hitPart,
                    [K3] = util:EncodeCFrame(partCF:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(hitPoint))),
                },
                [K2] = token,
            }, nil)
        end)
        return ok
    end

    local function fireMeleeSlash(item, originCF, hitPart, aimPoint)
        local below = originCF.Position.Y > hitPart.Position.Y + 1.5
        local knife = false
        pcall(function() knife = tostring(item.Name or ""):lower():find("knife", 1, true) ~= nil end)
        if fireEncodedMelee(item, hitPart, below, knife) then return true end
        local util, enums, useItem = getUtilEnumRemote()
        if not (util and enums and useItem) then return false end
        local objectId
        pcall(function() objectId = item:Get("ObjectID") end)
        if not objectId then return false end
        local eye = originCF.Position
        if (eye - aimPoint).Magnitude < 0.04 then
            eye = aimPoint + Vector3.new(0, 0.12, 0)
        end
        local aim = CFrame.lookAt(eye, aimPoint)
        sendKnifeCameraRotation(util, aim)
        local encodedAim = util:EncodeCFrame(aim)
        local token = enums:ToEnum("Attack1")
        return pcall(function()
            useItem:FireServer(objectId, enums:ToEnum("StartShooting"), {
                [K1] = {
                    [K0] = encodedAim,
                    [K1] = encodedAim,
                    [K2] = hitPart,
                    [K3] = util:EncodeCFrame(hitPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(aimPoint))),
                },
                [K2] = token,
            }, nil)
        end)
    end

    GunMods.FireKnifeBackstab = fireKnifeBackstab
    GunMods.FireMeleeSlash = fireMeleeSlash
    GunMods.BehindTargetCF = behindTargetCF
    GunMods.FireEncodedMelee = fireEncodedMelee

    local backstabConn = nil
    local manualStabBusy = false
    local BS_RANGE = 22

    local function nearestEnemyRoot(fromPos)
        local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
        local myTeam = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID")
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr == LocalPlayer then continue end
            if myTeam ~= nil and plr:GetAttribute("TeamID") == myTeam then continue end
            local char = plr.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local d = (root.Position - fromPos).Magnitude
                if d < BS_RANGE and d < bestD then best, bestD = root, d end
            end
        end
        return best
    end

    local function isHeavyMeleeItem(item)
        if type(item) ~= "table" then return false end
        local ok = false
        pcall(function()
            if type(item.StartAiming) == "function" then ok = true end
            local n = string.lower(tostring(item.Name or ""))
            if n:find("knife", 1, true) or n:find("melee", 1, true) then ok = true end
        end)
        return ok
    end

    local function getHeldMeleeItem()
        local ok, fc = pcall(function()
            return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
        end)
        if not ok or not fc then return nil end
        local f = fc.LocalFighter or (fc.GetFighter and fc:GetFighter(LocalPlayer))
        local item = f and f.EquippedItem
        if item and isHeavyMeleeItem(item) then return item end
        return nil
    end

    local function manualBackstab(item, targetRoot)
        if manualStabBusy then return end
        manualStabBusy = true
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                local origin = behindTargetCF(targetRoot)
                -- brief settle
                for _ = 1, 3 do
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    if not targetRoot.Parent then return end
                end
                fireKnifeBackstab(item, origin, targetRoot, true)
                local t1 = os.clock()
                while os.clock() - t1 < 0.15 and targetRoot.Parent do
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end
            end)
            manualStabBusy = false
        end)
    end

    GunMods.StopBackstab = function()
        if backstabConn then backstabConn:Disconnect(); backstabConn = nil end
    end

    GunMods.StartBackstab = function()
        if backstabConn then return end
        backstabConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not GunMods.AlwaysBackstab or manualStabBusy then return end
            local item = getHeldMeleeItem()
            if not item then return end
            local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not myRoot then return end
            local target = nearestEnemyRoot(myRoot.Position)
            if not target then return end
            -- only auto-stab when roughly in melee range
            if (target.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude > 12 then return end
            manualBackstab(item, target)
        end)
    end

    GunMods.KnifeView = function()
        local item = getHeldMeleeItem()
        local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not (item and myRoot) then return end
        local target = nearestEnemyRoot(myRoot.Position)
        if target then
            fireKnifeBackstab(item, behindTargetCF(target), target, true)
        end
    end
end

local function gmInstallHooks()
    if GunMods.Installed then return end
    local PS = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")
    local modules = PS:WaitForChild("Modules")
    local itemTypes = modules:WaitForChild("ItemTypes")
    GunMods.ClientItem = require(modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem)
    GunMods.GunItem = require(itemTypes:WaitForChild("Gun"))
    local meleeMod = itemTypes:FindFirstChild("Melee") or itemTypes:FindFirstChild("Knife")
    if meleeMod then GunMods.MeleeItem = require(meleeMod) end
    GunMods.KnifeItem = require(modules.Items:WaitForChild("Knife"))
    GunMods.Utility = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
    GunMods.CameraController = require(PS.Controllers.CameraController)
    GunMods.UpdateCameraRotation = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UpdateCameraRotation

    GunMods.OriginalInput = GunMods.ClientItem.Input
    GunMods.ClientItem.Input = function(self, input, ...)
        if gmIsLocalItem(self) then gmApplyInfoOptions(self) end
        return GunMods.OriginalInput(self, input, ...)
    end
    if GunMods.GunItem.StartShooting then
        GunMods.OriginalGunStartShooting = GunMods.GunItem.StartShooting
        GunMods.GunItem.StartShooting = function(self, ...)
            if gmIsLocalItem(self) then gmApplyInfoOptions(self) end
            return GunMods.OriginalGunStartShooting(self, ...)
        end
    end
    if GunMods.MeleeItem and GunMods.MeleeItem.StartShooting then
        GunMods.OriginalMeleeStartShooting = GunMods.MeleeItem.StartShooting
        GunMods.MeleeItem.StartShooting = function(self, ...)
            if gmIsLocalItem(self) then gmApplyInfoOptions(self) end
            return GunMods.OriginalMeleeStartShooting(self, ...)
        end
    end
    if GunMods.KnifeItem.StartAiming then
        GunMods.OriginalKnifeStartAiming = GunMods.KnifeItem.StartAiming
        GunMods.KnifeItem.StartAiming = function(self, force, ...)
            if gmIsLocalItem(self) then gmApplyInfoOptions(self) end
            -- Sonata: intercept heavy aim for always-backstab
            if not force and GunMods.AlwaysBackstab and gmIsLocalItem(self) then
                local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if myRoot and GunMods.BehindTargetCF then
                    local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
                    local myTeam = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID")
                    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and (myTeam == nil or plr:GetAttribute("TeamID") ~= myTeam) then
                            local r = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            local h = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            if r and h and h.Health > 0 then
                                local d = (r.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                                if d < 14 and d < bestD then best, bestD = r, d end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if best and GunMods.FireKnifeBackstab then
                        task.spawn(function()
                            GunMods.FireKnifeBackstab(self, GunMods.BehindTargetCF(best), best, true)
                        end)
                        return false
                    end
                end
            end
            return GunMods.OriginalKnifeStartAiming(self, force, ...)
        end
    end
    GunMods.Installed = true
end

local function gmRestoreHooks()
    GunMods.Enabled = false
    _G.CurrentCameraLoopID = (_G.CurrentCameraLoopID or 0) + 1
    gmRestoreInfo()
    if GunMods.ClientItem and GunMods.OriginalInput then GunMods.ClientItem.Input = GunMods.OriginalInput end
    if GunMods.GunItem and GunMods.OriginalGunStartShooting then GunMods.GunItem.StartShooting = GunMods.OriginalGunStartShooting end
    if GunMods.MeleeItem and GunMods.OriginalMeleeStartShooting then GunMods.MeleeItem.StartShooting = GunMods.OriginalMeleeStartShooting end
    if GunMods.KnifeItem and GunMods.OriginalKnifeStartAiming then GunMods.KnifeItem.StartAiming = GunMods.OriginalKnifeStartAiming end
end

local function gmEnable() GunMods.Enabled = true; gmInstallHooks(); gmRefreshCachedInfo() end
local function gmDisable() gmRestoreHooks() end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(1)
    if GunMods.Enabled then gmRestoreInfo(); gmRefreshCachedInfo() end
end)

-- ================= RAGEBOT (working: position + fire via UseItem) =================
UECfg = UECfg or { enable = false, key = "X", depth = 5.8 }
local RB_CFG = {
    Enabled = false,
    Mode = "Behind",
    TargetMode = "Closest",
    PrimarySlot = 1,
    FovDeg = 360,
    AttackWith = "Gun",
    AntiKatana = true,
    VoidSpam = { Enabled = false, HideSeconds = 0.69, AttackSeconds = 0.01 },
    -- Kicia weapon strategy: Index 1=Primary, 2=Secondary, 3=Melee
    Weapons = {
        Priority = { "Primary", "Secondary", "Melee" },
        Enabled = { Primary = true, Secondary = true, Melee = true },
        OnEmpty = "SwapOrReload", -- Reload | Swap | SwapOrReload
    },
}
local startRagebot, stopRagebot, RB_TARGET, RB_SYNC, RB_VOID_PHASE, RB_STATUS, weaponOf
RB_STATUS = {
    Enabled = true, Size = 12, Offset = 20, PosX = 0, PosY = 20,
    PositionOn = "on target", Font = "system",
    Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Outline = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), StrokeT = 0.5,
    Text = "",
}

do
    local wpnCache, wpnAt = {}, 0
    weaponOf = function(p)
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - wpnAt >= 0.08 then
            wpnAt = now
            local c, vms = {}, workspace:FindFirstChild("ViewModels")
            if vms then
                for _, m in vms:GetChildren() do
                    if m:IsA("Model") then
                        local sep = m.Name:find(" - ", 1, true)
                        if sep then c[m.Name:sub(1, sep - 1)] = m.Name:sub(sep + 3):lower() end
                    end
                end
            end
            wpnCache = c
        end
        return (p and wpnCache[p.Name]) or ""
    end
end

do
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    local running = false
    local hbConn
    local currentTarget = nil
    local lastShot = 0
    local lastMelee = 0
    local util, enums, useItemRemote
    local voidPhase = nil -- "hide" | "attack" | nil
    local voidT0 = 0

    local function ensureMods()
        if util and enums and useItemRemote then return true end
        pcall(function()
            util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
            enums = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.EnumLibrary)
            useItemRemote = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UseItem
        end)
        return util ~= nil and enums ~= nil and useItemRemote ~= nil
    end

    local function getFighter()
        local ok, fc = pcall(function()
            return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
        end)
        if not ok or not fc then return nil end
        if fc.LocalFighter then return fc.LocalFighter end
        local ok2, f = pcall(function() return fc:GetFighter(LocalPlayer) end)
        return ok2 and f or nil
    end

    local function getEquippedItem()
        local f = getFighter()
        return f and f.EquippedItem
    end

    local function sameTeam(p)
        local myT, pT = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID"), p:GetAttribute("TeamID")
        return myT ~= nil and pT ~= nil and myT == pT
    end

    local function isAliveChar(char)
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return hum and hum.Health > 0
    end

    local function getHitPart(char)
        if not char then return nil end
        return char:FindFirstChild("HitboxHead")
            or char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    local function pickTarget()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local origin = cam and cam.CFrame.Position
        if not origin then return nil, nil end

        local mode = tostring(RB_CFG.TargetMode or "Closest")
        local bestPlr, bestChar, bestScore = nil, nil, nil

        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LocalPlayer and not sameTeam(plr) then
                local char = plr.Character
                if isAliveChar(char) then
                    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hrp then
                        local skip = false
                        if RB_CFG.AntiKatana then
                            local w = weaponOf(plr)
                            if type(w) == "string" and w:find("katana", 1, true) then
                                skip = true
                            end
                        end
                        if not skip then
                            local dist = (hrp.Position - origin).Magnitude
                            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            local hp = hum and hum.Health or 100
                            local score
                            if mode == "Lowest HP" or mode == "Weakest" then
                                score = hp
                            elseif mode == "Highest HP" then
                                score = -hp
                            elseif mode == "Best FOV" or mode == "Crosshair" then
                                local dir = hrp.Position - origin
                                if dir.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
                                    score = 0
                                else
                                    score = -cam.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(dir.Unit)
                                end
                            elseif mode == "Random" then
                                score = math.random()
                            else
                                score = dist
                            end
                            if bestScore == nil or score < bestScore then
                                bestScore = score
                                bestPlr = plr
                                bestChar = char
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return bestPlr, bestChar
    end

    local function offsetForMode(tr, look)
        local mode = tostring(RB_CFG.Mode or "Behind")
        if mode == "Above" then
            return tr + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
        elseif mode == "Under" then
            return tr + Vector3.new(0, -4, 0)
        else -- Behind
