            local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
            if flat.Magnitude < 1e-3 then flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) else flat = flat.Unit end
            return tr - flat * 3.2 + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
        end
    end

    local function positionOnTarget(targetChar)
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHRP = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local tHRP = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not (myHRP and tHRP) then return end
        -- UE Counter mode is handled outside via UECfg
        if tostring(RB_CFG.Mode) == "UE Counter" then return end

        local look = tHRP.CFrame.LookVector
        local pos = offsetForMode(tHRP.Position, look)
        local face = tHRP.Position
        pcall(function()
            myHRP.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, face)
            myHRP.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            myHRP.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end)
    end

    local function shotData(fromPos, part)
        local v = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
        local lead = math.clamp(v.Magnitude / 350, 0, 0.12)
        local aim = part.Position + v * lead
        local look = CFrame.new(fromPos, aim)
        local data = {}
        data[utf8.char(1)] = {
            [utf8.char(0)] = util:EncodeCFrame(look),
            [utf8.char(1)] = util:EncodeCFrame(look),
            [utf8.char(2)] = part,
            [utf8.char(3)] = util:EncodeCFrame(part.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(aim))),
        }
        return data
    end

    local function fireGunAt(part)
        if not ensureMods() then return false end
        local item = getEquippedItem()
        if not item then return false end
        local objectId = item.Get and item:Get("ObjectID")
        if not objectId then return false end

        -- reload if empty
        local ammo = item.Get and item:Get("Ammo")
        if ammo == 0 then
            pcall(function()
                useItemRemote:FireServer(objectId, enums:ToEnum("Reload"), nil, nil)
            end)
            return false
        end

        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local from = cam and cam.CFrame.Position or part.Position
        local ok = pcall(function()
            useItemRemote:FireServer(objectId, enums:ToEnum("StartShooting"), shotData(from, part), nil)
        end)
        if ok then
            pcall(function()
                if item.StartShooting then item:StartShooting(part.Position) end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if item.Input then item:Input("StartShooting") end
            end)
        end
        return ok
    end

    local function fireMeleeAt(part)
        local item = getEquippedItem()
        if not item or not part then return false end
        local root = part.Parent and part.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or part
        -- Sonata path: encoded melee / knife backstab from behind
        if GunMods.FireKnifeBackstab and GunMods.BehindTargetCF and root then
            local origin = GunMods.BehindTargetCF(root)
            local heavy = false
            pcall(function()
                heavy = type(item.StartAiming) == "function"
                    or tostring(item.Name or ""):lower():find("knife", 1, true) ~= nil
            end)
            if GunMods.FireKnifeBackstab(item, origin, root, heavy) then
                return true
            end
        end
        if GunMods.FireMeleeSlash then
            local from = (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame) or CFrame.new(part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 2))
            if GunMods.FireMeleeSlash(item, from, part, part.Position) then
                return true
            end
        end
        -- fallback
        local ok = false
        pcall(function()
            if item.HeavyAttack then item:HeavyAttack(part.Position); ok = true end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if item.StartAiming then item:StartAiming(true); ok = true end
        end)
        if ensureMods() then
            local objectId = item.Get and item:Get("ObjectID")
            if objectId then
                pcall(function()
                    useItemRemote:FireServer(objectId, enums:ToEnum("StartShooting"), shotData(
                        (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position) or part.Position, part
                    ), nil)
                    ok = true
                end)
            end
        end
        return ok
    end

    -- Kicia weapon strategy: Primary(1) / Secondary(2) / Melee(3)
    -- Equip via ClientFighter:EquipItem(index); OnEmpty = Reload | Swap | SwapOrReload
    local lastEquipAt = 0
    local function slotName(index)
        if index == 1 then return "Primary" end
        if index == 2 then return "Secondary" end
        if index == 3 then return "Melee" end
        return nil
    end

    local function getClientFighter()
        local ok, fc = pcall(function()
            return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
        end)
        if not ok or not fc then return nil end
        if fc.LocalFighter then return fc.LocalFighter end
        local ok2, f = pcall(function() return fc:GetFighter(LocalPlayer) end)
        return ok2 and f or nil
    end

    local function getInventoryItems()
        -- returns list of { Index, Item, Slot, Ammo, Reserve, Type }
        local list = {}
        local cf = getClientFighter()
        if not cf then return list end

        -- try Items / Inventory tables on fighter
        local candidates = {}
        pcall(function()
            if type(cf.Items) == "table" then
                for i, it in pairs(cf.Items) do table.insert(candidates, { i, it }) end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if type(cf.Inventory) == "table" then
                for i, it in pairs(cf.Inventory) do table.insert(candidates, { i, it }) end
            end
        end)
        -- Equipped + siblings via character
        pcall(function()
            local eq = cf.EquippedItem
            if eq then
                local parent = eq.Parent
                if parent then
                    for _, ch in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
                        table.insert(candidates, { ch:GetAttribute("Index") or #candidates + 1, ch })
                    end
                end
            end
        end)

        local seen = {}
        for _, pair in ipairs(candidates) do
            local idx, it = pair[1], pair[2]
            if type(it) == "table" or typeof(it) == "Instance" then
                local index = tonumber(idx)
                if not index and type(it) == "table" then
                    index = tonumber(it.Index) or tonumber(rawget(it, "Index"))
                end
                if index and not seen[index] then
                    seen[index] = true
                    local ammo, reserve, typ, name = nil, nil, nil, nil
                    pcall(function()
                        if it.Get then
                            ammo = it:Get("Ammo")
                            reserve = it:Get("AmmoReserve")
                        elseif it.Data then
                            ammo = it.Data.Ammo
                            reserve = it.Data.AmmoReserve
                        end
                    end)
                    pcall(function()
                        typ = it.Info and it.Info.Type or it.__type
                        name = it.Name
                    end)
                    if not typ then
                        if index == 3 then typ = "Melee" else typ = "Gun" end
                    end
                    table.insert(list, {
                        Index = index,
                        Item = it,
                        Slot = slotName(index),
                        Ammo = ammo,
                        Reserve = reserve,
                        Type = tostring(typ or ""),
                        Name = tostring(name or ""),
                    })
                end
            end
        end

        -- fallback: if empty, synthesize slots 1/2/3 from equipped only
        if #list == 0 then
            local eq = getEquippedItem()
            if eq then
                local typ = eq.Info and eq.Info.Type or "Gun"
                local index = (tostring(typ):lower() == "melee") and 3 or (RB_CFG.PrimarySlot or 1)
                local ammo, reserve
                pcall(function()
                    if eq.Get then ammo = eq:Get("Ammo"); reserve = eq:Get("AmmoReserve") end
                end)
                table.insert(list, {
                    Index = index, Item = eq, Slot = slotName(index),
                    Ammo = ammo, Reserve = reserve, Type = tostring(typ), Name = tostring(eq.Name or ""),
                })
            end
        end
        return list
    end

    local function equipByIndex(index)
        if not index then return false end
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastEquipAt < 0.12 then return false end
        lastEquipAt = now
        local cf = getClientFighter()
        if cf and type(cf.EquipItem) == "function" then
            local ok = pcall(function()
                task.spawn(cf.EquipItem, cf, index)
            end)
            if ok then return true end
        end
        -- VirtualInput fallback 1/2/3
        pcall(function()
            local VIM = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
            local key = ({ Enum.KeyCode.One, Enum.KeyCode.Two, Enum.KeyCode.Three })[index]
            if key then
                VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, key, false, game)
                task.wait(0.03)
                VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, key, false, game)
            end
        end)
        return true
    end

    local function weaponAction()
        -- Kicia jM.getAction: pick best enabled slot by priority, handle empty ammo
        local wcfg = RB_CFG.Weapons or {}
        local priority = wcfg.Priority or { "Primary", "Secondary", "Melee" }
        local enabled = wcfg.Enabled or { Primary = true, Secondary = true, Melee = true }
        local onEmpty = tostring(wcfg.OnEmpty or "SwapOrReload")

        -- honor AttackWith quick filter
        local atk = tostring(RB_CFG.AttackWith or "Gun"):lower()
        if atk == "melee" or atk == "knife" then
            enabled = { Primary = false, Secondary = false, Melee = true }
            priority = { "Melee" }
        elseif atk == "gun" then
            enabled = {
                Primary = enabled.Primary ~= false,
                Secondary = enabled.Secondary ~= false,
                Melee = false,
            }
        end

        local items = getInventoryItems()
        local bestAttack, bestPri = nil, math.huge
        local bestEmptyReload, bestEmptyPri = nil, math.huge

        for _, entry in ipairs(items) do
            local slot = entry.Slot
            if slot and enabled[slot] then
                local pri = table.find(priority, slot) or 99
                local isGun = tostring(entry.Type):lower() == "gun" or slot ~= "Melee"
                local ammo = entry.Ammo
                if isGun and ammo == 0 then
                    local reserve = entry.Reserve or 0
                    if reserve > 0 and pri < bestEmptyPri then
                        bestEmptyPri = pri
                        bestEmptyReload = entry
                    end
                else
                    if pri < bestPri then
                        bestPri = pri
                        bestAttack = entry
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if bestAttack then
            local eq = getEquippedItem()
            local eqName = eq and tostring(eq.Name or "")
            local same = eq and (eq == bestAttack.Item or eqName == bestAttack.Name)
            if not same then
                return { Type = "Swap", Index = bestAttack.Index, Item = bestAttack.Item }
            end
            return { Type = "Attack", Index = bestAttack.Index, Item = bestAttack.Item }
        end

        if onEmpty == "Swap" then
            return nil
        end

        -- Reload or SwapOrReload with empty mag but reserve
        if bestEmptyReload then
            local eq = getEquippedItem()
            local same = eq and (eq == bestEmptyReload.Item or tostring(eq.Name or "") == bestEmptyReload.Name)
            if same then
                return { Type = "Reload", Index = bestEmptyReload.Index, Item = bestEmptyReload.Item }
            end
            return { Type = "Swap", Index = bestEmptyReload.Index, Item = bestEmptyReload.Item }
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function tryEquipPreferred()
        local action = weaponAction()
        if not action then return end
        if action.Type == "Swap" then
            equipByIndex(action.Index)
        elseif action.Type == "Reload" then
            -- ensure equipped then reload via UseItem
            equipByIndex(action.Index)
            if ensureMods() then
                local item = action.Item or getEquippedItem()
                local objectId = item and item.Get and item:Get("ObjectID")
                if objectId then
                    pcall(function()
                        useItemRemote:FireServer(objectId, enums:ToEnum("Reload"), nil, nil)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function voidTick(targetChar, hit)
        local vs = RB_CFG.VoidSpam
        if type(vs) ~= "table" or not vs.Enabled then
            voidPhase = nil
            return false
        end
        local hideT = tonumber(vs.HideSeconds) or 0.69
        local atkT = tonumber(vs.AttackSeconds) or 0.01
        local now = os.clock()
        if voidPhase == nil then
            voidPhase = "hide"
            voidT0 = now
        end
        local elapsed = now - voidT0
        if voidPhase == "hide" then
            -- park under map briefly
            local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if myHRP then
                pcall(function()
                    myHRP.CFrame = CFrame.new(myHRP.Position.X, -50, myHRP.Position.Z)
                end)
            end
            if elapsed >= hideT then
                voidPhase = "attack"
                voidT0 = now
            end
            return true
        else
            positionOnTarget(targetChar)
            if hit then
                local atk = tostring(RB_CFG.AttackWith or "Gun"):lower()
                if atk == "melee" or atk == "knife" then
                    fireMeleeAt(hit)
                else
                    fireGunAt(hit)
                end
            end
            if elapsed >= atkT then
                voidPhase = "hide"
                voidT0 = now
            end
            return true
        end
    end

    local function tickMain(dt)
        if not running or not RB_CFG.Enabled then return end

        local plr, char = pickTarget()
        currentTarget = plr
        if not (plr and char) then
            RB_STATUS.Text = "ragebot: waiting..."
            voidPhase = nil
            return
        end

        local hit = getHitPart(char)
        if not hit then
            RB_STATUS.Text = "ragebot: no hitbox"
            return
        end

        tryEquipPreferred()

        -- void spam overrides normal positioning cycle
        if voidTick(char, hit) then
            RB_STATUS.Text = (voidPhase == "hide")
                and ("void... " .. plr.Name)
                or ("void spamming " .. plr.Name .. "...")
            return
        end

        -- lobby detector is built into rage enable: never fight in lobby
        if getgenv().SolIsLobby and getgenv().SolIsLobby() then
            RB_STATUS.Text = "ragebot: lobby (waiting for match)"
            return
        end

        positionOnTarget(char)

        local atk = tostring(RB_CFG.AttackWith or "Gun"):lower()
        local now = os.clock()
        -- tighter reaction: fire every frame budget (gun ~0, melee ~50ms)
        if atk == "melee" or atk == "knife" then
            if now - lastMelee >= 0.05 then
                lastMelee = now
                fireMeleeAt(hit)
            end
            RB_STATUS.Text = "backstabbing " .. plr.Name .. "..."
        else
            if now - lastShot >= 0.0 then
                lastShot = now
                fireGunAt(hit)
            end
            RB_STATUS.Text = "killing " .. plr.Name .. "..."
        end
    end

    RB_SYNC = function(t)
        if type(t) ~= "table" then return end
        if t.Mode ~= nil then RB_CFG.Mode = t.Mode end
        if t.TargetMode ~= nil then RB_CFG.TargetMode = t.TargetMode end
        if t.PrimarySlot ~= nil then RB_CFG.PrimarySlot = t.PrimarySlot end
        if t.FovDeg ~= nil then RB_CFG.FovDeg = t.FovDeg end
        if t.AttackWith ~= nil then RB_CFG.AttackWith = t.AttackWith end
        if t.AntiKatana ~= nil then RB_CFG.AntiKatana = t.AntiKatana end
        if t.VoidSpam ~= nil then RB_CFG.VoidSpam = t.VoidSpam end
        if t.Enabled ~= nil then RB_CFG.Enabled = t.Enabled end
        if t.Weapons ~= nil then RB_CFG.Weapons = t.Weapons end
    end

    startRagebot = function()
        running = true
        RB_CFG.Enabled = true
        ensureMods()
        -- desync magnet + CameraController hook ON with rage
        pcall(function()
            if getgenv().SolSetDesync then getgenv().SolSetDesync(true) end
            if getgenv().SolSetDesyncMagnet then getgenv().SolSetDesyncMagnet(true) end
            local h = getgenv().SolCamHook
            if h and type(h.Install) == "function" then
                h.Install()
                h.Active = true
                h.Suppress = false
            end
        end)
        if not hbConn then
            hbConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                local ok, err = pcall(tickMain, dt)
                if not ok then
                    warn("[ragebot] " .. tostring(err))
                end
            end)
        end
        RB_STATUS.Text = "ragebot: on"
    end

    stopRagebot = function()
        running = false
        RB_CFG.Enabled = false
        currentTarget = nil
        voidPhase = nil
        RB_STATUS.Text = ""
        if hbConn then hbConn:Disconnect(); hbConn = nil end
        -- desync + CameraController hook OFF with rage
        pcall(function()
            if getgenv().SolSetDesync then getgenv().SolSetDesync(false) end
            local h = getgenv().SolCamHook
            if h then
                if type(h.ClearViewAngles) == "function" then h.ClearViewAngles() end
                if type(h.Uninstall) == "function" then h.Uninstall() end
                h.Active = false
                h.Suppress = true
            end
        end)
    end

    RB_TARGET = function()
        return currentTarget
    end
    getgenv().SolRageTarget = RB_TARGET

    RB_VOID_PHASE = function()
        if not (RB_CFG.VoidSpam and RB_CFG.VoidSpam.Enabled) then return nil end
        return voidPhase
    end

    getgenv().SolRageAddPriority = function() end
    getgenv().SolRageRemovePriority = function() end
    getgenv().SolRageMarkVoided = function() end
end

pcall(RB_SYNC, RB_CFG)
-- end ragebot v2

-- ================= KICIA DESYNC + CAMERA HOOK + LOBBY (built into rage) =================
-- Root desync (cs): Heartbeat applies server CF, RenderStep First restores client CF
-- CameraController: hooks Rotation / SetRotation + UpdateCameraRotation encode path
-- Lobby: EnvironmentID == nil => in lobby (rage enable waits / pauses automatically)
do
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    local TAU = math.pi * 2

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- Lobby
    local Lobby = { InLobby = true, LastCheck = 0, Interval = 0.2 }
    getgenv().SolLobby = Lobby

    local function readEnvironmentId()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char then
            local a = char:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID")
            if a ~= nil then return a end
            local cf = char:FindFirstChild("ClientFighter")
            if cf then
                a = cf:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID")
                if a ~= nil then return a end
            end
        end
        local ok, fc = pcall(function()
            return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
        end)
        if ok and fc then
            local f = fc.LocalFighter or (fc.GetFighter and select(2, pcall(fc.GetFighter, fc, LocalPlayer)))
            if f then
                if type(f.GetAttribute) == "function" then
                    local a = f:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID")
                    if a ~= nil then return a end
                end
                local st = f.State
                if type(st) == "table" and st.EnvironmentId ~= nil then return st.EnvironmentId end
                local ch = f.Character
                if type(ch) == "table" and ch.State and ch.State.EnvironmentId ~= nil then
                    return ch.State.EnvironmentId
                end
            end
        end
        return nil -- treat missing as lobby (Kicia)
    end

    local function refreshLobby()
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - Lobby.LastCheck < Lobby.Interval then return Lobby.InLobby end
        Lobby.LastCheck = now
        Lobby.InLobby = (readEnvironmentId() == nil)
        return Lobby.InLobby
    end

    getgenv().SolIsLobby = function()
        return refreshLobby()
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- CameraController hook (Kicia cp + cI style)
    local CamHook = {
        Installed = false,
        Active = false,
        Suppress = false,
        ForcedAngles = nil,
        GetRotation = nil,
        SetRotation = nil,
        GetCameraCFrame = nil,
        OrigEncode = nil,
        Utility = nil,
        UpdateCamRemote = nil,
        Controller = nil,
        FighterController = nil,
        ReplicationLoop = nil,
        ReplicationUtilIndex = nil,
        ReplicationOrigUtil = nil,
    }
    getgenv().SolCamHook = CamHook

    local function encodeRot(vec2)
        if not vec2 or vec2 ~= vec2 then
            return utf8.char(0) .. utf8.char(0)
        end
        local x = typeof(vec2) == "Vector2" and vec2.X or (tonumber(vec2) or 0)
        local y = typeof(vec2) == "Vector2" and vec2.Y or 0
        local n = math.clamp(math.floor((x % TAU) / TAU * 256 + 0.5), 0, 255)
        local n2 = math.clamp(math.floor((y % TAU) / TAU * 256 + 0.5), 0, 255)
        return utf8.char(n) .. utf8.char(n2)
    end

    -- Sonata-style CameraController resolve (PlayerScripts.Controllers.CameraController)
    local function resolveCameraController()
        if CamHook.Controller then return CamHook.Controller end
        local lp = LocalPlayer
        if not lp then return nil end
        local scripts = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
        local controllers = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
        local mod = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("CameraController")
        if mod then
            local ok, ctrl = pcall(require, mod)
            if ok and type(ctrl) == "table" then
                CamHook.Controller = ctrl
                return ctrl
            end
        end
        local ok2, ctrl2 = pcall(function()
            return require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.CameraController)
        end)
        if ok2 and type(ctrl2) == "table" then
            CamHook.Controller = ctrl2
            return ctrl2
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function resolveFighterController()
        local ok, fc = pcall(function()
            return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
        end)
        return ok and fc or nil
    end

    -- Sonata CharacterController (SetServerCFrame / SendViewAngles)
    local function resolveCharacterController()
        if CamHook.CharController and type(CamHook.CharController.SetServerCFrame) == "function" then
            return CamHook.CharController
        end
        local function consider(obj)
            if type(obj) == "table" and type(obj.SetServerCFrame) == "function" then
                CamHook.CharController = obj
                return obj
            end
        end
        local fc = resolveFighterController()
        local fighter = fc and (fc.LocalFighter or (fc.GetFighter and fc:GetFighter(LocalPlayer)))
        if fighter then
            consider(fighter.CharacterController)
            pcall(function()
                if type(fighter.Get) == "function" then consider(fighter:Get("CharacterController")) end
            end)
        end
        if fc then
            consider(fc.CharacterController)
            consider(fc.LocalCharacterController)
        end
        local scripts = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
        local controllers = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
        local mod = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("CharacterController")
        if mod then
            local ok, obj = pcall(require, mod)
            if ok then consider(obj) end
        end
        return CamHook.CharController
    end

    -- Kicia-style: patch Utility upvalue inside FighterController._CameraReplicationLoop
    local function hookReplicationLoop()
        local fc = resolveFighterController()
        if not fc then return false end
        CamHook.FighterController = fc
        local mt = getmetatable(fc)
        local proto = mt and (rawget(mt, "__index") or mt.__index)
        local loopFn = nil
        if type(proto) == "table" then
            loopFn = proto._CameraReplicationLoop or rawget(proto, "_CameraReplicationLoop")
        end
        if type(loopFn) ~= "function" then
            loopFn = rawget(fc, "_CameraReplicationLoop")
        end
        if type(loopFn) ~= "function" then return false end
        CamHook.ReplicationLoop = loopFn

        if not debug or not debug.getupvalue or not debug.setupvalue then return false end
        local utilIdx, utilVal = nil, nil
        for i = 1, 20 do
            local name, val = debug.getupvalue(loopFn, i)
            if type(val) == "table" and type(val.EncodeCameraRotation) == "function" then
                utilIdx, utilVal = i, val
                break
            end
            if name == nil and val == nil then break end
        end
        if not utilIdx then return false end
        CamHook.ReplicationUtilIndex = utilIdx
        CamHook.ReplicationOrigUtil = utilVal

        local proxy = {}
        setmetatable(proxy, {
            __index = function(_, k)
                if k == "EncodeCameraRotation" then
                    return function(self, rot)
                        if CamHook.Active and CamHook.ForcedAngles then
                            local f = CamHook.ForcedAngles
                            return encodeRot(Vector2.new(f.pitch or 0, f.yaw or 0))
                        end
                        return utilVal.EncodeCameraRotation(self, rot)
                    end
                end
                return utilVal[k]
            end,
            __newindex = function(_, k, v) utilVal[k] = v end,
        })
        pcall(debug.setupvalue, loopFn, utilIdx, proxy)
        return true
    end

    local function unhookReplicationLoop()
        if CamHook.ReplicationLoop and CamHook.ReplicationUtilIndex and CamHook.ReplicationOrigUtil then
            pcall(debug.setupvalue, CamHook.ReplicationLoop, CamHook.ReplicationUtilIndex, CamHook.ReplicationOrigUtil)
        end
        CamHook.ReplicationLoop = nil
        CamHook.ReplicationUtilIndex = nil
        CamHook.ReplicationOrigUtil = nil
    end

    local function installCameraControllerHook()
        if CamHook.Installed then
            CamHook.Active = true
            CamHook.Suppress = false
            pcall(hookReplicationLoop)
            return true
        end

        local ctrl = resolveCameraController()
        if not ctrl then
            warn("[camhook] CameraController not found")
            return false
        end
        CamHook.Controller = ctrl

        local mt = getmetatable(ctrl)
        local idx = mt and (rawget(mt, "__index") or mt.__index)
        if type(idx) == "table" then
            CamHook.SetRotation = idx.SetRotation
            CamHook.GetCameraCFrame = idx.GetCameraCFrame
        else
            CamHook.SetRotation = ctrl.SetRotation
            CamHook.GetCameraCFrame = ctrl.GetCameraCFrame
        end

        CamHook.GetRotation = function()
            local r = rawget(ctrl, "Rotation")
            return typeof(r) == "Vector2" and r or Vector2.zero
        end
        CamHook.SetRotationSafe = function(v2)
            if not CamHook.SetRotation then return end
            pcall(function() coroutine.wrap(CamHook.SetRotation)(ctrl, v2) end)
        end
        CamHook.GetCameraCFrameSafe = function()
            if not CamHook.GetCameraCFrame then
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                return cam and cam.CFrame
            end
            local ok2, cf = pcall(function() return coroutine.wrap(CamHook.GetCameraCFrame)(ctrl) end)
            return ok2 and cf or nil
        end

        -- global Utility encode wrap
        pcall(function()
            local util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
            CamHook.Utility = util
            if not CamHook.OrigEncode then
                CamHook.OrigEncode = util.EncodeCameraRotation
            end
            util.EncodeCameraRotation = function(self, rot)
                if CamHook.Active and CamHook.ForcedAngles then
                    local f = CamHook.ForcedAngles
                    return encodeRot(Vector2.new(f.pitch or 0, f.yaw or 0))
                end
                return CamHook.OrigEncode(self, rot)
            end
        end)

        pcall(function()
            CamHook.UpdateCamRemote = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UpdateCameraRotation
        end)

        pcall(hookReplicationLoop)

        CamHook.Installed = true
        CamHook.Active = true
        CamHook.Suppress = false
        return true
    end

    local function uninstallCameraControllerHook()
        CamHook.Active = false
        CamHook.Suppress = true
        CamHook.ForcedAngles = nil
        pcall(unhookReplicationLoop)
    end

    function CamHook.SendRaw(payload)
        if not CamHook.UpdateCamRemote then
            pcall(function()
                CamHook.UpdateCamRemote = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UpdateCameraRotation
            end)
        end
        if not CamHook.UpdateCamRemote then return end
        pcall(function()
            CamHook.UpdateCamRemote:FireServer(payload, nil)
        end)
    end

    function CamHook.SendViewAngles(pitchDeg, yawDeg)
        CamHook.ForcedAngles = {
            pitch = math.rad(tonumber(pitchDeg) or 0),
            yaw = math.rad(tonumber(yawDeg) or 0),
        }
        CamHook.SendRaw(encodeRot(Vector2.new(CamHook.ForcedAngles.pitch, CamHook.ForcedAngles.yaw)))
        -- Sonata path: CharacterController:SendViewAngles(rate, angles)
        pcall(function()
            local cc = resolveCharacterController()
            if cc and type(cc.SendViewAngles) == "function" then
                cc:SendViewAngles(20, Vector2.new(CamHook.ForcedAngles.pitch, CamHook.ForcedAngles.yaw))
            end
        end)
        -- also push through CameraController SetRotation when available
        pcall(function()
            if CamHook.SetRotationSafe then
                CamHook.SetRotationSafe(Vector2.new(CamHook.ForcedAngles.pitch, CamHook.ForcedAngles.yaw))
            end
        end)
    end

    function CamHook.SetServerCFrame(cf)
        local cc = resolveCharacterController()
        if not cc or type(cc.SetServerCFrame) ~= "function" then return false end
        local ok = pcall(function()
            cc:SetServerCFrame(cf)
            if type(cc.SendViewAngles) == "function" and CamHook.ForcedAngles then
                cc:SendViewAngles(20, Vector2.new(CamHook.ForcedAngles.pitch or 0, CamHook.ForcedAngles.yaw or 0))
            end
        end)
        return ok
    end

    function CamHook.ClearViewAngles()
        CamHook.ForcedAngles = nil
        CamHook.Suppress = false
    end

    CamHook.Install = installCameraControllerHook
    CamHook.Uninstall = uninstallCameraControllerHook
    CamHook.Active = false
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.35)
        pcall(resolveCameraController)
        pcall(resolveFighterController)
    end)

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- Root desync (Kicia cs)
    local Desync = {
        Enabled = false,
        Magnet = true, -- csync always magnets to enemy when desync is on
        MagnetOffset = Vector3.new(0, -3.5, 0),
        Mode = "magnet", -- always magnet-to-enemy
        CustomOffset = Vector3.new(0, -5, 0),
        ServerCF = nil,
        ClientCF = nil, -- _oldCFrame in Kicia
        BoundId = "Solaria_RootDesync",
        PhysicsBoost = true,
        PhysicsOn = false,
        OrigFallen = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight,
    }
    getgenv().SolDesync = Desync

    local function setfflag(name, value)
        local fn = rawget(getfenv(), "setfflag") or (syn and syn.setfflag)
        if type(fn) ~= "function" then
            pcall(function() fn = getgenv().setfflag end)
        end
        if type(fn) == "function" then pcall(fn, name, tostring(value)) end
    end

    local function applyPhysicsBoost(on)
        if not Desync.PhysicsBoost then return end
        if on == Desync.PhysicsOn then return end
        Desync.PhysicsOn = on
        if on then
            setfflag("DFIntS2PhysicsSenderRate", "120")
            setfflag("DFIntAssemblyHistoryBufferSize", "2147483648")
            setfflag("DFIntAssemblyHistorySkipSize", "0")
            pcall(function() workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = (0/0) end)
        else
            setfflag("DFIntS2PhysicsSenderRate", "15")
            setfflag("DFIntAssemblyHistoryBufferSize", "15")
            setfflag("DFIntAssemblyHistorySkipSize", "8")
            pcall(function() workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = Desync.OrigFallen end)
        end
    end

    local function getHRP()
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    local function computeServerCF(clientCF)
        -- CSync = magnet stuck to enemy (Kicia-style target lock desync)
        local t = getgenv().SolRageTarget and getgenv().SolRageTarget()
        local char = t and t.Character
        local root = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Head"))
        if root then
            local off = Desync.MagnetOffset or Vector3.new(0, -3.5, 0)
            -- stick hard to enemy; small offset so hits still register
            return root.CFrame * CFrame.new(off)
        end
        -- no target: hold last server CF or mild under-foot
        if Desync.ServerCF then return Desync.ServerCF end
        return clientCF * CFrame.new(0, -2.5, 0)
    end

    local function desyncActive()
        if not Desync.Enabled then return false end
        if refreshLobby() then return false end
        return true
    end

    -- HeartbeatUpdate (Kicia): stash client, write server CF
    local function heartbeatDesync()
        local hrp = getHRP()
        if not hrp then return end

        local on = desyncActive()
        applyPhysicsBoost(on and Desync.PhysicsBoost)

        if not on then
            Desync.ServerCF = nil
            Desync.ClientCF = nil
            return
        end

        if Desync.ClientCF == nil then
            Desync.ClientCF = hrp.CFrame
        end

        Desync.ServerCF = computeServerCF(Desync.ClientCF)
        pcall(function()
            hrp.CFrame = Desync.ServerCF
        end)
    end

    -- RenderStep First: restore client CF
    local function renderDesync()
        local hrp = getHRP()
        if not hrp then return end
        if not desyncActive() then return end
        if Desync.ClientCF ~= nil then
            pcall(function() hrp.CFrame = Desync.ClientCF end)
            Desync.ClientCF = nil
        end
    end

    pcall(function()
        RunService:BindToRenderStep(Desync.BoundId, Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value, function()
            pcall(renderDesync)
        end)
    end)
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        pcall(heartbeatDesync)
    end)

    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        Desync.ServerCF = nil
        Desync.ClientCF = nil
        Lobby.LastCheck = 0
        task.defer(function()
            task.wait(1)
            pcall(installCameraControllerHook)
        end)
    end)

    -- API
    getgenv().SolSetDesync = function(on)
        Desync.Enabled = on and true or false
        Desync.Magnet = true -- csync is always a magnet stuck to the enemy
        if not Desync.Enabled then
            applyPhysicsBoost(false)
            Desync.ServerCF = nil
            Desync.ClientCF = nil
            CamHook.ClearViewAngles()
        else
            pcall(installCameraControllerHook)
        end
    end
    getgenv().SolSetDesyncMagnet = function(on)
        -- kept for API compat; magnet is always on with desync
        Desync.Magnet = true
        if on then Desync.Enabled = true end
    end
    -- back-compat
    getgenv().SolCSync = Desync
    getgenv().SolSetCSync = getgenv().SolSetDesync
end

-- ================= RAGEBOT STATUS =================
do
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "SolRageStatus"; gui.ResetOnSpawn = false; gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true; gui.DisplayOrder = 9996
    gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; lbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    lbl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 40)
    local uiLib = getgenv().Library
    lbl.FontFace = (uiLib and uiLib.Font) or Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.Gotham)
    lbl.Visible = false; lbl.Parent = gui
    RB_STATUS.Size = RB_STATUS.Size or 12
    local function ensureFontFile(path, url)
        pcall(function()
            if not isfolder("solaria") then makefolder("solaria") end
            if not isfolder("solaria/fonts") then makefolder("solaria/fonts") end
            if not (isfile and isfile(path)) then
                local data = game:HttpGet(url)
                if data and #data > 100 then writefile(path, data) end
            end
        end)
        return isfile and isfile(path)
    end
    local function loadCustomFace(path, url, name)
        if not ensureFontFile(path, url) then return nil end
        local face = nil
        pcall(function()
            local asset = getcustomasset(path)
            local jsonPath = "solaria/fonts/" .. name .. ".font"
            if not (isfile and isfile(jsonPath)) then
                local payload = {
                    name = name,
                    faces = { { name = "Regular", weight = 400, style = "normal", assetId = asset } }
                }
                writefile(jsonPath, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(payload))
            end
            face = Font.new(getcustomasset(jsonPath))
        end)
        if face then return face end
        pcall(function() face = Font.new(getcustomasset(path), Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal) end)
        return face
    end
    local function applyStatusFont()
        local f = tostring(RB_STATUS.Font or "system"):lower()
        local face = nil
        if f == "minecraft" then
            face = loadCustomFace("solaria/fonts/Minecraft.ttf", "https://github.com/IdreesInc/Minecraft-Font/raw/master/Minecraft.ttf", "Minecraft")
        elseif f == "permanent marker" then
            face = loadCustomFace("solaria/fonts/PermanentMarker.ttf", "https://github.com/google/fonts/raw/main/ofl/permanentmarker/PermanentMarker-Regular.ttf", "PermanentMarker")
        elseif f == "fortnite" then
            face = loadCustomFace("solaria/fonts/BurbankBigCondensed.ttf", "https://github.com/sametexe001/luas/raw/refs/heads/main/fonts/windows-xp-tahoma.ttf", "Fortnite")
        end
        if face then
            lbl.FontFace = face
        else
            lbl.FontFace = (getgenv().Library and getgenv().Library.Font) or Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.Gotham)
        end
    end
    getgenv().SolariaApplyStatusFont = applyStatusFont
    pcall(applyStatusFont)

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local ok = pcall(function()
            if not (RB_CFG and RB_CFG.Enabled) or not RB_STATUS.Enabled then lbl.Visible = false; return end
            lbl.Visible = true
            lbl.TextSize = RB_STATUS.Size or 12
            lbl.TextColor3 = RB_STATUS.Color or Color3.new(1,1,1)
            lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = RB_STATUS.Outline or Color3.new(0,0,0)
            lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = RB_STATUS.StrokeT or 0.5
            local px = tonumber(RB_STATUS.PosX) or 0
            local py = tonumber(RB_STATUS.PosY) or 20
            local mode = tostring(RB_STATUS.PositionOn or "on target"):lower()
            local posSet = false
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam and mode == "on muzzle" and FovAnchor and FovAnchor.Hooks and FovAnchor.Hooks.Muzzle then
                local okm, w = pcall(FovAnchor.Hooks.Muzzle)
                if okm and typeof(w) == "Vector3" then
                    local sp = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(w)
                    if sp.Z > 0 then
                        lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sp.X + px, sp.Y + py)
                        posSet = true
                    end
                end
            end
            if not posSet and cam and mode == "on target" then
                local t = RB_TARGET and RB_TARGET()
                local head = t and (t.Head or (t.Character and t.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")))
                if head then
                    local sp = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                    if sp.Z > 0 then
                        lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sp.X + px, sp.Y + py)
                        posSet = true
                    end
                end
            end
            if not posSet then
                lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, px, 0.5, py)
            end
            local vp = RB_VOID_PHASE and RB_VOID_PHASE()
            local t = RB_TARGET and RB_TARGET()
            local name = nil
            if t then
                name = type(t) == "table" and (t.Name or (t.player and t.player.Name) or (t.Player and t.Player.Name)) or tostring(t)
            end
            if vp == "hide" then
                if name then lbl.Text = "void spamming " .. tostring(name) .. "..."
                else lbl.Text = "void..." end
            elseif t and name then
                local atk = tostring(RB_CFG and RB_CFG.AttackWith or ""):lower()
                if atk == "melee" or atk == "knife" then
                    lbl.Text = "backstabbing " .. tostring(name) .. "..."
                else
                    lbl.Text = "killing " .. tostring(name) .. "..."
                end
            else
                lbl.Text = "ragebot: waiting..."
            end
        end)
        if not ok then lbl.Visible = false end
    end)
end





-- ================= SILENT AIM =================
local SilentState = { Enabled=false, MaxDist=200, TeamCheck=true, TargetPart="Head", HitChance=100 }
local SilentOriginal, SilentConn, SilentTarget = nil, nil, nil

local function sFind()
    local mc = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not mc then return nil end
    local mr = mc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not mr then return nil end
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local center = SilentFov:Point()
    local cl, cd = nil, math.huge
    local mt = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID")
    for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then
            local sk = SilentState.TeamCheck and p:GetAttribute("TeamID") == mt
            if not sk then
                local c = p.Character
                local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local h = c and c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
                if r and h and h.Health > 0 then
                    local d = (mr.Position - r.Position).Magnitude
                    if d <= SilentState.MaxDist then
                        local score = d
                        if SilentFovCfg.Limit and cam then
                            local part = c:FindFirstChild(SilentState.TargetPart) or r
                            local sp, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                            if not on then
                                score = nil
                            else
                                local sd = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                                score = SilentFov:Contains(Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)) and sd or nil
                            end
                        end
                        if score and score < cd then cd = score; cl = p end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return cl
end

local function sInstall()
    local ok, gun = pcall(function() return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Modules.ItemTypes.Gun) end)
    if not ok or type(gun) ~= "table" or type(gun.StartShooting) ~= "function" then return end
    local util
    pcall(function() util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility) end)
    if not util or SilentOriginal then return end
    SilentOriginal = gun.StartShooting
    local old = SilentOriginal
    gun.StartShooting = function(self, ...)
        local res = {old(self, ...)}
        if not self.ClientFighter or not self.ClientFighter.IsLocalPlayer then return unpack(res) end
        local cd = res[3]
        if not cd or typeof(cd) ~= "table" then return unpack(res) end
        res[4] = true
        local t = SilentTarget
        if not SilentState.Enabled or not t or not t.Character then return unpack(res) end
        if math.random(1, 100) > SilentState.HitChance then return unpack(res) end
        local h = t.Character:FindFirstChild(SilentState.TargetPart) or t.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not h then return unpack(res) end
        local hp, hcf = h.Position, h.CFrame
        local jit = Vector3.new(math.random() * 0.1, math.random() * 0.1, math.random() * 0.1)
        cd[utf8.char(0)] = util:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(hp, hp + hcf.LookVector))
        cd[utf8.char(1)] = util:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(hp))
        cd[utf8.char(2)] = h
        cd[utf8.char(3)] = util:EncodeCFrame(hcf:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(hp + jit)))
        return unpack(res)
    end
    SilentConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() SilentTarget = sFind() end)
end

local function sUninstall()
    if SilentConn then SilentConn:Disconnect(); SilentConn = nil end
    SilentTarget = nil
    if SilentOriginal then
        pcall(function()
            local g = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Modules.ItemTypes.Gun)
            g.StartShooting = SilentOriginal
        end)
        SilentOriginal = nil
    end
end

-- ================= TRIGGERBOT =================
-- ray: camera forward, 2500 studs, ignores localPlayer.Character
-- gate: fire-time gate (0 = idle, otherwise tick() deadline)
getgenv().Solaria = getgenv().Solaria or {}
getgenv().Solaria.Combat = getgenv().Solaria.Combat or {}
local TB_CFG = {
    Enabled        = false,
    TeamCheck      = false,
    DisableOnScope = false,
    ReactionTime   = 0,
    ShootDelay     = 0.02,
    Whitelist      = {},
    Checks = {
        Shield       = false, -- skip targets holding a riot shield
        Katana       = false, -- skip targets currently deflecting with a katana
        Wall         = false, -- the ray already hits the part from the camera, so this always passes
        SniperScoped = false, -- only fire while the sniper is fully aimed
    },
}
getgenv().Solaria.Combat.Triggerbot = TB_CFG

local TB_MECH = nil
local function tbFighter()
    if not TB_MECH then
        local ok, m = pcall(require, LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.MechanicsController)
        if ok then TB_MECH = m end
    end
    return TB_MECH and TB_MECH.LocalFighter
end

local function tbTargetItem(player)
    local ok, ctrl = pcall(require, LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
    if not ok or not ctrl then return nil end
    local ok2, f = pcall(ctrl.GetFighter, ctrl, player)
    return ok2 and f and f.EquippedItem or nil
end

local function tbAiming(item)
    if not item then return false end
    local ok, r = pcall(function() return item:IsAiming() end)
    return ok and r == true
end

local function tbFullyAiming(item)
    if not item then return false end
    local ok, r = pcall(function() return item:IsFullyAiming() end)
    return ok and r == true
end

-- shooter: fires the equipped item through the game's own StartShooting input
local function tbShoot(fighter)
    local item = fighter and fighter.EquippedItem
    if not item then return end
    local old = getthreadidentity and getthreadidentity()
    if setthreadidentity then pcall(setthreadidentity, 8) end
    pcall(function() item:Input("StartShooting") end)
    if old and setthreadidentity then pcall(setthreadidentity, old) end
end

-- checker: returns false when an enabled check blocks this target
local function tbPasses(player, checks, part)
    local item = tbTargetItem(player)
    if checks.Shield and item and item.Name == "Riot Shield" then
        return false
    end
    if checks.Katana and item and item.Name == "Katana" then
        local ok, deflecting = pcall(function()
            return item._deflect_cooldown > tick() and item._attack_cooldown > tick() and item._deflect_hash % 2 == 1
        end)
        if ok and deflecting then return false end
    end
    return true
end

local gate = 0
local tbInstalled = false

local function tbInstall()
    if tbInstalled then return end
    tbInstalled = true

    RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
        local tb = TB_CFG
        local localFighter = tbFighter()

        if not tb.Enabled or not localFighter or not localFighter:IsActive() then
            gate = 0
            return
        end

        local equipped = localFighter.EquippedItem
        if tb.Checks.SniperScoped and (not equipped or (equipped.Name == "Sniper" and not tbFullyAiming(equipped))) then
            gate = 0
            return
        end

        if tb.DisableOnScope and tbAiming(equipped) then
            gate = 0
            return
        end

        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then gate = 0; return end
        local ray = Ray.new(cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.LookVector * 2500)
        local hit = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, { LocalPlayer.Character })
        local parent = hit and hit.Parent

        if not hit or not parent then
            gate = 0
            return
        end

        local humanoid = parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
        local target = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(parent)
        if not target or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            gate = 0
            return
        end

        if #tb.Whitelist > 0 and not table.find(tb.Whitelist, hit.Name) then
            gate = 0
            return
        end

        if tb.TeamCheck and target:GetAttribute("TeamID") == LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID") then
            gate = 0
            return
        end

        if not tbPasses(target, tb.Checks, hit) then
            gate = 0
            return
        end

        if gate == 0 then
            gate = tick() + tb.ReactionTime
        end

        if tick() < gate then
            return
        end

        tbShoot(localFighter)
        gate = tick() + tb.ShootDelay
    end)
end
