            Filled = { Enabled = true, Transparency = 0.72 },
            OutlineRGB = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            OutlineThickness = 1,
            Gradient = false,
            GradientFill = false,
            Animate = false,
            RotationSpeed = 300,
            GradientRGB1 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            GradientRGB2 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200),
            GradientFillRGB1 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200),
            GradientFillRGB2 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120),
        },
    },
}

local startESP, stopESP, removeESP
do
    local ESPConnections = {}
    local _espDrawLib = rawget(getfenv() or {}, "Drawing") or (getgenv and getgenv().Drawing) or Drawing
    local _espEntries = {}
    local _espChams = {}
    local _espConn = nil
    local _espAdded, _espRemoving = nil, nil
    local _espGui = nil

    local ESP_BONES = {
        { "Head", "UpperTorso" }, { "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso" },
        { "UpperTorso", "LeftUpperArm" }, { "LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm" }, { "LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand" },
        { "UpperTorso", "RightUpperArm" }, { "RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm" }, { "RightLowerArm", "RightHand" },
        { "LowerTorso", "LeftUpperLeg" }, { "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg" }, { "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot" },
        { "LowerTorso", "RightUpperLeg" }, { "RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg" }, { "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot" },
    }

    local function espParentGui()
        if _espGui and _espGui.Parent then return _espGui end
        local parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
        local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        g.Name = "SolariaESP"
        g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        g.ResetOnSpawn = false
        g.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
        g.DisplayOrder = 50
        g.Parent = parent
        _espGui = g
        return g
    end

    local function espNew(class)
        if not _espDrawLib or type(_espDrawLib.new) ~= "function" then return nil end
        local ok, d = pcall(_espDrawLib.new, class)
        if not ok or not d then return nil end
        d.Visible = false
        pcall(function() d.ZIndex = 40 end)
        return d
    end

    local function makeHealthUi(parent)
        local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
        bg.Name = "HpBg"
        bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
        bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        bg.Visible = false
        bg.Parent = parent
        local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
        fill.Name = "HpFill"
        fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        fill.Visible = false
        fill.Parent = bg
        local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        grad.Rotation = 90
        grad.Parent = fill
        return { bg = bg, fill = fill, grad = grad }
    end

    local function espHealthColor(frac)
        frac = math.clamp(frac, 0, 1)
        if frac > 0.6 then
            return ESP.HealthHigh:Lerp(ESP.HealthMid, (1 - frac) / 0.4)
        end
        return ESP.HealthMid:Lerp(ESP.HealthLow, (0.6 - frac) / 0.6)
    end

    local function orbitHealthColor(p)
        local high, mid, low = ESP.HealthHigh, ESP.HealthMid, ESP.HealthLow
        local x = p % 1
        if x < 0.25 then return high:Lerp(mid, x / 0.25)
        elseif x < 0.5 then return mid:Lerp(low, (x - 0.25) / 0.25)
        elseif x < 0.75 then return low:Lerp(mid, (x - 0.5) / 0.25)
        end
        return mid:Lerp(high, (x - 0.75) / 0.25)
    end

    local function espWeaponName(plr)
        if weaponOf then
            local w = weaponOf(plr)
            if type(w) == "string" and w ~= "" then return w end
        end
        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then return "" end
        for _, t in ipairs({ "EquippedItem", "Weapon", "Gun" }) do
            local inst = char:FindFirstChild(t)
            if inst then return tostring(inst.Name) end
        end
        return ""
    end

    local function espSameTeam(plr)
        local a, b = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID"), plr:GetAttribute("TeamID")
        return a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a == b
    end

    local function espWorldBox(char)
        local parts = {}
        for _, n in ipairs({ "Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso",
            "LeftUpperArm", "RightUpperArm", "LeftUpperLeg", "RightUpperLeg",
            "LeftFoot", "RightFoot", "LeftHand", "RightHand" }) do
            local p = char:FindFirstChild(n)
            if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts, p) end
        end
        if #parts == 0 then return nil end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return nil end
        local minX, minY, maxX, maxY = math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
        local any = false
        for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
            local cf, sz = p.CFrame, p.Size
            for _, ox in ipairs({ -0.5, 0.5 }) do
                for _, oy in ipairs({ -0.5, 0.5 }) do
                    for _, oz in ipairs({ -0.5, 0.5 }) do
                        local wpos = (cf * CFrame.new(ox * sz.X, oy * sz.Y, oz * sz.Z)).Position
                        local sp, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(wpos)
                        if on and sp.Z > 0 then
                            any = true
                            minX = math.min(minX, sp.X); minY = math.min(minY, sp.Y)
                            maxX = math.max(maxX, sp.X); maxY = math.max(maxY, sp.Y)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if not any then return nil end
        return minX, minY, maxX - minX, maxY - minY
    end

    local function espMakeEntry(plr)
        local e = {
            boxO = espNew("Square"), box = espNew("Square"), fill = espNew("Square"),
            name = espNew("Text"), dist = espNew("Text"), wep = espNew("Text"),
            tracer = espNew("Line"), skel = {},
            healthUi = makeHealthUi(espParentGui()),
        }
        for _ = 1, #ESP_BONES do table.insert(e.skel, espNew("Line")) end
        if e.boxO then e.boxO.Filled = false; e.boxO.Thickness = 3 end
        if e.box then e.box.Filled = false; e.box.Thickness = 1 end
        if e.fill then e.fill.Filled = true; e.fill.Thickness = 0 end
        for _, t in ipairs({ e.name, e.dist, e.wep }) do
            if t then
                t.Center = true; t.Outline = true; t.Size = ESP.FontSize
                pcall(function() t.Font = Drawing.Fonts and Drawing.Fonts.Plex or 2 end)
            end
        end
        return e
    end

    local function espHideAll(entry)
        if not entry then return end
        for k, d in pairs(entry) do
            if k == "skel" then
                for _, ln in ipairs(d) do pcall(function() ln.Visible = false end) end
            elseif k == "healthUi" then
                if d and d.bg then d.bg.Visible = false end
            else
                pcall(function() d.Visible = false end)
            end
        end
    end

    local function espDestroyEntry(entry)
        if not entry then return end
        for k, d in pairs(entry) do
            if k == "skel" then
                for _, ln in ipairs(d) do pcall(function() ln:Remove() end) end
            elseif k == "healthUi" then
                if d and d.bg then pcall(function() d.bg:Destroy() end) end
            else
                pcall(function() d:Remove() end)
            end
        end
    end

    local function espSetChams(plr, char, show)
        local hl = _espChams[plr]
        if not show or not ESP.Chams then
            if hl then pcall(function() hl:Destroy() end); _espChams[plr] = nil end
            return
        end
        if not hl or not hl.Parent then
            hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.Name = "SolariaEspChams"
            hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            hl.FillTransparency = ESP.ChamsTransparency
            hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.2
            _espChams[plr] = hl
        end
        hl.Adornee = char
        hl.FillColor = ESP.ChamsVisible
        hl.OutlineColor = ESP.ChamsOccluded
        hl.Parent = char
    end

    local function espRemove(plr)
        if _espEntries[plr] then
            espDestroyEntry(_espEntries[plr])
            _espEntries[plr] = nil
        end
        if _espChams[plr] then
            pcall(function() _espChams[plr]:Destroy() end)
            _espChams[plr] = nil
        end
    end

    local function espTick()
        if not ESP.Enabled then
            for _, e in pairs(_espEntries) do espHideAll(e) end
            return
        end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local myPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position or cam.CFrame.Position

        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr == LocalPlayer then continue end
            local entry = _espEntries[plr]
            if not entry then
                entry = espMakeEntry(plr)
                _espEntries[plr] = entry
            end
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local alive = hum and hum.Health > 0 and hrp
            local skipTeam = ESP.TeamCheck and espSameTeam(plr)
            local dist = alive and (hrp.Position - myPos).Magnitude or math.huge
            if not alive or skipTeam or dist > ESP.MaxDistance then
                espHideAll(entry)
                espSetChams(plr, char, false)
                continue
            end

            local x, y, w, h = espWorldBox(char)
            if not x or w < 2 or h < 2 then
                espHideAll(entry)
                continue
            end

            local showBox = ESP.Box ~= false
            if entry.box and showBox then
                entry.box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                entry.box.Size = Vector2.new(w, h)
                entry.box.Color = ESP.BoxColor
                entry.box.Thickness = 1
                entry.box.Visible = true
                if entry.boxO and ESP.BoxOutline then
                    entry.boxO.Position = Vector2.new(x - 1, y - 1)
                    entry.boxO.Size = Vector2.new(w + 2, h + 2)
                    entry.boxO.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    entry.boxO.Visible = true
                elseif entry.boxO then entry.boxO.Visible = false end
            else
                if entry.box then entry.box.Visible = false end
                if entry.boxO then entry.boxO.Visible = false end
            end

            if entry.fill and ESP.BoxFill then
                entry.fill.Position = Vector2.new(x + 1, y + 1)
                entry.fill.Size = Vector2.new(math.max(0, w - 2), math.max(0, h - 2))
                entry.fill.Color = ESP.BoxFillColor
                -- Drawing: higher Transparency = more transparent
                pcall(function() entry.fill.Transparency = math.clamp(ESP.BoxFillTransparency or 0.72, 0, 1) end)
                entry.fill.Visible = true
            elseif entry.fill then entry.fill.Visible = false end

            -- health bar (ScreenGui — always works, Sonata-style gradient)
            local showHp = ESP.Health ~= false
            local ui = entry.healthUi
            if showHp and ui then
                local frac = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
                local thick = math.max(2, ESP.HealthThickness or 3)
                local barX = x - thick - 5
                local barY = y
                local fillH = math.max(0, math.floor(h * frac + 0.5))
                local barColor = espHealthColor(frac)
                ui.bg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(barX - 1, barY - 1)
                ui.bg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(thick + 2, h + 2)
                ui.bg.BackgroundTransparency = 0
                ui.bg.Visible = true
                ui.fill.Visible = fillH >= 1
                ui.fill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1 + (h - fillH))
                ui.fill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(thick, fillH)
                if ESP.HealthGradient then
                    local t = ESP.HealthAnim and (os.clock() * math.clamp(ESP.HealthAnimSpeed or 1.2, 0.1, 8)) or 0
                    local c0 = orbitHealthColor(t)
                    ui.grad.Enabled = true
                    ui.grad.Rotation = 90
                    ui.grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, c0),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1/6, orbitHealthColor(t + 1/6)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(2/6, orbitHealthColor(t + 2/6)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, orbitHealthColor(t + 0.5)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(4/6, orbitHealthColor(t + 4/6)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(5/6, orbitHealthColor(t + 5/6)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c0),
                    })
                    ui.fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                else
                    ui.grad.Enabled = false
                    ui.fill.BackgroundColor3 = barColor
                end
            elseif ui then
                ui.bg.Visible = false
            end

            if entry.name and ESP.Names then
                entry.name.Text = (plr.DisplayName ~= "" and plr.DisplayName) or plr.Name
                entry.name.Size = ESP.FontSize
                entry.name.Color = ESP.NamesColor
                entry.name.Position = Vector2.new(x + w / 2, y - ESP.FontSize - 2)
                entry.name.Visible = true
            elseif entry.name then entry.name.Visible = false end

            if entry.dist and ESP.Distance then
                entry.dist.Text = string.format("%dm", math.floor(dist + 0.5))
                entry.dist.Size = math.max(11, ESP.FontSize - 1)
                entry.dist.Color = ESP.DistanceColor
                entry.dist.Position = Vector2.new(x + w / 2, y + h + 2)
                entry.dist.Visible = true
            elseif entry.dist then entry.dist.Visible = false end

            if entry.wep and ESP.Weapon then
                local wn = espWeaponName(plr)
                if wn ~= "" then
                    entry.wep.Text = wn
                    entry.wep.Size = math.max(11, ESP.FontSize - 1)
                    entry.wep.Color = ESP.WeaponColor
                    entry.wep.Position = Vector2.new(x + w / 2, y + h + (ESP.Distance and ESP.FontSize + 2 or 2))
                    entry.wep.Visible = true
                else entry.wep.Visible = false end
            elseif entry.wep then entry.wep.Visible = false end

            if entry.tracer and ESP.Tracers then
                entry.tracer.From = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y)
                entry.tracer.To = Vector2.new(x + w / 2, y + h)
                entry.tracer.Color = ESP.TracersColor
                entry.tracer.Thickness = ESP.TracersThickness
                entry.tracer.Visible = true
            elseif entry.tracer then entry.tracer.Visible = false end

            local skCfg = (ConfigStore and ConfigStore.Skeleton) or nil
            local showSk = ESP.Skeleton or (skCfg and skCfg.Enabled)
            if showSk and entry.skel then
                local col = (skCfg and skCfg.Color) or ESP.SkeletonColor
                local thick = (skCfg and skCfg.Thickness) or ESP.SkeletonThickness
                for i, pair in ipairs(ESP_BONES) do
                    local ln = entry.skel[i]
                    local a = char:FindFirstChild(pair[1])
                    local b = char:FindFirstChild(pair[2])
                    if ln and a and b and a:IsA("BasePart") and b:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local sa, oa = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(a.Position)
                        local sb, ob = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(b.Position)
                        if oa and ob and sa.Z > 0 and sb.Z > 0 then
                            ln.From = Vector2.new(sa.X, sa.Y)
                            ln.To = Vector2.new(sb.X, sb.Y)
                            ln.Color = col; ln.Thickness = thick; ln.Visible = true
                        else ln.Visible = false end
                    elseif ln then ln.Visible = false end
                end
            elseif entry.skel then
                for _, ln in ipairs(entry.skel) do ln.Visible = false end
            end

            espSetChams(plr, char, ESP.Chams)
        end
    end

    startESP = function()
        ESP.Enabled = true
        espParentGui()
        if not _espConn then
            _espConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                local ok, err = pcall(espTick)
                if not ok then warn("[esp] " .. tostring(err)) end
            end)
        end
        if not _espRemoving then
            _espRemoving = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(espRemove)
        end
    end

    stopESP = function()
        ESP.Enabled = false
        for plr in pairs(_espEntries) do espRemove(plr) end
        if _espConn then _espConn:Disconnect(); _espConn = nil end
        if _espGui then pcall(function() _espGui:Destroy() end); _espGui = nil end
    end

    removeESP = function(plr)
        espRemove(plr)
    end
end

-- ================= TRACER =================
local Removables = { NoGunTracers = false }   -- kicia's "Hide Game Tracers"
local Tracer = { Style="Beam", Enabled=false, Color=PINK, Color2=WHITE, Width=0.35, Length=1, Life=1, Glow=8, Gradient=true, Outline=true, OutlineColor=WHITE }

local function tMuz()
    local ok, ctrl = pcall(function() return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController) end)
    local f = ok and ctrl and (ctrl.LocalFighter or ctrl:GetFighter(LocalPlayer))
    local it = f and f.EquippedItem
    local m
    pcall(function() if it and it.ViewModel and it.ViewModel.GetMuzzlePosition then m = it.ViewModel:GetMuzzlePosition() end end)
    if m then return m end
    return workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
end

FovAnchor.Hooks.Muzzle = tMuz

local function tBeam(a, b)
    if not Tracer.Enabled or typeof(a) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(b) ~= "Vector3" then return end
    if (b - a).Magnitude < 0.5 then return end
    local endPos = a + (b - a) * math.clamp(Tracer.Length, 0.05, 1)
    local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
    local style = Tracer.Style or "Beam"

    if style == "CS2" then
        -- cs2-style: a thin hot core that snaps from the muzzle to the hit, with a soft accent glow behind it
        local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
        local life = math.max(0.15, Tracer.Life * 0.6)
        local head = Instance.new("Part"); head.Name = "ArgonTracerStart"; head.Anchored = true
        head.CanCollide = false; head.CanQuery = false; head.CanTouch = false; head.CastShadow = false
        head.Transparency = 1; head.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1); head.CFrame = CFrame.new(a); head.Parent = workspace
        local tip = head:Clone(); tip.Name = "ArgonTracerEnd"; tip.CFrame = CFrame.new(a); tip.Parent = workspace
        local ha = Instance.new("Attachment"); ha.Parent = head
        local ta = Instance.new("Attachment"); ta.Parent = tip
        local core = Instance.new("Beam")
        core.Attachment0 = ha; core.Attachment1 = ta
        core.Width0 = 0.06; core.Width1 = 0.05
        core.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 250, 220))
        core.Brightness = 4; core.LightEmission = 1; core.FaceCamera = true
        core.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
        core.Parent = head
        local glow = Instance.new("Beam")
        glow.Attachment0 = ha; glow.Attachment1 = ta
        glow.Width0 = 0.22; glow.Width1 = 0.16
        glow.Color = ColorSequence.new(Tracer.Color)
        glow.Brightness = 1.5; glow.LightEmission = 1; glow.FaceCamera = true
        glow.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.55)
        glow.Parent = head
        TweenService:Create(tip, TweenInfo.new(0.06, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { CFrame = CFrame.new(endPos) }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(core, TweenInfo.new(life, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Width0 = 0, Width1 = 0 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(glow, TweenInfo.new(life, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Width0 = 0, Width1 = 0 }):Play()
        Debris:AddItem(head, life + 0.1)
        Debris:AddItem(tip, life + 0.1)
        return
    end

    if style == "Dotted" then
        local n = math.clamp(math.floor((endPos - a).Magnitude / 1.5), 2, 120)
        local sz = math.max(0.1, Tracer.Width * 0.8)
        for i = 0, n do
            local d = Instance.new("Part")
            d.Name = "ArgonTracerDot"; d.Anchored = true; d.CanCollide = false; d.CanQuery = false; d.CanTouch = false; d.CastShadow = false
            d.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; d.Color = Tracer.Color; d.Size = Vector3.new(sz, sz, sz)
            d.Position = a + (endPos - a) * (i / n); d.Parent = workspace
            Debris:AddItem(d, Tracer.Life)
        end
        return
    end

    if style == "Lightning" or style == "Plasma" or style == "Dashed" or style == "Ribbon" then
        local width = Tracer.Width
        local bright = Tracer.Glow
        local dir = endPos - a
        local function tPart(pos)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name = "ArgonTracerNode"; p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.CanQuery = false; p.CanTouch = false; p.CastShadow = false
            p.Transparency = 1; p.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1); p.Position = pos; p.Parent = workspace
            local at = Instance.new("Attachment"); at.Parent = p
            Debris:AddItem(p, Tracer.Life)
            return p, at
        end
        local function tLink(pA, atA, atB, w0, w1, col, tr, glow)
            local bm = Instance.new("Beam")
            bm.Attachment0 = atA; bm.Attachment1 = atB
            bm.Width0 = w0; bm.Width1 = w1
            bm.Color = ColorSequence.new(col)
            bm.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(tr)
            bm.Brightness = glow; bm.LightEmission = 1; bm.FaceCamera = true
            bm.Parent = pA
        end
        if style == "Lightning" then
            local u = dir.Unit
            local side = u:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
            if side.Magnitude < 0.01 then side = Vector3.xAxis end
            side = side.Unit
            local up = u:Cross(side).Unit
            local jit = math.max(0.25, dir.Magnitude * 0.025)
            local steps = math.clamp(math.floor(dir.Magnitude / 4), 6, 40)
            local pPrev, aPrev = tPart(a)
            for i = 1, steps do
                local pos = a + dir * (i / steps)
                if i < steps then
                    pos = pos + side * ((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * jit) + up * ((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * jit)
                end
                local pCur, aCur = tPart(pos)
                tLink(pPrev, aPrev, aCur, width, width, Tracer.Color, 0.05, bright)
                pPrev, aPrev = pCur, aCur
            end
        elseif style == "Plasma" then
            local p0, a0 = tPart(a)
            local _, a1 = tPart(endPos)
            tLink(p0, a0, a1, width * 3, width * 2, Tracer.Color, 0.6, bright * 0.5)
            tLink(p0, a0, a1, width * 0.8, width * 0.4, Tracer.Color2, 0.1, bright * 1.5)
        elseif style == "Dashed" then
            local n = math.clamp(math.floor(dir.Magnitude / 2.5), 2, 80)
            for i = 0, n - 1, 2 do
                local p, a0 = tPart(a + dir * (i / n))
                local _, a1 = tPart(a + dir * math.min((i + 1) / n, 1))
                tLink(p, a0, a1, width, width, Tracer.Color, 0, bright)
            end
        else -- Ribbon
            local p, a0 = tPart(a)
            local _, a1 = tPart(endPos)
            tLink(p, a0, a1, width * 2.5, width * 0.4, Tracer.Color, 0.4, bright * 0.6)
        end
        return
    end

    if style == "Helix" or style == "Comet" or style == "Sparks" or style == "Pulse" then
        local dir = endPos - a
        local len = dir.Magnitude
        local u = dir.Unit
        local side = u:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
        if side.Magnitude < 0.01 then side = Vector3.xAxis end
        side = side.Unit
        local up = u:Cross(side).Unit

        local function tNode(pos)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name = "ArgonTracerNode"; p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.CanQuery = false; p.CanTouch = false; p.CastShadow = false
            p.Transparency = 1; p.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1); p.Position = pos; p.Parent = workspace
            local at = Instance.new("Attachment"); at.Parent = p
            Debris:AddItem(p, Tracer.Life)
            return p, at
        end
        local function tLink(pA, atA, atB, w0, w1, col, tr, glow)
            local bm = Instance.new("Beam")
            bm.Attachment0 = atA; bm.Attachment1 = atB
            bm.Width0 = w0; bm.Width1 = w1
            bm.Color = ColorSequence.new(col)
            bm.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(tr)
            bm.Brightness = glow; bm.LightEmission = 1; bm.FaceCamera = true
            bm.Parent = pA
        end

        if style == "Helix" then
            local steps = math.clamp(math.floor(len / 1.2), 10, 140)
            local r = math.max(0.35, Tracer.Width * 3)
            local pA, aA = tNode(a)
            local pB, aB = tNode(a)
            for i = 1, steps do
                local t = i / steps
                local ang = t * math.pi * 2 * 4
                local base = a + dir * t
                local posA = base + side * (math.cos(ang) * r) + up * (math.sin(ang) * r)
                local posB = base - side * (math.cos(ang) * r) - up * (math.sin(ang) * r)
                local nA, nAt = tNode(posA)
                local nB, nBt = tNode(posB)
                tLink(pA, aA, nAt, Tracer.Width, Tracer.Width, Tracer.Color, 0.1, Tracer.Glow)
                tLink(pB, aB, nBt, Tracer.Width, Tracer.Width, Tracer.Color2, 0.1, Tracer.Glow)
                pA, aA = nA, nAt
                pB, aB = nB, nBt
            end

        elseif style == "Comet" then
            local p0, a0 = tNode(a)
            local _, a1 = tNode(endPos)
            tLink(p0, a0, a1, Tracer.Width * 0.1, Tracer.Width * 2.5, Tracer.Color, 0.2, Tracer.Glow * 0.8)
            tLink(p0, a0, a1, Tracer.Width * 0.05, Tracer.Width * 0.8, Tracer.Color2, 0.5, Tracer.Glow * 1.4)

        elseif style == "Sparks" then
            local n = math.clamp(math.floor(len / 2), 6, 60)
            local jit = math.max(0.2, len * 0.02)
            local pPrev, aPrev = tNode(a)
            for i = 1, n do
                local pos = a + dir * (i / n) + side * ((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * jit) + up * ((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * jit)
                local p, at = tNode(pos)
                if math.random() < 0.6 then
                    tLink(pPrev, aPrev, at, Tracer.Width * 0.3, Tracer.Width * 0.1, Tracer.Color, 0.3, Tracer.Glow)
                end
                local spark = Instance.new("Part")
                spark.Name = "ArgonTracerDot"; spark.Anchored = true; spark.CanCollide = false; spark.CanQuery = false; spark.CanTouch = false; spark.CastShadow = false
                spark.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; spark.Color = (math.random() < 0.5) and Tracer.Color or Tracer.Color2
                local sz = math.max(0.05, Tracer.Width * (0.3 + math.random() * 0.5))
                spark.Size = Vector3.new(sz, sz, sz); spark.Position = pos; spark.Parent = workspace
                Debris:AddItem(spark, Tracer.Life)
                pPrev, aPrev = p, at
            end

        else -- Pulse
            local segs = math.clamp(math.floor(len / 6), 3, 24)
            for i = 0, segs - 1 do
                task.delay(i * (Tracer.Life / segs) * 0.5, function()
                    local s0 = a + dir * (i / segs)
                    local s1 = a + dir * math.min((i + 0.7) / segs, 1)
                    local p, at0 = tNode(s0)
                    local _, at1 = tNode(s1)
                    tLink(p, at0, at1, Tracer.Width * 2, Tracer.Width * 0.5, Tracer.Color, 0, Tracer.Glow * 1.5)
                end)
            end
        end
        return
    end

    if style == "Nebula" or style == "Aurora" or style == "Starfall" or style == "Orbit" or style == "Wormhole" or style == "Solar" then
        local dir = endPos - a
        local len = dir.Magnitude
        local u = dir.Unit
        local side = u:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
        if side.Magnitude < 0.01 then side = Vector3.xAxis end
        side = side.Unit
        local up = u:Cross(side).Unit

        local function tNode(pos)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name = "ArgonTracerNode"; p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.CanQuery = false; p.CanTouch = false; p.CastShadow = false
            p.Transparency = 1; p.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1); p.Position = pos; p.Parent = workspace
            local at = Instance.new("Attachment"); at.Parent = p
            Debris:AddItem(p, Tracer.Life)
            return p, at
        end
        local function tLink(pA, atA, atB, w0, w1, col, tr, glow)
            local bm = Instance.new("Beam")
            bm.Attachment0 = atA; bm.Attachment1 = atB
            bm.Width0 = w0; bm.Width1 = w1
            bm.Color = ColorSequence.new(col)
            bm.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(tr)
            bm.Brightness = glow; bm.LightEmission = 1; bm.FaceCamera = true
            bm.Parent = pA
        end
        local function tDot(pos, size, col, tr)
            local d = Instance.new("Part")
            d.Name = "ArgonTracerDot"; d.Anchored = true; d.CanCollide = false; d.CanQuery = false; d.CanTouch = false; d.CastShadow = false
            d.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; d.Color = col; d.Transparency = tr or 0
            d.Size = Vector3.new(size, size, size); d.Position = pos; d.Parent = workspace
            Debris:AddItem(d, Tracer.Life)
        end

        if style == "Nebula" then
            -- three soft layered bands in pink / violet / blue, plus drifting dust
            local p0, a0 = tNode(a)
            local _, a1 = tNode(endPos)
            tLink(p0, a0, a1, Tracer.Width * 6, Tracer.Width * 3, Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180), 0.75, Tracer.Glow * 0.4)
            tLink(p0, a0, a1, Tracer.Width * 3.5, Tracer.Width * 1.5, Color3.fromRGB(150, 90, 255), 0.6, Tracer.Glow * 0.7)
            tLink(p0, a0, a1, Tracer.Width * 1.2, Tracer.Width * 0.4, Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255), 0.3, Tracer.Glow * 1.2)
            local n = math.clamp(math.floor(len / 3), 4, 40)
            for i = 1, n do
                local pos = a + dir * (i / n) + side * ((math.random() - 0.5) * len * 0.08) + up * ((math.random() - 0.5) * len * 0.08)
                local c = (math.random() < 0.5) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255)
                tDot(pos, Tracer.Width * (0.4 + math.random() * 0.8), c, 0.5 + math.random() * 0.3)
            end

        elseif style == "Aurora" then
            -- rippling curtain: a wave of segments that shifts hue from teal through green to violet
            local steps = math.clamp(math.floor(len / 1.5), 12, 80)
            local amp = math.max(0.4, len * 0.04)
            local pPrev, aPrev = tNode(a)
            for i = 1, steps do
                local t = i / steps
                local wave = math.sin(t * math.pi * 4) * amp
                local wave2 = math.cos(t * math.pi * 2.5) * amp * 0.5
                local pos = a + dir * t + up * wave + side * wave2
                local p, at = tNode(pos)
                local col = Color3.fromHSV(0.45 + 0.35 * t, 0.7, 1)
                tLink(pPrev, aPrev, at, Tracer.Width * 1.8, Tracer.Width * 1.8, col, 0.35, Tracer.Glow * 0.9)
                pPrev, aPrev = p, at
            end

        elseif style == "Starfall" then
            -- shooting star: bright gold head at the hit point, a fading star-dust trail back to the muzzle
            local hp, ha = tNode(endPos)
            local tp, ta = tNode(a)
            tLink(tp, ta, ha, Tracer.Width * 0.05, Tracer.Width * 1.6, Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 180), 0.15, Tracer.Glow * 1.1)
            tLink(tp, ta, ha, Tracer.Width * 0.02, Tracer.Width * 0.6, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.4, Tracer.Glow * 1.6)
            tDot(endPos, Tracer.Width * 3, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0)
            local n = math.clamp(math.floor(len / 2.5), 6, 50)
            for i = 1, n do
                local t = i / n
                local pos = a + dir * t + side * ((math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6) + up * ((math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6)
                tDot(pos, Tracer.Width * (1.2 - t) * (0.3 + math.random() * 0.4), Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 140), t * 0.8)
            end

        elseif style == "Orbit" then
            -- thin line with rings of dots circling it at intervals, like planets around a sun
            local p0, a0 = tNode(a)
            local _, a1 = tNode(endPos)
            tLink(p0, a0, a1, Tracer.Width * 0.25, Tracer.Width * 0.12, Tracer.Color, 0.2, Tracer.Glow * 0.6)
            local rings = math.clamp(math.floor(len / 8), 2, 10)
            local seg = 12
            local r = math.max(0.4, Tracer.Width * 4)
            for k = 1, rings do
                local c = a + dir * (k / (rings + 1))
                local firstP, firstA, prevP, prevA
                for j = 0, seg - 1 do
                    local ang = j / seg * math.pi * 2
                    local pos = c + side * (math.cos(ang) * r) + up * (math.sin(ang) * r)
                    local p, at = tNode(pos)
                    tDot(pos, Tracer.Width * 0.9, (j % 2 == 0) and Tracer.Color or Tracer.Color2, 0.1)
                    if prevP then tLink(prevP, prevA, at, Tracer.Width * 0.3, Tracer.Width * 0.3, Tracer.Color2, 0.4, Tracer.Glow * 0.7) end
                    if not firstP then firstP, firstA = p, at end
                    prevP, prevA = p, at
                end
                tLink(prevP, prevA, firstA, Tracer.Width * 0.3, Tracer.Width * 0.3, Tracer.Color2, 0.4, Tracer.Glow * 0.7)
            end

        elseif style == "Wormhole" then
            -- concentric rings shrinking toward the hit point, colors blending from Color to Color2
            local rings = math.clamp(math.floor(len / 5), 4, 12)
            local seg = 16
            local r0 = math.max(0.8, len * 0.06)
            local tilt = 0.6
            for k = 0, rings - 1 do
                local t = k / rings
                local c = a + dir * t
                local r = r0 * (1 - t) + 0.25
                local col = Tracer.Color:Lerp(Tracer.Color2, t)
                local firstP, firstA, prevP, prevA
                for j = 0, seg - 1 do
                    local ang = j / seg * math.pi * 2
                    local pos = c + side * (math.cos(ang) * r) + up * (math.sin(ang) * r * tilt)
                    local p, at = tNode(pos)
                    if prevP then tLink(prevP, prevA, at, Tracer.Width * 0.6, Tracer.Width * 0.6, col, 0.2, Tracer.Glow) end
                    if not firstP then firstP, firstA = p, at end
                    prevP, prevA = p, at
                end
                tLink(prevP, prevA, firstA, Tracer.Width * 0.6, Tracer.Width * 0.6, col, 0.2, Tracer.Glow)
            end
            tDot(endPos, Tracer.Width * 2, Tracer.Color2, 0)

        else -- Solar
            -- hot core at the muzzle with radiating flare arcs and corona specks
            tDot(a, Tracer.Width * 4, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80), 0.3)
            tDot(a, Tracer.Width * 2, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.1)
            local flares = 10
            for j = 1, flares do
                local spread = side * ((math.random() - 0.5) * 2) + up * ((math.random() - 0.5) * 2)
                local tip = a + (spread.Unit * (len * (0.08 + math.random() * 0.12)))
                local mid = (a + tip) / 2 + spread.Unit * (len * 0.03)
                local p0, a0 = tNode(a)
                local pm, am = tNode(mid)
                local pt, at = tNode(tip)
                tLink(p0, a0, am, Tracer.Width * 0.8, Tracer.Width * 0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 60), 0.3, Tracer.Glow)
                tLink(pm, am, at, Tracer.Width * 0.5, Tracer.Width * 0.05, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 120), 0.5, Tracer.Glow * 0.8)
            end
            local n = math.clamp(math.floor(len / 6), 3, 20)
            for i = 1, n do
                tDot(a + dir * (i / n) * 0.9, Tracer.Width * 0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60), 0.4 + 0.4 * (i / n))
            end
        end
        return
    end

    local width = Tracer.Width
    local wEnd = math.max(0.02, width * 0.15)
    local transp = NumberSequence.new{ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.9) }
    local bright = Tracer.Glow
    if style == "Thin" then
        width = width * 0.35; wEnd = width * 0.5; bright = math.max(1, bright * 0.5)
    elseif style == "Fade" then
        wEnd = math.max(0.02, width * 0.02)
        transp = NumberSequence.new{ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.5), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }
    elseif style == "Laser" then
        width = width * 0.5; wEnd = wEnd * 0.5
    end

    local p0 = Instance.new("Part"); p0.Name="ArgonTracerStart"; p0.Anchored=true; p0.CanCollide=false; p0.CanQuery=false; p0.CanTouch=false; p0.Transparency=1; p0.Size=Vector3.new(0.1,0.1,0.1); p0.Position=a; p0.Parent=workspace
    local p1 = p0:Clone(); p1.Name="ArgonTracerEnd"; p1.Position=endPos; p1.Parent=workspace
    local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment"); a0.Parent = p0
    local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment"); a1.Parent = p1
    local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
    beam.Attachment0=a0; beam.Attachment1=a1; beam.Width0=width; beam.Width1=wEnd; beam.Brightness=bright; beam.FaceCamera=true; beam.LightEmission=1
    if style == "Rainbow" then
        beam.Color = ColorSequence.new{
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromHSV(0, 1, 1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, Color3.fromHSV(0.17, 1, 1)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromHSV(0.33, 1, 1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, Color3.fromHSV(0.58, 1, 1)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHSV(0.83, 1, 1)) }
    elseif Tracer.Gradient then beam.Color = ColorSequence.new{ ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Tracer.Color), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Tracer.Color2) }
    else beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Tracer.Color) end
    beam.Transparency = transp
    if style == "Laser" then
        local halo = Instance.new("Beam")
        halo.Attachment0=a0; halo.Attachment1=a1; halo.Width0=width*4; halo.Width1=wEnd*4; halo.Brightness=bright*0.3; halo.FaceCamera=true; halo.LightEmission=1
        halo.Color = beam.Color; halo.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.8); halo.Parent = p0
    end
    if Tracer.Outline then
        local o = Instance.new("Beam"); o.Attachment0=a0; o.Attachment1=a1; o.Width0=width+0.12; o.Width1=math.max(0.1, width*0.35); o.Brightness=0; o.LightEmission=0; o.FaceCamera=true; o.Color=ColorSequence.new(Tracer.OutlineColor); o.Parent=p0
    end
    beam.Parent = p0
    Debris:AddItem(p0, Tracer.Life)
    Debris:AddItem(p1, Tracer.Life)
end

local tHookedTracer = false
local function tInstallTracer()
    if tHookedTracer then return end
    local ok, gun = pcall(function() return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Modules.ItemTypes.Gun) end)
    if not ok or type(gun) ~= "table" or type(gun._Tracers) ~= "function" then return end
    local orig = gun._Tracers
    gun._Tracers = function(self, data, ...)
        local res = {}
        if not Removables.NoGunTracers then res = {orig(self, data, ...)} end
        if Tracer.Enabled and typeof(data) == "table" and data.IsLocal == true then
            task.spawn(function()
                local m = tMuz()
                local rays = data.RaycastResults or data.Rays or data.Raycasts
                if typeof(rays) == "table" then
                    for _, r in ipairs(rays) do
                        local sp, ep = r.StartPosition or m, r.Position or r.EndPosition
                        if sp and ep then tBeam(sp, ep) end
                    end
                else
                    local ep = data.Position or data.EndPosition or data.HitPosition
                    if ep and m then tBeam(m, ep) end
                end
            end)
        end
        return unpack(res)
    end
    tHookedTracer = true
end

-- ================= SNOW =================
local Snow = { Enabled=false, Color=WHITE, Rate=1000, Size=0.33, Speed=30, Spread=50, HeightOffset=20 }
local snowH = { part=nil, emitter=nil, conn=nil }

local function sEnsure()
    if snowH.part and snowH.part.Parent then return end
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Size = Vector3.new(40, 40, 85); p.CanCollide=false; p.Massless=true; p.CastShadow=false; p.Transparency=1; p.Anchored=true; p.Name="argon_snow"; p.Parent=workspace
    local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
    e.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.737), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.973,0.769), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1) })
    e.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=99851851"
    e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(Snow.Spread, Snow.Spread)
    e.Speed = NumberRange.new(Snow.Speed, Snow.Speed)
    e.LightEmission = 10; e.Rate = Snow.Rate; e.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
    e.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Snow.Size), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.551,Snow.Size*1.22), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Snow.Size) })
    e.Color = ColorSequence.new(Snow.Color); e.Enabled = Snow.Enabled; e.Parent = p
    snowH.part, snowH.emitter = p, e
end

local function sApply()
    sEnsure()
    local e = snowH.emitter
    if not e then return end
    e.Rate = Snow.Rate
    e.Color = ColorSequence.new(Snow.Color)
    e.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Snow.Size), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.551,Snow.Size*1.22), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Snow.Size) })
    e.Speed = NumberRange.new(Snow.Speed, Snow.Speed)
    e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(Snow.Spread, Snow.Spread)
    e.Enabled = Snow.Enabled
end

local function sStart()
    Snow.Enabled = true
    sEnsure()
    if snowH.emitter then snowH.emitter.Enabled = true end
    if snowH.conn then return end
    snowH.conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Snow.Enabled then if snowH.emitter then snowH.emitter.Enabled = false end return end
        sEnsure()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if snowH.part and cam then snowH.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(cam.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, Snow.HeightOffset, 0)) end
        if snowH.emitter then snowH.emitter.Enabled = true end
    end)
end

local function sStop()
    Snow.Enabled = false
    if snowH.conn then snowH.conn:Disconnect(); snowH.conn = nil end
    if snowH.emitter then snowH.emitter.Enabled = false end
    if snowH.part then snowH.part:Destroy() end
    snowH.part, snowH.emitter = nil, nil
end

-- ================= SKY =================
local Sky = { Enabled = false, Current = "Night" }
local skyOriginal = { SkyboxBk="", SkyboxDn="", SkyboxFt="", SkyboxLf="", SkyboxRt="", SkyboxUp="", StarCount=3000, SunAngularSize=21, MoonAngularSize=11 }
local SkyPresets = {
    ["Night"] = { "rbxassetid://12064107","rbxassetid://12064152","rbxassetid://12064121","rbxassetid://12063984","rbxassetid://12064115","rbxassetid://12064131",3000,0,12 },
    ["Space"] = { "rbxassetid://149397684","rbxassetid://149397686","rbxassetid://149397688","rbxassetid://149397692","rbxassetid://149397697","rbxassetid://149397702",6500,0,6 },
    ["Sunset"] = { "rbxassetid://264909420","rbxassetid://264907909","rbxassetid://264908339","rbxassetid://264908886","rbxassetid://264909758","rbxassetid://264907379",700,20,7 },
    ["Dawn"] = { "rbxassetid://1417494030","rbxassetid://1417494146","rbxassetid://1417494253","rbxassetid://1417494402","rbxassetid://1417494499","rbxassetid://1417494643",600,16,7 },
    ["Heaven"] = { "rbxassetid://591058823","rbxassetid://591059642","rbxassetid://591059876","rbxassetid://591057625","rbxassetid://591057861","rbxassetid://591058104",0,24,0 },
    ["Void"] = { "rbxassetid://0","rbxassetid://0","rbxassetid://0","rbxassetid://0","rbxassetid://0","rbxassetid://0",0,0,0 },
    ["Nebula"] = { "rbxassetid://149397697","rbxassetid://149397702","rbxassetid://149397692","rbxassetid://149397688","rbxassetid://149397684","rbxassetid://149397686",7000,0,5 },
    ["Cloudy"] = { "rbxassetid://591058823","rbxassetid://591059876","rbxassetid://591058104","rbxassetid://591057861","rbxassetid://591057625","rbxassetid://591059642",0,12,0 },
}
local skyObj = nil

local function applySky(name)
    local preset = SkyPresets[name]
    if not preset then return end
    if not skyObj then
        local existing = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
        if existing then
            skyOriginal.SkyboxBk = existing.SkyboxBk; skyOriginal.SkyboxDn = existing.SkyboxDn; skyOriginal.SkyboxFt = existing.SkyboxFt
            skyOriginal.SkyboxLf = existing.SkyboxLf; skyOriginal.SkyboxRt = existing.SkyboxRt; skyOriginal.SkyboxUp = existing.SkyboxUp
            skyOriginal.StarCount = existing.StarCount; skyOriginal.SunAngularSize = existing.SunAngularSize; skyOriginal.MoonAngularSize = existing.MoonAngularSize
        end
        skyObj = Instance.new("Sky"); skyObj.Name = "ArgonSky"; skyObj.Parent = Lighting
    end
    skyObj.SkyboxBk = preset[1]; skyObj.SkyboxDn = preset[2]; skyObj.SkyboxFt = preset[3]; skyObj.SkyboxLf = preset[4]; skyObj.SkyboxRt = preset[5]; skyObj.SkyboxUp = preset[6]
    skyObj.StarCount = preset[7]; skyObj.SunAngularSize = preset[8]; skyObj.MoonAngularSize = preset[9]
    skyObj.CelestialBodiesShown = preset[8] > 0 or preset[9] > 0
end

local function clearSky()
    if skyObj then skyObj:Destroy(); skyObj = nil end
    local existing = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
    if existing then
        existing.SkyboxBk = skyOriginal.SkyboxBk; existing.SkyboxDn = skyOriginal.SkyboxDn; existing.SkyboxFt = skyOriginal.SkyboxFt
        existing.SkyboxLf = skyOriginal.SkyboxLf; existing.SkyboxRt = skyOriginal.SkyboxRt; existing.SkyboxUp = skyOriginal.SkyboxUp
        existing.StarCount = skyOriginal.StarCount; existing.SunAngularSize = skyOriginal.SunAngularSize; existing.MoonAngularSize = skyOriginal.MoonAngularSize
    end
end

-- ================= POST FX =================
local Bloom = { Enabled=false, Intensity=0.6, Size=24, Threshold=0.9 }
local bloomObj = nil
local function applyBloom()
    if not bloomObj then bloomObj = Instance.new("BloomEffect"); bloomObj.Name = "ArgonBloom"; bloomObj.Parent = Lighting end
    bloomObj.Enabled = Bloom.Enabled; bloomObj.Intensity = Bloom.Intensity; bloomObj.Size = Bloom.Size; bloomObj.Threshold = Bloom.Threshold
end
local function clearBloom() if bloomObj then bloomObj:Destroy(); bloomObj = nil end end

local CC = { Enabled=false, Saturation=0, Contrast=0, Brightness=0, Tint=WHITE }
local ccObj = nil
local function applyCC()
    if not ccObj then ccObj = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect"); ccObj.Name = "ArgonCC"; ccObj.Parent = Lighting end
    ccObj.Enabled = CC.Enabled; ccObj.Saturation = CC.Saturation; ccObj.Contrast = CC.Contrast; ccObj.Brightness = CC.Brightness; ccObj.TintColor = CC.Tint
end
local function clearCC() if ccObj then ccObj:Destroy(); ccObj = nil end end

local SunRays = { Enabled=false, Intensity=0.25, Spread=1 }
local srObj = nil
local function applySunRays()
    if not srObj then srObj = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect"); srObj.Name = "ArgonSunRays"; srObj.Parent = Lighting end
    srObj.Enabled = SunRays.Enabled; srObj.Intensity = SunRays.Intensity; srObj.Spread = SunRays.Spread
end
local function clearSunRays() if srObj then srObj:Destroy(); srObj = nil end end

local Fullbright = { Enabled = false }
local fullbrightOrig = nil
local function applyFullbright()
    if not Fullbright.Enabled then
        if fullbrightOrig then
            Lighting.Brightness = fullbrightOrig.Brightness; Lighting.Ambient = fullbrightOrig.Ambient
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = fullbrightOrig.OutdoorAmbient; Lighting.ClockTime = fullbrightOrig.ClockTime
            fullbrightOrig = nil
        end
        return
    end
    if not fullbrightOrig then
        fullbrightOrig = { Brightness = Lighting.Brightness, Ambient = Lighting.Ambient, OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient, ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime }
    end
    Lighting.Brightness = 3; Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(180,180,180); Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180,180,180); Lighting.ClockTime = 14
end

-- ================= HIT MARKERS =================
local HitMarker = {
    Enabled = false, Duration = 0.35, Size = 12, Thickness = 2, Gap = 4,
    Color = PINK, Color2 = WHITE, Gradient = false,
    Shape = "Cross", Shapes = { "Cross", "X", "Bracket", "Circle", "Square", "Diamond", "Dot" }, MaxBars = 8,
    Outline = true, OutlineColor = BLACK, OutlineThickness = 1,
    FollowHit = false, Rise = 15,
    Arc = false, ArcHeight = 30, ArcSway = 12,
    Spin = false, SpinSpeed = 180,
    Glow = false, GlowSize = 6,
}
local hmHolder = nil
local hmPool = {}
local hmActive = {}

local function findHitPosition(data, depth)
    if depth > 5 then return nil end
    if typeof(data) == "Vector3" then return data end
    if typeof(data) == "Instance" then
        if data:IsA("BasePart") then return data.Position end
        local part = data:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        if part then return part.Position end
        return nil
    end
    if typeof(data) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local direct = rawget(data,"HitPart") or rawget(data,"Part") or rawget(data,"Hitbox") or rawget(data,"HitPosition") or rawget(data,"Position") or rawget(data, utf8.char(2))
    if typeof(direct) == "Vector3" then return direct end
    if typeof(direct) == "Instance" then
        if direct:IsA("BasePart") then return direct.Position end
        local p = direct:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true); if p then return p.Position end
    end
    for _, v in pairs(data) do local found = findHitPosition(v, depth + 1); if found then return found end end
    return nil
end

local function hmEnsure()
    if hmHolder then return end
    hmHolder = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    hmHolder.Name = "ArgonHitMarkers"; hmHolder.IgnoreGuiInset = true; hmHolder.ResetOnSpawn = false; hmHolder.DisplayOrder = 9998
    hmHolder.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui
end

local function hmBuildEntry()
    local root = Instance.new("Frame")
    root.BackgroundTransparency = 1; root.BorderSizePixel = 0; root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0); root.Visible = false

    local glow = Instance.new("Frame")
    glow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); glow.BorderSizePixel = 0; glow.Visible = false
    local gc = Instance.new("UICorner"); gc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0); gc.Parent = glow
    glow.Parent = root

    local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
    ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); ring.BorderSizePixel = 0; ring.Visible = false
    local rc = Instance.new("UICorner"); rc.Parent = ring
    local rs = Instance.new("UIStroke"); rs.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; rs.Parent = ring
    ring.Parent = root

    local bars = {}
    for i = 1, HitMarker.MaxBars do
        local b = Instance.new("Frame")
        b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.Visible = false
        local g = Instance.new("UIGradient"); g.Parent = b
        local st = Instance.new("UIStroke"); st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; st.Parent = b
        b.Parent = root
        bars[i] = { frame = b, grad = g, stroke = st }
    end
    return { root = root, glow = glow, ring = ring, ringStroke = rs, ringCorner = rc, bars = bars }
end

local function hmLayout(e)
    local s, t, gap = HitMarker.Size, HitMarker.Thickness, HitMarker.Gap
    local col = HitMarker.Color
    e.ring.Visible = false
    local n = 0

    local function bar(x, y, w, h, rot)
        n = n + 1
        local b = e.bars[n]
        b.frame.Visible = true
        b.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
        b.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
        b.frame.Rotation = rot
        b.frame.BackgroundColor3 = col
        b.frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        b.grad.Enabled = HitMarker.Gradient
        b.grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(col, HitMarker.Color2)
        b.stroke.Enabled = HitMarker.Outline
        b.stroke.Color = HitMarker.OutlineColor
        b.stroke.Thickness = HitMarker.OutlineThickness
        b.stroke.Transparency = 0
    end

    local function ringShape(size, corner, rot, filled)
        e.ring.Visible = true
        e.ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
        e.ring.Rotation = rot
        e.ringCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(corner, 0)
        if filled then
            e.ring.BackgroundColor3 = col; e.ring.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            e.ringStroke.Enabled = false
        else
            e.ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            e.ringStroke.Enabled = true; e.ringStroke.Color = col
            e.ringStroke.Thickness = t; e.ringStroke.Transparency = 0
        end
    end

    local shape = HitMarker.Shape
    if shape == "X" then
        local d = gap * 0.5 + s * 0.35
        bar(-d, -d, s, t, 45); bar(d, d, s, t, 45)
        bar(d, -d, s, t, -45); bar(-d, d, s, t, -45)
    elseif shape == "Bracket" then
        local o = s / 2 + gap
        for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
            for _, sy in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                bar(sx * o - sx * s / 4, sy * o, s / 2, t, 0)
                bar(sx * o, sy * o - sy * s / 4, t, s / 2, 0)
            end
        end
    elseif shape == "Circle" then ringShape(s * 2, 1, 0, false)
    elseif shape == "Square" then ringShape(s * 2, 0, 0, false)
    elseif shape == "Diamond" then ringShape(s * 2, 0, 45, false)
    elseif shape == "Dot" then ringShape(math.max(2, t * 2 + s * 0.3), 1, 0, true)
    else
        local o = gap + s / 2
        bar(-o, 0, s, t, 0); bar(o, 0, s, t, 0)
        bar(0, -o, t, s, 0); bar(0, o, t, s, 0)
    end
    for i = n + 1, HitMarker.MaxBars do e.bars[i].frame.Visible = false end

    e.glow.Visible = HitMarker.Glow
    local gs = s * 3 + HitMarker.GlowSize * 2
    e.glow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(gs, gs)
    e.glow.BackgroundColor3 = col
    e.glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85
end

local function hmSpawn(screenPos)
    if not HitMarker.Enabled then return end
    hmEnsure()
    local e = table.remove(hmPool)
    if not e then e = hmBuildEntry() end
    e.root.Parent = hmHolder
    hmLayout(e)
    local basePos
    if screenPos then basePos = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
    else local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera; basePos = cam and cam.ViewportSize * 0.5 or Vector2.new(500, 500) end
    e.root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(basePos.X, basePos.Y)
    e.root.Visible = true
    hmActive[e] = { time = tick(), base = basePos, dir = (math.random() < 0.5) and -1 or 1, spin0 = tick() }
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local now = tick()
    for e, info in pairs(hmActive) do
        local a = (now - info.time) / HitMarker.Duration
        if a >= 1 then
            e.root.Visible = false
            hmActive[e] = nil
            table.insert(hmPool, e)
        else
            local arcHump = 4 * a * (1 - a)
            local x = info.base.X + (HitMarker.Arc and info.dir * HitMarker.ArcSway * a or 0)
            local y = info.base.Y - HitMarker.Rise * a - (HitMarker.Arc and HitMarker.ArcHeight * arcHump or 0)
            e.root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
            e.root.Rotation = HitMarker.Spin and ((now - info.spin0) * HitMarker.SpinSpeed) or 0
            for _, b in ipairs(e.bars) do
                b.frame.BackgroundTransparency = a
                b.stroke.Transparency = a
            end
            e.ringStroke.Transparency = a
            if not e.ringStroke.Enabled then e.ring.BackgroundTransparency = a end
            e.glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85 + 0.15 * a
        end
    end
end)

local hmLastAt = 0
local function hmTrigger(screenPos)
    if not HitMarker.Enabled then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - hmLastAt < 0.1 then return end
    hmLastAt = now
    task.spawn(hmSpawn, screenPos)
end

local hmHooked = false
local function hmInstall()
    if hmHooked then return end
    hmHooked = true
    local okV, CVM = pcall(function() return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem.ClientViewModel) end)
    if okV and type(CVM) == "table" and type(CVM.PlayHitmarkerSound) == "function" then
        local origSound = CVM.PlayHitmarkerSound
        CVM.PlayHitmarkerSound = function(self, ...)
            hmTrigger(nil)
            local hfx = getgenv().HFX
            if hfx and hfx.Enabled and getgenv().SolHitFX then getgenv().SolHitFX(nil) end
            return origSound(self, ...)
        end
    else
        warn("[hitmarker] ClientViewModel.PlayHitmarkerSound not found")
    end
    local ok, itemInterface = pcall(function() return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem.ItemInterface) end)
    if not ok or type(itemInterface) ~= "table" or type(itemInterface.DamageEffect) ~= "function" then
        warn("[hitmarker] ItemInterface.DamageEffect not found, using sound trigger only")
        return
    end
    local orig = itemInterface.DamageEffect
    itemInterface.DamageEffect = function(self, ...)
        local hfxArgs = table.pack(...)
        if HitMarker.Enabled then
            local screenPos = nil
            if HitMarker.FollowHit then
                local args = table.pack(...)
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                for i = 1, args.n do
                    local wp = findHitPosition(args[i], 0)
                    if wp and cam then
                        local sp, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(wp)
                        if onScreen and sp.Z > 0 then screenPos = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) end
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            hmTrigger(screenPos)
        end
        local hfx = getgenv().HFX
        if hfx and hfx.Enabled and getgenv().SolHitFX then getgenv().SolHitFX(hfxArgs) end
        return orig(self, ...)
    end
end

local function hfxTween(obj, t, props, style, dir)
    game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
end

local function hfxRoot(c)
    if not hfxGui then
        hfxGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        hfxGui.Name = "ArgonHitFX"; hfxGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true; hfxGui.ResetOnSpawn = false; hfxGui.DisplayOrder = 9999
        hfxGui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
    end
    local r = Instance.new("Frame")
    r.BackgroundTransparency = 1; r.BorderSizePixel = 0; r.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
    r.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(c.X, c.Y)
    r.Parent = hfxGui
    return r
end

local function hfxDot(parent, size, x, y, col, tr)
    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
    f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); f.BorderSizePixel = 0
    f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size); f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
    f.BackgroundColor3 = col; f.BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0); c.Parent = f
    f.Parent = parent
    return f
end

local function hfxRing(parent, size, x, y, col, thick)
    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
    f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); f.BorderSizePixel = 0; f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size); f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0); c.Parent = f
    local st = Instance.new("UIStroke"); st.Color = col; st.Thickness = thick or 2
    st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; st.Parent = f
    f.Parent = parent
    return f, st
end

local function hfxBar(parent, len, thick, x, y, angle, col, tr)
    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
    f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5); f.BorderSizePixel = 0
    f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, thick); f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y); f.Rotation = angle
    f.BackgroundColor3 = col; f.BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0
    f.Parent = parent
    return f
end

    hfxTween(ring, 0.8, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230 * s, 230 * s) })

    for i = 0, 15 do
        local ray = hfxBar(r, 0, 2, 0, 0, i * 22.5, col, 0)
        hfxTween(ray, 0.6, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120 * s, 1) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
        hfxTween(ray, 0.6, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
    end
    return 0.9
end

HFX_FX["Constellation"] = function(r, s)
    local col = hfxPick()
    local pts, objs = {}, {}
    for i = 1, 6 do
        local ang = (i / 6) * math.pi * 2 + math.random() * 0.4
        local d = (40 + math.random(0, 40)) * s
        pts[i] = Vector2.new(math.cos(ang) * d, math.sin(ang) * d)
        objs[#objs + 1] = hfxDot(r, 5, pts[i].X, pts[i].Y, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0)
    end
    for i = 1, 6 do
        local a, b = pts[i], pts[i % 6 + 1]
        local dx, dy = b.X - a.X, b.Y - a.Y
        local len = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        objs[#objs + 1] = hfxBar(r, len, 1.5, a.X, a.Y, math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)), col, 0.3)
    end
    task.delay(0.6, function()
        for _, o in ipairs(objs) do hfxTween(o, 0.5, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end
    end)
    return 1.1
end

        bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(40, 140) * s, math.random(2, 10) * s)
        bar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y)

        bar.Parent = r
        for k = 1, 3 do
            task.delay(k * 0.08, function() bar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(-30, 30) * s, y) end)
        end
        task.delay(0.3, function() hfxTween(bar, 0.2, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end)
    end
    return 0.6
end

local function hfxPlay(args)
    if not HFX.Enabled then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - hfxLast < 0.12 then return end -- one burst per shot cycle, not one per remote
    hfxLast = now
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local c = nil
    for i = 1, (args and args.n or 0) do
        local okw, wp = pcall(findHitPosition, args[i], 0)
        if okw and wp then
            local sp, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(wp)
            if onScreen and sp.Z > 0 then c = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) end
            break
        end
    end
    c = c or (cam.ViewportSize / 2)
    local name = HFX.Effect
    if name == "Random" or not HFX_FX[name] then
        local pool = {}
        for k in pairs(HFX_FX) do pool[#pool + 1] = k end
        name = pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
    end
    local r = hfxRoot(c)
    local dur = HFX_FX[name](r, HFX.Scale or 1) or 1
    task.delay(dur + 0.3, function() if r then r:Destroy() end end)
end

getgenv().SolHitFX = function(args)
    local ok, err = pcall(hfxPlay, args)
    if not ok then warn("[hitfx] " .. tostring(err)) end
end
getgenv().SolHmInstall = hmInstall

end
