-- ================= WORLD VISUALS =================
local WorldVisuals = { Lighting = Lighting, OwnedAtmosphere = nil, LightingGuard = nil, NativeAtmosphereGuards = {}, Initialized = false, Connections = {} }
local WV_LightProps = {'Ambient','OutdoorAmbient','ColorShift_Top','ColorShift_Bottom','FogColor','FogStart','FogEnd'}
local WV_AtmosProps = {'Color','Decay','Density','Offset','Glare','Haze'}

function WorldVisuals.NewGuard(target)
    local g = { Target=target, Originals={}, HasOriginal={}, Overrides={}, Writing=false, Connection=nil }
    g.Connection = target.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
        if g.Writing or g.Overrides[prop] == nil then return end
        local ok, nv = pcall(function() return g.Target[prop] end); if not ok then return end
        g.Originals[prop] = nv; g.HasOriginal[prop] = true; g.Writing = true
        pcall(function() g.Target[prop] = g.Overrides[prop] end); g.Writing = false
    end)
    return g
end

function WorldVisuals.SetGuardOverride(g, prop, value)
    if not g or not g.Target then return false end
    local cap = false
    if g.HasOriginal[prop] ~= true then
        local ok, nv = pcall(function() return g.Target[prop] end); if not ok then return false end
        g.Originals[prop] = nv; g.HasOriginal[prop] = true; cap = true
    end
    g.Overrides[prop] = value; g.Writing = true
    local ok = pcall(function() g.Target[prop] = value end); g.Writing = false
    if not ok then
        g.Overrides[prop] = nil
        if cap then g.Originals[prop] = nil; g.HasOriginal[prop] = nil end
    end
    return ok
end

function WorldVisuals.ClearGuardOverride(g, prop)
    if not g or g.HasOriginal[prop] ~= true then return false end
    local nv = g.Originals[prop]; g.Overrides[prop] = nil; g.Writing = true
    local ok = pcall(function() g.Target[prop] = nv end); g.Writing = false
    g.Originals[prop] = nil; g.HasOriginal[prop] = nil
    return ok
end

function WorldVisuals.ReconcileGuard(g, props, desired)
    for _, p in ipairs(props) do
        if desired[p] ~= nil then WorldVisuals.SetGuardOverride(g, p, desired[p])
        else WorldVisuals.ClearGuardOverride(g, p) end
    end
end

function WorldVisuals.DestroyGuard(g)
    if not g then return end
    local ps = {}; for p in pairs(g.HasOriginal) do ps[#ps+1] = p end
    for _, p in ipairs(ps) do WorldVisuals.ClearGuardOverride(g, p) end
    if g.Connection then g.Connection:Disconnect(); g.Connection = nil end
end

local WV = { AmbientOn=false, AmbientIn=BLACK, AmbientOut=BLACK, ShiftOn=false, ShiftTop=BLACK, ShiftBot=WHITE, FogOn=false, FogColor=BLACK, FogStart=0, FogEnd=10000, AtmosOn=false, AtmosColor=BLACK, AtmosDecay=WHITE, AtmosDensity=0.395, AtmosOffset=0, AtmosGlare=0, AtmosHaze=0 }

function WorldVisuals.RefreshLighting()
    if not WorldVisuals.LightingGuard then return end
    local d = {}
    if WV.AmbientOn then d.Ambient = WV.AmbientIn; d.OutdoorAmbient = WV.AmbientOut end
    if WV.ShiftOn then d.ColorShift_Top = WV.ShiftTop; d.ColorShift_Bottom = WV.ShiftBot end
    if WV.FogOn then d.FogColor = WV.FogColor; d.FogStart = WV.FogStart; d.FogEnd = WV.FogEnd end
    WorldVisuals.ReconcileGuard(WorldVisuals.LightingGuard, WV_LightProps, d)
end

function WorldVisuals.RestoreAtmosphere()
    local owned = WorldVisuals.OwnedAtmosphere; WorldVisuals.OwnedAtmosphere = nil
    if owned then pcall(function() owned:Destroy() end) end
    for a, g in pairs(WorldVisuals.NativeAtmosphereGuards) do WorldVisuals.DestroyGuard(g); WorldVisuals.NativeAtmosphereGuards[a] = nil end
end

function WorldVisuals.RefreshAtmosphere()
    if not WV.AtmosOn then WorldVisuals.RestoreAtmosphere(); return end
    local d = { Color=WV.AtmosColor, Decay=WV.AtmosDecay, Density=WV.AtmosDensity, Offset=WV.AtmosOffset, Glare=WV.AtmosGlare, Haze=WV.AtmosHaze }
    local natives = {}
    for _, c in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA('Atmosphere') and c ~= WorldVisuals.OwnedAtmosphere then natives[#natives+1] = c end
    end
    if #natives > 0 then
        local owned = WorldVisuals.OwnedAtmosphere; WorldVisuals.OwnedAtmosphere = nil
        if owned then pcall(function() owned:Destroy() end) end
        for _, a in ipairs(natives) do
            local g = WorldVisuals.NativeAtmosphereGuards[a]
            if not g then g = WorldVisuals.NewGuard(a); WorldVisuals.NativeAtmosphereGuards[a] = g end
            WorldVisuals.ReconcileGuard(g, WV_AtmosProps, d)
        end
        return
    end
    local atmos = WorldVisuals.OwnedAtmosphere
    if not atmos or atmos.Parent == nil then
        atmos = Instance.new('Atmosphere'); atmos.Name = 'ArgonWorldVisuals_Atmosphere'; WorldVisuals.OwnedAtmosphere = atmos; atmos.Parent = Lighting
    end
    for p, v in pairs(d) do atmos[p] = v end
end

function WorldVisuals.EnsureInit()
    if WorldVisuals.Initialized then return end
    WorldVisuals.Initialized = true
    WorldVisuals.LightingGuard = WorldVisuals.NewGuard(Lighting)
end

function WorldVisuals.RefreshAll()
    WorldVisuals.EnsureInit()
    WorldVisuals.RefreshLighting()
    WorldVisuals.RefreshAtmosphere()
end

function WorldVisuals.Destroy()
    if not WorldVisuals.Initialized then return end
    WorldVisuals.Initialized = false
    for _, c in pairs(WorldVisuals.Connections) do c:Disconnect() end
    WorldVisuals.Connections = {}
    WorldVisuals.DestroyGuard(WorldVisuals.LightingGuard)
    WorldVisuals.LightingGuard = nil
    WorldVisuals.RestoreAtmosphere()
end

-- ================= AVATAR / DUELER SPOOF =================
local DuelerCloneSpoof = {}
DuelerCloneSpoof.__index = DuelerCloneSpoof
function DuelerCloneSpoof.new(dummy, isPlayersInstance)
    return setmetatable({ _dummy=dummy, _isPlayersInstance=isPlayersInstance or function(v) return v == Players end, _restore=nil, _spoofsByPlayer={}, _isArmed=false }, DuelerCloneSpoof)
end
function DuelerCloneSpoof:Arm()
    self._isArmed = true
    return self:_Load()
end
function DuelerCloneSpoof:_Load()
    if not (self._isArmed and self._restore == nil) then return end
    local ps = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    local ctrls = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
    local clientDueler = ctrls and ctrls:FindFirstChild("ClientDueler") or ctrls and ctrls:FindFirstChild("DuelController")
    if not clientDueler then return end
    local ok, ctrl = pcall(require, clientDueler)
    if not ok or type(ctrl) ~= "table" then return end
    local method = ctrl._PreloadCharacterModel
    if type(method) ~= "function" then return end
    local info = debug.getinfo and debug.getinfo(method, "u")
    if not info or info.nups <= 0 then return end
    local idx, inst
    for i = 1, info.nups do
        local name, val = debug.getupvalue(method, i)
        if val and typeof(val) == "Instance" and self._isPlayersInstance(val) then idx, inst = i, val; break end
    end
    if not idx then return end
    if self._dummy then debug.setupvalue(method, idx, self._dummy) end
    self._restore = { _method=method, _index=idx, _old=inst }
end
function DuelerCloneSpoof:SetSpoof(player, dummy)
    if self._spoofsByPlayer[player] == dummy then return end
    self._spoofsByPlayer[player] = dummy
end
function DuelerCloneSpoof:Unload()
    if not self._restore then return end
    pcall(function() debug.setupvalue(self._restore._method, self._restore._index, self._restore._old) end)
    self._restore = nil
end

local AvatarSpoofer = {}
AvatarSpoofer.__index = AvatarSpoofer
function AvatarSpoofer.new()
    return setmetatable({ _duelerCloneSpoof = DuelerCloneSpoof.new(nil), _armed = false, _connections = {} }, AvatarSpoofer)
end
function AvatarSpoofer:Arm()
    if self._armed then return end
    self._armed = true
    pcall(function() self._duelerCloneSpoof:Arm() end)
end
function AvatarSpoofer:Destroy()
    for _, c in self._connections do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(self._connections)
    pcall(function() self._duelerCloneSpoof:Unload() end)
end

local ViewModelHook = { NoMuzzleFlash=false, Hooked=false, MuzzleOriginal=nil }
local function installViewModelHook()
    if ViewModelHook.Hooked then return end
    local paths = {
        { LocalPlayer, "PlayerScripts", "Modules", "ClientReplicatedClasses", "ClientFighter", "ClientItem", "ClientViewModel" },
        { LocalPlayer, "PlayerScripts", "Modules", "ClientReplicatedClasses", "ClientFighter", "ClientViewModel" },
    }
    local vmModule
    for _, path in ipairs(paths) do
        local cur = path[1]
        for i = 2, #path do cur = cur and cur:FindFirstChild(path[i]) end
        if cur then
            local ok, m = pcall(require, cur)
            if ok and type(m) == "table" then vmModule = m; break end
        end
    end
    if not vmModule then return end
    local mf = vmModule.MuzzleFlash
    if type(mf) == "function" then
        ViewModelHook.MuzzleOriginal = mf
        vmModule.MuzzleFlash = function(self, ...)
            if ViewModelHook.NoMuzzleFlash then return end
            return mf(self, ...)
        end
    end
    ViewModelHook.Hooked = true
end
local function uninstallViewModelHook() ViewModelHook.NoMuzzleFlash = false end

-- ================= CONFIG =================
local ConfigStore = { File = "argon/config.json", Autoload = true, Loading = false }

-- every toggle / slider / dropdown / textbox / colorpicker / keybind the UI registered
-- lives in the library flag table. the hand-picked fields above never covered most toggles,
-- so the on/off state of ragebot, esp, aimbot, etc. was lost on save. this saves all of them.
ConfigStore.FlagSkip = { MenuKeybind = true, MenuKey = true, cfg_list = true, cfg_name = true, cfg_auto = true }

function ConfigStore.SerializeFlags()
    local out = {}
    local lib = getgenv().Library
    if not lib or type(lib.Flags) ~= "table" then return out end
    for k, v in pairs(lib.Flags) do
        if not ConfigStore.FlagSkip[k] then
            pcall(function()
                local entry
                if type(v) == "table" and v.Key then
                    entry = { Key = tostring(v.Key), Mode = v.Mode }
                elseif type(v) == "table" and typeof(v.Color) == "Color3" then
                    entry = { c = { v.Color.R, v.Color.G, v.Color.B }, a = v.Alpha or 0 }
                else
                    entry = v
                end
                local t = type(entry)
                if t == "boolean" or t == "number" or t == "string" or t == "table" then
                    HttpService:JSONEncode(entry)
                    out[k] = entry
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    return out
end

function ConfigStore.ApplyFlags(saved)
    local lib = getgenv().Library
    if not lib or type(saved) ~= "table" or type(lib.SetFlags) ~= "table" then return end
    for k, v in pairs(saved) do
        local set = lib.SetFlags[k]
        if set and not ConfigStore.FlagSkip[k] then
            local okSet, errSet = pcall(function()
                if type(v) == "table" and v.c then
                    set(Color3.new(v.c[1] or 1, v.c[2] or 1, v.c[3] or 1), v.a or 0)
                else
                    set(v)
                end
            end)
            if not okSet then warn("[config] flag " .. tostring(k) .. " failed: " .. tostring(errSet)) end
        end
    end
end

-- ================= FLY =================
do
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    local Fly = { Enabled = false, Speed = 100 }
    local connection = nil
    local isTouchControls = function() return false end

    function Fly.SetTouchCheck(fn)
        isTouchControls = fn
    end

    local function getMoveVector(cf, humanoid)
        local move = Vector3.zero

        if isTouchControls() then
            local md = humanoid.MoveDirection
            if md.Magnitude > 0 then
                local right = Vector3.new(cf.RightVector.X, 0, cf.RightVector.Z)
                local look = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
                if right.Magnitude > 0.001 and look.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                    move = move + cf.RightVector * md:Dot(right.Unit) + cf.LookVector * md:Dot(look.Unit)
                else
                    move = move + md
                end
            end
        else
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move = move + cf.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move = move - cf.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move = move - cf.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move = move + cf.RightVector end
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then move = move + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then move = move - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end

        return move
    end

    local function step(dt)
        if not Fly.Enabled then return end

        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character then return end

        local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not root or not humanoid then return end

        local cf = Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
        local move = getMoveVector(cf, humanoid)

        if move.Magnitude > 0 then
            root.CFrame = root.CFrame + move.Unit * Fly.Speed * dt
        else
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * (root.CFrame - root.CFrame.Position)
        end

        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end

    function Fly.SetEnabled(state)
        Fly.Enabled = state and true or false
    end

    function Fly.SetSpeed(speed)
        Fly.Speed = speed
    end

    function Fly.Init()
        if connection then return end
        connection = RunService.PreRender:Connect(step)
    end

    function Fly.Destroy()
        Fly.Enabled = false
        if connection then
            connection:Disconnect()
            connection = nil
        end
    end

    ConfigStore.Fly = Fly
end

-- ================= ANTI-AIM / SPINBOT =================
do
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    local TAU = math.pi * 2

    local AntiAim = {
        Enabled = false,
        YawMode = "jitter",   -- jitter | spin | random
        YawAngle = 90,
        PitchMode = "none",   -- none | custom | random | down
        PitchAngle = 0,
        PitchOffset = 0,
        Installed = false,
        Jitter = false,
        -- wild spin rate (rad/s). 200+ = very fast thrash
        SpinSpeed = 220,
    }
    ConfigStore.AntiAim = AntiAim

    local function aaEncodeBytes(pitchRad, yawRad)
        local pb = math.clamp(math.floor((pitchRad % TAU) / TAU * 256 + 0.5), 0, 255)
        local yb = math.clamp(math.floor((yawRad % TAU) / TAU * 256 + 0.5), 0, 255)
        return utf8.char(pb) .. utf8.char(yb)
    end

    local function aaYaw()
        local mode = tostring(AntiAim.YawMode or "jitter"):lower()
        if mode == "spin" then
            return (os.clock() * (AntiAim.SpinSpeed or 220)) % TAU
        end
        if mode == "random" then
            return math.random() * TAU
        end
        AntiAim.Jitter = not AntiAim.Jitter
        return math.rad(AntiAim.Jitter and (AntiAim.YawAngle or 90) or -(AntiAim.YawAngle or 90))
    end

    local function aaPitch()
        local mode = tostring(AntiAim.PitchMode or "none"):lower()
        if mode == "custom" then return math.rad(AntiAim.PitchAngle or 0) end
        if mode == "random" then return (math.random() * 2 - 1) * math.pi end
        if mode == "down" then return math.rad(89) end
        return nil
    end

    local aaOrigEncode = nil
    local aaUtil = nil
    local aaCamRemote = nil
    local function aaInstall()
        if AntiAim.Installed then return end
        local okU, util = pcall(function() return require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility) end)
        if not okU or not util then return end
        aaUtil = util
        aaOrigEncode = util.EncodeCameraRotation
        util.EncodeCameraRotation = function(self, rot)
            if not AntiAim.Enabled then
                return aaOrigEncode(self, rot)
            end
            local yaw = aaYaw()
            local yb = math.floor((yaw % TAU) / TAU * 256) % 256
            -- "down" uses the original special high codepoint pitch (not clamped)
            if tostring(AntiAim.PitchMode or ""):lower() == "down" then
                return utf8.char(512 + (AntiAim.PitchOffset or 0)) .. utf8.char(yb)
            end
            local pitch = aaPitch()
            if pitch == nil then
                pitch = (typeof(rot) == "Vector2" and rot.X) or 0
            end
            return aaEncodeBytes(pitch, yaw)
        end
        pcall(function()
            aaCamRemote = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UpdateCameraRotation
        end)
        AntiAim.Installed = true
    end
    task.spawn(function() pcall(aaInstall) end)

    -- force camera packets every frame so spin/random/down actually apply
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not AntiAim.Enabled then return end
        if not AntiAim.Installed then pcall(aaInstall) end
        local yaw = aaYaw()
        local yb = math.floor((yaw % TAU) / TAU * 256) % 256
        local payload
        if tostring(AntiAim.PitchMode or ""):lower() == "down" then
            payload = utf8.char(512 + (AntiAim.PitchOffset or 0)) .. utf8.char(yb)
        else
            local pitch = aaPitch() or 0
            payload = aaEncodeBytes(pitch, yaw)
        end
        if aaCamRemote then
            pcall(function() aaCamRemote:FireServer(payload, nil) end)
        end
    end)

    local Spin = { Enabled = false, Speed = 15, Angle = 0 }
    ConfigStore.Spinbot = Spin
    local spinConn = RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
        if not Spin.Enabled or ConfigStore.Fly.Enabled then return end
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return end
        Spin.Angle = (Spin.Angle + Spin.Speed * 100) % 360   -- 100x: slider value is multiplied by 100
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Spin.Angle), 0)
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0)
    end)
    function Spin.Destroy()
        Spin.Enabled = false
        if spinConn then spinConn:Disconnect(); spinConn = nil end
    end
end

-- ================= CROSSHAIR =================
do
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
    local LocalPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

    local CH = {
        Enabled = false, Style = "cross + circle", Length = 10, Gap = 6, Thickness = 2,
        Color = PINK, Opacity = 0.95, Outline = true, OutlineThickness = 2,
        Spin = false, SpinSpeed = 90,
        Pulse = true, PulseAmount = 3, PulseSpeed = 1.2,
        Rainbow = false,
        Expand = false, ExpandAmount = 6,
        FollowMouse = false,
        Anchor = "Center", OffsetX = 0, OffsetY = 0,
        -- text under the crosshair
        TextEnabled = false, Text = "i am good", TextSize = 14, TextFont = "GothamBold", TextOpacity = 1,
        TextMode = "gradient",            -- solid | gradient | rainbow
        TextColor = WHITE, TextColor2 = PINK,
        TextGradSpeed = 1, TextGradAngle = 0,   -- speed 0 = static gradient
        TextOutline = true, TextOutlineColor = BLACK, TextOutlineThickness = 1,
        TextOffsetX = 0, TextOffsetY = 6,
    }
    ConfigStore.Crosshair = CH

    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "SolCrosshair"; gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true; gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.DisplayOrder = 9997; gui.Enabled = false
    gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

    local root = Instance.new("Frame")
    root.BackgroundTransparency = 1; root.BorderSizePixel = 0
    root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0); root.Parent = gui

    local function box(color)
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0; f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        f.BackgroundColor3 = color; f.Parent = root
        return f
    end

    -- cross: 4 segments (top, bottom, left, right), each with an outline behind it
    local dirs = { {0, -1}, {0, 1}, {-1, 0}, {1, 0} }
    local crossO, crossM = {}, {}
    for i = 1, 4 do
        crossO[i] = box(BLACK)
        crossM[i] = box(WHITE)
    end

    -- circle: UIStroke ring, outline ring behind it
    local function ring(color)
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.BackgroundTransparency = 1; f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); f.Parent = root
        local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0); c.Parent = f
        local st = Instance.new("UIStroke"); st.Color = color
        st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; st.Parent = f
        return f, st
    end
    local ringO, ringOStroke = ring(BLACK)
    local ringM, ringMStroke = ring(WHITE)

    local txt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    txt.BackgroundTransparency = 1; txt.BorderSizePixel = 0
    txt.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0); txt.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
    txt.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0); txt.Text = ""; txt.TextColor3 = WHITE
    txt.ZIndex = 5; txt.Visible = false; txt.Parent = gui
    local txtGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient"); txtGrad.Enabled = false; txtGrad.Parent = txt
    local txtStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    txtStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual; txtStroke.Parent = txt

    local spinAngle, moveAmt = 0, 0

    local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not CH.Enabled then
            gui.Enabled = false
            return
        end
        gui.Enabled = true

        local t = tick()

        -- spin (rotates every child with the root)
        if CH.Spin then spinAngle = (spinAngle + CH.SpinSpeed * dt) % 360 end
        root.Rotation = CH.Spin and spinAngle or 0

        -- expand while moving
        local target = 0
        if CH.Expand then
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                target = math.clamp(Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude / 16, 0, 1)
            end
        end
        moveAmt = moveAmt + (target - moveAmt) * math.min(1, dt * 10)

        -- pulse (sine wave between 0 and PulseAmount)
        local pulse = 0
        if CH.Pulse then
            pulse = (math.sin(t * CH.PulseSpeed * math.pi * 2) * 0.5 + 0.5) * CH.PulseAmount
        end

        local extra = pulse + moveAmt * (CH.Expand and CH.ExpandAmount or 0)
        local L = CH.Length + extra
        local G = CH.Gap + extra
        local T = CH.Thickness
        local O = CH.Outline and CH.OutlineThickness or 0
        local col = CH.Rainbow and Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.25) % 1, 1, 1) or CH.Color
        local alpha = 1 - CH.Opacity

        local showCross = CH.Style ~= "circle"
        local showCircle = CH.Style ~= "cross"

        -- cross
        for i, d in ipairs(dirs) do
            local vertical = d[1] == 0
            local w, h = vertical and T or L, vertical and L or T
            local d0 = G + L / 2
            local pos = UDim2.fromOffset(d[1] * d0, d[2] * d0)

            local o, m = crossO[i], crossM[i]
            o.Visible = showCross and CH.Outline
            m.Visible = showCross
            o.Position = pos; o.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w + 2 * O, h + 2 * O)
            o.BackgroundTransparency = alpha
            m.Position = pos; m.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
            m.BackgroundColor3 = col; m.BackgroundTransparency = alpha
        end

        -- circle
        local R = G + L / 2
        ringO.Visible = showCircle and CH.Outline
        ringM.Visible = showCircle
        ringO.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2 * R, 2 * R)
        ringM.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2 * R, 2 * R)
        ringOStroke.Thickness = T + 2 * O; ringOStroke.Transparency = alpha
        ringMStroke.Thickness = T; ringMStroke.Color = col; ringMStroke.Transparency = alpha

        -- position
        local px, py
        if CH.FollowMouse then
            local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
            px, py = m.X - inset.X, m.Y - inset.Y
        else
            local p = FovAnchor.Resolve(CH.Anchor, CH.OffsetX, CH.OffsetY)
            px, py = p.X, p.Y
        end
        root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px, py)

        -- text under the crosshair (same anchor / follow-mouse position as the crosshair)
        local showTxt = CH.TextEnabled and CH.Text ~= ""
        txt.Visible = showTxt
        if showTxt then
            if txt.Text ~= CH.Text then txt.Text = CH.Text end
            if txt.TextSize ~= CH.TextSize then txt.TextSize = CH.TextSize end
            local fOk, font = pcall(function() return Enum.Font[CH.TextFont] end)
            if fOk and font and txt.Font ~= font then txt.Font = font end
            local ta = 1 - CH.TextOpacity
            txt.TextTransparency = ta
            txtStroke.Enabled = CH.TextOutline
            txtStroke.Color = CH.TextOutlineColor
            txtStroke.Thickness = CH.TextOutlineThickness
            txtStroke.Transparency = ta

            local mode, c1, c2, spd = CH.TextMode, CH.TextColor, CH.TextColor2, CH.TextGradSpeed
            if mode == "solid" then
                txtGrad.Enabled = false
                txt.TextColor3 = c1
            else
                -- gradient multiplies the text color, so the label stays white under it
                txt.TextColor3 = WHITE
                txtGrad.Enabled = true
                txtGrad.Rotation = CH.TextGradAngle
                if mode == "rainbow" then
                    local kp = {}
                    for k = 0, 6 do
                        kp[#kp + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(k / 6, Color3.fromHSV((k / 6 + t * spd * 0.25) % 1, 1, 1))
                    end
                    txtGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(kp)
                    txtGrad.Offset = Vector2.zero
                elseif spd > 0 then
                    -- c1 -> c2 -> c1, swept across the text (both ends are c1 so the loop is seamless)
                    txtGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, c1), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, c2), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c1) })
                    txtGrad.Offset = Vector2.new(((t * spd * 0.5) % 2) - 1, 0)
                else
                    txtGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(c1, c2)
                    txtGrad.Offset = Vector2.zero
                end
            end

            -- bottom edge of the crosshair at max pulse / expand, so the text never bobs or overlaps
            local O2 = CH.Outline and CH.OutlineThickness or 0
            local ex = (CH.Pulse and CH.PulseAmount or 0) + (CH.Expand and CH.ExpandAmount or 0)
            local bottom
            if showCross then
                bottom = CH.Gap + CH.Length + O2 + ex * 2
            else
                bottom = CH.Gap + CH.Length / 2 + CH.Thickness / 2 + O2 + ex * 1.5
            end
            txt.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px + CH.TextOffsetX, py + bottom + CH.TextOffsetY)
        end
    end)

    CH.Destroy = function()
        CH.Enabled = false
        if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
        gui:Destroy()
    end
end

-- ================= CHAMS / SKELETON =================
do
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    local C = { Enabled = false, Color = WHITE, FillTransparency = 0.02, Material = "Neon", TeamCheck = true, Kind = "Highlight", Glow = true, GlowAmount = 4.2 }
    local S = { Enabled = false, Color = PINK, Color2 = WHITE, Gradient = true, Thickness = 2, TeamCheck = true, MaxDistance = 1000 }
    ConfigStore.Chams = C
    ConfigStore.Skeleton = S

    ConfigStore.SerializeBlock = function(tbl)
        local out = {}
        for k, v in pairs(tbl) do
            if typeof(v) == "Color3" then out[k] = { v.R, v.G, v.B }
            elseif type(v) ~= "function" then out[k] = v end
        end
        return out
    end
    ConfigStore.LoadBlock = function(tbl, src)
        for k, v in pairs(src) do
            if typeof(tbl[k]) == "Color3" and type(v) == "table" then
                tbl[k] = Color3.new(v[1] or 1, v[2] or 1, v[3] or 1)
            elseif tbl[k] ~= nil and type(tbl[k]) ~= "function" and type(tbl[k]) ~= "userdata" and type(tbl[k]) ~= "table" then
                tbl[k] = v
            end
        end
    end

    local function isEnemy(p, teamCheck)
        if p == LocalPlayer then return false end
        if teamCheck and p.Team and LocalPlayer.Team and p.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then return false end
        return true
    end

    -- ---------- CHAMS ----------
    local hls = {}      -- player -> Highlight
    local orig = {}     -- part -> { Material, Color } (restored when chams turn off)

    local function restoreParts()
        for part, o in pairs(orig) do
            if part.Parent then part.Material = o.Material; part.Color = o.Color end
        end
        table.clear(orig)
    end

    local function restoreChar(char)
        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            local o = orig[d]
            if o then d.Material = o.Material; d.Color = o.Color; orig[d] = nil end
        end
    end

    local function clearHighlight(plr)
        local hl = hls[plr]
        if hl then hl:Destroy() end
        hls[plr] = nil
    end

    local function applyChams(plr, char)
        local hl = hls[plr]
        if not hl or hl.Parent ~= char then
            clearHighlight(plr)
            hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.Name = "SolChams"; hl.Adornee = char; hl.Parent = char
            hls[plr] = hl
        end
        hl.FillColor = C.Color
        hl.FillTransparency = C.FillTransparency
        -- kicia's Kind: Highlight uses the highlight overlay, Legacy recolours the parts (neon); Glow draws an outline
        hl.OutlineColor = C.Color
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 1
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Enabled = C.Kind ~= "Legacy"
        local mat = C.Material
        if (mat and mat ~= "None") or C.Kind == "Legacy" then
            for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if not orig[d] then orig[d] = { Material = d.Material, Color = d.Color } end
                    d.Material = Enum.Material[(mat and mat ~= "None") and mat or "Neon"]
                    d.Color = C.Color
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- neon glow: a bloom pass so neon parts bleed light like the reference shot
    local glowFx
    local function setGlow(on)
        on = false -- glow removed: no bloom, so the screen is never washed out
        if on then
            if not glowFx or not glowFx.Parent then
                glowFx = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
                glowFx.Name = "SolChamsGlow"; glowFx.Intensity = 4.2; glowFx.Size = 72; glowFx.Threshold = 0.2
                glowFx.Parent = game:GetService("Lighting")
            end
            glowFx.Intensity = C.GlowAmount or 4.2
            glowFx.Size = 24 + (C.GlowAmount or 4.2) * 12
        elseif glowFx then
            glowFx:Destroy(); glowFx = nil
        end
    end

    local chamsRunning = true
    task.spawn(function()
        while chamsRunning do
            setGlow(C.Enabled and (C.Glow or C.Material == "Neon"))
            if C.Enabled then
                for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    local char = plr.Character
                    if char and isEnemy(plr, C.TeamCheck) then
                        applyChams(plr, char)
                    else
                        clearHighlight(plr)
                        if char then restoreChar(char) end
                    end
                end
                if not ((C.Material and C.Material ~= "None") or C.Kind == "Legacy") and next(orig) then restoreParts() end
            elseif next(hls) or next(orig) then
                for plr in pairs(hls) do clearHighlight(plr) end
                restoreParts()
            end
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
    end)

    -- ---------- SKELETON ----------
    local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    sg.Name = "SolSkeleton"; sg.IgnoreGuiInset = true; sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
    sg.DisplayOrder = 9996; sg.Enabled = false
    sg.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

    local R15 = {
        { "Head", "UpperTorso" }, { "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso" },
        { "UpperTorso", "LeftUpperArm" }, { "LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm" }, { "LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand" },
        { "UpperTorso", "RightUpperArm" }, { "RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm" }, { "RightLowerArm", "RightHand" },
        { "LowerTorso", "LeftUpperLeg" }, { "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg" }, { "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot" },
        { "LowerTorso", "RightUpperLeg" }, { "RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg" }, { "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot" },
    }
    local R6 = {
        { "Head", "Torso" }, { "Torso", "Left Arm" }, { "Torso", "Right Arm" },
        { "Torso", "Left Leg" }, { "Torso", "Right Leg" },
    }

    local skelLines = {}  -- player -> array of Frames

    local function getLines(plr)
        local t = skelLines[plr]
        if not t then t = {}; skelLines[plr] = t end
        return t
    end

    local function hideLines(plr)
        local t = skelLines[plr]
        if t then for _, f in ipairs(t) do f.Visible = false end end
    end

    local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not S.Enabled then
            sg.Enabled = false
            for plr in pairs(skelLines) do hideLines(plr) end
            return
        end
        sg.Enabled = true

        local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end

        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local ok = hum and root and hum.Health > 0 and isEnemy(plr, S.TeamCheck)
                and (root.Position - camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude <= S.MaxDistance

            if not ok then
                hideLines(plr)
            else
                local list = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") and R15 or R6
                local t = getLines(plr)
                for i, pr in ipairs(list) do
                    local f = t[i]
                    if not f then
                        f = Instance.new("Frame")
                        f.BorderSizePixel = 0; f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); f.Visible = false
                        f.ClipsDescendants = false
                        local g = Instance.new("UIGradient"); g.Parent = f; f:SetAttribute("gradientOn", false)
                        f.Parent = sg
                        t[i] = f
                    end
                    local a, b = char:FindFirstChild(pr[1]), char:FindFirstChild(pr[2])
                    local shown = false
                    if a and b then
                        local pa = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(a.Position)
                        local pb = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(b.Position)
                        if pa.Z > 0 and pb.Z > 0 then
                            local A, B = Vector2.new(pa.X, pa.Y), Vector2.new(pb.X, pb.Y)
                            local d = B - A
                            f.BackgroundColor3 = S.Color
                            local g = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
                            if g then g.Enabled = S.Gradient; g.Color = ColorSequence.new(S.Color, S.Color2) end
                            f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d.Magnitude, S.Thickness)
                            f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((A.X + B.X) / 2, (A.Y + B.Y) / 2)
                            f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(d.Y, d.X))
                            shown = true
                        end
                    end
                    f.Visible = shown
                end
                for i = #list + 1, #t do t[i].Visible = false end
            end
        end
    end)

    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
        clearHighlight(plr)
        local t = skelLines[plr]
        if t then for _, f in ipairs(t) do f:Destroy() end end
        skelLines[plr] = nil
    end)

    ConfigStore.Chams.Destroy = function()
        C.Enabled = false; S.Enabled = false
        chamsRunning = false
        setGlow(false)
        for plr in pairs(hls) do clearHighlight(plr) end
        restoreParts()
        if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
        sg:Destroy()
    end
end

-- ================= SOUL PARTICLES / CHARACTER AURA =================
do
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    local function isEnemy(p, teamCheck)
        if p == LocalPlayer then return false end
        if teamCheck and p.Team and LocalPlayer.Team and p.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then return false end
        return true
    end

    -- ---------- SOUL PARTICLES ----------
    local SP = { Enabled = false, Duration = 3, Color = Color3.fromRGB(190, 125, 255), TeamCheck = true }
    ConfigStore.Soul = SP

    local soulFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    soulFolder.Name = "SolSouls"
    soulFolder.Parent = Workspace
    local souls = {}

    local function clearSouls()
        for _, v in ipairs(souls) do
            if v.Model then v.Model:Destroy() end
        end
        table.clear(souls)
    end

    local function spawnSoul(char)
        if not SP.Enabled or not char or not char.Parent then return end
        local dur = math.clamp(tonumber(SP.Duration) or 3, 0.5, 6)
        local model = Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name = "Soul"
        model.Parent = soulFolder

        local parts = {}
        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Transparency < 0.95 and d.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                local ok, clone = pcall(function() return d:Clone() end)
                if ok and clone then
                    for _, c in ipairs(clone:GetChildren()) do
                        if not c:IsA("DataModelMesh") then c:Destroy() end
                    end
                    clone.Anchored = true
                    clone.CanCollide = false; clone.CanQuery = false; clone.CanTouch = false
                    clone.CastShadow = false; clone.Massless = true
                    clone.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                    clone.Color = SP.Color
                    clone.Transparency = 0.55
                    clone.Parent = model
                    parts[#parts + 1] = { Part = clone, Origin = clone.CFrame }
                end
            end
        end
        if #parts == 0 then
            model:Destroy()
            return
        end

        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
        hl.FillColor = SP.Color
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.35
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 1
        hl.Adornee = model
        hl.Parent = model

        while #souls >= 6 do
            local old = table.remove(souls, 1)
            if old.Model then old.Model:Destroy() end
        end
        souls[#souls + 1] = { Model = model, Parts = parts, Highlight = hl, StartedAt = os.clock(), Duration = dur }
    end

    local soulConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not SP.Enabled then
            if #souls > 0 then clearSouls() end
            return
        end
        if #souls == 0 then return end
        local now = os.clock()
        for i = #souls, 1, -1 do
            local v = souls[i]
            local n = math.clamp((now - v.StartedAt) / v.Duration, 0, 1)
            if n >= 1 or not v.Model.Parent then
                v.Model:Destroy()
                table.remove(souls, i)
            else
                local rise = n * 5
                for _, p in ipairs(v.Parts) do
                    if p.Part.Parent then
                        p.Part.CFrame = p.Origin + Vector3.new(0, rise, 0)
                        p.Part.Transparency = 0.55 + n * 0.45
                    end
                end
                v.Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.35 + n * 0.65
            end
        end
    end)

    -- watch every other player's humanoid and spawn a soul when an enemy dies
    local function watchPlayer(plr)
        local function onChar(char)
            task.spawn(function()
                local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
                if not hum then return end
                hum.Died:Connect(function()
                    if SP.Enabled and isEnemy(plr, SP.TeamCheck) then
                        spawnSoul(char)
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end
        plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(onChar)
        if plr.Character then onChar(plr.Character) end
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then watchPlayer(p) end
    end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then watchPlayer(p) end
    end)

    SP.Destroy = function()
        SP.Enabled = false
        clearSouls()
        if soulConn then soulConn:Disconnect(); soulConn = nil end
        soulFolder:Destroy()
    end

    -- ---------- CHARACTER AURA ----------
    local CA = { Enabled = false, AssetId = "", Selected = { "starlight" }, Color = Color3.fromRGB(190, 125, 255), ColorOverride = false }
    ConfigStore.Aura = CA
    local AURA_PRESET_ORDER = { "starlight", "heavenly", "slot 3", "sakura", "angel", "wind", "flow", "star", "napoleon hat", "skibidi redrizz" }
    local AURA_PRESET_IDS = {
        starlight = "134645216613107", heavenly = "139300897520961", ["slot 3"] = "132069507632161",
        sakura = "81755778619404", angel = "97658130917593", wind = "80694081850877",
        flow = "119913533725648", star = "73754563740680", ["napoleon hat"] = "10758794",
    }
    ConfigStore.AuraPresetOrder = AURA_PRESET_ORDER

    local templates = {}
    local auraEntries = {}
    local auraConn

    local function clearAura()
        for _, e in ipairs(auraEntries) do
            if e.Clone then pcall(function() e.Clone:Destroy() end) end
        end
        table.clear(auraEntries)
        if auraConn then auraConn:Disconnect(); auraConn = nil end
    end

    local function loadTemplate(id)
        if id == nil or id == "" then return nil end
        if templates[id] ~= nil then return templates[id] or nil end
        local ok, res = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. id) end)
        if not ok or type(res) ~= "table" or not res[1] then
            warn("[aura] could not load asset " .. tostring(id))
            templates[id] = false
            return nil
        end
        local m = res[1]
        for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BaseScript") then d:Destroy() end
        end
        templates[id] = m
        return m
    end

    -- decorations only (emitters, trails, beams, lights, attachments): parented onto the matching body part,
    -- so no physics part is ever added to or moved on the rig
    local AURA_KINDS = { Attachment = true, ParticleEmitter = true, Trail = true, Beam = true, PointLight = true, SpotLight = true, SurfaceLight = true }

    local function resolveAuraIds()
        local ids, seen = {}, {}
        for _, name in ipairs(CA.Selected or {}) do
            local id = AURA_PRESET_IDS[name]
            if id and not seen[id] then seen[id] = true; ids[#ids + 1] = id end
        end
        if CA.AssetId ~= "" and not seen[CA.AssetId] then ids[#ids + 1] = CA.AssetId end
        return ids
    end

    local function applyOne(template, char)
        for _, part in ipairs(template:GetChildren()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                local target = char:FindFirstChild(part.Name)
                if not target or not target:IsA("BasePart") then
                    target = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                end
                if target then
                    for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                        if AURA_KINDS[child.ClassName] then
                            local c = child:Clone()
                            if CA.ColorOverride then
                                for _, d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                                    if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Beam") then
                                        d.Color = ColorSequence.new(CA.Color)
                                    elseif d:IsA("PointLight") or d:IsA("SpotLight") or d:IsA("SurfaceLight") then
                                        d.Color = CA.Color
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            c.Parent = target
                            auraEntries[#auraEntries + 1] = { Clone = c }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- built-in presets with no asset id: emitters are made in code (set from Auras.txt)
    local PROC_AURA = {}
    PROC_AURA["skibidi redrizz"] = function(char)
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return end
        local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
        att.Name = "SolRedRizz"
        att.Parent = root
        local defs = {
            { Name = "Healing Wave 1", Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.5, 1.5), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(10, -10), LockedToPart = true,
              Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.1702454, 0.7, 0.014881), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2254601, 0.03125, 0.03125), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2852761, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.702454, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8374233, 0.9125, 0.0601461), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
              LightEmission = 0.4, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(234, 8, 255)), VelocitySpread = 10, Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 6), Brightness = 10,
              Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 3.0624998, 1.8805969), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6420546, 1.9999999, 1.7619393), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.7499999, 0.7499999) }),
              Rate = 20, Texture = "rbxassetid://8047533775", RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(200, 400), Rotation = NumberRange.new(-180, 180),
              Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular },
            { Name = "Healing Wave 2", Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.5, 1.5), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(10, -10), LockedToPart = true,
              Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2254601, 0.03125, 0.03125), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6288344, 0.25625, 0.0593491), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8374233, 0.9125, 0.0601461), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
              LightEmission = 1, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(238, 3, 255)), VelocitySpread = 10, Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 5), Brightness = 10,
              Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 3.125), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4165329, 1.3749999, 1.3749999), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.9375, 0.9375) }),
              Rate = 20, Texture = "rbxassetid://8047796070", RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(100, 300), Rotation = NumberRange.new(-180, 180),
              Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular },
            { Name = "Sparks", Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 2), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, -180), LightEmission = 1,
              Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 21, 255)), Drag = 3, VelocitySpread = 180, Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 15), Brightness = 10,
              Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.14687, 0.4374999, 0.1875001), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
              Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), ZOffset = -1, Rate = 40, Texture = "rbxassetid://8611887361",
              RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-30, 30), Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityParallel },
            { Name = "Star Sparks", Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.5, 1.5), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, -180), LightEmission = 1,
              Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(226, 60, 255)), Drag = 3, VelocitySpread = 180, Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10), Brightness = 10,
              Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.1492777, 0.6874996, 0.6874996), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
              Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), ZOffset = 2, Texture = "rbxassetid://8611887703",
              RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-30, 30), Rotation = NumberRange.new(-30, 30) },
        }
        for _, p in ipairs(defs) do
            local em = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
            for k, v in pairs(p) do em[k] = v end
            if CA.ColorOverride then em.Color = ColorSequence.new(CA.Color) end
            em.Parent = att
        end
        auraEntries[#auraEntries + 1] = { Clone = att }
    end

    local function applyAura(char)
        clearAura()
        if not CA.Enabled or not char or not char.Parent then return end
        for _, name in ipairs(CA.Selected or {}) do
            local build = PROC_AURA[name]
            if build and char == LocalPlayer.Character then build(char) end
        end
        for _, id in ipairs(resolveAuraIds()) do
            local template = loadTemplate(id)
            if char ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
            if template then
                applyOne(template, char)
                -- accessories (hats) are added to the humanoid instead of body-part decorations
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local accs = template:IsA("Accessory") and { template } or {}
                for _, d in ipairs(template:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("Accessory") then accs[#accs + 1] = d end
                end
                if hum then
                    for _, a in ipairs(accs) do
                        local c = a:Clone()
                        if pcall(function() hum:AddAccessory(c) end) then
                            auraEntries[#auraEntries + 1] = { Clone = c }
                        else
                            pcall(function() c:Destroy() end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    CA.Refresh = function()
        task.spawn(function() applyAura(LocalPlayer.Character) end)
    end
    CA.Destroy = function()
        CA.Enabled = false
        clearAura()
    end

    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.spawn(function()
            char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
            task.wait(0.2)
            applyAura(char)
        end)
    end)
end

-- ================= SPOOFERS / GAME HITMARKER =================
do
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    -- local attribute overrides; original value is captured once and restored on toggle off
    local Spoof = {
        Level = { Enabled = false, Value = 9, Attr = "Level", Captured = false, Original = nil },
        Streak = { Enabled = false, Value = 99, Attr = "StatisticDuelsWinStreak", Captured = false, Original = nil },
    }
    ConfigStore.Spoof = Spoof

    local function applySpoof(s)
        if s.Enabled then
            if not s.Captured then
                s.Original = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(s.Attr)
                s.Captured = true
            end
            LocalPlayer:SetAttribute(s.Attr, s.Value)
        elseif s.Captured then
            LocalPlayer:SetAttribute(s.Attr, s.Original)
            s.Captured = false
            s.Original = nil
        end
    end

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        applySpoof(Spoof.Level)
        applySpoof(Spoof.Streak)
    end)

end

-- cosmetics (skins / charms / wraps) live in UnlockState, so profiles carry them too
local function cosSerialize()
    local out = {}
    for weapon, cosmetics in pairs(UnlockState.Equipped) do
        local w = {}
        for ctype, d in pairs(cosmetics) do
            if type(d) == "table" and d.Name then
                w[ctype] = { name = d.Name, seed = d.Seed, inverted = d.Inverted }
            end
        end
        if next(w) then out[weapon] = w end
    end
    return out
end

local function cosApply(data)
    if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
    -- an empty cosmetics block does nothing unless the hooks are already running,
    -- so a boot-time load can't wipe the unlockall file
    if next(data) == nil and not UnlockAll.Enabled then return end
    if not UnlockAll.Enabled then pcall(startUnlockAll) end
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        local mods = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules", 10)
        local CL = require(mods:WaitForChild("CosmeticLibrary", 10))
        local EL = require(mods:WaitForChild("EnumLibrary", 10))
        local equipped = {}
        for weapon, cosmetics in pairs(data) do
            if type(cosmetics) == "table" then
                for ctype, d in pairs(cosmetics) do
                    if type(d) == "table" and d.name then
                        local c = uaCloneCosmetic(CL, EL, d.name, ctype, { inverted = d.inverted })
                        if c then
                            c.Seed = d.seed or c.Seed
                            equipped[weapon] = equipped[weapon] or {}
                            equipped[weapon][ctype] = c
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        UnlockState.Equipped = equipped
    end)
    if not ok then warn("[config] cosmetics load failed: " .. tostring(err)); return end
    uaSaveConfig()
    pcall(function()
        local DC = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.PlayerDataController)
        DC.CurrentData:Replicate("WeaponInventory")
    end)
end

local function saveConfigAll(force, path)
    if not writefile then return end
    if ConfigStore.Loading then return end
    if not force and not ConfigStore.Autoload then return end
    local okSave, errSave = pcall(function()
        local data = { version = 3, flags = ConfigStore.SerializeFlags(), extra = {} }
        local okC, cos = pcall(cosSerialize)
        if okC then data.extra.cosmetics = cos end
        if ConfigStore.GunSkin then data.extra.skins = ConfigStore.GunSkin.Slots end
        if ConfigStore.ThemeGet then data.extra.theme = ConfigStore.ThemeGet() end
        if isfolder and makefolder and not isfolder("argon") then makefolder("argon") end
        if path and isfolder and makefolder then
            for _, d in ipairs({ "ArgonLose", "ArgonLose/configs" }) do
                if not isfolder(d) then makefolder(d) end
            end
        end
        writefile(path or ConfigStore.File, HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
    end)
    if not okSave then warn("[config] save failed: " .. tostring(errSave)) end
end

local function loadConfigAll(path)
    local target = path or ConfigStore.File
    if not readfile or not isfile or not isfile(target) then return false end
    local okDecode, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(target)) end)
    if not okDecode or type(data) ~= "table" then
        warn("[config] could not read " .. tostring(target))
        return false
    end
    ConfigStore.Loading = true
    local okFlags, errFlags = pcall(ConfigStore.ApplyFlags, data.flags)
    if not okFlags then warn("[config] flags failed: " .. tostring(errFlags)) end
    local extra = (type(data.extra) == "table" and data.extra) or data
    if extra.cosmetics then pcall(cosApply, extra.cosmetics) end
    if type(extra.skins) == "table" and ConfigStore.GunSkin then ConfigStore.GunSkin.Slots = extra.skins end
    if extra.theme and ConfigStore.ApplyThemeSaved then pcall(ConfigStore.ApplyThemeSaved, extra.theme) end
    ConfigStore.Loading = false
    return true
end

-- ================= HIT STAR + ASPECT RATIO =================
-- star: grows on the ragebot's target every time it takes damage, explodes on kill
local StarCfg = { Enabled = false, Base = 16, Step = 5, Max = 140, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180) }
local starClearAll
-- aspect: letterbox / pillarbox the view to a fixed ratio
local AspectCfg = { Ratio = "Off" }
local AspectRatios = { ["4:3"] = 4 / 3, ["5:4"] = 5 / 4, ["16:9"] = 16 / 9, ["16:10"] = 16 / 10, ["21:9"] = 21 / 9, ["1:1"] = 1 }

do
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local TweenSvc = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

    local Track = {}     -- [Player] = { char, hp, hits, star, dead }
    local RageOn = {}    -- [Player] = os.clock() of last tick the ragebot had them as target

    -- screen-space reticle: a ring + star pinned to the target's hitbox head every frame
    local starGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    starGui.Name = "ArgonStarGui"; starGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true; starGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    starGui.DisplayOrder = 9996
    starGui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
    local reticles = {}   -- [Frame] = part it tracks

    local function projectPart(part)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam or not part or not part.Parent then return nil end
        local p = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if p.Z <= 0 then return nil end
        return Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y)
    end

    local function makeStar(part, size, color)
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.Name = "ArgonStar"
        f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
        f.Visible = false
        f.Parent = starGui
        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner"); corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0); corner.Parent = f
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke"); stroke.Color = color; stroke.Thickness = 2; stroke.Parent = f
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        lbl.Text = "\u{2605}"
        lbl.TextScaled = true
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lbl.TextColor3 = color
        lbl.Parent = f
        reticles[f] = part
        return f
    end

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        for f, part in pairs(reticles) do
            if not f.Parent then
                reticles[f] = nil
            else
                local sp = projectPart(part)
                if sp then
                    f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sp.X, sp.Y)
                    f.Visible = true
                else
                    f.Visible = false
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    local function explode(part, color)
        local sp = projectPart(part)
        if not sp then return end
        local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
        holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        holder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sp.X, sp.Y)
        holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 320)
        holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        holder.Parent = starGui

        local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
        ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        ring.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
        ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        ring.Parent = holder
        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner"); corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0); corner.Parent = ring
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke"); stroke.Color = color; stroke.Thickness = 3; stroke.Parent = ring
        TweenSvc:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 300) }):Play()
        TweenSvc:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()

        for i = 1, 14 do
            local a = (i / 14) * math.pi * 2 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3
            local d = 90 + math.random() * 50
            local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            lbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            lbl.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            lbl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)
            lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            lbl.Text = "\u{2605}"
            lbl.TextSize = 22
            lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            lbl.TextColor3 = color
            lbl.Parent = holder
            TweenSvc:Create(lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(a) * d, 0.5, math.sin(a) * d),
                TextTransparency = 1,
            }):Play()
        end
        task.delay(0.8, function() holder:Destroy() end)
    end

    local function dropStar(r)
        if r and r.star then r.star:Destroy(); r.star = nil end
    end

    starClearAll = function()
        for _, r in pairs(Track) do dropStar(r) end
        table.clear(Track)
    end

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local now = os.clock()
        local rt = RB_TARGET()
        if rt then RageOn[rt] = now end

        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP then
                local char = p.Character
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local r = Track[p]
                if not r or r.char ~= char then
                    dropStar(r)
                    r = { char = char, hp = hum and hum.Health or 0, hits = 0, star = nil, dead = false }
                    Track[p] = r
                end
                if hum and not r.dead and StarCfg.Enabled then
                    local hp = hum.Health
                    local head = char:FindFirstChild("HitboxHead") or char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    local attributed = RageOn[p] and (now - RageOn[p]) < 1.0
                    if hp <= 0 and r.hp > 0 then
                        r.dead = true
                        if attributed then
                            dropStar(r)
                            explode(head, StarCfg.Color)
                        end
                    elseif hp > 0 and hp < r.hp and attributed and head then
                        r.hits += 1
                        local size = math.min(StarCfg.Base + r.hits * StarCfg.Step, StarCfg.Max)
                        if r.star and r.star.Parent then
                            r.star.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
                            reticles[r.star] = head
                        else
                            dropStar(r)
                            r.star = makeStar(head, size, StarCfg.Color)
                        end
                    end
                    r.hp = hp
                elseif hum then
                    r.hp = hum.Health
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- aspect ratio: black bars around the viewport
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "ArgonAspect"
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.DisplayOrder = 900
    gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

    local function bar()
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        f.Visible = false
        f.Parent = gui
        return f
    end
    local top, bottom, left, right = bar(), bar(), bar(), bar()

    local function hideBars()
        top.Visible, bottom.Visible, left.Visible, right.Visible = false, false, false, false
    end

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local r = AspectRatios[AspectCfg.Ratio]
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not r or not cam then hideBars(); return end
        local vw, vh = cam.ViewportSize.X, cam.ViewportSize.Y
        if vw <= 0 or vh <= 0 then return end
        local cur = vw / vh
        if math.abs(cur - r) < 0.001 then hideBars(); return end
        if cur > r then
            local w = math.floor((vw - vh * r) / 2)
            left.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0); left.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, vh)
            right.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(vw - w, 0); right.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, vh)
            left.Visible, right.Visible = true, true
            top.Visible, bottom.Visible = false, false
        else
            local h = math.floor((vh - vw / r) / 2)
            top.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0); top.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(vw, h)
            bottom.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, vh - h); bottom.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(vw, h)
            top.Visible, bottom.Visible = true, true
            left.Visible, right.Visible = false, false
        end
    end)
end

-- ================= UI =================
do
    -- ===== counters (ue + nebula), ported from counters.txt =====
    local CTR = { ue = nil, nebula = nil, savedPos = nil, ueLast = 0, nebLast = 0,
        UeYPer = 100, UeInterval = 0.05, EvadeMin = 100, EvadeMax = 150, NebHeight = 15 }
    local function ctrHRP()
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    local function ctrValid(v)
        return v.X == v.X and math.abs(v.X) < 1e7 and math.abs(v.Y) < 1e7 and math.abs(v.Z) < 1e7
    end
    local function ctrZeroVel(part)
        part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end
    local function ctrRingPos(origin, minR, maxR)
        local a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
        local r = minR + math.random() * (maxR - minR)
        return origin + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, 0, math.sin(a) * r)
    end
    local function ctrStartUe()
        if CTR.ue then return end
        CTR.ue = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            local hrp = ctrHRP()
            if not hrp then return end
            pcall(tbShoot, tbFighter())
            local now = tick()
            if now - CTR.ueLast < CTR.UeInterval then return end
            CTR.ueLast = now
            hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, CTR.UeYPer, 0)
        end)
    end
    local function ctrStopUe()
        if CTR.ue then CTR.ue:Disconnect(); CTR.ue = nil end
    end
    local function ctrStartNebula()
        if CTR.nebula then return end
        local hrp = ctrHRP()
        CTR.savedPos = hrp and hrp.CFrame or nil
        local CS = game:GetService("CollectionService")
        local rng = Random.new()
        CTR.nebula = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local root = ctrHRP()
            if not root then return end
            local now = tick()
            if now - CTR.nebLast < 0.1 then return end
            CTR.nebLast = now
            local dest
            for _, v in CS:GetTagged("OutOfBoundsPart") do
                if v:GetAttribute("KillDelay") == 0 then
                    dest = v.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, v.Size.Y / 2 + CTR.NebHeight, 0)
                    break
                end
            end
            if not dest then
                local p = ctrRingPos(root.Position, CTR.EvadeMin, CTR.EvadeMax)
                local x, y, z = p.X, p.Y, p.Z
                local pick = rng:NextInteger(1, 3)
                if pick == 1 then x = 1073741824
                elseif pick == 2 then y = 1073741824
                else z = 1073741824 end
                dest = CFrame.new(x, y, z)
            end
            local pos = dest.Position
            if not ctrValid(pos) then return end
            ctrZeroVel(root)
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
            ctrZeroVel(root)
        end)
    end
    local function ctrStopNebula()
        if CTR.nebula then CTR.nebula:Disconnect(); CTR.nebula = nil end
        local root = ctrHRP()
        if root and CTR.savedPos then root.CFrame = CTR.savedPos end
        CTR.savedPos = nil
    end
    getgenv().startUeCounter = ctrStartUe
    getgenv().stopUeCounter = ctrStopUe
    getgenv().startNebulaCounter = ctrStartNebula
    getgenv().stopNebulaCounter = ctrStopNebula

-- ================= AUTO SHOOT (xylo) =================
-- replaces the old automatic fire. fires the equipped gun at the nearest target (sFind) every frame
ConfigStore.AutoShoot = { Enabled = false, AutoReload = true }
do
    local AS = ConfigStore.AutoShoot
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local util, enums
    pcall(function()
        local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        util = require(rs.Modules.Utility)
        enums = require(rs.Modules.EnumLibrary)
    end)

    local function useItemRemote()
        local ok, r = pcall(function() return ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UseItem end)
        return ok and r or nil
    end

    local function equippedItem()
        local ok, fc = pcall(function() return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController) end)
        if not ok or not fc then return nil end
        local lf = fc.LocalFighter or (fc.GetFighter and fc:GetFighter(LocalPlayer))
        return lf and lf.EquippedItem
    end

    local function shotData(fromPos, part)
        local v = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
        local lead = math.clamp(v.Magnitude / 350, 0, 0.12)
        local aim = part.Position + v * lead
        local look = CFrame.new(fromPos, aim)
        local data = {}
        data[utf8.char(1)] = {
            [utf8.char(0)] = util:EncodeCFrame(look),
            [utf8.char(1)] = util:EncodeCFrame(look),
            [utf8.char(2)] = part,
            [utf8.char(3)] = util:EncodeCFrame(part.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(aim))),
        }
        return data
    end

    local warned = false
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not AS.Enabled then return end
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            local item = equippedItem()
            if not item then return end
            local objectId = item.Get and item:Get("ObjectID")
            local remote = useItemRemote()
            if not objectId or not remote or not util or not enums then return end
            if AS.AutoReload and item.Get and item:Get("Ammo") == 0 then
                remote:FireServer(objectId, enums:ToEnum("Reload"), nil, nil)
                return
            end
            local target = sFind()
            local head = target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if not head then return end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local from = cam and cam.CFrame.Position or head.Position
            remote:FireServer(objectId, enums:ToEnum("StartShooting"), shotData(from, head), nil)
        end)
        if not ok and not warned then
            warned = true
            warn("[auto shoot] " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end)
end

-- ================= GUN CHAMS =================
-- colours the local viewmodel's gun parts, cycling between Color and Color2. restores the originals when off
ConfigStore.GunChams = { Enabled = false, Color = WHITE, Color2 = PINK, Material = "Neon", CycleSpeed = 1 }
do
    local GC = ConfigStore.GunChams
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local saved = {}
    local warned = false

    -- first-person gun model: the local fighter's equipped item's view model (same path the viewmodel hooks use)
    local function localViewModel()
        local ok, fc = pcall(function() return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController) end)
        local lf = ok and fc and (fc.LocalFighter or (fc.GetFighter and fc:GetFighter(LocalPlayer))) or nil
        local item = lf and lf.EquippedItem
        local vm = item and item.ViewModel and item.ViewModel.ItemModel
        if vm and vm.Parent then return vm end
        local vms = workspace:FindFirstChild("ViewModels")
        if not vms then return nil end
        local prefix = LocalPlayer.Name .. " - "
        for _, m in ipairs(vms:GetChildren()) do
            if m:IsA("Model") and string.sub(m.Name, 1, #prefix) == prefix then return m end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function restore()
        for part, o in pairs(saved) do
            if part.Parent then part.Material = o.Material; part.Color = o.Color end
        end
        saved = {}
    end

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not GC.Enabled then
            if next(saved) then restore() end
            return
        end
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            local vm = localViewModel()
            if not vm then
                if next(saved) then restore() end
                return
            end
            local t = (tick() * GC.CycleSpeed) % 2
            local k = t <= 1 and t or (2 - t)
            local col = GC.Color:Lerp(GC.Color2, k)
            local mat = Enum.Material[GC.Material] or Enum.Material.Neon
            for _, d in ipairs(vm:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if not saved[d] then saved[d] = { Material = d.Material, Color = d.Color } end
                    d.Material = mat
                    d.Color = col
                end
            end
        end)
        if not ok and not warned then
            warned = true
            warn("[gun chams] " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end)
end
