-- ================= CHARACTER TAB =================
do
    local AnimationPlayer = { Enabled = false }
    local Anim = { Value = "Floss" }
    local CustomAnimation = { Value = "" }
    local AnimationSpeed = { Value = 1 }
    local AnimationStart = { Value = 0 }
    local AnimationEnd = { Value = 100 }
    local CurrentTrack, CurrentAnimation, CurrentHumanoid, CurrentAnimator
    local ReplayToken, LastReplay = 0, 0

    local animations = {
        ["Bodybuilder"]="3994130516",["Crawling in a Circle"]="116935126100338",["Dolphin Dance"]="5938365243",["Dance"]="507771019",
        ["Dance Break"]="94258912028011",["French Confidence"]="116968182519797",["Floss"]="72174079036035",["Frosty Flair"]="10214406616",
        ["Full Wiggle"]="86520127496722",["Ghost Floating"]="75911227509248",["Gun"]="81100102810594",["Gangnam Style"]="78801539668900",
        ["Hip Bounce"]="123602332785269",["Hype Dance"]="93079641847306",["Kicking Feet"]="109814083870185",["Line Dance"]="4049646104",
        ["Lay Floating"]="126579240140537",["Let's Drive"]="17360720445",["Long Legs"]="82416741608012",["Rock Out"]="18225077553",
        ["Samba"]="6869813008",["Still Standing"]="11435177473",["Spiral"]="81926730031709",["Solar System"]="118314972618293",
        ["Twirl"]="3716633898",["Take Me Under"]="6797938823",["The Worm"]="99563207397301",["Take the L"]="110664723286332",
        ["Zesty"]="102901317133934",
    }

    local animationList = {"Bodybuilder","Custom","Crawling in a Circle","Dolphin Dance","Dance","Dance Break","French Confidence","Floss","Frosty Flair","Full Wiggle","Ghost Floating","Gun","Gangnam Style","Hip Bounce","Hype Dance","Kicking Feet","Line Dance","Lay Floating","Let's Drive","Long Legs","Rock Out","Samba","Still Standing","Spiral","Solar System","Twirl","Take Me Under","The Worm","Take the L","Zesty"}

    local function stopAnimation()
        ReplayToken += 1
        if CurrentTrack then pcall(CurrentTrack.Stop, CurrentTrack, 0.1); pcall(CurrentTrack.Destroy, CurrentTrack); CurrentTrack = nil end
        if CurrentAnimation then CurrentAnimation:Destroy(); CurrentAnimation = nil end
        CurrentHumanoid, CurrentAnimator = nil, nil
    end

    local function selectedId()
        if Anim.Value == "Custom" then return CustomAnimation.Value and tostring(CustomAnimation.Value):match("%d+") end
        return animations[Anim.Value]
    end

    local function loadCatalogEmote(humanoid, animator, id)
        local description = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("HumanoidDescription")
        if not description then return nil end
        local emoteName = "LionAnimationPlayer"
        local captured
        local connection = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track) captured = track end)
        local ok = pcall(function()
            pcall(description.RemoveEmote, description, emoteName)
            description:AddEmote(emoteName, tonumber(id))
            humanoid:PlayEmote(emoteName)
        end)
        local timeout = os.clock() + 2
        while ok and not captured and os.clock() < timeout do RunService.Heartbeat:Wait() end
        connection:Disconnect()
        return captured
    end

    local function playSelected()
        if not AnimationPlayer.Enabled then return end
        local id = selectedId()
        if not id or id == "" then stopAnimation(); return end
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid then return end
        local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if not animator then return end
        stopAnimation()
        ReplayToken += 1
        local token = ReplayToken
        local track, animation
        if Anim.Value ~= "Custom" then track = loadCatalogEmote(humanoid, animator, id)
        else
            animation = Instance.new("Animation")
            animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
            local ok; ok, track = pcall(animator.LoadAnimation, animator, animation)
            if not ok then track = nil end
        end
        if not track then if animation then animation:Destroy() end return end
        CurrentAnimation, CurrentTrack, CurrentHumanoid, CurrentAnimator = animation, track, humanoid, animator
        LastReplay = os.clock()
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
        track.Looped = true
        track:Play(0.1, 1, AnimationSpeed.Value)
        task.spawn(function()
            while token == ReplayToken and CurrentTrack == track and AnimationPlayer.Enabled do
                local length = track.Length
                local sp, ep = AnimationStart.Value, AnimationEnd.Value
                if ep <= sp then ep = math.min(100, sp + 1) end
                if length > 0 then
                    local s = length * sp / 100
                    local e = length * ep / 100
                    if track.TimePosition < s or track.TimePosition >= e then track.TimePosition = s end
                end
                if not track.IsPlaying then track:Play(0.05, 1, AnimationSpeed.Value) end
                track:AdjustSpeed(AnimationSpeed.Value)
                track:AdjustWeight(1, 0)
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
        end)
    end

    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.spawn(function()
            local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
            if not humanoid then return end
            humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 10)
            if LocalPlayer.Character ~= character then return end
            task.wait(0.5)
            if AnimationPlayer.Enabled then playSelected() end
        end)
    end)

    LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
        if LocalPlayer.Character == character then stopAnimation() end
    end)

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not AnimationPlayer.Enabled or os.clock() - LastReplay < 1 then return end
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        local trackValid = false
        if CurrentTrack then trackValid = pcall(function() return CurrentTrack.IsPlaying end) end
        if humanoid and animator and (humanoid ~= CurrentHumanoid or animator ~= CurrentAnimator or not CurrentTrack or not trackValid) then
            LastReplay = os.clock()
            task.spawn(playSelected)
        end
    end)

    local AnimGB = mkGB(Tabs.Character, "L", "Animation Player", "play")
    if AnimGB then
        sAdd(AnimGB, "AddToggle", "anim_enabled", { Text = "enabled", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) AnimationPlayer.Enabled = v; if v then playSelected() else stopAnimation() end end })
        sAdd(AnimGB, "AddDropdown", "anim_anim", { Values = animationList, Default = "Floss", Text = "animation",
            Callback = function(v) Anim.Value = v; playSelected() end })
        sAdd(AnimGB, "AddInput", "anim_custom", { Text = "custom animation", Default = "", Placeholder = "id... (ex: 4049646104)",
            Callback = function(v) CustomAnimation.Value = v; if Anim.Value == "Custom" then playSelected() end end })
        sAdd(AnimGB, "AddSlider", "anim_speed", { Text = "speed", Min = 0.1, Max = 5, Default = 1, Rounding = 10,
            Callback = function(v) AnimationSpeed.Value = v; if CurrentTrack then CurrentTrack:AdjustSpeed(v) end end })
        sAdd(AnimGB, "AddSlider", "anim_start", { Text = "start", Min = 0, Max = 99, Default = 0, Rounding = 1, Suffix = "%",
            Callback = function(v) AnimationStart.Value = v end })
        sAdd(AnimGB, "AddSlider", "anim_end", { Text = "end", Min = 1, Max = 100, Default = 100, Rounding = 1, Suffix = "%",
            Callback = function(v) AnimationEnd.Value = v end })
    end
end

do
(function()
    local CharacterMovement = { Enabled = false }
    local VelocityEnabled = { Enabled = false }
    local VelocitySpeed = { Value = 50 }
    local SlideBoostEnabled = { Enabled = false }
    local SlideBoostValue = { Value = 1 }
    local DoubleJumpHeightEnabled = { Enabled = false }
    local DoubleJumpHeightValue = { Value = 1 }
    local MaulSlamEnabled = { Enabled = false }
    local MaulSlamValue = { Value = 1 }
    local InfiniteDoubleJump = { Enabled = false }

    local state = { Mechanics=nil, OldSlide=nil, OldDoubleJump=nil, OldHighJump=nil, Hooked=false, HookedMechanics=nil, SlideOriginals={}, ItemOriginals={}, LastSlidingAt=0 }
    local hbConn, charConn

    local function getMechanics()
        if state.Mechanics then return state.Mechanics end
        local ok, mech = pcall(function() return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.MechanicsController) end)
        if ok and mech then state.Mechanics = mech; return mech end
    end

    local function getRootHumanoid()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end

    local function getLocalFighter()
        local mech = getMechanics()
        return mech and mech.LocalFighter
    end

    local function isAirborne(hum, root)
        if not hum then return false end
        local s = hum:GetState()
        if s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding then return true end
        if hum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then return true end
        return root and math.abs(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) > 3 or false
    end

    local function isSliding(hum)
        local mech = getMechanics()
        if mech and mech.IsSliding then state.LastSlidingAt = os.clock(); return true end
        local fighter = mech and mech.LocalFighter or getLocalFighter()
        if fighter and fighter.IsSlidingLocally then state.LastSlidingAt = os.clock(); return true end
        if fighter and type(fighter.Get) == "function" then
            for _, key in ipairs({"IsSliding","SlidingActive"}) do
                local ok, value = pcall(function() return fighter:Get(key) end)
                if ok and value then state.LastSlidingAt = os.clock(); return true end
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function applyMovementVelocity()
        if not CharacterMovement.Enabled or not VelocityEnabled.Enabled then return false end
        local root, hum = getRootHumanoid()
        if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
        local sliding = isSliding(hum)
        local airborne = isAirborne(hum, root)
        local slideGrace = os.clock() - (state.LastSlidingAt or 0) < 0.35
        if sliding then return false end
        local move = hum.MoveDirection
        if move.Magnitude > 0.1 then
            local dir = Vector3.new(move.X, 0, move.Z).Unit
            local speed = VelocitySpeed.Value or 50
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(dir.X * speed, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, dir.Z * speed)
        else
            if airborne or slideGrace then return false end
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
        end
        return true
    end

    getgenv().__LionApplyMovementVelocity = applyMovementVelocity

    local function restoreSlideBoost()
        for fighter, value in pairs(state.SlideOriginals) do
            pcall(function() if fighter and type(fighter.Set) == "function" then fighter:Set("SlidingSpeedMax", value) end end)
            state.SlideOriginals[fighter] = nil
        end
    end

    local function applySlideBoost(fighter)
        if not fighter or not SlideBoostEnabled.Enabled then return end
        local ok, current = pcall(function() return fighter:Get("SlidingSpeedMax") end)
        local base = (state.SlideOriginals[fighter] ~= nil and state.SlideOriginals[fighter]) or (ok and current) or 3
        state.SlideOriginals[fighter] = base
        pcall(function() fighter:Set("SlidingSpeedMax", base * SlideBoostValue.Value) end)
    end

    local function restoreItemInfo()
        for info, values in pairs(state.ItemOriginals) do
            if info then for key, value in pairs(values) do pcall(function() info[key] = value end) end end
            state.ItemOriginals[info] = nil
        end
    end

    local function saveInfoValue(info, key)
        state.ItemOriginals[info] = state.ItemOriginals[info] or {}
        if state.ItemOriginals[info][key] == nil then state.ItemOriginals[info][key] = info[key] end
    end

    local function patchEquippedItem()
        local mech = getMechanics()
        local fighter = mech and mech.LocalFighter
        local item = fighter and fighter.EquippedItem
        local info = item and item.Info
        if not info then return end
        if InfiniteDoubleJump.Enabled then
            saveInfoValue(info, "MaxDoubleJumps")
            info.MaxDoubleJumps = math.huge
            local objectId
            pcall(function() objectId = item:Get("ObjectID") end)
            if objectId and mech._double_jumps_used then mech._double_jumps_used[objectId] = 0 end
        end
        if MaulSlamEnabled.Enabled then
            for _, key in ipairs({"SlamDamage","SlamRadius"}) do
                if type(info[key]) == "number" then
                    saveInfoValue(info, key)
                    info[key] = state.ItemOriginals[info][key] * MaulSlamValue.Value
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function installHooks()
        local mech = getMechanics()
        if not mech then return end
        if state.Hooked and state.HookedMechanics == mech then return end
        state.Hooked = true
        state.HookedMechanics = mech
        if type(mech.Slide) == "function" then
            state.OldSlide = mech.Slide
            mech.Slide = function(self, ...) applySlideBoost(self and self.LocalFighter); return state.OldSlide(self, ...) end
        end
        if type(mech.HighJump) == "function" then
            state.OldHighJump = mech.HighJump
            mech.HighJump = function(self, ...) state.LastSlidingAt = os.clock(); return state.OldHighJump(self, ...) end
        end
        if type(mech.DoubleJump) == "function" then
            state.OldDoubleJump = mech.DoubleJump
            mech.DoubleJump = function(self, ...)
                local result = state.OldDoubleJump(self, ...)
                if CharacterMovement.Enabled and DoubleJumpHeightEnabled.Enabled then
                    local fighter = self and self.LocalFighter
                    local root = fighter and fighter.Entity and fighter.Entity.RootPart
                    if root then
                        local vel = root.Velocity
                        root.Velocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, vel.Y * DoubleJumpHeightValue.Value, vel.Z)
                    end
                end
                return result
            end
        end
    end

    local function startMovement()
        CharacterMovement.Enabled = true
        installHooks()
        hbConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            applyMovementVelocity()
            local mech = getMechanics()
            if mech and SlideBoostEnabled.Enabled then applySlideBoost(mech.LocalFighter) end
            patchEquippedItem()
        end)
        charConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            state.Mechanics = nil
            task.delay(0.35, function()
                if not CharacterMovement.Enabled then return end
                installHooks()
                local mech = getMechanics()
                if mech and SlideBoostEnabled.Enabled then applySlideBoost(mech.LocalFighter) end
                patchEquippedItem()
                applyMovementVelocity()
            end)
        end)
    end

    local function stopMovement()
        CharacterMovement.Enabled = false
        if hbConn then hbConn:Disconnect(); hbConn = nil end
        if charConn then charConn:Disconnect(); charConn = nil end
        restoreSlideBoost()
        restoreItemInfo()
        local root = getRootHumanoid()
        if root then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.y, 0) end
    end

    local MoveGB = mkGB(Tabs.Character, "R", "Movement", "zap")
    if MoveGB then
        sAdd(MoveGB, "AddToggle", "mv_enabled", { Text = "enabled", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) if v then startMovement() else stopMovement() end end })
        sAdd(MoveGB, "AddToggle", "mv_velocity", { Text = "velocity", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) VelocityEnabled.Enabled = v end })
        sAdd(MoveGB, "AddSlider", "mv_velocity_speed", { Text = "velocity speed", Min = 0, Max = 250, Default = 50, Rounding = 0, Suffix = "s",
            Callback = function(v) VelocitySpeed.Value = v end })
        sAdd(MoveGB, "AddToggle", "mv_slide_boost", { Text = "slide boost", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) SlideBoostEnabled.Enabled = v; if not v then restoreSlideBoost() end end })
        sAdd(MoveGB, "AddSlider", "mv_slide_boost_val", { Text = "slide boost multiplier", Min = 1, Max = 5, Default = 1, Rounding = 10, Suffix = "x",
            Callback = function(v) SlideBoostValue.Value = v; restoreSlideBoost() end })
        sAdd(MoveGB, "AddToggle", "mv_dj_height", { Text = "double jump height", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) DoubleJumpHeightEnabled.Enabled = v end })
        sAdd(MoveGB, "AddSlider", "mv_dj_height_val", { Text = "double jump height multiplier", Min = 1, Max = 10, Default = 1, Rounding = 10, Suffix = "x",
            Callback = function(v) DoubleJumpHeightValue.Value = v end })
        sAdd(MoveGB, "AddToggle", "mv_maul", { Text = "maul slam multiplier", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) MaulSlamEnabled.Enabled = v; if not v then restoreItemInfo() end end })
        sAdd(MoveGB, "AddSlider", "mv_maul_val", { Text = "maul slam multiplier value", Min = 1, Max = 10, Default = 1, Rounding = 10, Suffix = "x",
            Callback = function(v) MaulSlamValue.Value = v; restoreItemInfo() end })
        sAdd(MoveGB, "AddToggle", "mv_inf_dj", { Text = "infinite double jump", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) InfiniteDoubleJump.Enabled = v; if not v then restoreItemInfo() end end })
    end

end)()

    local Fly = ConfigStore.Fly
    Fly.SetTouchCheck(function() return UserInputService.TouchEnabled end)
    Fly.Init()

    local FlyGB = mkGB(Tabs.Character, "L", "Fly", "zap")
    if FlyGB then
        sAdd(FlyGB, "AddToggle", "fly_enabled", { Text = "enabled", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) Fly.SetEnabled(v); saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(FlyGB, "AddSlider", "fly_speed", { Text = "speed", Min = 10, Max = 500, Default = 100, Rounding = 0,
            Callback = function(v) Fly.SetSpeed(v); saveConfigAll() end })
    end


    -- kicia's Third Person: the camera is moved by an offset after the camera's own update, with an optional
    -- ray check so it stops at walls, and the local body can be shown while it's on
    TPG = mkGB(Tabs.Character, "L", "Third Person", "eye")
    if TPG then
        TP = { Enabled = false, X = 0, Y = 2, Z = 8, RayCheck = true, ShowReplica = true }
        tpRay = RaycastParams.new()
        tpRay.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        tpRay.IgnoreWater = true
        tpHidden = {}   -- parts whose local transparency we changed, so they can be restored
        function tpShowBody(on)
            local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
            local ch = lp.Character
            if on and ch then
                for _, d in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("BasePart") and tpHidden[d] == nil then
                        tpHidden[d] = d.LocalTransparencyModifier
                        d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    end
                end
            else
                for part, v in pairs(tpHidden) do
                    if part.Parent then part.LocalTransparencyModifier = v end
                end
                table.clear(tpHidden)
            end
        end
        game:GetService("RunService"):BindToRenderStep("ArgonThirdPerson", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function()
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local ch = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
            local head = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if not TP.Enabled or not cam or not head then return end
            local base = cam.CFrame
            local off = base * CFrame.new(TP.X, TP.Y, TP.Z)
            if TP.RayCheck then
                tpRay.FilterDescendantsInstances = { ch }
                local dir = off.Position - head.Position
                if dir.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                    local hit = workspace:Raycast(head.Position, dir, tpRay)
                    if hit then
                        off = CFrame.new(hit.Position - dir.Unit * 0.5) * (base - base.Position)
                    end
                end
            end
            cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Track
            cam.CFrame = off
        end)
        sAdd(TPG, "AddToggle", "tp_enabled", { Text = "enable third person", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v)
                TP.Enabled = v
                tpShowBody(v and TP.ShowReplica)
                if not v then
                    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if cam then cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom end
                end
                saveConfigAll()
            end })
        sAdd(TPG, "AddToggle", "tp_raycheck", { Text = "ray check (stop at walls)", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) TP.RayCheck = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(TPG, "AddToggle", "tp_replica", { Text = "show body", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) TP.ShowReplica = v; tpShowBody(TP.Enabled and v); saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(TPG, "AddSlider", "tp_x", { Text = "x offset", Min = -15, Max = 15, Default = 0, Rounding = 1, Callback = function(v) TP.X = v end })
        sAdd(TPG, "AddSlider", "tp_y", { Text = "y offset", Min = -5, Max = 10, Default = 2, Rounding = 1, Callback = function(v) TP.Y = v end })
        sAdd(TPG, "AddSlider", "tp_z", { Text = "distance", Min = 0, Max = 15, Default = 8, Rounding = 1, Callback = function(v) TP.Z = v end })
    end

    AAG = mkGB(Tabs.Character, "R", "Anti-Aim", "eye-off")
    if AAG then
        local AA = ConfigStore.AntiAim
        sAdd(AAG, "AddToggle", "aa_enabled", { Text = "enabled", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) AA.Enabled = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(AAG, "AddDropdown", "aa_yaw_mode", { Text = "yaw mode", Values = { "jitter", "spin", "random" }, Default = "jitter",
            Callback = function(v) AA.YawMode = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(AAG, "AddSlider", "aa_yaw_angle", { Text = "yaw angle", Min = 0, Max = 180, Default = 90, Rounding = 0, Suffix = "deg",
            Callback = function(v) AA.YawAngle = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(AAG, "AddDropdown", "aa_pitch_mode", { Text = "pitch mode", Values = { "none", "custom", "random", "down" }, Default = "none",
            Callback = function(v) AA.PitchMode = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(AAG, "AddSlider", "aa_pitch_angle", { Text = "pitch angle", Min = -89, Max = 89, Default = 0, Rounding = 0, Suffix = "deg",
            Callback = function(v) AA.PitchAngle = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(AAG, "AddSlider", "aa_pitch_offset", { Text = "down offset", Min = 0, Max = 255, Default = 0, Rounding = 0,
            Callback = function(v) AA.PitchOffset = v; saveConfigAll() end })
    end

    SpinGB = mkGB(Tabs.Character, "L", "Spinbot", "zap")
    if SpinGB then
        local Spin = ConfigStore.Spinbot
        sAdd(SpinGB, "AddToggle", "spin_enabled", { Text = "enabled", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) Spin.Enabled = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(SpinGB, "AddSlider", "spin_speed", { Text = "speed", Min = 1, Max = 90, Default = 15, Rounding = 0,
            Callback = function(v) Spin.Speed = v; saveConfigAll() end })
    end

    local SpoofGB = mkGB(Tabs.Character, "L", "Spoofers", "user")
    if SpoofGB then
        L, St = ConfigStore.Spoof.Level, ConfigStore.Spoof.Streak
        sAdd(SpoofGB, "AddToggle", "spoof_level_enable", { Text = "level", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) L.Enabled = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(SpoofGB, "AddInput", "spoof_level_val", { Text = "level value", Default = "9",
            Callback = function(t) L.Value = tonumber(t) or 0; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(SpoofGB, "AddToggle", "spoof_streak_enable", { Text = "win streak", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) St.Enabled = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(SpoofGB, "AddInput", "spoof_streak_val", { Text = "streak value", Default = "99",
            Callback = function(t) St.Value = tonumber(t) or 0; saveConfigAll() end })
    end
end

-- ================= AUTO MODULES (queue / vote map / load / ban) =================
do
    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local SP = game:GetService("StarterPlayer")
    local A = { Alive = true, Queue = false, QueueWas = false, QueueRun = false,
        Vote = false, VoteMap = "Arena",
        Load = false, LoadRun = false, LoadSilent = false, LoadInterval = 0.5, Pick = { "None", "None", "None", "None" },
        Ban = false, BanRandom = false, BanWeapons = true, BanRun = false, RandRun = false,
        Ban1 = "None", Ban2 = "None", Ban1Delay = 0, Ban2Delay = 0, MapDelay = 0,
        Mode = "1v1" }
    ConfigStore.AutoStop = function() A.Alive = false; A.Queue = false; A.Vote = false; A.Load = false; A.Ban = false end

    local function note(t) pcall(function() Library:Notify(t, 3) end) end
    local function remote(...)
        local o = RS
        for _, n in ipairs({ ... }) do o = o and o:FindFirstChild(n) end
        return o
    end

    local DuelLibrary
    pcall(function() DuelLibrary = require(RS.Modules.DuelLibrary) end)

    -- ── queue ──
    queueLookup = { ["1v1"] = "1v1", ["2v2_beginner"] = "2v2_beginner" }
    local function queueList()
        local list = {}
        if DuelLibrary then
            for _, q in pairs(DuelLibrary.MatchmakingQueueOrder or {}) do
                local info = DuelLibrary.MatchmakingQueues and DuelLibrary.MatchmakingQueues[q]
                local d = info and info.DisplayName or q
                list[#list + 1] = d; queueLookup[d] = q
            end
        end
        if #list == 0 then list = { "1v1", "2v2_beginner" } end
        return list
    end

    local function queueInto()
        local q = queueLookup[A.Mode] or A.Mode or "1v1"
        local ok, ctl = pcall(function() return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.MatchmakingController) end)
        if ok and ctl and ctl.QueueInto then return ctl:QueueInto(q) end
        local jq = remote("Remotes", "Matchmaking", "JoinQueue")
        if jq and jq.InvokeServer then return jq:InvokeServer(q) end
    end

    local function leaveQueue()
        local r = remote("Remotes", "Matchmaking", "LeaveQueue")
        if r and r.FireServer then pcall(r.FireServer, r) end
    end

    local function setQueue(on)
        A.Queue = on
        if on then
            A.QueueWas = true
            if A.QueueRun then return end
            A.QueueRun = true
            task.spawn(function()
                while A.Alive and A.Queue do pcall(queueInto); task.wait(5) end
                A.QueueRun = false
            end)
        elseif A.QueueWas then
            A.QueueWas = false
            leaveQueue()
        end
    end

    -- ── vote map ──
    local maps = { "Arena", "Big Graveyard", "Docks", "Splash", "Bridge", "Crossroads", "Big Crossroads", "Big Backrooms", "Battleground",
        "Big Arena", "Construction", "Playground", "Onyx", "Graveyard", "Big Splash", "Big Onyx", "Backrooms", "Station", "Dimension" }
    local function castVote(name)
        local r = remote("Remotes", "Duels", "Vote")
        if r and name and name ~= "" and name ~= "None" then pcall(r.FireServer, r, name) end
    end
    local function setVote(on)
        A.Vote = on
        if not on then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            while A.Alive and A.Vote do castVote(A.VoteMap); task.wait(0.75) end
        end)
    end

    -- ── weapons list ──
    local weaponList = { "None" }
    pcall(function()
        local wf = SP.StarterPlayerScripts.Assets.ViewModels.Weapons
        local seen = {}
        local function add(folder)
            for _, v in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                if v:IsA("Model") and not seen[v.Name] then seen[v.Name] = true; weaponList[#weaponList + 1] = v.Name end
            end
        end
        add(wf)
        local un = wf:FindFirstChild("Unobtainable"); if un then add(un) end
    end)
    table.sort(weaponList, function(a, b)
        if a == "None" then return true end
        if b == "None" then return false end
        return a < b
    end)
    local function idxOf(name, fallback) return table.find(weaponList, name) or fallback or 1 end

    -- ── auto load ──
    local function pickLoadout()
        local r = remote("Remotes", "Replication", "Fighter", "PickWeapons")
        if not r then return end
        r:FireServer({ A.Pick[1], A.Pick[2], A.Pick[3], A.Pick[4] })
    end
    local function setLoad(on)
        A.Load = on
        if not on or A.LoadRun then return end
        A.LoadRun = true
        if not A.LoadSilent then note("auto load: sending loadout") end
        task.spawn(function()
            while A.Alive and A.Load do pcall(pickLoadout); task.wait(math.max(A.LoadInterval, 0.2)) end
            A.LoadRun = false
        end)
    end

    -- ── auto ban ──
    local function mapNames()
        local out = {}
        if DuelLibrary then
            for _, n in pairs(DuelLibrary.MapOrder or {}) do
                local m = DuelLibrary.Maps and DuelLibrary.Maps[n]
                if m and not m.IsHidden then out[#out + 1] = n end
            end
            if #out == 0 then for n, m in pairs(DuelLibrary.Maps or {}) do if not m.IsHidden then out[#out + 1] = n end end end
        end
        table.sort(out)
        return #out > 0 and out or maps
    end
    local function banWeaponsLoop()
        if A.BanRun then return end
        A.BanRun = true
        task.spawn(function()
            local i = 1
            while A.Alive and A.Ban and A.BanWeapons do
                local votes = {}
                if A.Ban1 ~= "None" then votes[#votes + 1] = { A.Ban1, A.Ban1Delay } end
                if A.Ban2 ~= "None" then votes[#votes + 1] = { A.Ban2, A.Ban2Delay } end
                if #votes > 0 then
                    i = ((i - 1) % #votes) + 1
                    task.wait(math.max(votes[i][2], 0))
                    castVote(votes[i][1])
                    i = i % #votes + 1
                end
                task.wait(1)
            end
            A.BanRun = false
        end)
    end
    local function banRandomLoop()
        if A.RandRun then return end
        A.RandRun = true
        task.spawn(function()
            local rng = Random.new()
            while A.Alive and A.Ban and A.BanRandom do
                local list = mapNames()
                task.wait(math.max(A.MapDelay, 0))
                castVote(list[rng:NextInteger(1, #list)])
                task.wait(1)
            end
            A.RandRun = false
        end)
    end
    local function startBans()
        if not A.Ban then return end
        if A.BanWeapons then banWeaponsLoop() end
        if A.BanRandom then banRandomLoop() end
    end

    -- ================= WALLBANG (from wallbang.txt) =================
(function()
    local WB = { Enabled = false, MaxDistance = 200 }
    local wbRS = game:GetService("RunService")
    local DESYNC_OFFSET = Vector3.new(0, -5, 0)
    local wbGun, wbOldStart, wbHooked, wbUtil
    local wbTarget, wbDesync, wbCurrent = nil, false, nil
    local wbConn1, wbConn2, wbTask1

    local function wbFindTarget()
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myRoot then return nil end
        local closest, closestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player == LocalPlayer then continue end
            if player:GetAttribute("TeamID") == LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID") then continue end
            local char = player.Character
            if not char then continue end
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
            if not (root and head and hum and hum.Health > 0) then continue end
            local dist = (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
            if dist > WB.MaxDistance then continue end
            if dist < closestDist then closestDist, closest = dist, player end
        end
        return closest
    end

    local function wbDesyncStop()
        wbDesync = false
        wbCurrent = nil
        if wbConn2 then wbConn2:Disconnect(); wbConn2 = nil end
    end

    local function wbDesyncStart(t)
        if wbConn2 then wbConn2:Disconnect() end
        wbDesync = true
        wbCurrent = t
        wbConn2 = wbRS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not wbDesync then return end
            local root = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then return end
            local tRoot = t.Character and t.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not tRoot then wbDesyncStop() return end
            local savedCF, savedVel, savedRot = root.CFrame, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, root.AssemblyAngularVelocity
            root.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(DESYNC_OFFSET)
            pcall(function() wbRS:UnbindFromRenderStep("__wb_restore") end)
            wbRS:BindToRenderStep("__wb_restore", 101, function()
                root.CFrame = savedCF
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = savedVel
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = savedRot
                wbRS:UnbindFromRenderStep("__wb_restore")
            end)
        end)
    end

    local function wbStartShooting(self, ...)
        local res = { wbOldStart(self, ...) }
        if not self.ClientFighter or not self.ClientFighter.IsLocalPlayer then
            return table.unpack(res)
        end
        local payload = res[3]
        if not payload or typeof(payload) ~= "table" then return table.unpack(res) end
        res[4] = true
        local t = wbTarget
        if not WB.Enabled or not t or not t.Character then return table.unpack(res) end
        if not wbDesync or wbCurrent ~= t then
            wbDesyncStart(t)
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
        if wbTask1 then task.cancel(wbTask1); wbTask1 = nil end
        local head = t.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return table.unpack(res) end
        local headPos = head.Position
        local lookFrom = headPos - Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
        local look = CFrame.lookAt(lookFrom, headPos)
        local localHead = head.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(headPos))
        payload[utf8.char(0)] = wbUtil:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(lookFrom, headPos) * CFrame.Angles(look:ToOrientation()))
        payload[utf8.char(1)] = wbUtil:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(headPos) * CFrame.Angles(look:ToOrientation()))
        payload[utf8.char(2)] = head
        payload[utf8.char(3)] = wbUtil:EncodeCFrame(localHead)
        wbTask1 = task.delay(0.15, wbDesyncStop)
        return table.unpack(res)
    end

    function WB.Start()
        if wbHooked then return true end
        local okG, gun = pcall(function() return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Modules.ItemTypes.Gun) end)
        local okU, util = pcall(function() return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.Utility) end)
        if not (okG and okU and type(gun) == "table" and gun.StartShooting) then
            warn("[wallbang] Gun/Utility module not found")
            return false
        end
        wbGun, wbUtil = gun, util
        wbOldStart = gun.StartShooting
        wbHooked = wbStartShooting
        gun.StartShooting = wbStartShooting
        wbConn1 = wbRS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if WB.Enabled then wbTarget = wbFindTarget() end
        end)
        return true
    end

    function WB.Stop()
        WB.Enabled = false
        if wbConn1 then wbConn1:Disconnect(); wbConn1 = nil end
        wbDesyncStop()
        if wbTask1 then task.cancel(wbTask1); wbTask1 = nil end
        wbTarget = nil
        if wbGun and wbHooked and wbGun.StartShooting == wbHooked then
            wbGun.StartShooting = wbOldStart
        end
        wbHooked = nil
    end

    -- manipulation scheduler: toggle requests arming; actual WB.Enabled starts after random 30–60s
    local manipWanted = false
    local manipToken = 0
    local manipTask = nil

    local function cancelManipDelay()
        manipToken = manipToken + 1
        if manipTask then
            pcall(task.cancel, manipTask)
            manipTask = nil
        end
    end

    getgenv().SolSetManipulation = function(on)
        manipWanted = on and true or false
        cancelManipDelay()
        if not manipWanted then
            pcall(function() WB.Stop() end)
            return
        end
        -- random delay between 30 and 60 seconds before manipulation actually activates
        local delaySec = 30 + math.random() * 30
        local myToken = manipToken
        print(string.format("[manipulation] arming in %.0fs", delaySec))
        manipTask = task.delay(delaySec, function()
            if myToken ~= manipToken or not manipWanted then return end
            local ok = false
            pcall(function() ok = WB.Start() end)
            if ok then
                WB.Enabled = true
                print("[manipulation] active")
            else
                warn("[manipulation] failed to start")
            end
        end)
    end

    getgenv().SolManipulationActive = function()
        return WB.Enabled == true
    end
end)()

    -- ── ui ──
    local QG = mkGB(Tabs.Main, "R", "Auto Queue / Vote", "zap")
    local qDrop
    if QG then
        sAdd(QG, "AddToggle", "aq_enabled", { Text = "auto queue", Default = false, Callback = setQueue })
        qDrop = sAdd(QG, "AddDropdown", "aq_mode", { Values = { "1v1", "2v2_beginner" }, Default = 1, Text = "game mode",
            Callback = function(v) A.Mode = v; if A.Queue then pcall(queueInto) end end })
        sAdd(QG, "AddToggle", "av_enabled", { Text = "auto vote map", Default = false, Callback = setVote })
        sAdd(QG, "AddDropdown", "av_map", { Values = maps, Default = 1, Text = "map",
            Callback = function(v) A.VoteMap = v; if A.Vote then castVote(v) end end })
    end

    local LG = mkGB(Tabs.Settings, "L", "Auto Load", "zap")
    if LG then
        sAdd(LG, "AddToggle", "al_enabled", { Text = "auto load", Default = false, Callback = setLoad })
        sAdd(LG, "AddToggle", "al_silent", { Text = "silent mode", Default = false, Callback = function(v) A.LoadSilent = v end })
        sAdd(LG, "AddSlider", "al_interval", { Text = "send interval", Min = 0.2, Max = 5, Default = 0.5, Rounding = 1, Suffix = "s",
            Callback = function(v) A.LoadInterval = v end })
        for i, label in ipairs({ "primary", "secondary", "melee", "slot 4" }) do
            sAdd(LG, "AddDropdown", "al_slot" .. i, { Values = weaponList, Default = 1, Text = label,
                Callback = function(v) A.Pick[i] = v end })
        end
    end

    local BG = mkGB(Tabs.Main, "R", "Auto Ban", "x")
    if BG then
        sAdd(BG, "AddToggle", "ab2_enabled", { Text = "auto ban", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) A.Ban = v; if v then startBans() end end })
        sAdd(BG, "AddToggle", "ab2_weapons", { Text = "ban weapons", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) A.BanWeapons = v; startBans() end })
        sAdd(BG, "AddDropdown", "ab2_first", { Values = weaponList, Default = idxOf("Riot Shield", 2), Text = "first ban",
            Callback = function(v) A.Ban1 = v end })
        sAdd(BG, "AddSlider", "ab2_first_d", { Text = "first ban delay", Min = 0, Max = 10, Default = 0, Rounding = 1, Suffix = "s",
            Callback = function(v) A.Ban1Delay = v end })
        sAdd(BG, "AddDropdown", "ab2_second", { Values = weaponList, Default = idxOf("Katana", 3), Text = "second ban",
            Callback = function(v) A.Ban2 = v end })
        sAdd(BG, "AddSlider", "ab2_second_d", { Text = "second ban delay", Min = 0, Max = 10, Default = 0, Rounding = 1, Suffix = "s",
            Callback = function(v) A.Ban2Delay = v end })
        sAdd(BG, "AddToggle", "ab2_random", { Text = "ban random map", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) A.BanRandom = v; startBans() end })
        sAdd(BG, "AddSlider", "ab2_map_d", { Text = "map ban delay", Min = 0, Max = 10, Default = 0, Rounding = 1, Suffix = "s",
            Callback = function(v) A.MapDelay = v end })
    end
    A.Ban1 = weaponList[idxOf("Riot Shield", 2)] or "None"
    A.Ban2 = weaponList[idxOf("Katana", 3)] or "None"

    -- refresh queue list once the duel library is readable
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(1)
        local ok, list = pcall(queueList)
        if ok and qDrop then
            if qDrop.Refresh then pcall(function() qDrop:Refresh(list) end)
            elseif qDrop.SetValues then pcall(function() qDrop:SetValues(list) end) end
        end
    end)
end

-- ================= WATERMARK + DAMAGE NUMBERS (solaria.lol) =================
(function()
    local Players      = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService   = game:GetService("RunService")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local Stats        = game:GetService("Stats")
    local Debris       = game:GetService("Debris")
    local LP           = Players.LocalPlayer

    local PINKL = Color3.fromRGB(255, 182, 213)   -- light pink
    local WHT   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local function parentGui() return (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui") end
    local function grad(c1, c2) return ColorSequence.new({ ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, c1), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, c2), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c1) }) end

    -- ───────────── watermark ─────────────
    local WM = { Enabled = false, Fps = true, Ping = true, Name = true, C1 = PINKL, C2 = WHT, Gui = nil, Conn = nil }

    local function wmStop()
        WM.Enabled = false
        if WM.Conn then WM.Conn:Disconnect(); WM.Conn = nil end
        if WM.Gui then WM.Gui:Destroy(); WM.Gui = nil end
    end

    local function wmStart()
        if WM.Gui then return end
        WM.Enabled = false
        local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        sg.Name = "SolariaWatermark"; sg.IgnoreGuiInset = true; sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
        sg.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global; sg.DisplayOrder = 200

        local fr = Instance.new("Frame")
        fr.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0); fr.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 12)
        fr.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X; fr.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26)
        fr.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14); fr.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25; fr.BorderSizePixel = 0
        fr.Parent = sg
        local cr = Instance.new("UICorner"); cr.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5); cr.Parent = fr
        local st = Instance.new("UIStroke"); st.Thickness = 1; st.Color = WHT; st.Transparency = 0.35; st.Parent = fr
        local sg2 = Instance.new("UIGradient"); sg2.Rotation = 0; sg2.Parent = st   -- outline uses the same pink/white blend
        local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding"); pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10); pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10); pad.Parent = fr

        local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; tl.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X; tl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
        tl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; tl.TextSize = 13; tl.TextColor3 = WHT
        tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6; tl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        tl.Text = "solaria.lol"; tl.Parent = fr
        local tg = Instance.new("UIGradient"); tg.Parent = tl

        sg.Parent = parentGui()
        WM.Gui = sg

        local fps, acc, t = 60, 0, 0
        WM.Conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            fps = fps + (1 / math.max(dt, 1e-4) - fps) * 0.1
            t += dt; acc += dt
            local cs = grad(WM.C1, WM.C2)
            tg.Color = cs; sg2.Color = cs
            local off = math.sin(t * 1.2) * 0.35        -- slow sweep of the gradient
            tg.Offset = Vector2.new(off, 0); sg2.Offset = Vector2.new(off, 0)
            if acc < 0.25 then return end
            acc = 0
            local parts = { "solaria.lol" }
            if WM.Fps then pcall(function() parts[#parts + 1] = math.floor(fps + 0.5) .. " fps" end) end -- incase
            if WM.Ping then
                local ok, p = pcall(function() return Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() end)
                if ok and p then parts[#parts + 1] = math.floor(Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()) .. " ms" end
            end
            if WM.Name then parts[#parts + 1] = LP.DisplayName ~= "" and LP.DisplayName or LP.Name end
            tl.Text = table.concat(parts, "  |  ")
        end)
    end

    -- ───────────── damage numbers (Phantom Forces style) ─────────────
    local DN = {
        Enabled = false,
        DisableIngame = true,
        Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0),
        HeadshotColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 20),
        TextSize = 24,
        Thickness = 0.5,
        GoldenAngle = 2.3999632297286531,
        Counter = 0,
        Hooked = false,
    }
    local dnFont = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Zekton.json", Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    local dnHeadFont = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Zekton.json", Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Italic)

    local function dnClamp(n)
        n = tonumber(n) or 0
        if n > 99 and n < 100 then return 99 end
        if n > 0 and n < 1 then return 1 end
        return math.round(n)
    end

    local function dnAnchor(pos)
        if typeof(pos) == "Instance" and pos:IsA("BasePart") then pos = pos.Position end
        if typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end
        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
        part.Transparency = 1
        part.CanCollide = false
        part.CanQuery = false
        part.CanTouch = false
        part.Anchored = true
        part.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
        part.Parent = workspace
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Name = "BillboardDamage"
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 200)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.MaxDistance = 9e9
        bb.ClipsDescendants = false
        bb.Adornee = part
        bb.Parent = part
        return part, bb
    end

    local function dnLabel(parent, name, text, fontFace, textColor3, zIndex)
        local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        tl.Name = name
        tl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        tl.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        tl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        tl.ZIndex = zIndex
        tl.Text = text
        tl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        tl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        tl.FontFace = fontFace
        tl.TextSize = DN.TextSize
        tl.TextColor3 = textColor3
        tl.Parent = parent
        local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        st.Thickness = DN.Thickness
        st.Parent = tl
        return tl
    end

    local function dnEffect(worldPos, damage, isHead)
        if not DN.Enabled then return end
        local num = tonumber(damage) or 0
        if num <= 0 then return end
        local anchor, gui = dnAnchor(worldPos)
        if not anchor then return end
        local str = tostring(dnClamp(num))
        local face = isHead and dnHeadFont or dnFont
        local col = isHead and DN.HeadshotColor or DN.Color
        local shadow = dnLabel(gui, "TextDamageShadow", str, face, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 0)
        local main = dnLabel(gui, "TextDamage", str, face, col, 1)
        shadow.Position = shadow.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1)
        local ang = DN.GoldenAngle * DN.Counter
        DN.Counter = DN.Counter + 1
        local dest = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(ang) * 32, 0.5, math.sin(ang) * -48 - 90)
        main:TweenPosition(dest, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, 1, true)
        shadow:TweenPosition(dest + UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, 1, true)
        task.delay(1, function()
            for i = 1, 10 do
                if not anchor.Parent then return end
                main.TextTransparency = i / 10
                shadow.TextTransparency = i / 10
                task.wait(0.0167)
            end
            pcall(function() anchor:Destroy() end)
        end)
    end

    local function dnHook()
        if DN.Hooked then return end
        local LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        local ok, fc = pcall(function()
            return require(LP.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
        end)
        if not ok or not fc then
            warn("[damage numbers] FighterController not found")
            return
        end
        local fighter = fc.LocalFighter or (fc.GetFighter and fc:GetFighter(LP))
        if not fighter then
            -- retry when fighter appears
            task.spawn(function()
                for _ = 1, 40 do
                    task.wait(0.25)
                    fighter = fc.LocalFighter or (fc.GetFighter and fc:GetFighter(LP))
                    if fighter and fighter.ReplicateFromServer then break end
                end
                if fighter and fighter.ReplicateFromServer and not DN.Hooked then
                    DN.Hooked = true
                    local orig = fighter.ReplicateFromServer
                    fighter.ReplicateFromServer = function(self, kind, ...)
                        if kind == "DamageNumberEffect" then
                            local part, dmg, headFlag = ...
                            local parent = typeof(part) == "Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Parent
                            if parent and type(dmg) == "number" and parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                                if DN.Enabled then
                                    task.defer(dnEffect, part.Position, dmg, headFlag == true)
                                    if DN.DisableIngame then return end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        return orig(self, kind, ...)
                    end
                end
            end)
            return
        end
        if not fighter.ReplicateFromServer then return end
        DN.Hooked = true
        local orig = fighter.ReplicateFromServer
        fighter.ReplicateFromServer = function(self, kind, ...)
            if kind == "DamageNumberEffect" then
                local part, dmg, headFlag = ...
                local parent = typeof(part) == "Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Parent
                if parent and type(dmg) == "number" and parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                    if DN.Enabled then
                        task.defer(dnEffect, part.Position, dmg, headFlag == true)
                        if DN.DisableIngame then return end
                    end
                end
            end
            return orig(self, kind, ...)
        end
    end

    local function dnStart()
        DN.Enabled = true
        dnHook()
    end
    local function dnStop()
        DN.Enabled = false
    end

    local DG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "R", "Damage Numbers", "zap")
    if DG then
        sAdd(DG, "AddToggle", "dn_enabled", { Text = "damage numbers", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) if v then dnStart() else dnStop() end; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(DG, "AddToggle", "dn_disable_ingame", { Text = "disable ingame numbers", Default = true,
            Callback = function(v) DN.DisableIngame = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(DG, "AddSlider", "dn_size", { Text = "text size", Min = 12, Max = 48, Default = 24, Rounding = 0,
            Callback = function(v) DN.TextSize = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        addPicker(DG, "dn_color", { Default = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0), Title = "color", Transparency = 0,
            Callback = function(c) DN.Color = c; saveConfigAll() end })
        addPicker(DG, "dn_hs_color", { Default = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 20), Title = "headshot color", Transparency = 0,
            Callback = function(c) DN.HeadshotColor = c; saveConfigAll() end })
    end

    -- Shoot Sound (Sonata-style: catalog + Shot signal + optional mute)
    do
        local SOUND_IDS = {
            Crossbow = "rbxassetid://8616930816",
            AK47 = "rbxassetid://801142899",
            M249 = "rbxassetid://2934844996",
            PlasmaPistol = "rbxassetid://5312934759",
            G36c = "rbxassetid://4759267374",
            PlasmaMachine = "rbxassetid://2605256561",
            PlasmaShotgun = "rbxassetid://2605233927",
            MP40 = "rbxassetid://103807799095792",
            Bow = "rbxassetid://3442683707",
        }
        local SOUND_ORDER = {
            "Crossbow", "AK47", "M249", "PlasmaPistol", "G36c",
            "PlasmaMachine", "PlasmaShotgun", "MP40", "Bow",
        }
        ConfigStore.ShootSound = ConfigStore.ShootSound or {
            Enabled = false, Selected = "AK47", Volume = 1, Pitch = 1,
            MuteGame = true, Hooked = false,
        }
        local ShootSound = ConfigStore.ShootSound
        if not SOUND_IDS[ShootSound.Selected] then ShootSound.Selected = "AK47" end
        ShootSound.Volume = ShootSound.Volume or 1
        ShootSound.Pitch = ShootSound.Pitch or 1

        local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
        -- Elisium-style output: PlayLocalSound for clean 2D client audio (no 3D falloff)
        local fxFolder = SoundService:FindFirstChild("solaria_fx_sounds")
        if not fxFolder then
            fxFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
            fxFolder.Name = "solaria_fx_sounds"
            fxFolder.Parent = SoundService
        end
        local shootTemplate = Instance.new("Sound")
        shootTemplate.Name = "solaria_shoot_template"
        shootTemplate.Parent = fxFolder
        local lastShootAt = 0
        local liveCount = 0

        local function playShootSoundLocal()
            if not ShootSound.Enabled then return end
            local id = SOUND_IDS[ShootSound.Selected]
            if type(id) ~= "string" or id == "" then return end
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - lastShootAt < 0.012 then return end
            lastShootAt = now
            if liveCount >= 8 then return end
            local vol = math.clamp(tonumber(ShootSound.Volume) or 1, 0, 5)
            local pitch = math.clamp(tonumber(ShootSound.Pitch) or 1, 0.1, 3)
            -- PlayLocalSound clones playback through the sound engine (Elisium-style output)
            local played = false
            pcall(function()
                shootTemplate.SoundId = id
                shootTemplate.Volume = vol
                shootTemplate.PlaybackSpeed = pitch
                if type(SoundService.PlayLocalSound) == "function" then
                    SoundService:PlayLocalSound(shootTemplate)
                    played = true
                end
            end)
            if played then return end
            -- fallback if PlayLocalSound unavailable
            local s = Instance.new("Sound")
            s.Name = "solaria_shoot"
            s.SoundId = id
            s.Volume = vol
            s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch
            s.Parent = fxFolder
            liveCount += 1
            local done = false
            local function cleanup()
                if done then return end
                done = true
                liveCount = math.max(0, liveCount - 1)
                pcall(function() s:Destroy() end)
            end
            pcall(function() s.Ended:Connect(cleanup) end)
            pcall(function() s:Play() end)
            task.delay(6, cleanup)
        end

        -- bind to equipped item Shot signal (Sonata)
        local shotConn = nil
        local function bindShot(item)
            if shotConn then pcall(function() shotConn:Disconnect() end); shotConn = nil end
            if type(item) ~= "table" then return end
            local shot = item.Shot
            if type(shot) == "table" and type(shot.Connect) == "function" then
                local ok, conn = pcall(function()
                    return shot:Connect(function()
                        pcall(playShootSoundLocal)
                    end)
                end)
                if ok then shotConn = conn end
            end
        end

        local function watchEquipped()
            local ok, fc = pcall(function()
                return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
            end)
            if not ok or not fc then return end
            local f = fc.LocalFighter or (fc.GetFighter and fc:GetFighter(LocalPlayer))
            if f and f.EquippedItem then bindShot(f.EquippedItem) end
        end

        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not ShootSound.Enabled then return end
            pcall(watchEquipped)
        end)

        -- also StartShooting fallback
        local function hookGunStartShooting()
            if ShootSound.GunHooked then return end
            local ok, gun = pcall(function()
                return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Modules.ItemTypes.Gun)
            end)
            if not ok or type(gun) ~= "table" or type(gun.StartShooting) ~= "function" then return end
            local old = gun.StartShooting
            gun.StartShooting = function(self, ...)
                if ShootSound.Enabled then pcall(playShootSoundLocal) end
                return old(self, ...)
            end
            ShootSound.GunHooked = true
        end

        -- mute default gun sounds optionally via Utility.CreateSound
        -- Mute game shoot: SoundLibrary ids + CreateSound hook + Sound:Play namecall + DescendantAdded
        local gunSoundIds = {}
        local function shouldSkipMuteKey(key)
            local s = string.lower(tostring(key or ""))
            return s:find("horn", 1, true) or s:find("whistle", 1, true)
                or s:find("megaphone", 1, true) or s:find("trumpet", 1, true)
                or s:find("warhorn", 1, true) or s:find("music", 1, true)
                or s:find("ui", 1, true) or s:find("menu", 1, true)
        end
        local function collectSoundIds(bucket)
            if type(bucket) ~= "table" then return end
            for k, v in pairs(bucket) do
                if shouldSkipMuteKey(k) then continue end
                if type(v) == "string" and (v:find("rbxassetid", 1, true) or v:find("http", 1, true)) then
                    gunSoundIds[v] = true
                elseif type(v) == "table" then
                    collectSoundIds(v)
                end
            end
        end
        local function rebuildGunSoundIds()
            table.clear(gunSoundIds)
            pcall(function()
                local sl = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SoundLibrary)
                collectSoundIds(sl)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local modules = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
                if not modules then return end
                for _, child in ipairs(modules:GetDescendants()) do
                    if child:IsA("ModuleScript") and string.lower(child.Name):find("sound", 1, true) then
                        local ok, mod = pcall(require, child)
                        if ok then collectSoundIds(mod) end
                    end
                end
            end)
            -- never mute our custom fx folder
            gunSoundIds["solaria_skip"] = nil
        end
        local function isGunSoundId(soundId)
            if type(soundId) ~= "string" or soundId == "" then return false end
            if gunSoundIds[soundId] then return true end
            -- numeric id form
            local num = soundId:match("(%d+)")
            if num and gunSoundIds["rbxassetid://" .. num] then return true end
            return false
        end
        local function muteSoundInstance(sound)
            if typeof(sound) ~= "Instance" or not sound:IsA("Sound") then return end
            -- never mute our custom shoot sound
            if sound.Name == "solaria_shoot" or sound.Name == "solaria_shoot_template" then return end
            if sound.Parent and sound.Parent.Name == "solaria_fx_sounds" then return end
            pcall(function()
                sound.Volume = 0
                sound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.01
            end)
        end
        pcall(rebuildGunSoundIds)

        local function hookMuteGameShoot()
            if ShootSound.MuteHooked then return end
            pcall(rebuildGunSoundIds)

            local function afterCreate(result, soundId)
                if not ShootSound.MuteGame then return end
                if isGunSoundId(soundId) then
                    muteSoundInstance(result)
                elseif typeof(result) == "Instance" and result:IsA("Sound") and isGunSoundId(result.SoundId) then
                    muteSoundInstance(result)
                end
            end

            -- Utility.CreateSound
            pcall(function()
                local util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
                if type(util) ~= "table" or type(util.CreateSound) ~= "function" then return end
                local oldCreate = util.CreateSound
                local function createHook(self, soundId, ...)
                    local packed = table.pack(oldCreate(self, soundId, ...))
                    pcall(afterCreate, packed[1], soundId)
                    return table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n)
                end
                if type(hookfunction) == "function" then
                    local hooked
                    local function wrapper(...)
                        local soundId = select(2, ...)
                        local packed = table.pack(hooked(...))
                        pcall(afterCreate, packed[1], soundId)
                        return table.unpack(packed, 1, packed.n)
                    end
                    if type(newcclosure) == "function" then
                        hooked = hookfunction(util.CreateSound, newcclosure(wrapper))
                    else
                        hooked = hookfunction(util.CreateSound, wrapper)
                    end
                else
                    util.CreateSound = createHook
                end
            end)

            -- mute sounds that appear under character / viewmodel / SoundService
            pcall(function()
                local function tryMute(obj)
                    if not ShootSound.MuteGame then return end
                    if typeof(obj) ~= "Instance" or obj.ClassName ~= "Sound" then return end
                    if obj.Name == "solaria_shoot" or obj.Name == "solaria_shoot_template" then return end
                    if obj.Parent and obj.Parent.Name == "solaria_fx_sounds" then return end
                    if isGunSoundId(obj.SoundId) then
                        muteSoundInstance(obj)
                    end
                end
                local function watch(container)
                    if not container then return end
                    for _, d in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
                        tryMute(d)
                    end
                    container.DescendantAdded:Connect(tryMute)
                end
                watch(workspace)
                watch(game:GetService("SoundService"))
                if LocalPlayer.Character then watch(LocalPlayer.Character) end
                LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch) watch(ch) end)
                -- light periodic sweep for late-created gun sounds
                task.spawn(function()
                    while ShootSound.MuteHooked do
                        task.wait(0.5)
                        if ShootSound.MuteGame then
                            pcall(function()
                                for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                                    if d.ClassName == "Sound" then tryMute(d) end
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end)

            ShootSound.MuteHooked = true
        end

        local SSG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "L", "Shoot Sound", "zap")
        if SSG then
            sAdd(SSG, "AddToggle", "ss_enabled", { Text = "enabled", Default = false,
                Callback = function(v)
                    ShootSound.Enabled = v
                    if v then
                        pcall(hookGunStartShooting)
                        pcall(hookMuteGameShoot)
                        pcall(watchEquipped)
                    end
                    saveConfigAll()
                end })
            sAdd(SSG, "AddDropdown", "ss_sound", { Text = "sound", Values = SOUND_ORDER, Default = 2,
                Callback = function(v) ShootSound.Selected = v; saveConfigAll() end })
            sAdd(SSG, "AddSlider", "ss_vol", { Text = "volume", Min = 0, Max = 5, Default = 1, Rounding = 2,
                Callback = function(v) ShootSound.Volume = v; saveConfigAll() end })
            sAdd(SSG, "AddSlider", "ss_pitch", { Text = "pitch", Min = 0.1, Max = 3, Default = 1, Rounding = 2,
                Callback = function(v) ShootSound.Pitch = v; saveConfigAll() end })
            sAdd(SSG, "AddToggle", "ss_mute", { Text = "mute game shoot", Default = true,
                Callback = function(v) ShootSound.MuteGame = v; if v then pcall(hookMuteGameShoot) end; saveConfigAll() end })
        end
        task.defer(function()
            task.wait(1)
            pcall(hookGunStartShooting)
            pcall(hookMuteGameShoot)
        end)
    end

    task.defer(function() pcall(dnHook) end)

    local RBT = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "R", "Ragebot Text", "crosshair")
    if RBT then
        sAdd(RBT, "AddToggle", "rbs_enabled", { Text = "show ragebot text", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) RB_STATUS.Enabled = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(RBT, "AddSlider", "rbs_size", { Text = "text size", Min = 8, Max = 40, Default = 12, Rounding = 0,
            Callback = function(v) RB_STATUS.Size = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(RBT, "AddSlider", "rbs_offset", { Text = "offset below crosshair", Min = -200, Max = 300, Default = 20, Rounding = 0, Suffix = "px",
            Callback = function(v) RB_STATUS.Offset = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(RBT, "AddSlider", "rbs_outline", { Text = "outline strength", Min = 0, Max = 1, Default = 0, Rounding = 2,
            Callback = function(v) RB_STATUS.StrokeT = 1 - v; saveConfigAll() end })
        addPicker(RBT, "rbs_color", { Default = WHT, Title = "text color", Transparency = 0, Callback = function(c) RB_STATUS.Color = c; saveConfigAll() end })
        addPicker(RBT, "rbs_outline_color", { Default = BLACK, Title = "outline color", Transparency = 0, Callback = function(c) RB_STATUS.Outline = c; saveConfigAll() end })
    end

    -- both default on; idempotent in case the UI already fired the callbacks
    if getgenv then getgenv().SolWmStop = wmStop end
    task.defer(function() pcall(wmStart) end)
end)()
