-- ================= HIT SOUND (data + playback) =================
-- the UI block further down was calling these names without them ever being defined,
-- so the whole Hit Sound groupbox errored out silently. everything lives on one table now.
local HitSound = { Enabled = false, ReplaceDefault = false, Selected = "CSGO", Custom = "", Volume = 1, Pitch = 1 }
ConfigStore.HitSound = HitSound
HitSound.Import_Buffer = ""

local HS_DIR = "argon/sounds"
-- built-in presets. FILL: put real rbxassetid numbers here, the ids below are placeholders
local HS_PRESETS = {
    BowHit = "rbxassetid://1053296915",
    Click = "rbxassetid://1347140027",
    CSGO = "rbxassetid://5764885315",
    Damage = "rbxassetid://8587183599",
    Explosion = "rbxassetid://90854697257230",
    Gamesense = "rbxassetid://4817809188",
    Hover = "rbxassetid://6333717580",
    Hitmarker = "rbxassetid://1129547534",
    Impact = "rbxassetid://6759025689",
    Ice = "rbxassetid://268934012",
    Minecraft = "rbxassetid://4018616850",
    Neverlose = "rbxassetid://6607204501",
    Pop = "rbxassetid://18803667669",
    Rust = "rbxassetid://5043539486",
    Sparkle = "rbxassetid://132463144859699",
    Steve = "rbxassetid://4965083997",
    TF2 = "rbxassetid://8255306220",
    Windows = "rbxassetid://9066167010",
}

function HitSound.Say(msg) print("[hitsound] " .. tostring(msg)) end

function HitSound.List()
    local out = {}
    for name in pairs(HS_PRESETS) do out[#out + 1] = name end
    table.sort(out)
    out[#out + 1] = "custom"
    if listfiles and isfolder and isfolder(HS_DIR) then
        for _, f in ipairs(listfiles(HS_DIR)) do
            local n = f:match("([^/\\]+)$")
            if n and n:find("%.") then out[#out + 1] = "file: " .. n end
        end
    end
    return out
end

-- downloads a url into argon/sounds, returns the local path (nil + reason on failure)
function HitSound.Import(src)
    src = (src or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    if not src:match("^https?://") then return nil, "not a http(s) link" end
    if not (writefile and game.HttpGet) then return nil, "executor lacks writefile/HttpGet" end
    if makefolder and not (isfolder and isfolder(HS_DIR)) then pcall(makefolder, HS_DIR) end
    local ok, data = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, src)
    if not ok or type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 100 then return nil, "download failed" end
    local name = src:match("/([^/%?#]+)%??[^/]*$") or "sound"
    if not name:match("%.%w+$") then name = name .. ".mp3" end
    local path = HS_DIR .. "/" .. name
    writefile(path, data)
    return path
end

local hsCache = {}
-- turns the current selection into something Sound.SoundId accepts
function HitSound.Resolve()
    local sel = HitSound.Selected
    local raw
    if HS_PRESETS[sel] then raw = HS_PRESETS[sel]
    elseif sel == "custom" then raw = HitSound.Custom
    elseif sel:sub(1, 6) == "file: " then raw = HS_DIR .. "/" .. sel:sub(7) end
    if not raw or raw == "" or raw == "0" then return nil end
    if hsCache[raw] then return hsCache[raw] end

    local id
    if raw:match("^%d+$") then id = "rbxassetid://" .. raw
    elseif raw:match("^rbxassetid://") then id = raw
    else
        local path = raw
        if raw:match("^https?://") then path = HitSound.Import(raw) end
        if path and isfile and isfile(path) and getcustomasset then
            local okA, a = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
            if okA then id = a end
        end
    end
    if id then hsCache[raw] = id end
    return id
end

local hsSound
function HitSound.Play(force)
    if not force and not HitSound.Enabled then return end
    local id = HitSound.Resolve()
    if not id then return false end
    if not hsSound or not hsSound.Parent then
        hsSound = Instance.new("Sound")
        hsSound.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
    end
    hsSound.SoundId = id
    hsSound.Volume = HitSound.Volume
    hsSound.PlaybackSpeed = HitSound.Pitch
    hsSound:Play()
    return true
end

function HitSound.Preview()
    if not HitSound.Play(true) then
        HitSound.Say("nothing to play for '" .. tostring(HitSound.Selected) .. "' (check ids / custom input)")
    end
end

-- hooks the game's own hit confirmation, so the sound lines up with real hits
local hsHooked = false
function HitSound.Hook()
    if hsHooked then return end
    local okV, CVM = pcall(function()
        return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem.ClientViewModel)
    end)
    if not (okV and type(CVM) == "table" and type(CVM.PlayHitmarkerSound) == "function") then
        HitSound.Say("PlayHitmarkerSound not found, hit sound not hooked")
        return
    end
    hsHooked = true
    local orig = CVM.PlayHitmarkerSound
    CVM.PlayHitmarkerSound = function(self, ...)
        if HitSound.Enabled then
            HitSound.Play()
            if HitSound.ReplaceDefault then return end
        end
        return orig(self, ...)
    end
end

-- ================= GUN WIREFRAME + HIT SOUND =================
local WireInit = function()
    local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
    local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

    -- ---------- gun wireframe (kicia's method) ----------
    -- each gun MeshPart gets its mesh swapped for thin quads along its crease edges, built from the
    -- mesh's own binary data. originals are restored when the wireframe is turned off.
    -- materials: kicia's names first (Ghost, Flat, Foil, Custom, Reflective) then the rest of roblox's list
    local WIRE_MATERIALS = {
        Original = false,   -- keep the gun's own material
        Ghost = Enum.Material.ForceField, Flat = Enum.Material.Neon, Foil = Enum.Material.Foil,
        Custom = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Reflective = Enum.Material.Glass,
        Marble = Enum.Material.Marble, Granite = Enum.Material.Granite, Brick = Enum.Material.Brick,
        Cobblestone = Enum.Material.Cobblestone, Concrete = Enum.Material.Concrete, Fabric = Enum.Material.Fabric,
        Ice = Enum.Material.Ice, Metal = Enum.Material.Metal, Wood = Enum.Material.Wood,
        WoodPlanks = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Plastic = Enum.Material.Plastic, Sand = Enum.Material.Sand,
        Slate = Enum.Material.Slate, Pebble = Enum.Material.Pebble, Asphalt = Enum.Material.Asphalt,
        DiamondPlate = Enum.Material.DiamondPlate, CorrodedMetal = Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal,
    }
    local WIRE_MAT_ORDER = { "Original", "Ghost", "Flat", "Foil", "Custom", "Reflective", "Marble", "Granite", "Brick",
        "Cobblestone", "Concrete", "Fabric", "Ice", "Metal", "Wood", "WoodPlanks", "Plastic", "Sand", "Slate", "Pebble",
        "Asphalt", "DiamondPlate", "CorrodedMetal" }
    local WireCfg = { Enabled = false, Color = PINK, Width = 0.012, Crease = 24,
        Material = "Flat", Transparency = 0, Reflectance = 0 }
    ConfigStore.GunWire = WireCfg

    local FC = nil
    local function fighterCtrl()
        if FC == nil then
            local ok, c = pcall(function() return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController) end)
            FC = ok and c or false
        end
        return FC or nil
    end
    local function getGun()
        local fc = fighterCtrl()
        local lf = fc and fc.LocalFighter
        local it = lf and lf.EquippedItem
        return it and it.ViewModel and it.ViewModel.ItemModel
    end

    local UGC = nil
    local function getUGC()
        if UGC == nil then
            local ok, svc = pcall(function() return cloneref(game:GetService("UGCValidationService")) end)
            UGC = ok and svc or false
        end
        return UGC or nil
    end

    -- run fn under identity 8 (kicia's identity for mesh/colour writes), then restore the old one
    local function asIdentity(fn)
        local old = getthreadidentity and getthreadidentity()
        if setthreadidentity then pcall(setthreadidentity, 8) end
        local ok, err = pcall(fn)
        if old and setthreadidentity then pcall(setthreadidentity, old) end
        return ok, err
    end

    local function meshScale(part)
        local ms, sz = part.MeshSize, part.Size
        local sum, cnt = 0, 0
        for _, pr in ipairs({ { ms.X, sz.X }, { ms.Y, sz.Y }, { ms.Z, sz.Z } }) do
            if pr[2] > 1e-6 then sum += pr[1] / pr[2]; cnt += 1 end
        end
        return cnt > 0 and sum / cnt or 1
    end

    local function posKey(v) return ("%.3f,%.3f,%.3f"):format(v.X, v.Y, v.Z) end

    -- crease-edge mesh for one mesh id; returns a Content or nil
    local function buildWire(meshId, width, creaseDeg)
        local ugc = getUGC(); if not ugc then return nil end
        local okD, data = pcall(ugc.GetMeshDataBinaryString, ugc, meshId)
        if not okD or not data then return nil end
        local okM, em = pcall(ugc.CreateEditableMeshFromBinaryStringRobloxOnly, ugc, data)
        if not okM or not em then return nil end

        local faces = {}
        for _, fid in ipairs(em:GetFaces()) do
            local fv = em:GetFaceVertices(fid)
            if #fv >= 3 then
                local pos = {}
                for k, vid in ipairs(fv) do pos[k] = em:GetPosition(vid) end
                local n = (pos[2] - pos[1]):Cross(pos[3] - pos[1])
                if n.Magnitude >= 1e-6 then
                    faces[#faces + 1] = { FaceId = fid, Verts = fv, Pos = pos, Normal = n.Unit }
                end
            end
        end
        for _, f in ipairs(faces) do pcall(em.RemoveFace, em, f.FaceId) end
        pcall(em.RemoveUnused, em)

        local edgeMap, edges = {}, {}
        for _, f in ipairs(faces) do
            local n = #f.Verts
            for i = 1, n do
                local a, b = f.Pos[i], f.Pos[i % n + 1]
                local ka, kb = posKey(a), posKey(b)
                local key = ka .. "|" .. kb
                if kb < ka then key = kb .. "|" .. ka end
                local e = edgeMap[key]
                if e == nil then
                    e = { A = a, B = b, Normal = f.Normal, Opposite = nil }
                    edgeMap[key] = e
                    edges[#edges + 1] = e
                elseif e.Opposite == nil then
                    e.Opposite = f.Normal
                end
            end
        end

        -- a crease: the two faces bend past the crease angle, or the edge sits on an open border
        local cosT = math.cos(math.rad(creaseDeg))
        local half = width * 0.5
        local added = 0
        for _, e in ipairs(edges) do
            if added >= 10000 then break end
            if e.Opposite == nil or e.Normal:Dot(e.Opposite) < cosT then
                local dir = e.B - e.A
                if dir.Magnitude >= 1e-6 then
                    local side = e.Normal:Cross(dir.Unit)
                    if side.Magnitude >= 1e-6 then
                        local u, lift = side.Unit, e.Normal * 0.001
                        local ok = pcall(function()
                            local v1 = em:AddVertex(e.A - u * half + lift)
                            local v2 = em:AddVertex(e.A + u * half + lift)
                            local v3 = em:AddVertex(e.B + u * half + lift)
                            local v4 = em:AddVertex(e.B - u * half + lift)
                            for _ = 1, 4 do em:AddColor(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 1) end
                            em:AddTriangle(v1, v2, v3)
                            em:AddTriangle(v1, v3, v4)
                        end)
                        if ok then added += 1 end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if added == 0 then return nil end
        local okC, content = pcall(Content.fromObject, em)
        return okC and content or nil
    end

    local skinOn = false                 -- set by the skin section: a skinned gun is never wired
    local skinWireHook = function() end
    local wireCache = {}   -- key -> Content, or false when the build failed
    local tracked = {}     -- [MeshPart] = { MeshContent, Color } (originals)

    -- every style setting goes through here: material, transparency, reflectance, colour
    local function styleWire(part, snap)
        asIdentity(function()
            part.Color = WireCfg.Color
            local m = WIRE_MATERIALS[WireCfg.Material]
            part.Material = (m == nil or m == false) and snap.Material or m
            part.Transparency = WireCfg.Transparency
            part.Reflectance = WireCfg.Reflectance
        end)
    end

    local function applyWire(part)
        if tracked[part] or not part:IsA("MeshPart") then return end
        if skinOn then return end
        local id = part.MeshId
        if id == nil or id == "" then return end
        tracked[part] = { MeshContent = part.MeshContent, Color = part.Color, Material = part.Material,
            Transparency = part.Transparency, Reflectance = part.Reflectance }
        task.spawn(function()
            local width = WireCfg.Width * meshScale(part)
            local key = id .. "|" .. string.format("%.5f|%.2f", width, WireCfg.Crease)
            local content = wireCache[key]
            if content == nil then
                content = buildWire(id, width, WireCfg.Crease) or false
                wireCache[key] = content
            end
            if not content or not tracked[part] or not part.Parent then return end
            asIdentity(function()
                part.MeshContent = content
            end)
            styleWire(part, tracked[part])
        end)
    end

    local function restorePart(part, snap)
        if not part.Parent then return end
        asIdentity(function()
            part.MeshContent = snap.MeshContent
            part.Color = snap.Color
            part.Material = snap.Material
            part.Transparency = snap.Transparency
            part.Reflectance = snap.Reflectance
        end)
    end

    local function wireRestyle()
        for part, snap in pairs(tracked) do
            if part.Parent then styleWire(part, snap) end
        end
    end

    local function clearWire()
        for part, snap in pairs(tracked) do restorePart(part, snap) end
        table.clear(tracked)
    end

    -- ---------- gun skin (asset id per weapon slot, applied to the held viewmodel) ----------
    -- SkinCfg.Slots[slot] = asset number. slot 1 primary, 2 secondary, 3 melee/knife (Rivals' Slot attribute)
    local SkinCfg = { Enabled = false, Pending = "", Slots = {} }
    ConfigStore.GunSkin = SkinCfg
    local skinTracked = {}   -- [instance] = { prop, orig }

    local function skinNote(msg)
        pcall(function() Library:Notification(msg, 3, Library.Theme.Accent) end)
    end

    local function assetDigits(text)
        local d = tostring(text or ""):match("(%d+)")
        return d
    end

    local function equippedItem()
        local fc = fighterCtrl()
        local lf = fc and fc.LocalFighter
        return lf and lf.EquippedItem
    end

    local function heldSlot()
        local it = equippedItem()
        if not it then return nil end
        local ok, sl = pcall(function() return it:Get("Slot") end)
        return ok and tonumber(sl) or nil
    end

    local function skinAssetForHeld()
        if not SkinCfg.Enabled then return nil end
        local sl = heldSlot()
        local digits = sl and SkinCfg.Slots[tostring(sl)]
        return digits and ("rbxassetid://" .. digits) or nil
    end

    local function clearSkin()
        for obj, rec in pairs(skinTracked) do
            if obj.Parent then pcall(function() obj[rec.prop] = rec.orig end) end
        end
        table.clear(skinTracked)
    end

    -- sets prop to asset, remembering the game's original value once so it can be restored
    local function skinTarget(obj, prop, asset)
        local rec = skinTracked[obj]
        if not rec then
            local ok, orig = pcall(function() return obj[prop] end)
            if not ok then return end
            rec = { prop = prop, orig = orig }
            skinTracked[obj] = rec
        end
        if obj[rec.prop] ~= asset then pcall(function() obj[rec.prop] = asset end) end
    end

    local function applySkin(gun)
        local asset = gun and skinAssetForHeld()
        if (asset ~= nil) ~= skinOn then
            skinOn = asset ~= nil
            skinWireHook(skinOn)   -- a skinned gun can't keep its wire: the wire mesh has no UVs for the texture
        end
        if not asset then clearSkin(); return end
        for _, d in ipairs(gun:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                local sa = d:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
                if sa then skinTarget(sa, "ColorMap", asset) end
                if d:IsA("MeshPart") then skinTarget(d, "TextureID", asset) end
            end
        end
    end

    -- ---------- gun wireframe driver ----------
    local currentGun = nil

    local function scanGun(gun)
        for _, d in ipairs(gun:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("MeshPart") then applyWire(d) end
        end
    end

    local function wireRebuild()
        clearWire()
        if WireCfg.Enabled and currentGun then scanGun(currentGun) end
    end

    skinWireHook = function(skinned)
        if skinned then clearWire()
        elseif WireCfg.Enabled then wireRebuild() end
    end

    local function startWire()
        WireCfg.Enabled = true
        wireRebuild()
    end

    local function stopWire()
        WireCfg.Enabled = false
        clearWire()
    end
    WireCfg.Start, WireCfg.Stop, WireCfg.Restyle = startWire, stopWire, wireRestyle

    -- one loop watches the held gun: rewires on change, and keeps the skin on (the game can re-set textures)
    local nextSkin = 0
    RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
        local gun = getGun()
        if gun ~= currentGun then
            clearWire()
            clearSkin()
            currentGun = gun
            nextSkin = 0
            if gun and WireCfg.Enabled then scanGun(gun) end
        end
        if currentGun and os.clock() >= nextSkin then
            nextSkin = os.clock() + 0.5
            applySkin(currentGun)
        end
    end)

    local SKG = mkGB(Tabs.Skins, "R", "Gun Skin", "palette")
    if SKG then
        sAdd(SKG, "AddToggle", "skin_enabled", { Text = "enabled", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) SkinCfg.Enabled = v; nextSkin = 0; if not v then clearSkin() end; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(SKG, "AddTextbox", "skin_id", { Text = "asset id", Placeholder = "paste rbxassetid or link", Default = "",
            Finished = true, Callback = function(t) SkinCfg.Pending = assetDigits(t) or "" end })
        local function setSlot(slot, label)
            return function()
                local d = SkinCfg.Pending
                if not d or d == "" then skinNote("paste an asset id first"); return end
                SkinCfg.Slots[tostring(slot)] = d
                nextSkin = 0
                saveConfigAll()
                skinNote(label .. " skin set to " .. d)
            end
        end
        sAdd(SKG, "AddButton", { Text = "Set Primary", Func = setSlot(1, "primary") })
        sAdd(SKG, "AddButton", { Text = "Set Secondary", Func = setSlot(2, "secondary") })
        sAdd(SKG, "AddButton", { Text = "Set Melee / Knife", Func = setSlot(3, "melee") })
        sAdd(SKG, "AddButton", { Text = "Clear all skins", Func = function()
            SkinCfg.Slots = {}
            nextSkin = 0
            saveConfigAll()
            skinNote("cleared all gun skins")
        end })
    end

    local HSG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "R", "Hit Sound", "zap")
    if HSG then
        sAdd(HSG, "AddToggle", "hs_enabled", { Text = "enabled", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) HitSound.Enabled = v; if v then HitSound.Hook() end; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(HSG, "AddToggle", "hs_replace", { Text = "replace default sound", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) HitSound.ReplaceDefault = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        local hsDrop = sAdd(HSG, "AddDropdown", "hs_sound", { Values = HitSound.List(), Default = "CSGO", Text = "sound",
            Callback = function(v) HitSound.Selected = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(HSG, "AddTextbox", "hs_custom", { Text = "custom id / path / url", Placeholder = "asset id, path or link", Default = "",
            Finished = true, Callback = function(t)
                HitSound.Custom = t or ""
                HitSound.Selected = "custom"
                pcall(function() if hsDrop and hsDrop.Set then hsDrop:Set("custom") end end)
                saveConfigAll()
            end })
        sAdd(HSG, "AddTextbox", "hs_import", { Text = "import file / url", Placeholder = "path or https link", Default = "",
            Finished = true, Callback = function(t) HitSound.Import_Buffer = t or "" end })
        sAdd(HSG, "AddButton", { Text = "Import", Func = function()
            local path, err = HitSound.Import(HitSound.Import_Buffer)
            if not path then HitSound.Say(err); return end
            HitSound.Say("imported " .. (path:match("([^/]+)$") or path))
            if hsDrop and hsDrop.Refresh then pcall(function() hsDrop:Refresh(HitSound.List()) end) end
        end })
        sAdd(HSG, "AddSlider", "hs_volume", { Text = "volume", Min = 0, Max = 10, Default = 1, Rounding = 2, Suffix = "x",
            Callback = function(v) HitSound.Volume = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(HSG, "AddSlider", "hs_pitch", { Text = "pitch", Min = 0.1, Max = 3, Default = 1, Rounding = 2,
            Callback = function(v) HitSound.Pitch = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(HSG, "AddButton", { Text = "Preview", Func = HitSound.Preview })
    end
end
local okWire, errWire = pcall(WireInit)
if not okWire then warn("[ui] wire/skin/hitsound failed: " .. tostring(errWire)) end


-- ================= AURA SUB-TAB: WIREFRAME + VALORANT ARMS =================
-- wireframe: viewmodel edges drawn with WireframeHandleAdornment, per-line gradient
-- (solid/start, middle, end, color mode, gradient directions, transparency)
-- valorant arms: obj arm meshes, swapped in over the default arms.
do
local ValArms = {}
local okAura, errAura = pcall(function()
    local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
    local cloneref_ = cloneref or function(x) return x end
    local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

    local function withIdentity(fn, ...)
        local old = getthreadidentity and getthreadidentity()
        if setthreadidentity then pcall(setthreadidentity, 8) end
        local ok, res = pcall(fn, ...)
        if old and setthreadidentity then pcall(setthreadidentity, old) end
        return ok, res
    end

    local ARM_LIST = { "LeftArm", "RightArm" }
    local ARM_NAMES = {
        LeftArm = true, RightArm = true, LeftArmWrapped = true, RightArmWrapped = true,
        LeftUpperArm = true, RightUpperArm = true, LeftLowerArm = true, RightLowerArm = true,
        LeftHand = true, RightHand = true, ["Left Arm"] = true, ["Right Arm"] = true,
    }

    -- FighterController.LocalFighter.EquippedItem.ViewModel
    local AuraFC = nil
    local function localViewModel()
        if AuraFC == nil then
            local ok, c = pcall(function() return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController) end)
            AuraFC = ok and c or false
        end
        local lf = AuraFC and AuraFC.LocalFighter
        local it = lf and lf.EquippedItem
        return it and it.ViewModel or nil
    end

    -- ---------- edges ----------
    local UGC = nil
    local function getUGC()
        if UGC == nil then
            local ok, svc = pcall(function() return cloneref_(game:GetService("UGCValidationService")) end)
            UGC = ok and svc or false
        end
        return UGC or nil
    end

    local function editableFromMeshId(meshId)
        local ugc = getUGC()
        if not ugc then return nil end
        local ok, data = withIdentity(ugc.GetMeshDataBinaryString, ugc, meshId)
        if not ok or not data then return nil end
        local ok2, em = withIdentity(ugc.CreateEditableMeshFromBinaryStringRobloxOnly, ugc, data)
        return ok2 and em or nil
    end

    local function posKey(v)
        return string.format("%.3f,%.3f,%.3f", v.X, v.Y, v.Z)
    end

    local EDGE_MAX = 30000
    local function buildEdges(em)
        local okF, faces = pcall(function() return em:GetFaces() end)
        if not okF or not faces then return nil end
        local segs, seen = {}, {}
        local mn = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        local mx = Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
        for _, fid in ipairs(faces) do
            local okV, fv = pcall(function() return em:GetFaceVertices(fid) end)
            if okV and fv and #fv >= 3 then
                local n = #fv
                for i = 1, n do
                    local pa = em:GetPosition(fv[i])
                    local pb = em:GetPosition(fv[i % n + 1])
                    local ka, kb = posKey(pa), posKey(pb)
                    local k = ka < kb and (ka .. "|" .. kb) or (kb .. "|" .. ka)
                    if not seen[k] then
                        seen[k] = true
                        segs[#segs + 1] = pa
                        segs[#segs + 1] = pb
                        mn = Vector3.new(math.min(mn.X, pa.X, pb.X), math.min(mn.Y, pa.Y, pb.Y), math.min(mn.Z, pa.Z, pb.Z))
                        mx = Vector3.new(math.max(mx.X, pa.X, pb.X), math.max(mx.Y, pa.Y, pb.Y), math.max(mx.Z, pa.Z, pb.Z))
                    end
                end
                if #segs >= EDGE_MAX * 2 then break end
            end
        end
        if #segs == 0 then return nil end
        return { segs = segs, min = mn, max = mx }
    end

    local EDGE_CACHE = {}
    local function edgesOf(key)
        local c = EDGE_CACHE[key]
        if c == nil then
            local em
            if type(key) == "string" then em = editableFromMeshId(key) else em = key end
            c = em and buildEdges(em) or false
            EDGE_CACHE[key] = c
        end
        return c or nil
    end

    -- ---------- gradient ----------
    local AXIS_DEF = {
        ["length"] = { "X", false }, ["height"] = { "Y", false }, ["width"] = { "Z", false },
        ["reverse length"] = { "X", true }, ["reverse height"] = { "Y", true }, ["reverse width"] = { "Z", true },
    }

    local function axisT(cfg, ed, p)
        local axes = cfg.GradientAxis
        if not axes or #axes == 0 then return 0 end
        local span = ed.max - ed.min
        local tot = 0
        for _, name in ipairs(axes) do
            local def = AXIS_DEF[name]
            if def then
                local ax = def[1]
                local s = span[ax]
                local t = s > 1e-6 and (p[ax] - ed.min[ax]) / s or 0.5
                t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
                if def[2] then t = 1 - t end
                tot += t
            end
        end
        return tot / #axes
    end

    local function colorAt(cfg, t)
        if cfg.ColorMode ~= "gradient" then return cfg.Color end
        if t <= 0.5 then return cfg.Color:Lerp(cfg.ColorMiddle, t * 2) end
        return cfg.ColorMiddle:Lerp(cfg.Color2, (t - 0.5) * 2)
    end

    local function styleKey(c)
        return table.concat({
            c.ColorMode, tostring(c.Color), tostring(c.ColorMiddle), tostring(c.Color2),
            table.concat(c.GradientAxis, ","), tostring(c.Transparency),
        }, "|")
    end

    local function rebuild(item)
        local ad, ed, cfg = item.adorn, item.edges, item.cfg
        ad:Clear()
        ad.Transparency = cfg.Transparency
        local sc, off = item.sc, item.off
        local segs = ed.segs
        for i = 1, #segs, 2 do
            local a, b = segs[i], segs[i + 1]
            ad.Color3 = colorAt(cfg, axisT(cfg, ed, (a + b) * 0.5))
            ad:AddLine(a * sc + off, b * sc + off)
        end
        item.key = styleKey(cfg)
    end

    -- ---------- engine ----------
    local function newEngine(cfg, collect)
        local E = { cfg = cfg, items = {}, acc = 0 }

        function E.release(part, item)
            if item.adorn then item.adorn:Destroy() end
            if item.hidden and part and part.Parent then
                part.LocalTransparencyModifier = item.origLTM or 0
            end
        end

        function E.clear(self)
            for part, item in pairs(self.items) do E.release(part, item) end
            self.items = {}
        end

        function E.step(self, dt)
            if not cfg.Enabled then
                if next(self.items) then self:clear() end
                return
            end
            self.acc += dt
            if self.acc < 0.1 then return end
            self.acc = 0

            local seen = {}
            for _, w in ipairs(collect()) do
                local part = w.part
                seen[part] = true
                local item = self.items[part]
                if not item then
                    local ad = Instance.new("WireframeHandleAdornment")
                    ad.Name = "SolWire"
                    ad.ZIndex = 10
                    ad.Thickness = 1
                    ad.AlwaysOnTop = true
                    ad.Adornee = part
                    ad.Parent = PlayerGui
                    item = { adorn = ad, cfg = cfg, hidden = false }
                    self.items[part] = item
                end
                item.cfg = cfg
                item.sc, item.off = w.sc, w.off
                local ed = edgesOf(w.src)
                if ed and (item.edges ~= ed or item.sc ~= w.sc or item.off ~= w.off or item.key ~= styleKey(cfg)) then
                    item.edges = ed
                    rebuild(item)
                end
                if w.hide then
                    if not item.hidden then
                        item.hidden = true
                        item.origLTM = part.LocalTransparencyModifier
                    end
                    part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                end
            end

            for part, item in pairs(self.items) do
                if not seen[part] or not part.Parent then
                    E.release(part, item)
                    self.items[part] = nil
                end
            end
        end
        return E
    end

    -- ---------- targets ----------
    local function gunTargets()
        local out = {}
        local vm = localViewModel()
        local model = vm and vm.ItemModel
        if not model or not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return out end
        for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") and not ARM_NAMES[d.Name] then
                if d:IsA("MeshPart") then
                    if d.MeshId ~= "" then
                        local ms, sz = d.MeshSize, d.Size
                        local sc = Vector3.new(
                            ms.X > 1e-4 and sz.X / ms.X or 1,
                            ms.Y > 1e-4 and sz.Y / ms.Y or 1,
                            ms.Z > 1e-4 and sz.Z / ms.Z or 1)
                        out[#out + 1] = { part = d, src = d.MeshId, sc = sc, off = Vector3.zero, hide = true }
                    end
                else
                    local sm = d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
                    if sm and sm.MeshId ~= "" then
                        out[#out + 1] = { part = d, src = sm.MeshId, sc = sm.Scale, off = sm.Offset, hide = true }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return out
    end

    local function armTargets()
        local out = {}
        local vm = localViewModel()
        local model = vm and vm.Model
        if not model or not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return out end
        for _, name in ipairs(ARM_LIST) do
            local arm = model:FindFirstChild(name)
            if arm and arm:IsA("BasePart") then
                local rec = ValArms.RecordFor(arm)
                if rec and rec.Visual and rec.Visual.Parent then
                    local a = rec.Asset.Size
                    local v = rec.Visual.Size
                    local sc = Vector3.new(a.X > 1e-4 and v.X / a.X or 1, a.Y > 1e-4 and v.Y / a.Y or 1, a.Z > 1e-4 and v.Z / a.Z or 1)
                    out[#out + 1] = { part = rec.Visual, src = rec.Editable, sc = sc, off = Vector3.zero, hide = false }
                else
                    local sm = arm:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
                    if sm and sm.MeshId ~= "" then
                        out[#out + 1] = { part = arm, src = sm.MeshId, sc = sm.Scale, off = sm.Offset, hide = false }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return out
    end

    -- ---------- valorant arms ----------
    local VAL_DIR = "Solaria/Assets/ValorantArms"
    local VAL_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/engnyg/123f1/refs/heads/main/valorant/arm/"
    local VAL_FILES = {
        LeftArm = { File = "valorant-leftV2.obj", Id = "12307734932" },
        RightArm = { File = "valorant-rightV2.obj", Id = "12307583853" },
    }
    local VAL_TEX = "FP_Wushu_S0_DF.png"
    local BIND = "SolariaValorantArms"
    local valState = { Enabled = false, Loading = false, Ready = false, Meshes = {}, Records = {}, Texture = nil }

    function ValArms.RecordFor(part)
        return valState.Records[part]
    end

    local function ensureDir()
        pcall(function()
            if not makefolder then return end
            for _, f in ipairs({ "Solaria", "Solaria/Assets", "Solaria/Assets/ValorantArms" }) do
                if not (isfolder and isfolder(f)) then makefolder(f) end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function download(name, check)
        local path = VAL_DIR .. "/" .. name
        if isfile and isfile(path) then
            local okR, body = pcall(readfile, path)
            if okR and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then return body end
        end
        local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(VAL_URL .. name) end)
        if not ok or type(body) ~= "string" or (check and not check(body)) then
            error("download failed: " .. name)
        end
        if writefile then pcall(writefile, path, body) end
        return body
    end

    local function objIndex(s, n)
        local v = tonumber(s)
        if not v then return nil end
        if v < 0 then v = n + v + 1 end
        return v
    end

    local function buildMesh(objText)
        local V, UV, N, F = {}, {}, {}, {}
        for line in objText:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
            local kind, rest = line:match("^%s*(%S+)%s+(.+)$")
            if kind == "v" then
                local x, y, z = rest:match("^(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)")
                V[#V + 1] = Vector3.new(tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z))
            elseif kind == "vt" then
                local u, v = rest:match("^(%S+)%s+(%S+)")
                UV[#UV + 1] = Vector2.new(tonumber(u), 1 - tonumber(v))
            elseif kind == "vn" then
                local x, y, z = rest:match("^(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)")
                N[#N + 1] = Vector3.new(tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z))
            elseif kind == "f" then
                local corners = {}
                for tok in rest:gmatch("%S+") do
                    local vi, ti, ni = tok:match("^(%-?%d+)/?(%-?%d*)/?(%-?%d*)$")
                    if vi then
                        corners[#corners + 1] = {
                            objIndex(vi, #V), objIndex(ti, #UV), objIndex(ni, #N),
                        }
                    end
                end
                if #corners == 3 then
                    F[#F + 1] = corners
                elseif #corners == 4 then
                    F[#F + 1] = { corners[1], corners[2], corners[3] }
                    F[#F + 1] = { corners[1], corners[3], corners[4] }
                end
            end
        end
        assert(#V > 0 and #F > 0, "empty obj")

        local mn, mx = V[1], V[1]
        for _, v in ipairs(V) do
            mn = Vector3.new(math.min(mn.X, v.X), math.min(mn.Y, v.Y), math.min(mn.Z, v.Z))
            mx = Vector3.new(math.max(mx.X, v.X), math.max(mx.Y, v.Y), math.max(mx.Z, v.Z))
        end
        local center = (mn + mx) * 0.5

        local em = AssetService:CreateEditableMesh()
        local vid, uid, nid = {}, {}, {}
        for i, v in ipairs(V) do vid[i] = em:AddVertex(v - center) end
        for i, uv in ipairs(UV) do uid[i] = em:AddUV(uv) end
        for i, n in ipairs(N) do nid[i] = em:AddNormal(n) end
        for _, f in ipairs(F) do
            local a, b, c = f[1], f[2], f[3]
            local tri = em:AddTriangle(vid[a[1]], vid[b[1]], vid[c[1]])
            if a[2] and b[2] and c[2] then
                pcall(em.SetFaceUVs, em, tri, { uid[a[2]], uid[b[2]], uid[c[2]] })
            end
            if a[3] and b[3] and c[3] then
                pcall(em.SetFaceNormals, em, tri, { nid[a[3]], nid[b[3]], nid[c[3]] })
            end
        end

        local template = AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromObject(em), { CollisionFidelity = Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box })
        return { Template = template, Editable = em, Center = center, Size = mx - mn }
    end

    local function loadAssets()
        if valState.Ready or valState.Loading then return end
        valState.Loading = true
        ensureDir()
        for k, info in pairs(VAL_FILES) do
            local okD, body = pcall(download, info.File, function(b)
                return b:find("\nv ", 1, true) and b:find("\nf ", 1, true)
            end)
            if okD then
                local okM, mesh = pcall(buildMesh, body)
                if okM then valState.Meshes[k] = mesh
                else warn("[valorant arms] " .. k .. ": " .. tostring(mesh)) end
            else
                warn("[valorant arms] " .. tostring(body))
            end
        end
        local okT = pcall(download, VAL_TEX)
        if okT and getcustomasset then
            local okA, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, VAL_DIR .. "/" .. VAL_TEX)
            if okA then valState.Texture = asset end
        end
        valState.Ready = next(valState.Meshes) ~= nil
        valState.Loading = false
    end

    local function removeRecord(orig)
        local rec = valState.Records[orig]
        if not rec then return end
        valState.Records[orig] = nil
        if rec.conn then rec.conn:Disconnect() end
        if rec.Visual then rec.Visual:Destroy() end
        if orig.Parent then orig.LocalTransparencyModifier = rec.Visibility end
    end

    local function makeRecord(orig, k)
        local mesh = valState.Meshes[k]
        local sm = orig:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
        if not mesh or not sm or not sm.MeshId:find(VAL_FILES[k].Id, 1, true) then return nil end

        local clone = mesh.Template:Clone()
        clone.Name = "SolariaValorantArm_" .. k
        clone.Anchored = true
        clone.CanCollide = false
        clone.CanTouch = false
        clone.CanQuery = false
        clone.CastShadow = false
        clone.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        clone.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        if valState.Texture then clone.TextureID = valState.Texture end

        local rec = {
            Visual = clone, Mesh = sm, Asset = mesh, Editable = mesh.Editable,
            Visibility = orig.LocalTransparencyModifier, writing = false,
        }
        rec.conn = orig:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalTransparencyModifier"):Connect(function()
            if rec.writing or orig.LocalTransparencyModifier == 1 then return end
            rec.Visibility = orig.LocalTransparencyModifier
            rec.writing = true
            orig.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
            rec.writing = false
        end)
        valState.Records[orig] = rec
        return rec
    end

    local function valUpdate()
        if not valState.Enabled then return end
        local vm = localViewModel()
        local model = vm and vm.Model
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not model or not cam or not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
            for orig in pairs(valState.Records) do removeRecord(orig) end
            return
        end
        for orig, rec in pairs(valState.Records) do
            if orig.Parent ~= model or rec.Mesh.Parent ~= orig then removeRecord(orig) end
        end
        for k in pairs(VAL_FILES) do
            local orig = model:FindFirstChild(k)
            if orig and orig:IsA("BasePart") then
                local rec = valState.Records[orig] or makeRecord(orig, k)
                if rec then
                    local vis, mesh, asset = rec.Visual, rec.Mesh, rec.Asset
                    local size = asset.Size * mesh.Scale
                    if vis.Size ~= size then vis.Size = size end
                    vis.CFrame = orig.CFrame * CFrame.new(mesh.Offset + asset.Center * mesh.Scale)
                    vis.Transparency = orig.Transparency
                    vis.LocalTransparencyModifier = rec.Visibility
                    if vis.Parent ~= cam then vis.Parent = cam end
                    rec.writing = true
                    orig.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                    rec.writing = false
                end
            end
        end
    end

    function ValArms.SetEnabled(on)
        valState.Enabled = on and true or false
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BIND) end)
        if on then
            task.spawn(function()
                loadAssets()
                if valState.Enabled and valState.Ready then
                    RunService:BindToRenderStep(BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 2, valUpdate)
                end
            end)
        else
            for orig in pairs(valState.Records) do removeRecord(orig) end
        end
    end

    function ValArms.Unload()
        ValArms.SetEnabled(false)
        for _, m in pairs(valState.Meshes) do
            pcall(function() m.Template:Destroy(); m.Editable:Destroy() end)
        end
        valState.Meshes = {}
        valState.Ready = false
    end

    -- ---------- config + drivers ----------
    local function makeCfg()
        return {
            Enabled = false,
            Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180),
            ColorMiddle = Color3.fromRGB(190, 125, 255),
            Color2 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255),
            ColorMode = "solid",
            GradientAxis = {},
            Transparency = 0,
        }
    end

    local WF = { Gun = makeCfg(), Arms = makeCfg() }
    local gunEngine = newEngine(WF.Gun, gunTargets)
    local armEngine = newEngine(WF.Arms, armTargets)
    local wireConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        pcall(function() gunEngine:step(dt) end)
        pcall(function() armEngine:step(dt) end)
    end)

    ConfigStore.ViewWire = {
        Unload = function()
            if wireConn then wireConn:Disconnect(); wireConn = nil end
            gunEngine:clear()
            armEngine:clear()
            ValArms.Unload()
        end,
    }

    -- ---------- UI ----------
    local function collectSel(v)
        local out = {}
        if type(v) ~= "table" then return out end
        for k2, val in pairs(v) do
            if type(k2) == "number" and type(val) == "string" then out[#out + 1] = val
            elseif val == true then out[#out + 1] = k2 end
        end
        return out
    end

        addPicker(gb, prefix .. "_cm", { Default = cfg.ColorMiddle, Title = "middle", Transparency = 0,
            Callback = function(c) cfg.ColorMiddle = c; saveConfigAll() end })
        addPicker(gb, prefix .. "_c2", { Default = cfg.Color2, Title = "end", Transparency = 0,
            Callback = function(c) cfg.Color2 = c; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(gb, "AddDropdown", prefix .. "_mode", { Text = "color mode", Values = { "solid", "gradient" },
            Default = cfg.ColorMode, Callback = function(v) cfg.ColorMode = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(gb, "AddDropdown", prefix .. "_dirs", { Text = "gradient directions",
            Values = { "length", "height", "width", "reverse length", "reverse height", "reverse width" },
            Default = {}, Multi = true,
            Callback = function(v) cfg.GradientAxis = collectSel(v); saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(gb, "AddSlider", prefix .. "_tr", { Text = "transparency", Min = 0, Max = 1, Default = 0, Rounding = 2,
            Callback = function(v) cfg.Transparency = v; saveConfigAll() end })
    end

    local WWG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "L", "Weapon Wireframe", "crosshair")
    if WWG then wireControls(WWG, "ew_gun", WF.Gun) end

    local AWG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "R", "Arm Wireframe", "user")

    local VAG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "R", "Valorant Arms", "user")
    if VAG then
        sAdd(VAG, "AddToggle", "val_arms_enabled", { Text = "valorant arms", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) ValArms.SetEnabled(v); saveConfigAll() end })
    end

    ConfigStore.ValArms = ValArms
end)
if not okAura then warn("[ui] aura/wireframe failed: " .. tostring(errAura)) end
end

    -- ================= ARM CHAMS =================
(function()
    local AC = { Enabled = false, Kind = "Legacy", AlwaysOnTop = false,
        Material = Enum.Material.ForceField, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Transparency = 0,
        FillTransparency = 0.5, OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), OutlineTransparency = 0 }
    local MATERIALS = {
        ForceField = Enum.Material.ForceField, Neon = Enum.Material.Neon, Glass = Enum.Material.Glass,
        SmoothPlastic = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Metal = Enum.Material.Metal, Foil = Enum.Material.Foil,
        Marble = Enum.Material.Marble, Plastic = Enum.Material.Plastic, Wood = Enum.Material.Wood,
        Slate = Enum.Material.Slate,
    }
    local MATERIAL_LIST = { "ForceField", "Neon", "Glass", "SmoothPlastic", "Metal", "Foil", "Marble", "Plastic", "Wood", "Slate" }
    local acOrig, acHL = {}, {}
    local acBind = "__arm_chams"
    local acBound, acWarned = false, false
    local RS = game:GetService("RunService")

    local function acIsArm(part, cam)
        if not part:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
        local n = part.Name
        if not (string.find(n, "Arm") or string.find(n, "Hand")) then return false end
        local node = part
        while node and node ~= cam do
            if node.Name == "ItemVisual" then return false end
            node = node.Parent
        end
        return node == cam
    end

    local function acSave(part)
        local o = acOrig[part]
        if o then return o end
        o = { Color = part.Color, Material = part.Material, Transparency = part.Transparency,
              Reflectance = part.Reflectance, Removed = {}, Faded = {}, TexID = nil }
        if part:IsA("MeshPart") then o.TexID = part.TextureID end
        acOrig[part] = o
        return o
    end

    local function acApplyLegacy(part, o)
        part.Material = AC.Material
        part.Color = AC.Color
        part.Transparency = AC.Transparency
        part.Reflectance = 0
        if part:IsA("MeshPart") then pcall(function() part.TextureID = "" end) end
        for _, c in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                table.insert(o.Removed, { c, part })
                c.Parent = nil
            elseif c:IsA("Decal") or c:IsA("Texture") then
                table.insert(o.Faded, { c, c.Transparency })
                c.Transparency = 1
            end
        end
    end

    local function acApplyHighlight(part)
        local h = acHL[part]
        if not h or not h.Parent then
            h = Instance.new("Highlight")
            h.Adornee = part
            h.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
            acHL[part] = h
        end
        h.DepthMode = AC.AlwaysOnTop and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
        h.FillColor = AC.Color
        h.FillTransparency = AC.FillTransparency
        h.OutlineColor = AC.OutlineColor
        h.OutlineTransparency = AC.OutlineTransparency
    end

    local function acRestore()
        for part, o in pairs(acOrig) do
            if part.Parent then
                part.Color = o.Color
                part.Material = o.Material
                part.Transparency = o.Transparency
                part.Reflectance = o.Reflectance
                if o.TexID then pcall(function() part.TextureID = o.TexID end) end
            end
            for _, p in ipairs(o.Removed) do pcall(function() p[1].Parent = p[2] end) end
            for _, p in ipairs(o.Faded) do pcall(function() p[1].Transparency = p[2] end) end
        end
        table.clear(acOrig)
        for _, h in pairs(acHL) do pcall(function() h:Destroy() end) end
        table.clear(acHL)
    end

    -- runs at the last render priority so the game's own viewmodel update can't overwrite it
    local function acTick()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        local found = 0
        for _, d in ipairs(cam:GetDescendants()) do
            if acIsArm(d, cam) then
                found = found + 1
                local o = acSave(d)
                if AC.Kind == "Highlight" then acApplyHighlight(d) else acApplyLegacy(d, o) end
            end
        end
        if found == 0 and not acWarned then
            acWarned = true
            warn("[arm chams] no Arm/Hand parts found under workspace.CurrentCamera")
        end
    end

    local function acStart()
        if acBound then return end
        acBound = true
        acWarned = false
        RS:BindToRenderStep(acBind, Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, acTick)
    end

    local function acStop()
        if acBound then
            pcall(function() RS:UnbindFromRenderStep(acBind) end)
            acBound = false
        end
        acRestore()
    end

    local ACG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "L", "Arm Chams", "eye")
    if ACG then
        sAdd(ACG, "AddToggle", "ac_enabled", { Text = "enabled", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) AC.Enabled = v; if v then acStart() else acStop() end; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(ACG, "AddDropdown", "ac_kind", { Text = "style", Values = { "Legacy", "Highlight" }, Default = 1,
            Callback = function(v) AC.Kind = v; acRestore(); saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(ACG, "AddDropdown", "ac_material", { Text = "material", Values = MATERIAL_LIST, Default = 1,
            Callback = function(v) AC.Material = MATERIALS[v] or AC.Material; acRestore(); saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(ACG, "AddSlider", "ac_transp", { Text = "transparency", Min = 0, Max = 1, Default = 0, Rounding = 2,
            Callback = function(v) AC.Transparency = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(ACG, "AddToggle", "ac_ontop", { Text = "always on top (highlight)", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) AC.AlwaysOnTop = v; saveConfigAll() end })
    end
end)()

    local SKG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "R", "Skybox", "cloud")
    if SKG then
        sAdd(SKG, "AddToggle", "sky_enabled", { Text = "enabled", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) Sky.Enabled = v; if v then applySky(Sky.Current) else clearSky() end; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(SKG, "AddDropdown", "sky_preset", { Values = {"Night","Space","Sunset","Dawn","Heaven","Void","Nebula","Cloudy"}, Default = 1, Text = "preset",
            Callback = function(v) Sky.Current = v; if Sky.Enabled then applySky(v) end; saveConfigAll() end })
    end

    local FXG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "R", "Effects", "sparkles")
    if FXG then
        sAdd(FXG, "AddToggle", "fx_aura", { Text = "character aura", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) ConfigStore.Aura.Enabled = v; saveConfigAll(); ConfigStore.Aura.Refresh() end })
        sAdd(FXG, "AddDropdown", "fx_aura_preset", { Text = "aura preset", Values = ConfigStore.AuraPresetOrder, Multi = true,
            Default = ConfigStore.Aura.Selected,
            Callback = function(v)
                local t = {}
                for _, n in ipairs(v or {}) do t[#t + 1] = n end
                ConfigStore.Aura.Selected = t
                saveConfigAll(); ConfigStore.Aura.Refresh()
            end })
        sAdd(FXG, "AddDropdown", "aspect_ratio", { Values = {"Off", "4:3", "5:4", "16:9", "16:10", "21:9", "1:1"}, Default = 1,
            Text = "aspect ratio", Callback = function(v) AspectCfg.Ratio = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(FXG, "AddDropdown", "cc_preset", { Text = "color grading preset", Values = { "Default", "Retro" }, Default = 1,
            Callback = function(v)
                if v == "Retro" then CC.Saturation, CC.Contrast, CC.Tint = -0.25, 0.2, Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 180)
                else CC.Saturation, CC.Contrast, CC.Tint = 0, 0, WHITE end
                if CC.Enabled then applyCC() end
                saveConfigAll()
            end })
        -- kicia's motion blur: a blur effect whose size follows how fast the camera moves (position + turn),
        -- clamped to the intensity and smoothed. the 0.01 scale on movement is a guess at kicia's constant.
        local MB = { Enabled = false, Intensity = 12, Sensitivity = 1 }
        local mbBlur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
        mbBlur.Name = "ArgonMotionBlur"; mbBlur.Size = 0; mbBlur.Enabled = false
        mbBlur.Parent = game:GetService("Lighting")
        local mbLast = nil
        game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then return end
            local cf = cam.CFrame
            local prev = mbLast
            mbLast = cf
            mbBlur.Enabled = MB.Enabled
            if not MB.Enabled or not prev or dt <= 0 then
                if not MB.Enabled then mbBlur.Size = 0 end
                return
            end
            local move = (cf.Position - prev.Position).Magnitude / dt
            local _, turn = cf:ToObjectSpace(prev):ToAxisAngle()
            local value = move * 0.01 + math.abs(turn) / dt * 3
            local target = math.clamp(value * MB.Sensitivity, 0, MB.Intensity)
            mbBlur.Size = mbBlur.Size + (target - mbBlur.Size) * math.min(1, dt * 10)
        end)
        sAdd(FXG, "AddToggle", "mb_enabled", { Text = "motion blur", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) MB.Enabled = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(FXG, "AddSlider", "mb_intensity", { Text = "motion blur intensity", Min = 0, Max = 56, Default = 12, Rounding = 2,
            Callback = function(v) MB.Intensity = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(FXG, "AddSlider", "mb_sensitivity", { Text = "motion blur sensitivity", Min = 0, Max = 5, Default = 1, Rounding = 2,
            Callback = function(v) MB.Sensitivity = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(FXG, "AddToggle", "bloom_enabled", { Text = "bloom", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) Bloom.Enabled = v; if v then applyBloom() else clearBloom() end; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(FXG, "AddSlider", "bloom_intensity", { Text = "bloom intensity", Min = 0, Max = 3, Default = 0.6, Rounding = 2,
            Callback = function(v) Bloom.Intensity = v; if Bloom.Enabled then applyBloom() end; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(FXG, "AddSlider", "bloom_size", { Text = "bloom size", Min = 0, Max = 56, Default = 24, Rounding = 0,

    -- kicia's world visuals: lighting override (clock, exposure, shadows) and depth of field
    local WLG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "R", "World", "sun")
    if WLG then
        local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
        local LO = { Enabled = false, ClockTime = 14, Exposure = 0, Shadows = true }
        local loSaved = nil
        local function loApply()
            if not LO.Enabled then
                if loSaved then
                    pcall(function()
                        Lighting.ClockTime = loSaved.ClockTime
                        Lighting.ExposureCompensation = loSaved.Exposure
                        Lighting.GlobalShadows = loSaved.Shadows
                    end)
                    loSaved = nil
                end
                return
            end
            if not loSaved then
                loSaved = { ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime, Exposure = Lighting.ExposureCompensation, Shadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows }
            end
            pcall(function()
                Lighting.ClockTime = LO.ClockTime
                Lighting.ExposureCompensation = LO.Exposure
                Lighting.GlobalShadows = LO.Shadows
            end)
        end
        game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if LO.Enabled then loApply() end
        end)

        local dof = Instance.new("DepthOfFieldEffect")
        dof.Name = "ArgonDOF"; dof.Enabled = false; dof.FarIntensity = 0.5; dof.NearIntensity = 0
        dof.FocusDistance = 50; dof.InFocusRadius = 20
        dof.Parent = Lighting

        sAdd(WLG, "AddToggle", "lo_enabled", { Text = "lighting override", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) LO.Enabled = v; loApply(); saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(WLG, "AddSlider", "lo_time", { Text = "clock time", Min = 0, Max = 24, Default = 14, Rounding = 2, Suffix = "h",
            Callback = function(v) LO.ClockTime = v; loApply(); saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(WLG, "AddSlider", "lo_exposure", { Text = "exposure", Min = -5, Max = 5, Default = 0, Rounding = 2,
            Callback = function(v) LO.Exposure = v; loApply(); saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(WLG, "AddToggle", "lo_shadows", { Text = "global shadows", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) LO.Shadows = v; loApply(); saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(WLG, "AddToggle", "dof_enabled", { Text = "depth of field", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) dof.Enabled = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(WLG, "AddSlider", "dof_far", { Text = "far intensity", Min = 0, Max = 1, Default = 0.5, Rounding = 2,
            Callback = function(v) dof.FarIntensity = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(WLG, "AddSlider", "dof_near", { Text = "near intensity", Min = 0, Max = 1, Default = 0, Rounding = 2,
            Callback = function(v) dof.NearIntensity = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(WLG, "AddSlider", "dof_focus", { Text = "focus distance", Min = 0, Max = 1000, Default = 50, Rounding = 0, Suffix = "studs",
            Callback = function(v) dof.FocusDistance = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(WLG, "AddSlider", "dof_radius", { Text = "in-focus radius", Min = 0, Max = 100, Default = 20, Rounding = 0,
            Callback = function(v) dof.InFocusRadius = v; saveConfigAll() end })
    end

    -- weather + sky: rain, lightning, latitude (sun angle) and shadow softness
    local WXG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "R", "Weather", "cloud")
    if WXG then
        local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
        local RSv = game:GetService("RunService")
        local WX = { Rain = false, Lightning = false, RainRate = 600, RainColor = Color3.fromRGB(190, 200, 215), Latitude = 0, Softness = 0.5 }

        -- rain: a transparent part that follows the camera, carrying a streak emitter
        local rainPart = Instance.new("Part")
        rainPart.Name = "ArgonRain"; rainPart.Anchored = true; rainPart.CanCollide = false; rainPart.CanQuery = false
        rainPart.CanTouch = false; rainPart.Transparency = 1; rainPart.Size = Vector3.new(160, 1, 160)
        rainPart.Parent = workspace
        local rain = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        rain.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
        rain.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
        rain.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(4, 4)
        rain.Speed = NumberRange.new(120, 140)
        rain.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.7)
        rain.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.12)
        rain.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.35)
        rain.LightEmission = 0
        rain.Rate = WX.RainRate
        rain.Color = ColorSequence.new(WX.RainColor)
        rain.Enabled = false
        rain.Parent = rainPart

        RSv.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam and WX.Rain then rainPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(cam.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, 45, 0)) end
        end)

        -- lightning: a random brightness flash while enabled
        local baseBrightness = Lighting.Brightness
        local nextFlash = os.clock() + math.random(4, 12)
        RSv.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not WX.Lightning then return end
            local now = os.clock()
            if now >= nextFlash then
                nextFlash = now + math.random(4, 12)
                local b = baseBrightness
                pcall(function() Lighting.Brightness = 6 end)
                task.delay(0.08, function() pcall(function() Lighting.Brightness = b end) end)
                task.delay(0.22, function() pcall(function() Lighting.Brightness = 4 end) end)
                task.delay(0.3, function() pcall(function() Lighting.Brightness = b end) end)
            end
        end)

        sAdd(WXG, "AddToggle", "wx_rain", { Text = "rain", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) WX.Rain = v; rain.Enabled = v; rainPart.Transparency = 1; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(WXG, "AddSlider", "wx_rain_rate", { Text = "rain amount", Min = 50, Max = 2000, Default = 600, Rounding = 0,
            Callback = function(v) WX.RainRate = v; rain.Rate = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        addPicker(WXG, "wx_rain_color", { Default = WX.RainColor, Title = "rain color", Transparency = 0,
            Callback = function(c) WX.RainColor = c; rain.Color = ColorSequence.new(c); saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(WXG, "AddToggle", "wx_lightning", { Text = "lightning", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) WX.Lightning = v; if not v then pcall(function() Lighting.Brightness = baseBrightness end) end; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(WXG, "AddSlider", "wx_latitude", { Text = "latitude (sun angle)", Min = -90, Max = 90, Default = 0, Rounding = 1, Suffix = "deg",
            Callback = function(v) WX.Latitude = v; pcall(function() Lighting.GeographicLatitude = v end); saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(WXG, "AddSlider", "wx_softness", { Text = "shadow softness", Min = 0, Max = 1, Default = 0.5, Rounding = 2,
            Callback = function(v) WX.Softness = v; pcall(function() Lighting.ShadowSoftness = v end); saveConfigAll() end })
    end

    -- kicia's Stretched Resolution: the camera CFrame is multiplied by a matrix with X / Y scale on its
    -- rotation axes, bound just after the camera's own update so the game's camera can't undo it
    local SRG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "R", "Stretched Resolution", "sparkles")
    if SRG then
        local SR = { Enabled = false, X = 1, Y = 1 }
        local SR_BIND = "ArgonStretchedResolution"
        game:GetService("RunService"):BindToRenderStep(SR_BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
            if not SR.Enabled then return end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then return end
            cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, SR.X, 0, 0, 0, SR.Y, 0, 0, 0, 1)
        end)
        sAdd(SRG, "AddToggle", "sr_stretch_enabled", { Text = "enable stretched resolution", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) SR.Enabled = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(SRG, "AddSlider", "sr_stretch_x", { Text = "x scale", Min = 0.01, Max = 1, Default = 1, Rounding = 2,
            Callback = function(v) SR.X = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(SRG, "AddSlider", "sr_stretch_y", { Text = "y scale", Min = 0.01, Max = 1, Default = 1, Rounding = 2,
            Callback = function(v) SR.Y = v; saveConfigAll() end })
    end

    -- kicia's Camera FOV and Removables

        end)
        sAdd(CFG, "AddToggle", "cam_fov_enabled", { Text = "camera fov", Default = false,

        sAdd(SG, "AddSlider", "snow_speed", { Text = "speed", Min = 1, Max = 200, Default = 30, Rounding = 1, Callback = function(v) Snow.Speed = v; sApply(); saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(SG, "AddSlider", "snow_spread", { Text = "spread", Min = 0, Max = 180, Default = 50, Rounding = 0, Callback = function(v) Snow.Spread = v; sApply(); saveConfigAll() end })

end)
if not ok_visuals then warn("[ui] visuals failed: " .. tostring(err_visuals)) end

local AvatarSpooferInstance = nil
local ok_settings, err_settings = pcall(function()
    local DeviceMap = { Computer="MouseKeyboard", Mobile="Touch", Console="Gamepad", VR="VR" }
    local DS = { Enabled = false, Device = "Mobile" }

        end)

    local function notify(msg)
        if not pcall(function() getgenv().Library:Notification(msg, 3, getgenv().Library.Theme.Accent) end) then print("[solaria] " .. msg) end

    local AG = mkGB(Tabs.Settings, "L", "Avatar Spoofer", "user")
    if AG then
        local AV = { Enabled = false, Desc = nil, Id = nil }

        local function resolveUserId(input)
            local n = tonumber(input)
            if n then return math.floor(n) end
            if type(input) ~= "string" or input == "" then return nil end
            local ok, id = pcall(function() return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(input) end)
            return ok and id or nil
        end

        local function applyAvatar()
            if not AV.Desc then return end
            local c = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then pcall(function() hum:ApplyDescription(AV.Desc) end) end
        end

        local function loadAvatar(input)
            local id = resolveUserId(input)
            if not id then notify("avatar: unknown user " .. tostring(input)); return end
            local ok, desc = pcall(function() return Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(id) end)
            if not ok or not desc then notify("avatar: could not load user " .. id); return end
            AV.Id, AV.Desc = id, desc
            notify("avatar: loaded " .. id)
            if AV.Enabled then applyAvatar() end
        end

        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            if AV.Enabled and AV.Desc then task.wait(0.8); applyAvatar() end
        end)

        sAdd(AG, "AddToggle", "avatar_spoofer_enabled", { Text = "enable avatar spoofer", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v)
                AV.Enabled = v
