                    pcall(function() AvatarSpooferInstance:Arm() end)
                    applyAvatar()
                elseif AvatarSpooferInstance then
                    pcall(function() AvatarSpooferInstance:Destroy() end); AvatarSpooferInstance = nil
                end
            end })
        sAdd(AG, "AddTextbox", "avatar_id", { Text = "avatar id / username", Placeholder = "user id or name", Default = "",
            Finished = true, Callback = function(t) loadAvatar(t) end })
        sAdd(AG, "AddButton", { Text = "Apply Now", Func = function() applyAvatar() end })
    end

    getgenv().SolCustomSkinHooks = getgenv().SolCustomSkinHooks or {}
    local CustomSkinHooks = getgenv().SolCustomSkinHooks
    local CosUI = { Gui = nil, Weapon = nil, Type = "Skin", Search = "", Lib = nil, Refresh = nil, Category = "All", ShowAll = false }
    local CosG = mkGB(Tabs.Skins, "L", "Cosmetics", "sparkles")
    if CosG then
        local COS_ALIAS = { Wrapping = "Wrap" }

        local function cosMake(class, props, parent)
            local o = Instance.new(class)
            for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
            if parent then o.Parent = parent end
            return o
        end

        local function loadLibs()
            if CosUI.Lib then return CosUI.Lib end
            local ok, lib = pcall(function()
                local mods = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules", 10)
                return {
                    Cos  = require(mods:WaitForChild("CosmeticLibrary", 10)),
                    Item = require(mods:WaitForChild("ItemLibrary", 10)),
                    Enum = require(mods:WaitForChild("EnumLibrary", 10)),
                    Data = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers:WaitForChild("PlayerDataController", 10)),
                }
            end)
            if not ok or type(lib) ~= "table" then warn("[cosmetics] library load failed: " .. tostring(lib)); return nil end
            CosUI.Lib = lib
            return lib
        end

        -- only the three types the viewmodel hooks actually render
        local function cosType(name, c)
            local t = COS_ALIAS[c.Type or ""] or c.Type
            if t == "Skin" or t == "Charm" or t == "Wrap" then return t end
            if not c.Type or c.Type == "" then
                local n = name:lower()
                if n:find("charm") then return "Charm" end
                if n:find("wrap") then return "Wrap" end
            end
            return nil
        end

        -- image for a cosmetic tile. wraps and other types store their picture under different keys,
        -- so this tries the usual image fields on the item view model and the cosmetic, then any string that looks like an asset
        local ICON_KEYS = { "ImageHighResolution", "Image", "Icon", "Thumbnail", "ThumbnailId", "ImageId", "Texture",
            "Decal", "Preview", "PreviewImage", "ViewModelImage", "ImageAsset", "ImageUrl", "Asset", "AssetId" }
        local function cosIconValue(v)
            if v == nil or type(v) == "table" then return nil end
            local t = string.gsub(string.gsub(tostring(v), "^%s+", ""), "%s+$", "")
            if t == "" or t == "0" or t == "nil" then return nil end
            if not string.find(t, "://", 1, true) and string.match(t, "^%d+$") then t = "rbxassetid://" .. t end
            return t
        end
        local function cosIcon(lib, name, c)
            local vm = lib.Item.ViewModels and lib.Item.ViewModels[name]
            for _, src in ipairs({ vm, c }) do
                if type(src) == "table" then
                    for _, k in ipairs(ICON_KEYS) do
                        local t = cosIconValue(src[k])
                        if t then return t end
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, src in ipairs({ c, vm }) do
                if type(src) == "table" then
                    for _, v in pairs(src) do
                        local t = cosIconValue(v)
                        if t and (string.find(t, "rbxasset", 1, true) or string.find(t, "http", 1, true)) then return t end
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function listCosmetics(lib)
            local out = {}
            for name, c in pairs(lib.Cos.Cosmetics) do
                if type(c) == "table" and cosType(name, c) == CosUI.Type then
                    if CosUI.Search == "" or name:lower():find(CosUI.Search, 1, true) then
                        out[#out + 1] = { Name = name, Icon = cosIcon(lib, name, c), Data = c, Rarity = c.Rarity and tostring(c.Rarity) or "" }
                    end
                end
            end
            table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
            return out
        end

        -- weapon category from the item data (Primary / Secondary / Melee / Utility)
        local function cosWeaponCategory(item)
            if type(item) ~= "table" then return "All" end
            for _, k in ipairs({ "Category", "Slot", "WeaponType", "Class", "Type" }) do
                local v = item[k]
                if type(v) == "string" then
                    local l = string.lower(v)
                    if string.find(l, "primary") then return "Primary" end
                    if string.find(l, "secondary") then return "Secondary" end
                    if string.find(l, "melee") or string.find(l, "knife") then return "Melee" end
                    if string.find(l, "utility") then return "Utility" end
                end
            end
            return "All"
        end

        -- does this cosmetic belong to this weapon? (reads the weapon link fields if the library has them)
        -- names are compared with spaces/punctuation/case stripped: "Assault Rifle", "AssaultRifle", "assault_rifle" all match
        local function cosNorm(s)
            return (string.gsub(string.lower(tostring(s)), "[^%w]", ""))
        end

        local COS_WEAPON_KEYS = { "Weapon", "Weapons", "Item", "Items", "ForWeapon", "Gun" }
        -- does this skin name the weapon anywhere in its data (any key, any depth up to 2)?
        local function cosLinksTo(c, weapon)
            local found, match = false, false
            local w = cosNorm(weapon)
            for _, k in ipairs(COS_WEAPON_KEYS) do
                if c[k] ~= nil then found = true end
            end
            local function scan(v, depth)
                for key, x in pairs(v) do
                    if type(key) == "string" and cosNorm(key) == w and x then match = true end
                    if type(x) == "string" and cosNorm(x) == w then match = true end
                    if type(x) == "table" and depth < 2 then scan(x, depth + 1) end
                end
            end
            scan(c, 0)
            return found, match
        end

        -- the weapon's own item entry lists the skins it allows: scans every table field of the item
        local function cosItemAllows(lib, weapon, name)
            local items = (type(lib.Item.Items) == "table" and lib.Item.Items) or (type(lib.Item.Weapons) == "table" and lib.Item.Weapons) or {}
            local item = items[weapon]
            if type(item) ~= "table" then
                local wn = cosNorm(weapon)
                for k, v in pairs(items) do
                    if cosNorm(k) == wn then item = v; break end
                end
            end
            if type(item) ~= "table" then return false, false end
            local known, listed = false, false
            local want = cosNorm(name)
            for _, v in pairs(item) do
                if type(v) == "table" then
                    known = true
                    if want ~= "" then
                        for key, x in pairs(v) do
                            if (type(key) == "string" and cosNorm(key) == want)
                                or (type(x) == "string" and cosNorm(x) == want)
                                or (type(x) == "table" and type(x.Name) == "string" and cosNorm(x.Name) == want) then
                                listed = true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return known, listed
        end

        -- skins for one weapon. a skin belongs to the weapon if: its weapon link names it, the weapon's
        -- item entry lists it, or the skin name contains the weapon name. if the library has none of those
        -- for this weapon, it returns everything and says so (the status line shows it)
        local function cosListFor(lib, weapon)
            local all = listCosmetics(lib)
            if not weapon then return {}, false end
            -- "show all" toggle: every skin of this type, equippable on any weapon
            if CosUI.ShowAll then return all, false end
            local wl = string.lower(weapon)
            local out, anyKnown = {}, false
            local itemKnown = false
            for _, e in ipairs(all) do
                local found, match = cosLinksTo(e.Data or {}, weapon)
                if found then anyKnown = true end
                if not match then
                    local known, listed = cosItemAllows(lib, weapon, e.Name)
                    if known then itemKnown = true end
                    if listed then match = true end
                end
                if not match and string.find(cosNorm(e.Name), cosNorm(weapon), 1, true) then match = true end
                if match then out[#out + 1] = e end
            end
            if anyKnown or itemKnown then return out, false end
            local _, hasItem = cosItemAllows(lib, weapon, "")
            if hasItem or #out > 0 then return out, false end
            return all, true
        end

        -- key aug (assault rifle) and archrambit (knife) always show in the list under their weapon,
        -- even when the library doesn't link them to the weapon
        local CUSTOM_LIST = {
            { weapon = "assaultrifle", match = function(n)
                local l = string.lower(n)
                return string.find(cosNorm(n), "keyaug", 1, true) ~= nil or string.find(l, "%f[%a]aug%f[%A]") ~= nil
            end },
            { weapon = "knife", match = function(n)
                local l = cosNorm(n)
                return string.find(l, "keyrambit", 1, true) ~= nil or string.find(l, "archrambit", 1, true) ~= nil
            end },
        }
        local cosListForBase = cosListFor
        cosListFor = function(lib, weapon)
            -- charms and wraps aren't weapon-locked: always list every one of that type
            if CosUI.Type ~= "Skin" then return listCosmetics(lib), false end
            local out, fb = cosListForBase(lib, weapon)
            -- a skin type with no weapon match falls back to everything instead of an empty grid
            if #out == 0 then out, fb = listCosmetics(lib), true end
            if not weapon then return out, fb end
            local wn = cosNorm(weapon)
            local have = {}
            for _, e in ipairs(out) do have[e.Name] = true end
            for _, rule in ipairs(CUSTOM_LIST) do
                if wn == rule.weapon then
                    for name, c in pairs(lib.Cos.Cosmetics) do
                        if type(name) == "string" and type(c) == "table" and not have[name]
                            and cosType(name, c) == CosUI.Type and rule.match(name) then
                            out[#out + 1] = { Name = name, Icon = cosIcon(lib, name, c), Data = c, Rarity = c.Rarity and tostring(c.Rarity) or "" }
                            have[name] = true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
            return out, fb
        end

        local function setEquip(lib, weapon, ctype, name)
            if name then
                local cloned = uaCloneCosmetic(lib.Cos, lib.Enum, name, ctype)
                if not cloned then return false, "not found" end
                UnlockState.Equipped[weapon] = UnlockState.Equipped[weapon] or {}
                UnlockState.Equipped[weapon][ctype] = cloned
            elseif UnlockState.Equipped[weapon] then
                UnlockState.Equipped[weapon][ctype] = nil
                if not next(UnlockState.Equipped[weapon]) then UnlockState.Equipped[weapon] = nil end
            end
            uaSaveConfig()
            pcall(function() lib.Data.CurrentData:Replicate("WeaponInventory") end)
            return true
        end

        -- ===== skin changer: embedded in the Skins tab, no separate window =====
        local SKIN_TAB_ORDER = { "Skins", "Wraps", "Charms", "Finishers", "Models", "Custom" }
        local SKIN_TAB_TYPE = { Skins = "Skin", Wraps = "Wrap", Charms = "Charm", Finishers = "Finisher", Custom = "Custom" }
        local CAT_ICON = { Skins = "", Wraps = "", Charms = "", Finishers = "", Models = "", Custom = "" } -- FILL: "rbxassetid://..." per tab, empty = text only
        -- fallback tile image when the library has no Image for an entry (same placeholder the Kicia build uses)
        local TYPE_ICON = { Skin = "", Wrap = "rbxassetid://89204837120267", Charm = "rbxassetid://89204837120267", Finisher = "rbxassetid://89204837120267" }
        local CUSTOM_ITEMS = {
            { name = "key aug",    key = "aug",        icon = "", color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 90, 255) }, -- FILL icon: aug image
            { name = "archrambit", key = "archrambit", icon = "", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 60) }, -- FILL icon: knife image
        }
        local RARITY_COLOR = {
            common = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), uncommon = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120),
            rare = Color3.fromRGB(70, 140, 255), epic = Color3.fromRGB(170, 90, 255),
            legendary = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 60), mythic = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70),
        }

        -- icon map from the paste the icons script uses: IL[category][name] = "rbxassetid://..."
        local ICON_MAP = nil
        local function loadIconMap()
            if ICON_MAP then return ICON_MAP end
            ICON_MAP = {}
            pcall(function()
                local r = game:HttpGet("https://pastefy.app/M1BAZ3hi/raw")
                if not r or #r < 100 then return end
                local c
                for l in r:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
                    local w = l:match('%["(.-)"%]%s*=%s*{%s*$')
                    if w then c = w; ICON_MAP[c] = {} end
                    if c then
                        local n, id = l:match('Name%s*=%s*"(.-)".-Image%s*=%s*"(rbxassetid://.-)"')
                        if n and id then ICON_MAP[c][n] = id end
                    end
                end
            end)
            return ICON_MAP
        end
        -- kind: "Wrap", "Charm", "Finisher"; matches the category names that contain it (Wraps, Charms, Finishers)
        local function mapIcon(kind, name)
            local want = string.lower(kind)
            for cat, names in pairs(loadIconMap()) do
                if string.find(string.lower(cat), want, 1, true) and names[name] then
                    return names[name]
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        -- the Skins tab's page frame; nil if the library doesn't expose it (then a floating window is used)
        local function skinHost()
            local p = Tabs.Skins and Tabs.Skins.Page
            if type(p) ~= "table" then return nil end
            local it = p.Items and p.Items["Page"]
            local inst = (it and it.Instance) or p.Instance or p.Frame
            if typeof(inst) == "Instance" then return inst end
            return nil
        end

        local function weaponNames(lib)
            local items = (type(lib.Item.Items) == "table" and lib.Item.Items) or (type(lib.Item.Weapons) == "table" and lib.Item.Weapons) or {}
            local names = {}
            for n in pairs(items) do names[#names + 1] = tostring(n) end
            table.sort(names)
            return names
        end

        local function finisherList(lib)
            if CosUI.FinList then return CosUI.FinList end
            local out = {}
            local mods = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
            local folder = mods and mods:FindFirstChild("Finishers")
            if folder then
                for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                    if m:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                        local icon = nil
                        local ok, mod = pcall(require, m)
                        if ok and type(mod) == "table" then icon = cosIcon(lib, m.Name, mod) end
                        -- finishers can carry their Image on the cosmetic entry instead of the module
                        icon = icon or cosIcon(lib, m.Name, lib.Cos and lib.Cos.Cosmetics and lib.Cos.Cosmetics[m.Name])
                        out[#out + 1] = { Name = m.Name, Icon = icon, Rarity = "" }
                    end
                end
            end
            table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
            CosUI.FinList = out
            return out
        end

        local function buildPanel(lib)
            local UI = getgenv().Library or {}
            local TH = UI.Theme or {}
            local FONT = UI.Font or Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.SourceSans)
            local SIZE = 12
            local OUTLINE = TH.Outline or Color3.fromRGB(51, 51, 51)
            local BG = TH.Background or Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 12)
            local INLINE = TH.Inline or Color3.fromRGB(19, 19, 19)
            local ELEM = TH.Element or Color3.fromRGB(39, 39, 39)
            local HOVER = TH["Hovered Element"] or Color3.fromRGB(61, 61, 61)
            local TXT = TH.Text or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            local DIM = TH["Inactive Text"] or Color3.fromRGB(134, 134, 134)
            local ACC = TH.Accent or PINK

            local function stroke(parent, color, thick)
                return cosMake("UIStroke", { Color = color, Thickness = thick or 1,
                    ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Parent = parent })
            end
            local function label(parent, text, size, color, xAlign)
                return cosMake("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = text, FontFace = FONT, TextSize = size or SIZE,
                    TextColor3 = color or TXT, TextXAlignment = xAlign or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Parent = parent })
            end
            local function button(parent, text)
                local b = cosMake("TextButton", { BackgroundColor3 = ELEM, BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = false,
                    Text = text, FontFace = FONT, TextSize = SIZE, TextColor3 = TXT, Parent = parent })
                stroke(b, OUTLINE, 1)
                b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() b.BackgroundColor3 = HOVER end)
                b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() b.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM end)
                return b
            end

            -- the side groupboxes are replaced by the footer row under the panel
            local skinPage = Tabs.Skins and Tabs.Skins.Page
            if skinPage and skinPage.ColumnsData then
                for _, col in pairs(skinPage.ColumnsData) do
                    if col.Instance then
                        for _, s in ipairs(col.Instance:GetChildren()) do
                            if s:IsA("GuiObject") then s.Visible = false end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            -- host: the Skins tab page if the library gives us it, otherwise a floating window
            local host = skinHost()
            print("[skins] host: " .. (host and host:GetFullName() or "none, using floating window"))
            local root
            if host then
                root = cosMake("Frame", { Name = "SolSkins", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = host })
            else
                local gui = cosMake("ScreenGui", { Name = "SolCosmetics", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 150 },
                    (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui)
                root = cosMake("Frame", { Name = "SolSkins", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(660, 440), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = gui })
            end
            CosUI.Root = root
            if host then
                for _, s in ipairs(host:GetChildren()) do
                    if s ~= root and s:IsA("GuiObject") then s.Visible = false end
                end
            end

            local bg = cosMake("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BG, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = root })
            stroke(bg, OUTLINE, 1)

            -- top bar: current weapon + change
            local topBar = cosMake("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 26),
                BackgroundColor3 = INLINE, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = bg })
            stroke(topBar, OUTLINE, 1)
            local weaponLbl = label(topBar, CosUI.Weapon or "pick a weapon", 12, TXT)
            weaponLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0); weaponLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 1, 0)
            local changeBtn = button(topBar, "change")
            changeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 20); changeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0.5, -10)

            -- category row with icons
            local catRow = cosMake("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 38), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 42),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = bg })
            cosMake("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), Parent = catRow })
            local catBtns, catText = {}, {}
            local refreshCats
            refreshCats = function()
                for name, b in pairs(catBtns) do
                    local on = (name == CosUI.Tab)
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = on and ELEM or INLINE
                    catText[name].TextColor3 = on and ACC or DIM
                end
            end

            -- search
            local search = cosMake("TextBox", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 84), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 22),
                BackgroundColor3 = ELEM, BorderSizePixel = 0, PlaceholderText = "search cosmetics...", PlaceholderColor3 = DIM,
                Text = "", TextColor3 = TXT, FontFace = FONT, TextSize = SIZE, ClearTextOnFocus = false,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = bg })
            stroke(search, OUTLINE, 1)
            cosMake("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), Parent = search })

            -- tile grid
            local grid = cosMake("ScrollingFrame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 112), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -204),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 2, ScrollBarImageColor3 = ACC,
                CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = bg })
            cosMake("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / 6, -5, 0, 96), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4),
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = grid })

            -- status line
            local status = label(bg, "", SIZE, DIM)
            status.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -84); status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 16)
            local function setStatus(msg) status.Text = msg end

            -- bottom actions
            local actRow = cosMake("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 1, -30), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 24),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = bg })
            cosMake("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), Parent = actRow })

            -- footer: the old side toggles, under the panel, driven through the library flags
            local footer = cosMake("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 1, -62), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 22),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = bg })
            cosMake("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), Parent = footer })
            local FOOT = {
                { "unlock all", "unlock_enabled" },
            }
            local footBtns = {}
            local function flagOn(f)
                local lib2 = getgenv().Library
                return lib2 and lib2.Flags and lib2.Flags[f] == true
            end
            local function refreshFoot()
                for _, fb in ipairs(footBtns) do
                    local on = flagOn(fb.flag)
                    fb.btn.TextColor3 = on and ACC or TXT
                    fb.btn.BackgroundColor3 = on and ELEM or INLINE
                end
            end
            for i, f in ipairs(FOOT) do
                local b = button(footer, f[1])
                b.LayoutOrder = i
                b.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -4, 1, 0)
                footBtns[#footBtns + 1] = { btn = b, flag = f[2] }
                b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    local lib2 = getgenv().Library
                    local set = lib2 and lib2.SetFlags and lib2.SetFlags[f[2]]
                    if set then set(not flagOn(f[2])) end
                    task.defer(refreshFoot)
                end)
            end

            -- weapon picker overlay (opened by change)
            local wPick = cosMake("ScrollingFrame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 36), Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 260),
                Visible = false, ZIndex = 10, BackgroundColor3 = INLINE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 2,
                ScrollBarImageColor3 = ACC, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), Parent = root })
            stroke(wPick, OUTLINE, 1)
            cosMake("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = wPick })

            local function replicate()
                pcall(function() lib.Data.CurrentData:Replicate("WeaponInventory") end)
            end

            -- what the grid shows for the active tab
            local function currentList()
                if CosUI.Tab == "Custom" then
                    local out = {}
                    for _, c in ipairs(CUSTOM_ITEMS) do
                        out[#out + 1] = { Name = c.name, Icon = (c.icon ~= "" and c.icon) or nil, Rarity = "", Custom = c }
                    end
                    return out
                end
                if CosUI.Type == "Finisher" then return finisherList(lib) end
                if not CosUI.Type or not CosUI.Weapon then return {} end
                local list = cosListFor(lib, CosUI.Weapon)
                return list
            end

            local function equipTile(e)
                if e.Custom then
                    CosUI.CustomOn = CosUI.CustomOn or {}
                    CosUI.CustomOn[e.Custom.key] = true
                    local hook = CustomSkinHooks[e.Custom.key]
                    if hook then task.spawn(hook) end
                    setStatus(e.Name .. " enabled")
                    return
                end
                if not CosUI.Weapon then setStatus("pick a weapon first"); return end
                if not UnlockAll.Enabled then pcall(startUnlockAll) end
                local ok, err = setEquip(lib, CosUI.Weapon, CosUI.Type, e.Name)
                CosUI.LastPick = e.Name
                setStatus(ok and ("equipped " .. e.Name .. " on " .. CosUI.Weapon) or ("failed: " .. tostring(err)))
            end

            local refreshGrid, refreshWeapons
            refreshGrid = function()
                for _, ch in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do
                    if ch:IsA("GuiObject") then ch:Destroy() end
                end
                local list = currentList()
                local cur = nil
                if CosUI.Tab ~= "Custom" and CosUI.Weapon and CosUI.Type and UnlockState.Equipped[CosUI.Weapon] then
                    cur = UnlockState.Equipped[CosUI.Weapon][CosUI.Type]
                end
                local q = string.lower(CosUI.Search or "")
                local shown = 0
                for _, e in ipairs(list) do
                    if q == "" or string.find(string.lower(e.Name), q, 1, true) then
                        shown = shown + 1
                        local on
                        if e.Custom then on = (CosUI.CustomOn or {})[e.Custom.key] == true
                        else on = cur ~= nil and cur.Name == e.Name end
                        local tile = cosMake("TextButton", { Name = e.Name, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = shown,
                            BackgroundColor3 = on and ELEM or INLINE, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = grid })
                        stroke(tile, on and ACC or OUTLINE, on and 2 or 1)
                        local img = e.Icon or (CosUI.Type and CosUI.Type ~= "Custom" and mapIcon(CosUI.Type, e.Name))
                            or TYPE_ICON[CosUI.Type or ""] or ""
                        if img ~= "" then
                            cosMake("ImageLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -26, 0, 8),
                                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = img, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Parent = tile })
                        end
                        local nm = label(tile, e.Name, 11, on and ACC or TXT, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
                        nm.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 14); nm.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -22)
                        local lineCol = OUTLINE
                        if e.Custom then lineCol = e.Custom.color
                        elseif e.Rarity and RARITY_COLOR[string.lower(e.Rarity)] then lineCol = RARITY_COLOR[string.lower(e.Rarity)] end
                        cosMake("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 2), Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -6),
                            BackgroundColor3 = lineCol, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = tile })
                        tile.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if not on then tile.BackgroundColor3 = HOVER end end)
                        tile.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tile.BackgroundColor3 = on and ELEM or INLINE end)
                        tile.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() equipTile(e); refreshGrid() end)
                    end
                end
                if CosUI.Tab == "Models" then
                    setStatus("models aren't in the library yet")
                elseif shown == 0 then
                    setStatus("nothing for " .. tostring(CosUI.Weapon or "this tab"))
                elseif CosUI.Tab == "Custom" then
                    setStatus(shown .. " custom (toggle on click)")
                else
                    setStatus(shown .. " " .. string.lower(CosUI.Tab) .. " for " .. tostring(CosUI.Weapon or "?"))
                end
            end

            refreshWeapons = function()
                wPick.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #weaponNames(lib) * 20 + 4)
                for _, ch in ipairs(wPick:GetChildren()) do
                    if ch:IsA("TextButton") then ch:Destroy() end
                end
                for i, n in ipairs(weaponNames(lib)) do
                    local on = (n == CosUI.Weapon)
                    local row = cosMake("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), LayoutOrder = i, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 11,
                        AutoButtonColor = false, Text = n, FontFace = FONT, TextSize = SIZE,
                        TextColor3 = on and ACC or TXT, BackgroundColor3 = on and ELEM or INLINE, Parent = wPick })
                    row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        CosUI.Weapon = n
                        weaponLbl.Text = n
                        wPick.Visible = false
                        refreshWeapons(); refreshGrid()
                    end)
                end
            end

            changeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                wPick.Visible = not wPick.Visible
                if wPick.Visible then refreshWeapons() end
            end)

            -- category buttons
            for i, name in ipairs(SKIN_TAB_ORDER) do
                local b = cosMake("TextButton", { LayoutOrder = i, Size = UDim2.new(1 / #SKIN_TAB_ORDER, -4, 1, 0),
                    BackgroundColor3 = INLINE, BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", Parent = catRow })
                stroke(b, OUTLINE, 1)
                if CAT_ICON[name] and CAT_ICON[name] ~= "" then
                    cosMake("ImageLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -9, 0, 3),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = CAT_ICON[name], Parent = b })
                end
                local t = label(b, string.lower(name), 11, DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
                t.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14); t.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -17)
                catBtns[name] = b
                catText[name] = t
                b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    CosUI.Tab = name
                    CosUI.Type = SKIN_TAB_TYPE[name]
                    refreshCats(); refreshGrid()
                end)
            end

            search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                CosUI.Search = search.Text
                refreshGrid()
            end)

            -- actions
            local function pickRandom(list)
                if #list == 0 then return nil end
                return list[math.random(1, #list)]
            end
            local ACTS = {
                { "random", function()
                    if CosUI.Tab == "Custom" or not CosUI.Type or not CosUI.Weapon then setStatus("pick a weapon and a tab first"); return end
                    local p = pickRandom(cosListFor(lib, CosUI.Weapon))
                    if p then equipTile(p) else setStatus("nothing to roll") end
                    refreshGrid()
                end },
                { "random all", function()
                    if CosUI.Tab == "Custom" or not CosUI.Type then setStatus("pick a skin, wrap or charm tab"); return end
                    local n = 0
                    for _, w in ipairs(weaponNames(lib)) do
                        local p = pickRandom(cosListFor(lib, w))
                        if p and setEquip(lib, w, CosUI.Type, p.Name) then n = n + 1 end
                    end
                    replicate(); refreshGrid()
                    setStatus("random " .. string.lower(CosUI.Type) .. " on " .. n .. " weapons")
                end },
                { "apply to all", function()
                    if CosUI.Tab == "Custom" or not CosUI.Type or not CosUI.LastPick then setStatus("click a tile first"); return end
                    local n = 0
                    for _, w in ipairs(weaponNames(lib)) do
                        for _, e in ipairs(cosListFor(lib, w)) do
                            if e.Name == CosUI.LastPick then
                                if setEquip(lib, w, CosUI.Type, e.Name) then n = n + 1 end
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    replicate(); refreshGrid()
                    setStatus("applied " .. CosUI.LastPick .. " to " .. n .. " weapons")
                end },
                { "reset weapon", function()
                    if not CosUI.Weapon then setStatus("pick a weapon first"); return end
                    for _, t in ipairs({ "Skin", "Charm", "Wrap" }) do setEquip(lib, CosUI.Weapon, t, nil) end
                    replicate(); refreshGrid()
                    setStatus("reset " .. CosUI.Weapon)
                end },
                { "reset all", function()
                    for w in pairs(UnlockState.Equipped) do UnlockState.Equipped[w] = nil end
                    uaSaveConfig(); replicate(); refreshGrid()
                    setStatus("reset every weapon")
                end },
            }
            for i, a in ipairs(ACTS) do
                local b = button(actRow, a[1])
                b.LayoutOrder = i
                b.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, -4, 1, 0)
                b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(a[2])
            end

            -- start on the first weapon, Skins tab
            if not CosUI.Weapon then
                local names = weaponNames(lib)
                CosUI.Weapon = names[1]
            end
            weaponLbl.Text = CosUI.Weapon or "pick a weapon"
            CosUI.Tab = CosUI.Tab or "Skins"
            CosUI.Type = SKIN_TAB_TYPE[CosUI.Tab]
            refreshCats(); refreshWeapons(); refreshGrid(); refreshFoot()
            CosUI.Refresh = function() refreshCats(); refreshWeapons(); refreshGrid(); refreshFoot() end
        end

        local function openCosmetics()
            task.spawn(function()
                local lib = loadLibs()
                if not lib then notify("cosmetics: libraries not found"); return end
                if CosUI.Root then CosUI.Root:Destroy(); CosUI.Root = nil end
                buildPanel(lib)
            end)
        end

        -- prints the weapon's item entry and a few skins' fields to the console, so the weapon-to-skin link can be matched exactly
        sAdd(CosG, "AddButton", { Text = "dump weapon data (console)", Func = function()
            task.spawn(function()
                local lib = loadLibs()
                if not lib then return end
                local w = CosUI.Weapon or "?"
                local items = (type(lib.Item.Items) == "table" and lib.Item.Items) or (type(lib.Item.Weapons) == "table" and lib.Item.Weapons) or {}
                local function dumpKeys(t, depth, pre)
                    if type(t) ~= "table" or depth > 1 then return end
                    for k, v in pairs(t) do
                        print(pre .. tostring(k) .. " = " .. (type(v) == "table" and "{table}" or tostring(v)))
                        if type(v) == "table" then dumpKeys(v, depth + 1, pre .. "  ") end
                    end
                end
                print("[dump] selected weapon: " .. tostring(w))
                print("[dump] item entry:")
                dumpKeys(items[w], 0, "  ")
                print("[dump] first skins:")
                local n = 0
                for name, c in pairs(lib.Cos.Cosmetics) do
                    if type(c) == "table" and n < 3 and cosType(name, c) == "Skin" then
                        n = n + 1
                        print("  [skin] " .. tostring(name))
                        dumpKeys(c, 0, "    ")
                    end
                end
                print("[dump] done. copy everything between [dump] lines")
            end)
        end })
        sAdd(CosG, "AddButton", { Text = "rebuild skin panel", Func = openCosmetics })
        sAdd(CosG, "AddButton", { Text = "dump wrap/charm/finisher keys", Func = function()
            task.spawn(function()
                local lib = loadLibs()
                if not lib then return end
                local function keys(t, pre)
                    if type(t) ~= "table" then return end
                    for k, v in pairs(t) do
                        print(pre .. tostring(k) .. " = " .. (type(v) == "table" and "{table}" or tostring(v)))
                    end
                end
                local seen = {}
                for name, c in pairs(lib.Cos.Cosmetics) do
                    local t = type(c) == "table" and cosType(name, c) or nil
                    if t and (t == "Wrap" or t == "Charm") and not seen[t] then
                        seen[t] = true
                        print("[dump] " .. t .. ": " .. name)
                        keys(c, "  ")
                        local vm = lib.Item.ViewModels and lib.Item.ViewModels[name]
                        if type(vm) == "table" then print("  [viewmodel]"); keys(vm, "    ") end
                    end
                end
                local mods = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
                local folder = mods and mods:FindFirstChild("Finishers")
                local m = folder and folder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ModuleScript")
                if m then
                    local ok, mod = pcall(require, m)
                    print("[dump] Finisher: " .. m.Name)
                    if ok then keys(mod, "  ") end
                end
                print("[dump] done. copy everything between [dump] lines")
            end)
        end })
        task.spawn(function() task.wait(2); pcall(openCosmetics) end)
        sAdd(CosG, "AddButton", { Text = "start unlock hooks", Func = function()
            task.spawn(function() if not UnlockAll.Enabled then pcall(startUnlockAll) end end)
        end })
    end

    local CG = mkGB(Tabs.Settings, "R", "Config", "save")
    if CG then
        local CFG_DIR = "ArgonLose/configs/"
        local cfgName, cfgSel, cfgList = "default", nil, nil

        local function sanitize(n) return ((n or ""):gsub("[^%w_%-]", "")) end
        local function cfgPath(n) return CFG_DIR .. n .. ".json" end
        local function cfgExists(n) return isfile ~= nil and isfile(cfgPath(n)) end
        -- the picked config, or whatever is typed in the name box
        local function target()
            local n = cfgSel or sanitize(cfgName)
            if n == nil or n == "" then return nil end
            return n
        end

        local function listCfgs()
            local out = {}
            if not listfiles then return out end
            pcall(function()
                if isfolder and makefolder then
                    for _, d in ipairs({ "ArgonLose", "ArgonLose/configs" }) do
                        if not isfolder(d) then makefolder(d) end
                    end
                end
            end)
            local ok, files = pcall(listfiles, CFG_DIR)
            if ok and type(files) == "table" then
                for _, f in ipairs(files) do
                    local n = tostring(f):match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
                    if n then out[#out + 1] = n end
                end
            end
            table.sort(out)
            return out
        end

        local function refreshCfgs()
            if cfgList and cfgList.Refresh then pcall(function() cfgList:Refresh(listCfgs()) end) end
        end

        local initial = listCfgs()
        cfgSel = initial[1]
        cfgList = sAdd(CG, "AddDropdown", "cfg_list", { Values = initial, Default = initial[1] or "none", Text = "configs",
            Callback = function(v) cfgSel = v end })

        sAdd(CG, "AddTextbox", "cfg_name", { Text = "config name", Placeholder = "config name", Default = "default",
            Callback = function(t) cfgName = sanitize(t) end })

        sAdd(CG, "AddButton", { Text = "Create", Func = function()
            local n = sanitize(cfgName)
            if n == "" then notify("type a config name first"); return end
            if cfgExists(n) then notify(n .. " already exists"); return end
            saveConfigAll(true, cfgPath(n))
            if cfgExists(n) then
                cfgSel = n; refreshCfgs(); notify("created " .. n)
            else
                notify("could not write " .. n .. ", check console")
            end
        end })
        sAdd(CG, "AddButton", { Text = "Load", Func = function()
            local n = target()
            if not n then notify("pick a config"); return end
            if not cfgExists(n) then notify(n .. " does not exist"); return end
            local ok = loadConfigAll(cfgPath(n))
            pcall(syncUIFromState)
            notify(ok and ("loaded " .. n) or ("could not read " .. n))
        end })
        sAdd(CG, "AddButton", { Text = "Overwrite", Func = function()
            local n = target()
            if not n then notify("pick a config"); return end
            saveConfigAll(true, cfgPath(n))
            refreshCfgs()
            notify("saved " .. n)
        end })
        sAdd(CG, "AddButton", { Text = "Delete", Func = function()
            local n = target()
            if not n then notify("pick a config"); return end
            if not cfgExists(n) then notify(n .. " does not exist"); return end
            pcall(delfile, cfgPath(n))
            cfgSel = nil
            refreshCfgs()
            notify("deleted " .. n)
        end })
        sAdd(CG, "AddButton", { Text = "Refresh list", Func = refreshCfgs })
        sAdd(CG, "AddToggle", "cfg_auto", { Text = "auto save on change", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) ConfigStore.Autoload = v end })

        -- auto load: remembers one config name and loads it when the script starts
        local AUTO_FILE = "ArgonLose/autoload_config.txt"
        local function autoName()
            if not isfile or not readfile or not isfile(AUTO_FILE) then return nil end
            local ok, n = pcall(readfile, AUTO_FILE)
            if ok and type(n) == "string" and n ~= "" then return n end
            return nil
        end
        local function setAuto(n)
            if not writefile then return false end
            pcall(function() if isfolder and makefolder and not isfolder("ArgonLose") then makefolder("ArgonLose") end end)
            return pcall(writefile, AUTO_FILE, n or "")
        end
        sAdd(CG, "AddButton", { Text = "Set selected as autoload", Func = function()
            local n = target()
            if not n then notify("pick a config"); return end
            if not cfgExists(n) then notify(n .. " does not exist"); return end
            setAuto(n)
            notify("autoload: " .. n)
        end })
        sAdd(CG, "AddButton", { Text = "Clear autoload", Func = function()
            setAuto("")
            notify("autoload cleared")
        end })
        task.defer(function()
            local n = autoName()
            if n and cfgExists(n) then
                loadConfigAll(cfgPath(n))
                pcall(syncUIFromState)
                notify("autoloaded " .. n)
            end
        end)
    end

    local M = mkGB(Tabs.Settings, "R", "Menu", "settings")
    if M then
        if not (game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled and not game:GetService("UserInputService").KeyboardEnabled) then sAdd(M, "AddDropdown", "MenuKey", {
            Values = {"RightShift","X","LeftShift","RightControl","LeftControl","End","Delete","F1","F2","F3","F4","F5","P"},
            Default = 1, Text = "menu keybind",
            Callback = function(v) pcall(function() Library:SetKeybind(Enum.KeyCode[v]) end) end }) end
        sAdd(M, "AddButton", { Text = "Unload",
            Func = function()
                -- 1) force ALL option toggles off (boolean values) via Set/SetValue
                pcall(function()
                    for id, opt in pairs(Options or {}) do
                        pcall(function()
                            local v = nil
                            pcall(function()
                                if opt.Get then v = opt:Get() else v = opt.Value end
                            end)
                            if type(v) == "boolean" or v == nil then
                                if type(opt.SetValue) == "function" then pcall(opt.SetValue, opt, false) end
                                if type(opt.Set) == "function" then pcall(opt.Set, opt, false) end
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end)
                -- also force known Library flags
                pcall(function()
                    if Library and Library.Flags then
                        for k, v in pairs(Library.Flags) do
                            if type(v) == "boolean" then Library.Flags[k] = false end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                -- 2) watermark OFF (solaria custom + library watermark)
                pcall(function() local s = getgenv and getgenv().SolWmStop; if s then s() end end)
                pcall(function()
                    for _, g in ipairs((gethui and gethui() or game:GetService("CoreGui")):GetChildren()) do
                        if g.Name == "SolariaWatermark" or g.Name == "SolRageStatus" then
                            pcall(function() g:Destroy() end)
                        end
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if Library and Library.Watermark and Library.Watermark.SetVisibility then
                        Library.Watermark:SetVisibility(false)
                    end
                end)
                -- 3) stop combat / hooks / visuals
                pcall(function() ConfigStore.AutoStop() end)
                pcall(stopRagebot)
                pcall(sUninstall)
                pcall(stopESP)
                pcall(sStop)
                pcall(stopUnlockAll)
                pcall(gmDisable)
                pcall(function()
                    if getgenv().SolSetDesync then getgenv().SolSetDesync(false) end
                    local h = getgenv().SolCamHook
                    if h then
                        if h.Uninstall then h.Uninstall() end
                        h.Active = false
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function() if getgenv().SolSetManipulation then getgenv().SolSetManipulation(false) end end)
                pcall(function() if WB then WB.Enabled = false; if WB.Stop then WB.Stop() end end end)
                pcall(function() if ConfigStore.AntiAim then ConfigStore.AntiAim.Enabled = false end end)
                pcall(function() if TB_CFG then TB_CFG.Enabled = false end end)
                pcall(function() if AimbotState then AimbotState.Enabled = false end end)
                pcall(function() if SilentState then SilentState.Enabled = false end end)
                pcall(function() if ConfigStore.ShootSound then ConfigStore.ShootSound.Enabled = false end end)
                pcall(function() if ConfigStore.HitSound then ConfigStore.HitSound.Enabled = false end end)
                pcall(function() if ConfigStore.Spotify then ConfigStore.Spotify.Enabled = false end end)
                pcall(function() if ConfigStore.AutoShoot then ConfigStore.AutoShoot.Enabled = false end end)
                pcall(function() if ConfigStore.GunChams then ConfigStore.GunChams.Enabled = false end end)
                pcall(uninstallViewModelHook)
                pcall(clearSky); pcall(clearBloom); pcall(clearCC); pcall(clearSunRays); pcall(clearTint)
                pcall(function() Fullbright.Enabled = false; applyFullbright() end)
                pcall(function() HitMarker.Enabled = false; if hmHolder then hmHolder:Destroy(); hmHolder = nil end end)
                pcall(function() WorldVisuals.Destroy() end)
                pcall(function() ConfigStore.Fly.Destroy() end)
                pcall(function() ConfigStore.Spinbot.Destroy() end)
                pcall(function() ConfigStore.Crosshair.Destroy() end)
                pcall(function() ConfigStore.Chams.Destroy() end)
                pcall(function() ConfigStore.Soul.Destroy() end)
                pcall(function() ConfigStore.Aura.Destroy() end)
                pcall(function() if AvatarSpooferInstance then AvatarSpooferInstance:Destroy() end end)
                pcall(function() if CosUI and CosUI.Gui then CosUI.Gui:Destroy() end end)
                pcall(function() ConfigStore.GunWire.Stop() end)
                pcall(function() ConfigStore.ViewWire.Unload() end)
                pcall(function()
                    if getgenv().Solaria and getgenv().Solaria.Combat then
                        for _, t in pairs(getgenv().Solaria.Combat) do
                            if type(t) == "table" and t.Enabled ~= nil then t.Enabled = false end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    for k, v in pairs(ConfigStore or {}) do
                        if type(v) == "table" and type(v.Enabled) == "boolean" then v.Enabled = false end
                    end
                end)
                -- 4) tear UI down
                pcall(function() Library:Unload() end)
            end })
    end
end)
if not ok_settings then warn("[ui] settings failed: " .. tostring(err_settings)) end

-- ================= SPOTIFY NOW PLAYING =================
-- uses the Spotify Web API with a user access token (scopes: user-read-playback-state, user-modify-playback-state).
-- needs the executor's request() for HTTP; Roblox's own HttpService can't call Spotify from the client.
local okSpotify, errSpotify = pcall(function()
    local Http = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local req = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request)

    local SP = { Enabled = false, Token = "", Playing = nil, Status = "", LastPoll = 0, Interval = 3, Busy = false,
        ArtUrl = nil, Art = nil }
    ConfigStore.Spotify = SP

    local function spCall(method, path, body)
        if not req then return nil, "executor has no request()" end
        if SP.Token == "" then return nil, "paste an access token" end
        local ok, res = pcall(req, { Url = "https://api.spotify.com/v1" .. path, Method = method,
            Headers = { Authorization = "Bearer " .. SP.Token, ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" }, Body = body or "" })
        if not ok or type(res) ~= "table" then return nil, "request failed" end
        return res.StatusCode, res.Body
    end

    local function spPoll()
        local code, body = spCall("GET", "/me/player/currently-playing")
        if code == 200 and body then
            local ok, d = pcall(Http.JSONDecode, Http, body)
            if ok and type(d) == "table" and type(d.item) == "table" then
                local art = d.item.album and d.item.album.images and d.item.album.images[1]
                SP.Playing = {
                    name = d.item.name or "?",
                    artist = (d.item.artists and d.item.artists[1] and d.item.artists[1].name) or "",
                    art = art and art.url,
                    progress = (d.progress_ms or 0) / 1000,
                    duration = (d.item.duration_ms or 0) / 1000,
                    playing = d.is_playing == true,
                    at = os.clock(),
                }
                SP.Status = ""
                return
            end
        end
        SP.Playing = nil
        if code == 204 or code == 200 then SP.Status = "nothing playing"
        elseif code then SP.Status = "spotify " .. tostring(code) .. (code == 401 and " (token expired)" or "")
        else SP.Status = tostring(body or "") end
    end

    local function spArt(url)
        if not url or url == SP.ArtUrl or not req or not writefile or not getcustomasset then return end
        SP.ArtUrl = url
        pcall(function() if isfolder and not isfolder("argon") then makefolder("argon") end end)
        local ok, res = pcall(req, { Url = url, Method = "GET" })
        if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.Body then
            pcall(writefile, "argon/spotify_art.jpg", res.Body)
            local ok2, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, "argon/spotify_art.jpg")
            if ok2 then SP.Art = asset end
        end
    end

    local function spAction(kind)
        task.spawn(function()
            if kind == "toggle" then
                local playing = SP.Playing and SP.Playing.playing
                spCall("PUT", playing and "/me/player/pause" or "/me/player/play")
            elseif kind == "next" then spCall("POST", "/me/player/next")
            elseif kind == "prev" then spCall("POST", "/me/player/previous") end
            task.wait(0.4)
            spPoll()
        end)
    end

    local function fmt(sec)
        sec = math.max(0, math.floor(sec or 0))
        return ("%d:%02d"):format(sec // 60, sec % 60)
    end

    -- ---------- the card: same look as the solaria menu (sharp corners, outlines, pink liner, menu font) ----------
    local UI = getgenv().Library or {}
    local TH = UI.Theme or {}
    local FONT = UI.Font or Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.SourceSans)
    local BORDER = TH.Border or Color3.fromRGB(3, 3, 3)
    local OUTLINE = TH.Outline or Color3.fromRGB(51, 51, 51)
    local BG = TH.Background or Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 12)
    local INLINE = TH.Inline or Color3.fromRGB(19, 19, 19)
    local ELEM = TH.Element or Color3.fromRGB(39, 39, 39)
    local HOVER = TH["Hovered Element"] or Color3.fromRGB(61, 61, 61)
    local TXT = TH.Text or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local DIM = TH["Inactive Text"] or Color3.fromRGB(134, 134, 134)
    local ACC = TH.Accent or PINK

    local function edge(parent, color, thick)
        local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        st.Color = color; st.Thickness = thick or 1
        st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; st.Parent = parent
        return st
    end

    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "ArgonSpotify"; gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true; gui.ResetOnSpawn = false; gui.DisplayOrder = 140
    gui.Enabled = false
    gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

    -- Border > Outline > Background, the same nesting the main window uses
    local card = Instance.new("Frame")
    card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0); card.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 60)
    card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(380, 118); card.BackgroundColor3 = BORDER; card.BorderSizePixel = 0; card.Parent = gui
    local cardOutline = Instance.new("Frame")
    cardOutline.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1); cardOutline.Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2)
    cardOutline.BackgroundColor3 = OUTLINE; cardOutline.BorderSizePixel = 0; cardOutline.Parent = card
    local cardBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    cardBg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1); cardBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2)
    cardBg.BackgroundColor3 = BG; cardBg.BorderSizePixel = 0; cardBg.Parent = cardOutline
    local liner = Instance.new("Frame")
    liner.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2); liner.BackgroundColor3 = ACC; liner.BorderSizePixel = 0; liner.Parent = cardBg

    local art = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    art.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 12); art.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 80)
    art.BackgroundColor3 = INLINE; art.BorderSizePixel = 0; art.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
    art.Parent = cardBg
    edge(art, OUTLINE, 1)

    local function txt(parent, pos, size, color, text, xa)
        local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        l.BackgroundTransparency = 1; l.Position = pos; l.Size = size; l.FontFace = FONT; l.TextSize = 12
        l.TextColor3 = color; l.Text = text; l.TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        l.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd; l.Parent = parent
        return l
    end
    local titleLbl = txt(cardBg, UDim2.fromOffset(100, 14), UDim2.fromOffset(220, 18), TXT, "nothing playing")
    local artistLbl = txt(cardBg, UDim2.fromOffset(100, 32), UDim2.fromOffset(220, 16), DIM, "")

    local function btn(text, x, onClick)
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
        b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 54); b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 20)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM; b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.AutoButtonColor = false
        b.FontFace = FONT; b.TextSize = 12; b.TextColor3 = TXT
        b.Text = text; b.Parent = cardBg
        edge(b, OUTLINE, 1)
        b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() b.BackgroundColor3 = HOVER end)
        b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() b.BackgroundColor3 = ELEM end)
        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onClick)
        return b
    end
    local prevB = btn("<<", 100, function() spAction("prev") end)
    local playB = btn(">", 136, function() spAction("toggle") end)
    local nextB = btn(">>", 172, function() spAction("next") end)

    local barBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    barBg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 92); barBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 3)
    barBg.BackgroundColor3 = INLINE; barBg.BorderSizePixel = 0; barBg.Parent = cardBg
    edge(barBg, OUTLINE, 1)
    local barFill = Instance.new("Frame")
    barFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1); barFill.BackgroundColor3 = ACC; barFill.BorderSizePixel = 0; barFill.Parent = barBg
    local tElapsed = txt(cardBg, UDim2.fromOffset(10, 98), UDim2.fromOffset(60, 14), DIM, "0:00")
    local tTotal = txt(cardBg, UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 98), UDim2.fromOffset(60, 14), DIM, "0:00", Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)

    -- drag the card by its body
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
    card.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging, dragStart, startPos = true, i.Position, card.Position
            i.Changed:Connect(function() if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end end)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            local d = i.Position - dragStart
            card.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end)

    -- ---------- polling + redraw ----------
    local lastArtUrl = nil
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        gui.Enabled = SP.Enabled
        if not SP.Enabled then return end
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - SP.LastPoll > SP.Interval and not SP.Busy then
            SP.Busy = true; SP.LastPoll = now
            task.spawn(function()
                spPoll()
                if SP.Playing and SP.Playing.art then spArt(SP.Playing.art) end
                SP.Busy = false
            end)
        end

        local p = SP.Playing
        if p then
            titleLbl.Text = p.name
            artistLbl.Text = p.artist
            local elapsed = p.progress + (p.playing and (now - p.at) or 0)
            if p.duration > 0 then
                elapsed = math.min(elapsed, p.duration)
                barFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(elapsed / p.duration, 1)
            end
            tElapsed.Text = fmt(elapsed)
            tTotal.Text = fmt(p.duration)
            playB.Text = p.playing and "||" or ">"
            if SP.Art and p.art ~= lastArtUrl then art.Image = SP.Art; lastArtUrl = p.art end
        else
            titleLbl.Text = SP.Status ~= "" and SP.Status or "nothing playing"
            artistLbl.Text = ""
            barFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
            tElapsed.Text = "0:00"; tTotal.Text = "0:00"
            playB.Text = ">"
        end
    end)

    -- ---------- settings in the Visuals tab ----------
    local SPG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "R", "Spotify", "music")
    if SPG then
        sAdd(SPG, "AddToggle", "sp_show", { Text = "show now playing", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) SP.Enabled = v end })
        sAdd(SPG, "AddTextbox", "sp_token", { Text = "access token", Placeholder = "paste your spotify access token", Default = "",
            Finished = true, Callback = function(t) SP.Token = (t or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"); SP.LastPoll = 0 end })
        sAdd(SPG, "AddButton", { Text = "Previous", Func = function() spAction("prev") end })
        sAdd(SPG, "AddButton", { Text = "Play / Pause", Func = function() spAction("toggle") end })
        sAdd(SPG, "AddButton", { Text = "Next", Func = function() spAction("next") end })
    end
end)
if not okSpotify then warn("[spotify] failed: " .. tostring(errSpotify)) end

-- ================= TARGET HUD (SolariaTargetGUI layout) =================
do
local okTargetHUD, errTargetHUD = pcall(function()
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

    local TH = {
        Enabled = false,
        X = 0.5,
        Y = 0.78,
        Scale = 1,
        Tiers = nil,
        Tried = false,
    }
    ConfigStore.TargetHUD = TH

    local Theme = {
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Background = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30),
        Line = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60),
        Section = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40),
        Element = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50),
        DimText = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170),
        Light = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70),
        Accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180),
    }
    pcall(function()
        local t = Library and Library.Theme
        if type(t) == "table" then
            if typeof(t.Accent) == "Color3" then Theme.Accent = t.Accent end
            if typeof(t.Background) == "Color3" then Theme.Background = t.Background end
            if typeof(t.Inline) == "Color3" then Theme.Section = t.Inline end
            if typeof(t.Outline) == "Color3" then Theme.Line = t.Outline end
        end
    end)

    local objs = nil
    local itemLib = nil
    pcall(function() itemLib = require(RS:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("ItemLibrary")) end)

    local function mk(class, props)
        local i = Instance.new(class)
        if props then
            for k, v in pairs(props) do
                if k ~= "Parent" then pcall(function() i[k] = v end) end
            end
            if props.Parent then i.Parent = props.Parent end
        end
        return i
    end

    local function parentGui()
        return (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
    end

    local function loadTiers()
        if TH.Tried then return TH.Tiers end
        TH.Tried = true
        local found = {}
        for _, d in ipairs(RS:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                local ok, t = pcall(require, d)
                if ok and type(t) == "table" and type(t.RequiredELO) == "table" then
                    for name, elo in pairs(t.RequiredELO) do
                        if type(elo) == "number" then found[#found+1] = { name = tostring(name), elo = elo } end
                    end
                end
            end
            if #found > 0 then break end
        end
        table.sort(found, function(a, b) return a.elo < b.elo end)
        TH.Tiers = found
        return TH.Tiers
    end

    local function rankFor(elo)
        if type(elo) ~= "number" then return "none" end
        local tiers = loadTiers()
        if not tiers or #tiers == 0 then return "none" end
        local best = tiers[1].name
        for _, t in ipairs(tiers) do
            if elo >= t.elo then best = t.name else break end
        end
        return best
    end

    local function ensureHud()
        if objs and objs.root and objs.root.Parent then return true end
        local parent = parentGui()
        if not parent then return false end
        pcall(function()
            local prior = parent:FindFirstChild("SolariaTargetGUIScreen")
            if prior then prior:Destroy() end
            local prior2 = parent:FindFirstChild("__solaria_target_hud")
            if prior2 then prior2:Destroy() end
        end)

        local screen = mk("ScreenGui", {
            Name = "SolariaTargetGUIScreen",
            IgnoreGuiInset = true,
            ResetOnSpawn = false,
            DisplayOrder = 900,
            Parent = parent,
        })

        local Frame = mk("Frame", {
            Name = "TargetHUD",
            Active = true,
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(TH.X or 0.5, TH.Y or 0.78),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(700, 220),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = false,
            Parent = screen,
            ZIndex = 120,
        })
        local UIScale = mk("UIScale", { Scale = TH.Scale or 1, Parent = Frame })
        mk("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Thickness = 1, Parent = Frame })

        local Frame2 = mk("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -18, 1, -18),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = Frame,
            ZIndex = 121,
        })
        mk("UIStroke", { Color = Theme.Line, Thickness = 1, Parent = Frame2 })

        local v90 = mk("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -18, 1, -18),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = Frame2,
            ZIndex = 122,
        })
        mk("UIStroke", { Color = Theme.Line, Thickness = 1, Parent = v90 })

        local Frame3 = mk("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -18, 1, -18),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Section,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Parent = v90,
            ZIndex = 123,
        })
        mk("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Thickness = 1, Parent = Frame3 })

        -- 4 weapon image slots (2 left, 2 right)
        local slotPos = {
            UDim2.fromOffset(17, 18),
            UDim2.fromOffset(17, 88),
            UDim2.new(1, -75, 0, 18),

        }
        local itemImages = {}
        local itemFrames = {}
        for i, pos in ipairs(slotPos) do
            local box = mk("Frame", {
                Position = pos,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 58),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ClipsDescendants = true,
                Parent = Frame3,
                ZIndex = 124,

            mk("UIStroke", { Color = Theme.Line, Thickness = 1, Parent = box })
            local img = mk("ImageLabel", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Image = "",

                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                Parent = box,
                ZIndex = 125,

            itemImages[i] = img
            itemFrames[i] = box
        end

        local function label(props)
            props.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            props.BorderSizePixel = 0

            props.TextColor3 = props.TextColor3 or Theme.Text
            props.TextSize = props.TextSize or 12
            props.TextXAlignment = props.TextXAlignment or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            props.TextYAlignment = props.TextYAlignment or Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
            props.TextTruncate = props.TextTruncate or Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
            return mk("TextLabel", props)
        end

        local nameL = label({
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(92, 23),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -280, 0, 22),
            Text = "no target",

            Parent = Frame3,
            ZIndex = 125,
        })
        local metaL = label({
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(92, 43),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -280, 0, 18),
            Text = "level 0   rank none   device none   streak 0",
            TextColor3 = Theme.DimText,
            TextSize = 11,
            Parent = Frame3,

        label({

        local hpText = label({

        local hpTrack = mk("Frame", {

        -- Large enemy avatar / animation viewport (right side)
        local avOuter = mk("Frame", {
            Name = "AvatarPanel",

        })
        mk("UIStroke", { Color = Theme.Line, Thickness = 1, Parent = avOuter })
        local viewport = mk("ViewportFrame", {
            Name = "AvatarViewport",
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 18),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180),

        local world = Instance.new("WorldModel")
