        local avatarState = {
            userId = nil,
            model = nil,
            track = nil,
            anim = nil,
            angle = 0,
        }

        local function clearAvatar()
            if avatarState.track then pcall(function() avatarState.track:Stop() end) end
            if avatarState.model then pcall(function() avatarState.model:Destroy() end) end
            avatarState.model = nil
            avatarState.track = nil
            avatarState.anim = nil
            avatarState.userId = nil
        end

        local function loadAvatar(player)
            if not player or not player.UserId then
                clearAvatar()
                return
            end
            if avatarState.userId == player.UserId and avatarState.model then
                return
            end
            clearAvatar()
            avatarState.userId = player.UserId
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok, desc = pcall(function()
                    return Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(player.UserId)
                end)
                if not ok or not desc then return end
                if avatarState.userId ~= player.UserId then return end
                local model
                local ok2, m = pcall(function()
                    return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(desc, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
                end)
                if ok2 then model = m end
                if not model then return end
                if avatarState.userId ~= player.UserId then
                    model:Destroy()
                    return
                end
                model.Name = "TargetAvatar"
                model.Parent = world
                local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local hrp = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart
                if hrp then
                    model.PrimaryPart = hrp
                    hrp.Anchored = true
                end
                -- idle animation
                pcall(function()
                    if not hum then return end
                    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                    if not animator then
                        animator = Instance.new("Animator")
                        animator.Parent = hum
                    end
                    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
                    anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://507766666" -- R15 idle
                    local track = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
                    track.Looped = true
                    track:Play()
                    avatarState.anim = anim
                    avatarState.track = track
                end)
                avatarState.model = model
                avatarState.angle = 0
                -- frame camera
                if hrp then
                    local pos = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)
                    cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 5.2), pos)
                end
            end)
        end

        local function spinAvatar(dt)
            local model = avatarState.model
            if not model then return end
            local hrp = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart
            if not hrp then return end
            avatarState.angle = (avatarState.angle or 0) + (dt or 0.016) * 0.55
            local pos = hrp.Position
            -- keep root facing slowly; camera orbits slightly
            local dist = 5.2
            local height = 1.5
            local cx = pos.X + math.sin(avatarState.angle) * dist
            local cz = pos.Z + math.cos(avatarState.angle) * dist
            cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(cx, pos.Y + height, cz), pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.0, 0))
        end

        -- drag when menu open-ish (always allow)
        local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
        Frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = Frame.Position
            end
        end)
        UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                if dragging then
                    TH.X = Frame.Position.X.Scale
                    TH.Y = Frame.Position.Y.Scale
                    pcall(saveConfigAll)
                end
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
        UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging then return end
            if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            local n = input.Position - dragStart
            Frame.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + n.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + n.Y)
        end)

        objs = {
            root = Frame, scale = UIScale, name = nameL, meta = metaL,
            hpText = hpText, hpFill = hpFill, dmgText = dmgText, dmgFill = dmgFill,
            itemImages = itemImages, itemFrames = itemFrames,
            loadAvatar = loadAvatar, clearAvatar = clearAvatar, spinAvatar = spinAvatar,
        }
        return true
    end

    local function getItemImage(name)
        if not name or name == "" then return "" end
        local img = ""
        if itemLib then
            pcall(function()
                if type(itemLib.GetViewModelImage) == "function" then
                    img = itemLib:GetViewModelImage(name) or ""
                end
            end)
        end
        return img or ""
    end

    local function readWeapons(player)
        local items = {}
        local seen = {}
        -- Fighter inventory slots when available
        pcall(function()
            local fc = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
            local f = fc.GetFighter and fc:GetFighter(player)
            if not f then return end
            local inv = f.Inventory or f.Items or f.Objects
            if type(inv) ~= "table" then return end
            for _, it in pairs(inv) do
                local n = nil
                pcall(function() n = it.Name or (it.Get and it:Get("Name")) end)
                if type(n) == "string" and n ~= "" and not seen[n] then
                    seen[n] = true
                    table.insert(items, n)
                end
            end
        end)
        -- ViewModels: "PlayerName - Weapon"
        pcall(function()
            local vms = workspace:FindFirstChild("ViewModels")
            if not vms or not player then return end
            local prefix = player.Name .. " - "
            for _, m in ipairs(vms:GetChildren()) do
                if m:IsA("Model") and m.Name:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
                    local n = m.Name:sub(#prefix + 1)
                    if n ~= "" and not seen[n] then
                        seen[n] = true
                        table.insert(items, n)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        -- character tools
        pcall(function()
            if not player.Character then return end
            for _, child in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Tool") and not seen[child.Name] then
                    seen[child.Name] = true
                    table.insert(items, child.Name)
                end
            end
        end)
        -- equipped fallback
        if #items == 0 and weaponOf and player then
            local w = weaponOf(player)
            if type(w) == "string" and w ~= "" then table.insert(items, w) end
        end
        while #items > 4 do table.remove(items) end
        -- pad empty slots so all 4 boxes stay visible
        while #items < 4 do table.insert(items, "") end
        return items
    end

    local function setWeapons(names)
        if not objs then return end
        for i = 1, 4 do
            local n = names[i] or ""
            local img = n ~= "" and getItemImage(n) or ""
            local label = objs.itemImages[i]
            if label then
                if img ~= "" then
                    label.Image = img
                    label.ImageTransparency = 0
                else
                    label.Image = ""
                    label.ImageTransparency = 1
                end
            end
            if objs.itemFrames[i] then
                objs.itemFrames[i].Visible = true
            end
        end
    end

    local function resolveTarget()
        local tgt = nil
        pcall(function() if AimbotState and AimbotState.LockedTarget then tgt = AimbotState.LockedTarget end end)
        if not tgt then pcall(function() if type(RB_TARGET) == "function" then tgt = RB_TARGET() end end) end
        if not tgt then pcall(function() tgt = SilentTarget end) end
        return tgt
    end

    local lastWeaponsAt, lastWeaponsPlayer = 0, nil
    local dmgGiven, dmgTaken = 0, 0

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not TH.Enabled then
            if objs and objs.root then objs.root.Visible = false end
            return
        end
        if not ensureHud() then return end
        objs.scale.Scale = math.clamp(tonumber(TH.Scale) or 1, 0.5, 1.5)
        local tgt = resolveTarget()
        local ch = tgt and tgt.Character
        local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not (tgt and hum) or hum.Health <= 0 then
            objs.root.Visible = false
            if objs.clearAvatar then objs.clearAvatar() end
            return
        end
        objs.root.Visible = true
        if objs.loadAvatar then objs.loadAvatar(tgt) end
        if objs.spinAvatar then objs.spinAvatar(dt) end
        local name = (tgt.DisplayName ~= "" and tgt.DisplayName) or tgt.Name
        objs.name.Text = name
        local level = tgt:GetAttribute("Level") or tgt:GetAttribute("DisplayLevel") or 0
        local elo = tgt:GetAttribute("DisplayELO")
        local rank = rankFor(elo)
        local device = tgt:GetAttribute("Device") or tgt:GetAttribute("InputType") or "pc"
        local streak = tgt:GetAttribute("WinStreak") or tgt:GetAttribute("Streak") or 0
        objs.meta.Text = string.format("level %s   rank %s   device %s   streak %s",
            tostring(level), tostring(rank), tostring(device), tostring(streak))
        local maxHp = math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1)
        local hp = hum.Health
        objs.hpText.Text = string.format("%d / %d", math.floor(hp + 0.5), math.floor(maxHp + 0.5))
        objs.hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(hp / maxHp, 0, 1), 1)
        objs.hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
        -- damage ratio (best-effort attributes)
        pcall(function()
            dmgGiven = tgt:GetAttribute("DamageDealt") or tgt:GetAttribute("DamageGiven") or dmgGiven
            dmgTaken = tgt:GetAttribute("DamageTaken") or dmgTaken
        end)
        objs.dmgText.Text = string.format("%s attack  %s defense", tostring(dmgGiven), tostring(dmgTaken))
        local ratio = 0
        if (dmgGiven + dmgTaken) > 0 then
            ratio = dmgGiven / (dmgGiven + dmgTaken)
        end
        objs.dmgFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(ratio, 0, 1), 1)
        objs.dmgFill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
        local now = os.clock()
        if tgt ~= lastWeaponsPlayer or now - lastWeaponsAt > 0.35 then
            lastWeaponsPlayer = tgt
            lastWeaponsAt = now
            setWeapons(readWeapons(tgt))
        end
    end)

    local TG = mkGB(Tabs.ESP, "L", "Target HUD", "target")
    if TG then
        sAdd(TG, "AddToggle", "thud_enabled", { Text = "enabled", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) TH.Enabled = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(TG, "AddSlider", "thud_scale", { Text = "scale", Min = 0.5, Max = 1.5, Default = 1, Rounding = 2,
            Callback = function(v)
                TH.Scale = v
                if objs and objs.scale then objs.scale.Scale = v end
                saveConfigAll()
            end })
    end
end)
if not okTargetHUD then warn("[ui] target hud failed: " .. tostring(errTargetHUD)) end
end



-- ================= 3D ESP PREVIEW (only while ui is open) =================
-- a spinning preview (normal tung or our avatar) with an overlay driven by every ESP toggle.
-- lives inside the ESP Preview groupbox by default; "free" mode pops it out to the screen.
-- wrapped in pcall so a preview error can never stop the rest of the script from loading.
local okPrev, errPrev = pcall(function()
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local LocalPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

    -- skeleton bone pairs: R6-style and R15-style (avatar)
    local PR6 = {
        { "Head", "Torso" }, { "Torso", "Left Arm" }, { "Torso", "Right Arm" },
        { "Torso", "Left Leg" }, { "Torso", "Right Leg" },
    }
    local PR15 = {
        { "Head", "UpperTorso" }, { "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso" },
        { "UpperTorso", "LeftUpperArm" }, { "LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm" }, { "LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand" },
        { "UpperTorso", "RightUpperArm" }, { "RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm" }, { "RightLowerArm", "RightHand" },
        { "LowerTorso", "LeftUpperLeg" }, { "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg" }, { "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot" },
        { "LowerTorso", "RightUpperLeg" }, { "RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg" }, { "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot" },
    }

    -- settings state
    local previewOn = false  -- matches the "show preview" toggle default
    local cfg = { model = "normal", mode = "groupbox", width = 220, height = 260, offX = 0, offY = 0 }
    local MODEL_KEY = { ["Normal Tung"] = "normal", ["Our Avatar"] = "avatar" }

    local PVG = mkGB(Tabs.ESP, "L", "ESP Preview", "eye")

    local function espTabOpen()
        local pg = Tabs.ESP and Tabs.ESP.Page
        if pg == nil then return true end
        return pg.Active and true or false
    end

    -- true only while the solaria window itself is open
    local function uiOpen()
        local win = Tabs.ESP and Tabs.ESP.Page and Tabs.ESP.Page.Window
        return win ~= nil and win.IsOpen == true
    end

    local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    sg.Name = "ArgonESPPreview"; sg.ResetOnSpawn = false; sg.IgnoreGuiInset = true; sg.DisplayOrder = 150; sg.Enabled = false
    sg.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

    holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, cfg.height + 8)

    panel.Name = "Panel"; panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 12); panel.BorderSizePixel = 0

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1; title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22); title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2)
    title.Text = "ESP preview"; title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1); title.TextSize = 13; title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansSemibold
    title.Parent = panel

    local VP_SIZE, VP_POS = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -34), UDim2.fromOffset(6, 26)
    local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
    vp.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20); vp.BorderSizePixel = 0
    vp.Size = VP_SIZE; vp.Position = VP_POS
    vp.Ambient = Color3.new(1, 1, 1); vp.LightColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    vp.Parent = panel
    local wm = Instance.new("WorldModel"); wm.Parent = vp
    local cam = Instance.new("Camera"); cam.Parent = vp; vp.CurrentCamera = cam
    cam.FieldOfView = 55

    -- 2D tung images (decals do not render reliably inside ViewportFrame)
    local tungImg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    tungImg.Name = "TungImage"
    tungImg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
    tungImg.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    tungImg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    tungImg.Size = VP_SIZE
    tungImg.Position = VP_POS
    tungImg.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    tungImg.Visible = false
    tungImg.ZIndex = 2
    tungImg.Parent = panel
    local function tungImageUrl()
        -- rbxthumb is the reliable UI form for decal/image assets on ImageLabels
        return "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=139818999438291&w=420&h=420"
    end
    local TUNG_IMG = {
        normal = tungImageUrl(),
    }

    -- world -> overlay pixels, computed from the camera itself
    local function project(p)
        local rel = cam.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(p)
        local depth = -rel.Z
        if depth <= 0.01 then return nil end
        local halfH = depth * math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) / 2)
        local W, H = vp.AbsoluteSize.X, vp.AbsoluteSize.Y
        if W <= 0 or H <= 0 then return nil end
        local halfW = halfH * (W / H)
        return (0.5 + 0.5 * rel.X / halfW) * W, (0.5 - 0.5 * rel.Y / halfH) * H
    end

    -- overlay sits on top of the viewport
    local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
    overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1; overlay.Size = VP_SIZE; overlay.Position = VP_POS; overlay.ClipsDescendants = true; overlay.ZIndex = 3; overlay.Parent = panel
    local boxFill = Instance.new("Frame"); boxFill.BorderSizePixel = 0; boxFill.Visible = false; boxFill.Parent = overlay
    local box = Instance.new("Frame")
    box.BackgroundTransparency = 1; box.BorderSizePixel = 0; box.Visible = false; box.Parent = overlay
    local boxStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke"); boxStroke.Thickness = 1; boxStroke.Parent = box
    local bones = {}
    for i = 1, 16 do
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0; f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); f.Visible = false; f.Parent = overlay
        bones[i] = f
    end

    local function mkLabel(anchor)
        local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        l.BackgroundTransparency = 1; l.AnchorPoint = anchor or Vector2.new(0.5, 0); l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 14)
        l.Font = ESP.Drawing.Text.Font; l.TextSize = 11; l.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1); l.Text = ""
        l.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3; l.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        l.Visible = false; l.Parent = overlay
        return l
    end
    local nameL, distL, weaponL = mkLabel(), mkLabel(), mkLabel()
    distL.Text = "12 studs"; weaponL.Text = "Assault Rifle"
    local hpTextL = mkLabel(Vector2.new(1, 0))
    hpTextL.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 14); hpTextL.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    local hpBack = Instance.new("Frame"); hpBack.BorderSizePixel = 0; hpBack.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0); hpBack.Visible = false; hpBack.Parent = overlay
    local hpFill = Instance.new("Frame"); hpFill.BorderSizePixel = 0; hpFill.Parent = hpBack
    local tracer = Instance.new("Frame"); tracer.BorderSizePixel = 0; tracer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); tracer.Visible = false; tracer.Parent = overlay
    local headH = Instance.new("Frame"); headH.BorderSizePixel = 0; headH.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); headH.Visible = false; headH.Parent = overlay
    local headV = Instance.new("Frame"); headV.BorderSizePixel = 0; headV.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); headV.Visible = false; headV.Parent = overlay

    -- ---------- shared part helpers ----------
    local PALE   = Color3.fromRGB(238, 236, 232)
    local PALE2  = Color3.fromRGB(220, 217, 212)
    local WING   = Color3.fromRGB(247, 242, 230)
    local WING2  = Color3.fromRGB(230, 214, 172)
    local GOLD   = Color3.fromRGB(236, 196, 96)
    local WHITE  = Color3.fromRGB(252, 252, 252)
    local BLUE   = Color3.fromRGB(96, 172, 236)
    local BLACK  = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
    local MOUTH  = Color3.fromRGB(150, 74, 84)
    local UPRIGHT = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)) -- cylinders run along X by default; this stands them up

    local function makePart(m, shape, size, cf, color, name, mat, invisible)
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Shape = shape; p.Size = size; p.CFrame = cf; p.Color = color
        p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.CanTouch = false; p.CanQuery = false; p.CastShadow = false
        p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth; p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        if name then p.Name = name end
        if invisible then p.Transparency = 1 end
        p.Parent = m
        return p
    end

    -- ---------- normal tung (2D image + invisible rig for ESP overlay) ----------
    -- Asset ID is a Decal; the visible art is the ImageLabel above the ViewportFrame.
    local function buildTungRig(name)
        local m = Instance.new("Model")
        m.Name = name
        local function invPart(partName, size, cf)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name = partName
            p.Size = size
            p.CFrame = cf
            p.Anchored = true
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.CanTouch = false
            p.CanQuery = false
            p.CastShadow = false
            p.Transparency = 1
            p.Parent = m
            return p
        end
        local root = invPart("HumanoidRootPart", Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), CFrame.new(0, 3.1, 0))
        m.PrimaryPart = root
        invPart("Head", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), CFrame.new(0, 5.2, 0))
        invPart("Torso", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), CFrame.new(0, 3.5, 0))
        invPart("Left Arm", Vector3.new(0.6, 1.6, 0.6), CFrame.new(-1.4, 3.5, 0))
        invPart("Right Arm", Vector3.new(0.6, 1.6, 0.6), CFrame.new(1.4, 3.5, 0))
        invPart("Left Leg", Vector3.new(0.7, 1.8, 0.7), CFrame.new(-0.5, 1.2, 0))
        invPart("Right Leg", Vector3.new(0.7, 1.8, 0.7), CFrame.new(0.5, 1.2, 0))
        return m
    end

    local function buildNormal()
        return buildTungRig("NormalTung")
    end

    -- ---------- our avatar (clone of our character) ----------
    local function buildAvatar()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return nil end
        local ok, m = pcall(function()
            char.Archivable = true
            return char:Clone()
        end)
        if not ok or not m then return nil end
        for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Script") or d:IsA("LocalScript") then d:Destroy()
            elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Anchored = true; d.CanCollide = false; d.CanTouch = false; d.CanQuery = false end
        end
        m.PrimaryPart = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart
        return m
    end

    local model, modelKind
    local function clearModel()
        if model then model:Destroy(); model = nil end
    end
    local function rebuild()
        clearModel()
        local kind = cfg.model
        local m
        if kind == "avatar" then m = buildAvatar() end
        if not m then
            m = buildNormal()
            kind = "normal"
        end
        if not m then return end
        model, modelKind = m, kind
        model.Parent = wm
    end

    local hl
    local function applyChams(m)
        local C = ConfigStore.Chams
        if C.Enabled then
            if not hl or hl.Parent ~= m then
                if hl then hl:Destroy() end
                hl = Instance.new("Highlight"); hl.Name = "PreviewChams"; hl.Adornee = m; hl.Parent = m
                hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            end
            hl.Enabled = true
            hl.FillColor = C.Color; hl.FillTransparency = C.FillTransparency
            hl.OutlineTransparency = 1
            local mat = C.Material
            if mat and mat ~= "None" then
                for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Material = Enum.Material[mat]; d.Color = C.Color end
                end
            end
        elseif hl then
            hl.Enabled = false
        end
    end

    local function hideOverlay()
        box.Visible = false; boxFill.Visible = false
        nameL.Visible = false; distL.Visible = false; weaponL.Visible = false; hpTextL.Visible = false
        hpBack.Visible = false; tracer.Visible = false; headH.Visible = false; headV.Visible = false
        for _, f in ipairs(bones) do f.Visible = false end
    end

    -- ---------- settings (inside the ESP Preview groupbox) ----------
    local layoutKey = nil
    local function applyLayout()
        local key = cfg.mode .. "|" .. cfg.width .. "|" .. cfg.height .. "|" .. cfg.offX .. "|" .. cfg.offY
        if key == layoutKey then return end
        layoutKey = key
        local W, H = cfg.width, cfg.height
        local free = cfg.mode == "free" or not PVG
        holder.Size = free and UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, H + 8)
        panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
        if free then
            panel.Parent = sg
            panel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16 + cfg.offX, 1, -(H + 16) - cfg.offY)
        else
            panel.Parent = holder
            panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -W / 2 + cfg.offX, 0, 4 + cfg.offY)
        end
    end

    local content = PVG and PVG.Section and PVG.Section.Items and PVG.Section.Items["Content"]
    content = content and content.Instance
    local preKids = {}
    if PVG then
        sAdd(PVG, "AddToggle", "esp_preview", { Text = "show tung / avatar preview", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) previewOn = v; saveConfigAll() end })
    end
    if content then
        for _, c in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do preKids[c] = true end -- the toggle is in here now
        holder.Parent = content
    end

    if PVG then
        sAdd(PVG, "AddDropdown", "esp_pv_model", { Text = "preview model (tung / avatar)", Values = { "Normal Tung", "Our Avatar" }, Default = 1,
            Callback = function(v) cfg.model = MODEL_KEY[v] or "normal" end })
        sAdd(PVG, "AddDropdown", "esp_pv_mode", { Text = "mode", Values = { "Groupbox", "Free" }, Default = 1,
            Callback = function(v) cfg.mode = (v == "Free") and "free" or "groupbox" end })
        sAdd(PVG, "AddSlider", "esp_pv_w", { Text = "width", Min = 120, Max = 400, Default = 220, Rounding = 0, Suffix = "px",
            Callback = function(v) cfg.width = v end })
        sAdd(PVG, "AddSlider", "esp_pv_h", { Text = "height", Min = 120, Max = 500, Default = 260, Rounding = 0, Suffix = "px",
            Callback = function(v) cfg.height = v end })
        sAdd(PVG, "AddSlider", "esp_pv_x", { Text = "move x", Min = -800, Max = 800, Default = 0, Rounding = 0, Suffix = "px",
            Callback = function(v) cfg.offX = v end })
        sAdd(PVG, "AddSlider", "esp_pv_y", { Text = "move y", Min = -400, Max = 400, Default = 0, Rounding = 0, Suffix = "px",
            Callback = function(v) cfg.offY = v end })
    end

    -- toggle stays first, the preview sits right under it, settings come after
    if content then
        for _, c in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("GuiObject") then
                c.LayoutOrder = (c == holder and 1) or (preKids[c] and 0) or 2
            end
        end
    end

    -- ---------- update ----------
    local spinT = 0
    local warned = false
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        local okU, errU = pcall(function()
            local gate = previewOn and espTabOpen() and uiOpen() or false
            applyLayout()
            sg.Enabled = gate and cfg.mode == "free" and PVG ~= nil
            panel.Visible = gate
            if not gate then return end

            if modelKind ~= cfg.model and not (cfg.model == "avatar" and modelKind == "normal") then
                clearModel() -- model choice changed: rebuild below
            end
            if not model then rebuild() end
            local m = model
            if not m then return end

            local isTung = (cfg.model == "normal")
            if isTung then
                local primary = TUNG_IMG.normal
                if tungImg.Image ~= primary then
                    tungImg.Image = primary
                end
                tungImg.Visible = true
                tungImg.Size = VP_SIZE
                tungImg.Position = VP_POS
                vp.Visible = false
            else
                tungImg.Visible = false
                vp.Visible = true
            end

            spinT = spinT + dt * 0.45 -- slow spin
            m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0, 3.1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, spinT, 0))
            cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 3.1, -9.5), Vector3.new(0, 3.1, 0))
            if not isTung then applyChams(m) end

            -- screen box: for tung, hug the ImageLabel (the tung picture). for avatar, project the 3D model.
            local minX, minY, maxX, maxY
            if isTung then
                local W = math.max(overlay.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
                local H = math.max(overlay.AbsoluteSize.Y, 1)
                -- ImageLabel uses Fit: estimate the letterboxed image rect (tung art is ~3:4 portrait)
                local imgAspect = 3 / 4
                local frameAspect = W / H
                local drawW, drawH
                if frameAspect > imgAspect then
                    drawH = H * 0.92
                    drawW = drawH * imgAspect
                else
                    drawW = W * 0.92
                    drawH = drawW / imgAspect
                end
                minX = (W - drawW) * 0.5
                maxX = minX + drawW
                minY = (H - drawH) * 0.5
                maxY = minY + drawH
            else
                local bb, bsz = m:GetBoundingBox()
                minX, minY, maxX, maxY = math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
                local behind = false
                for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do for _, sy in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do for _, sz in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                    local x, y = project((bb * CFrame.new(sx * bsz.X / 2, sy * bsz.Y / 2, sz * bsz.Z / 2)).Position)
                    if not x then
                        behind = true
                    else
                        minX, minY = math.min(minX, x), math.min(minY, y)
                        maxX, maxY = math.max(maxX, x), math.max(maxY, y)
                    end
                end end end
                if behind or minX == math.huge then hideOverlay(); return end
            end

            local D = ESP.Drawing
            local hb = D.Healthbar
            local cx = (minX + maxX) / 2
            nameL.Text = (modelKind == "avatar") and LocalPlayer.Name or "Tung Tung Sahur"
            for _, l in ipairs({ nameL, distL, weaponL, hpTextL }) do
                l.Font = D.Text.Font; l.TextSize = ESP.FontSize
            end

            -- filled box + outline box
            boxFill.Visible = D.Boxes.Filled.Enabled
            if boxFill.Visible then
                boxFill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(minX, minY)
                boxFill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(maxX - minX, maxY - minY)
                boxFill.BackgroundColor3 = D.Boxes.GradientFillRGB1
                boxFill.BackgroundTransparency = D.Boxes.Filled.Transparency
            end
            box.Visible = D.Boxes.Full.Enabled
            if box.Visible then
                box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(minX, minY)
                box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(maxX - minX, maxY - minY)
                boxStroke.Color = D.Boxes.GradientRGB1
            end

            -- name above, distance and weapon below
            nameL.Visible = D.Name.Enabled
            nameL.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, minY - 15)
            nameL.TextColor3 = D.Name.RGB
            distL.Visible = D.Distances.Enabled
            distL.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, maxY + 2)
            distL.TextColor3 = D.Distances.RGB
            weaponL.Visible = D.Weapons.Enabled
            weaponL.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, maxY + 2 + (D.Distances.Enabled and 13 or 0))
            weaponL.TextColor3 = D.Weapons.WeaponTextRGB

            -- health bar: real health for the avatar, animated for the tung models
            local hum = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hp
            if hum and hum.MaxHealth > 0 then
                hp = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
            else
                hp = math.clamp(0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(os.clock() * 0.9), 0, 1)
            end
            hpBack.Visible = hb.Enabled
            hpBack.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(minX - hb.Width - 4, minY)
            hpBack.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hb.Width, maxY - minY)
            hpFill.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1 - hp, 0)
            hpFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, hp, 0)
            hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = hp > 0.5 and hb.GradientRGB1 or (hp > 0.25 and hb.GradientRGB2 or hb.GradientRGB3)
            hpTextL.Visible = hb.Enabled and hb.HealthText
            hpTextL.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(minX - hb.Width - 6, minY)
            hpTextL.Text = tostring(math.floor(hp * 100))
            hpTextL.TextColor3 = hb.HealthTextRGB

            -- tracer from bottom / center / top to feet or head
            local tr = D.Tracers
            tracer.Visible = tr.Enabled
            if tracer.Visible then
                local vs = vp.AbsoluteSize
                local ox, oy = vs.X / 2, vs.Y
                if tr.Origin == "Center" then oy = vs.Y / 2 elseif tr.Origin == "Top" then oy = 0 end
                local tx, ty = cx, maxY
                local hd = m:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if tr.Target == "Head" and hd then
                    local hx, hy = project(hd.Position)
                    if hx then tx, ty = hx, hy end
                end
                local dx, dy = tx - ox, ty - oy
                tracer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((ox + tx) / 2, (oy + ty) / 2)
                tracer.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), tr.Thickness)
                tracer.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
                tracer.BackgroundColor3 = tr.RGB
            end

            -- head marker
            local hm = D.HeadMarker
            local hx, hy
            if isTung then
                hx = (minX + maxX) * 0.5
                hy = minY + (maxY - minY) * 0.12
            else
                local hd2 = m:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if hd2 then hx, hy = project(hd2.Position) end
            end
            local hvis = hm.Enabled and hx ~= nil
            headH.Visible = hvis; headV.Visible = hvis
            if hvis then
                headH.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(hx, hy); headH.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hm.Size * 2, 2); headH.BackgroundColor3 = hm.RGB
                headV.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(hx, hy); headV.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, hm.Size * 2); headV.BackgroundColor3 = hm.RGB
            end

            -- skeleton (avatar only; tung is a flat image)
            local S = ConfigStore.Skeleton
            if isTung or not S.Enabled then
                for i = 1, #bones do bones[i].Visible = false end
            else
                local list = m:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") and PR15 or PR6
                for i = 1, #bones do
                    local f = bones[i]
                    local pr = list[i]
                    local a = pr and m:FindFirstChild(pr[1])
                    local b = pr and m:FindFirstChild(pr[2])
                    local show = false
                    if a and b then
                        local ax, ay = project(a.Position)
                        local bx, by = project(b.Position)
                        if ax and bx then
                            local A, B = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Vector2.new(bx, by)
                            local d = B - A
                            f.BackgroundColor3 = S.Color
                            f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d.Magnitude, S.Thickness)
                            f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((A.X + B.X) / 2, (A.Y + B.Y) / 2)
                            f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(d.Y, d.X))
                            show = true
                        end
                    end
                    f.Visible = show
                end
            end
        end)
        if not okU and not warned then
            warned = true
            warn("[esp preview] update error: " .. tostring(errU))
        end
    end)
end)
if not okPrev then warn("[esp preview] failed: " .. tostring(errPrev)) end

-- ================= AMMO BAR (under crosshair) =================
pcall(function()
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local AB2 = { Enabled = false, Width = 90, Height = 3, Offset = 26 }
    local LocalPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local function getAmmoRatio()
        local ctrl = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
        local f = ctrl.LocalFighter or ctrl:GetFighter(LocalPlayer)
        local it = f and f.EquippedItem
        if not it or not it.Get then return nil end
        local a = it:Get("Ammo") or 0
        local info = it.Info
        local mx = info and (info.AmmoMax or info.ClipSize or info.MagazineSize or info.MaxAmmo)
        if not mx or mx <= 0 then return nil end
        return a / mx
    end
    local abGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    abGui.Name = "ArgonAmmoBar"; abGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true; abGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    abGui.DisplayOrder = 9998; abGui.Enabled = false
    abGui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
    local back = Instance.new("Frame")
    back.BorderSizePixel = 0; back.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0); back.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4; back.Parent = abGui
    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0; fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); fill.Parent = back
    local abGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    abGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(PINK, WHITE); abGrad.Parent = fill
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not AB2.Enabled then abGui.Enabled = false; return end
        local ok, r = pcall(getAmmoRatio)
        if not ok or type(r) ~= "number" then abGui.Enabled = false; return end
        abGui.Enabled = true
        r = math.clamp(r, 0, 1)
        back.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(AB2.Width, AB2.Height)
        back.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -AB2.Width / 2, 0.5, AB2.Offset)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(r, 0, 1, 0)
    end)
    local AG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "L", "Ammo Bar", "zap")
    if AG then
        sAdd(AG, "AddToggle", "ammo_bar", { Text = "enabled", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) AB2.Enabled = v end })
        sAdd(AG, "AddSlider", "ammo_w", { Text = "width", Min = 20, Max = 300, Default = 90, Rounding = 0, Suffix = "px",
            Callback = function(v) AB2.Width = v end })
        sAdd(AG, "AddSlider", "ammo_h", { Text = "height", Min = 1, Max = 12, Default = 3, Rounding = 0, Suffix = "px",
            Callback = function(v) AB2.Height = v end })
        sAdd(AG, "AddSlider", "ammo_off", { Text = "offset from center", Min = -300, Max = 300, Default = 26, Rounding = 0, Suffix = "px",
            Callback = function(v) AB2.Offset = v end })
    end
end)

-- ================= UI THEMES =================
local okTheme, errTheme = pcall(function()
    -- key order matches getgenv().Library.Theme keys
    local TKEYS = { "Border", "Outline", "Background", "Inline", "Accent", "Text", "Inactive Text", "Element", "Element 2", "Hovered Element" }
    local TPRESETS = {
        ["Pink"]     = { {3,3,3}, {51,51,51}, {12,12,12}, {19,19,19}, {255,105,180}, {255,255,255}, {134,134,134}, {39,39,39}, {56,56,56}, {61,61,61} },
        ["Midnight"] = { {3,4,10}, {30,36,60}, {10,12,22}, {16,19,34}, {90,140,255}, {235,240,255}, {110,118,140}, {30,34,52}, {42,47,70}, {50,56,82} },
        ["Crimson"]  = { {6,2,2}, {60,20,24}, {14,6,7}, {24,10,12}, {220,40,60}, {255,240,240}, {140,110,112}, {38,16,18}, {54,24,26}, {66,30,32} },
        ["Emerald"]  = { {2,6,4}, {24,60,44}, {7,14,11}, {12,24,19}, {60,220,140}, {235,255,245}, {110,140,124}, {20,38,30}, {28,54,42}, {34,66,52} },
        ["Gold"]     = { {6,5,2}, {60,50,20}, {14,12,6}, {24,20,10}, {255,190,60}, {255,248,230}, {140,130,110}, {38,32,16}, {54,46,24}, {66,56,30} },
        ["Violet"]   = { {5,2,8}, {50,30,70}, {12,8,18}, {20,14,30}, {170,110,255}, {245,240,255}, {125,115,140}, {32,22,46}, {44,32,62}, {54,40,74} },
        ["Ice"]      = { {4,8,10}, {40,70,80}, {9,14,17}, {15,24,29}, {120,220,255}, {240,252,255}, {120,140,150}, {26,40,48}, {36,54,64}, {44,64,74} },
        ["Mono"]     = { {3,3,3}, {51,51,51}, {12,12,12}, {19,19,19}, {230,230,230}, {255,255,255}, {134,134,134}, {39,39,39}, {56,56,56}, {61,61,61} },
    }
    local TORDER = { "Pink", "Midnight", "Crimson", "Emerald", "Gold", "Violet", "Ice", "Mono" }
    -- picker flag -> theme key
    local PICKS = {
        { "ui_c_accent", "Accent" }, { "ui_c_bg", "Background" }, { "ui_c_inline", "Inline" },
        { "ui_c_outline", "Outline" }, { "ui_c_border", "Border" }, { "ui_c_text", "Text" }, { "ui_c_element", "Element" },
    }

    local TState = { preset = "Pink", colors = {} }   -- colors = per-key overrides as {r,g,b} in 0..1

    local function rgbOf(a) return Color3.fromRGB(a[1], a[2], a[3]) end
    -- recolours everything already on screen. ChangeTheme only reaches items registered with the library's
    -- theme system, so anything built with a raw colour is found here by matching its old colour
    local RECOLOR_PROPS = { "BackgroundColor3", "TextColor3", "BorderColor3", "ImageColor3", "ScrollBarImageColor3", "Color" }
    local function colorEq(a, b)
        return a and b and math.abs(a.R - b.R) < 0.004 and math.abs(a.G - b.G) < 0.004 and math.abs(a.B - b.B) < 0.004
    end
    local function snapshot()
        local t = {}
        for _, k in ipairs(TKEYS) do
            local v = getgenv().Library.Theme and getgenv().Library.Theme[k]
            if typeof(v) == "Color3" then t[k] = v end
        end
        return t
    end
    local function recolorScreen(old, new)
        local swaps = {}
        for k, o in pairs(old) do
            local n = new[k]
            if n and not colorEq(o, n) then swaps[#swaps + 1] = { o, n } end
        end
        if #swaps == 0 then return end
        local function mapC(c)
            for _, sw in ipairs(swaps) do if colorEq(c, sw[1]) then return sw[2] end end
            return nil
        end
        local okH, root = pcall(function() return gethui and gethui() end)
        if not (okH and root) then root = game:GetService("CoreGui") end
        for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
            for _, prop in ipairs(RECOLOR_PROPS) do
                local ok, v = pcall(function() return d[prop] end)
                if ok and typeof(v) == "Color3" then
                    local nc = mapC(v)
                    if nc then pcall(function() d[prop] = nc end) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- applies a list of {key, color}; updates the registered items, then recolours the rest on screen
    local function setKeys(list)
        local old = snapshot()
        for _, kc in ipairs(list) do
            pcall(function() getgenv().Library:ChangeTheme(kc[1], kc[2]) end)
        end
        pcall(recolorScreen, old, snapshot())
    end
    local function setKey(k, c) setKeys({ { k, c } }) end

    local function syncPickers()
        if type(getgenv().Library.SetFlags) ~= "table" then return end
        for _, pk in ipairs(PICKS) do
            local set = getgenv().Library.SetFlags[pk[1]]
            local c = getgenv().Library.Theme and getgenv().Library.Theme[pk[2]]
            if set and c then pcall(set, c, 0) end
        end
    end

    local function applyPreset(name)
        local p = TPRESETS[name]
        if not p then return end
        TState.preset = name
        TState.colors = {}
        local list = {}
        for i, k in ipairs(TKEYS) do list[#list + 1] = { k, rgbOf(p[i]) } end
        setKeys(list)
        syncPickers()
    end

    local function applyColor(k, c)
        TState.colors[k] = { c.R, c.G, c.B }
        setKey(k, c)
    end

    -- hooks for saveConfigAll / loadConfigAll
    ConfigStore.ThemeGet = function()
        return { preset = TState.preset, colors = TState.colors }
    end
    ConfigStore.ApplyThemeSaved = function(t)
        if type(t) ~= "table" then return end
        if t.preset and TPRESETS[t.preset] then applyPreset(t.preset) end
        for k, v in pairs(t.colors or {}) do
            if type(v) == "table" then applyColor(k, Color3.new(v[1] or 1, v[2] or 1, v[3] or 1)) end
        end
        syncPickers()
    end

    local TG = mkGB(Tabs.Settings, "L", "UI Theme", "palette")
    if TG then
        sAdd(TG, "AddDropdown", "ui_theme", { Text = "theme", Values = TORDER, Default = 1,
            Callback = function(v) applyPreset(v); saveConfigAll() end })
        addPicker(TG, "ui_c_accent",  { Default = rgbOf(TPRESETS.Pink[5]), Title = "accent", Transparency = 0,
            Callback = function(c) applyColor("Accent", c); saveConfigAll() end })
        addPicker(TG, "ui_c_bg",      { Default = rgbOf(TPRESETS.Pink[3]), Title = "background", Transparency = 0,
            Callback = function(c) applyColor("Background", c); saveConfigAll() end })
        addPicker(TG, "ui_c_inline",  { Default = rgbOf(TPRESETS.Pink[4]), Title = "inline", Transparency = 0,
            Callback = function(c) applyColor("Inline", c); saveConfigAll() end })
        addPicker(TG, "ui_c_outline", { Default = rgbOf(TPRESETS.Pink[2]), Title = "outline", Transparency = 0,
            Callback = function(c) applyColor("Outline", c); saveConfigAll() end })
        addPicker(TG, "ui_c_border",  { Default = rgbOf(TPRESETS.Pink[1]), Title = "border", Transparency = 0,
            Callback = function(c) applyColor("Border", c); saveConfigAll() end })
        addPicker(TG, "ui_c_text",    { Default = rgbOf(TPRESETS.Pink[6]), Title = "text", Transparency = 0,
            Callback = function(c) applyColor("Text", c); saveConfigAll() end })
        addPicker(TG, "ui_c_element", { Default = rgbOf(TPRESETS.Pink[8]), Title = "element", Transparency = 0,
            Callback = function(c) applyColor("Element", c); saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(TG, "AddButton", { Text = "Reset to preset", Func = function()
            applyPreset(TState.preset); saveConfigAll()
        end })
    end
end)
if not okTheme then warn("[theme] setup failed: " .. tostring(errTheme)) end

do
-- ================= CUSTOM SKINS (aug on assault rifle, archrambit on knife) =================
-- both run once and cannot be unhooked. no skin image: no icon/texture swaps, mesh + sounds only
local CUSTOM_SKIN_RAN = { aug = false, archrambit = false }

local function startAugAR()
    if CUSTOM_SKIN_RAN.aug then return end
    CUSTOM_SKIN_RAN.aug = true
    --[[
        Assault Rifle only - auto-equip an "Aug" skin (client-side, visual only)
        Optimized: cached lookups, no full-game rescans, signals only on relevant instances.
    ]]

    local frontOk, frontErr = pcall(function()

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- config
    local KEYWORD = "aug"
    local PICK    = nil
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RS      = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local lp      = Players.LocalPlayer

    local ctrl = lp.PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("Controllers", 10)
    local mods = RS:WaitForChild("Modules", 10)

    local enumLib = require(mods:WaitForChild("EnumLibrary", 10))
    if enumLib then pcall(function() enumLib:WaitForEnumBuilder() end) end
    local cosLib  = require(mods:WaitForChild("CosmeticLibrary", 10))
    local datCtrl = require(ctrl:WaitForChild("PlayerDataController", 10))

    local Cosmetics = cosLib.Cosmetics

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers (memoized)
    local arCache, augCache = {}, {}

    local function isAR(w)
        if type(w) == "table" then w = w.Name end
        if type(w) ~= "string" then return false end
        local r = arCache[w]
        if r == nil then
            r = (w:lower():gsub("%s+", "")) == "assaultrifle"
            arCache[w] = r
        end
        return r
    end

    local function isAugSkin(n)
        if type(n) ~= "string" then return false end
        local r = augCache[n]
        if r == nil then
            local c = Cosmetics[n]
            r = (n:lower():find(KEYWORD, 1, true) ~= nil) and c ~= nil and c.Type == "Skin"
            augCache[n] = r
        end
        return r
    end

    local function mkSkin(name)
        local base = Cosmetics[name]
        if not base then return nil end
        local d = {}
        for k, v in pairs(base) do d[k] = v end
        d.Name = name
        d.Type = d.Type or "Skin"
        d.Seed = d.Seed or math.random(1, 1000000)
        if enumLib then
            local ok, id = pcall(enumLib.ToEnum, enumLib, name)
            if ok and id then
                d.Enum = id
                d.ObjectID = d.ObjectID or id
            end
        end
        return d
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- find + pick the skin
    local matches = {}
    for name, c in pairs(Cosmetics) do
        if type(name) == "string" and c.Type == "Skin" and name:lower():find(KEYWORD, 1, true) then
            table.insert(matches, name)
        end
    end
    table.sort(matches)

    if #matches == 0 then
        warn("[AR-Aug] no skins containing '" .. KEYWORD .. "' found")
        return
    end

    local chosen = matches[1]
    if PICK and isAugSkin(PICK) then chosen = PICK end

    local arSkin = mkSkin(chosen)
    print(("[AR-Aug] %d matching skin(s); equipping '%s'"):format(#matches, chosen))

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- ownership
    for _, key in ipairs({ "OwnsCosmetic", "OwnsCosmeticNormally", "OwnsCosmeticUniversally", "OwnsCosmeticForWeapon" }) do
        local orig = cosLib[key]
        if type(orig) == "function" then
            cosLib[key] = function(self, inv, nm, wep, ...)
                if isAR(wep) and isAugSkin(nm) then return true end
                return orig(self, inv, nm, wep, ...)
            end
        end
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- inventory view (cached)
    local origGet = datCtrl.Get
    local invSrc, invProxy
    local invMeta = {
        __index = function(_, k)
            if isAugSkin(k) then return true end
            return nil
        end,
    }
    datCtrl.Get = function(self, key, ...)
        local val = origGet(self, key, ...)
        if key == "CosmeticInventory" then
            if invProxy and invSrc == val then return invProxy end
            local prx = {}
            if val then for k, v in pairs(val) do prx[k] = v end end
            invSrc, invProxy = val, setmetatable(prx, invMeta)
            return invProxy
        end
        return val
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- loadout view (cached)
    local origGetWep = datCtrl.GetWeaponData
    local wepCache = {}
    datCtrl.GetWeaponData = function(self, wn, ...)
        local d = origGetWep(self, wn, ...)
        if not d then return nil end
        if arSkin and isAR(wn) then
            local c = wepCache[wn]
            if c and c.src == d and c.skin == arSkin then return c.out end
            local m = {}
            for k, v in pairs(d) do m[k] = v end
            m.Name = wn
            m.Skin = arSkin
            wepCache[wn] = { src = d, skin = arSkin, out = m }
            return m
        end
        return d
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- remotes
    if hookmetamethod and getnamecallmethod then
        local remotes  = RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")

        if equipRem then
            local old
            old = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
                if self == equipRem and getnamecallmethod() == "FireServer" then
                    local wn, ct, cn = ...
                    if isAR(wn) and ct == "Skin" and isAugSkin(cn) then
                        arSkin = mkSkin(cn)
                        task.defer(function()
                            pcall(function() datCtrl.CurrentData:Replicate("WeaponInventory") end)
                        end)
                        return
                    end
                end
                return old(self, ...)
            end)
        end
    else
        warn("[AR-Aug] hookmetamethod not available; UI equips will still hit the server")
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- first-person viewmodel
    local function applySkin(data, enumFn)
        if not (arSkin and data) then return end
        if enumFn then
            data[enumFn("Skin")] = arSkin
            data[enumFn("Name")] = arSkin.Name
        else
            data.Skin = arSkin
            data.Name = arSkin.Name
        end
    end

    end)

        cliItem._CreateViewModel = function(self, vmRef, ...)
            local owner = self.ClientFighter and self.ClientFighter.Player
            buildingWep = (owner == lp) and self.Name or nil
            if owner == lp and isAR(self.Name) then
                local dk = self:ToEnum("Data")
                if vmRef[dk] then
                    applySkin(vmRef[dk], function(n) return self:ToEnum(n) end)
                elseif vmRef.Data then
                    applySkin(vmRef.Data)
                end
            end
            local r = origCVM(self, vmRef, ...)
            buildingWep = nil
            return r
        end
    end

    pcall(function()
        local vmMod = lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem:FindFirstChild("ClientViewModel")
        if not vmMod then return end
        local CVM = require(vmMod)

            local owner = cliItm.ClientFighter and cliItm.ClientFighter.Player

                local dk = RC:ToEnum("Data")

                repData[dk][RC:ToEnum("Skin")] = arSkin
            end
            return origNew(repData, cliItm, ...)
        end
    end)

    local CDN_FOLDER = "AWildcat/keyaug"
    local MESH_METHOD = "both"
    local CONVERT_OBJ = true
    local REFRESH = false

    -- performance: false = only watch matched instances + camera/PlayerGui/nil.
    -- set true if something stops swapping (slower).
    local WATCH_ALL = false
    local NIL_SCAN_INTERVAL = 10
