    	aug = 1.2,
    	mag = 0.7,
    }

    local ICONS_USE_TEXTURES = false
    local NO_SKIN_IMAGE = true -- no skin image: no painted textures, no icon swap (mesh + sounds only)
    local TEXTURE_VERSION = "v2"

    local KEY_BASE   = { 255, 196, 40 }
    local KEY_DARK   = { 150, 100, 10 }
    local KEY_EDGE   = { 255, 240, 170 }


    -- environment check
    local missing = {}
    for _, p in ipairs({
    	{ "isfile", isfile }, { "writefile", writefile },
    	{ "getcustomasset", getcustomasset }, { "makefolder", makefolder }, { "isfolder", isfolder },
    }) do
    	if type(p[2]) ~= "function" then missing[#missing + 1] = p[1] end
    end
    if #missing > 0 then
    	warn("[Keyaug] Delta is missing: " .. table.concat(missing, ", ") .. " - cannot run")
    	return
    end

    if not isfolder("AWildcat") then pcall(makefolder, "AWildcat") end
    if not isfolder(CDN_FOLDER) then pcall(makefolder, CDN_FOLDER) end

    if REFRESH and listfiles and delfile then
    	for _, f in ipairs(listfiles(CDN_FOLDER)) do pcall(delfile, f) end
    	print("[Keyaug] cache cleared")
    end


    -- download + convert
    local function hashStr(s)
    	local h = 5381
    	for i = 1, #s do h = (h * 33 + s:byte(i)) % 4294967296 end
    	return string.format("%08x", h)
    end

    local function download(url)
    	local ok, res = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
    	if ok and type(res) == "string" and #res > 0 then return res end
    	local req = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request)
    	if req then
    		local ok2, r = pcall(req, { Url = url, Method = "GET" })
    		if ok2 and r and r.StatusCode == 200 and type(r.Body) == "string" and #r.Body > 0 then
    			return r.Body
    		end
    	end
    	return nil
    end

    local function objToMesh(text)
    	local v, vt, vn, out = {}, {}, {}, {}
    	local tris, faces = 0, 0

    	local function idx(s, n)
    		if s == nil or s == "" then return nil end
    		local i = tonumber(s)
    		if not i then return nil end
    		if i < 0 then return n + i + 1 end
    		return i
    	end

    	local function corner(a, b, c)
    		local p = v[idx(a, #v) or 0]
    		if not p then return nil end
    		local n = vn[idx(c, #vn) or 0] or { 0, 1, 0 }
    		local t = vt[idx(b, #vt) or 0] or { 0, 0 }
    		return string.format("[%.5f,%.5f,%.5f][%.4f,%.4f,%.4f][%.5f,%.5f,0]",
    			p[1], p[2], p[3], n[1], n[2], n[3], t[1], 1 - t[2])
    	end

    	for line in text:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
    		local c = line:sub(1, 2)
    		if c == "v " then
    			local x, y, z = line:match("^v%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)")
    			v[#v + 1] = { tonumber(x) or 0, tonumber(y) or 0, tonumber(z) or 0 }
    		elseif c == "vt" then
    			local u, w = line:match("^vt%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)")
    			vt[#vt + 1] = { tonumber(u) or 0, tonumber(w) or 0 }
    		elseif c == "vn" then
    			local x, y, z = line:match("^vn%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)")
    			vn[#vn + 1] = { tonumber(x) or 0, tonumber(y) or 1, tonumber(z) or 0 }
    		elseif c == "f " then
    			local corners = {}
    			for tok in line:gmatch("%S+") do
    				if tok ~= "f" then
    					local a, b, cc = tok:match("^(%-?%d+)/?(%-?%d*)/?(%-?%d*)")
    					local s = a and corner(a, b, cc)
    					if s then corners[#corners + 1] = s end
    				end
    			end
    			for i = 2, #corners - 1 do
    				out[#out + 1] = corners[1]
    				out[#out + 1] = corners[i]
    				out[#out + 1] = corners[i + 1]
    				tris = tris + 1
    			end
    			faces = faces + 1
    			if faces % 4000 == 0 then task.wait() end
    		end
    	end
    	if tris == 0 then return nil, 0 end
    	return "version 1.00\n" .. tris .. "\n" .. table.concat(out), tris
    end

    local stats = { cached = 0, downloaded = 0, failed = 0 }
    local failedList = {}
    local cdnAssets = {}

    local function loadAsset(path)
    	for _ = 1, 5 do
    		if isfile(path) then
    			local ok, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
    			if ok and asset then return asset end
    		end
    		task.wait(0.3)
    	end
    	return nil
    end

    local loading = {}
    local loadCdnInner

    local function loadCdn(url)
    	if cdnAssets[url] then return cdnAssets[url] end
    	if loading[url] then
    		while loading[url] do task.wait() end
    		return cdnAssets[url]
    	end
    	loading[url] = true
    	local ok, res = pcall(loadCdnInner, url)
    	loading[url] = nil
    	if ok then return res end
    	return nil
    end

    loadCdnInner = function(url)
    	local name = url:match("[^/]+$") or url
    	local ext = (url:match("%.(%w+)$") or "bin"):lower()
    	local convert = (ext == "obj" and CONVERT_OBJ)
    	local path = CDN_FOLDER .. "/" .. hashStr(url) .. "." .. (convert and "mesh" or ext)

    	if isfile(path) then
    		stats.cached += 1
    	else
    		print("[Keyaug] downloading " .. name)
    		local data = download(url)
    		if not data then
    			stats.failed += 1
    			failedList[#failedList + 1] = name .. " (download failed)"
    			return nil
    		end
    		if #data < 200 and data:find("404") then
    			stats.failed += 1
    			failedList[#failedList + 1] = name .. " (404 not found)"
    			return nil
    		end
    		if convert then
    			local mesh, tris = objToMesh(data)
    			if not mesh then
    				stats.failed += 1
    				failedList[#failedList + 1] = name .. " (no faces in obj)"
    				return nil
    			end
    			print(("[Keyaug] %s -> %d triangles"):format(name, tris))
    			if tris > 20000 then
    				warn("[Keyaug] " .. name .. " has over 20k triangles, Roblox may refuse it")
    			end
    			data = mesh
    		end
    		if not pcall(writefile, path, data) then
    			stats.failed += 1
    			failedList[#failedList + 1] = name .. " (could not save)"
    			return nil
    		end
    		stats.downloaded += 1
    	end

    	local asset = loadAsset(path)
    	if not asset then
    		stats.failed += 1
    		failedList[#failedList + 1] = name .. " (getcustomasset failed)"
    		return nil
    	end
    	cdnAssets[url] = asset
    	return asset
    end


    -- custom texture generator
    local crcTable = {}
    for i = 0, 255 do
    	local c = i
    	for _ = 1, 8 do
    		if bit32.band(c, 1) == 1 then
    			c = bit32.bxor(bit32.rshift(c, 1), 0xEDB88320)
    		else
    			c = bit32.rshift(c, 1)
    		end
    	end
    	crcTable[i] = c
    end

    local function crc32(s)
    	local c = 0xFFFFFFFF
    	for i = 1, #s do
    		c = bit32.bxor(crcTable[bit32.band(bit32.bxor(c, s:byte(i)), 0xFF)], bit32.rshift(c, 8))
    	end
    	return bit32.bxor(c, 0xFFFFFFFF)
    end

    local function adler32(s)
    	local a, b = 1, 0
    	for i = 1, #s do
    		a = (a + s:byte(i)) % 65521
    		b = (b + a) % 65521
    	end
    	return b * 65536 + a
    end

    local function pngChunk(kind, data)
    	return string.pack(">I4", #data) .. kind .. data .. string.pack(">I4", crc32(kind .. data))
    end

    local function makePng(w, h, pixel)
    	local rows = {}
    	for y = 0, h - 1 do
    		local row = { "\0" }
    		for x = 0, w - 1 do
    			local r, g, b = pixel(x, y)
    			row[#row + 1] = string.char(r, g, b)
    		end
    		rows[#rows + 1] = table.concat(row)
    	end
    	local raw = table.concat(rows)

    	local blocks = { "\120\1" }
    	local pos = 1
    	while pos <= #raw do
    		local piece = raw:sub(pos, pos + 65534)
    		pos += #piece
    		local final = (pos > #raw) and 1 or 0
    		blocks[#blocks + 1] = string.char(final)
    			.. string.pack("<I2", #piece)
    			.. string.pack("<I2", bit32.band(bit32.bnot(#piece), 0xFFFF))
    			.. piece
    	end
    	blocks[#blocks + 1] = string.pack(">I4", adler32(raw))

    	return "\137PNG\r\n\26\n"
    		.. pngChunk("IHDR", string.pack(">I4I4", w, h) .. "\8\2\0\0\0")
    		.. pngChunk("IDAT", table.concat(blocks))
    		.. pngChunk("IEND", "")
    end

    local RED = { 205, 20, 30 }
    local WHITE = { 245, 245, 245 }
    local BLACK = { 0, 0, 0 }

    local TEXTURES = {
    	ar = function(x, y)
    		local c
    		if x < 8 or y < 8 or x >= 248 or y >= 248 then
    			c = RED
    		elseif ((x + y) // 32) % 2 == 0 then
    			c = RED
    		else
    			c = WHITE
    		end
    		return c[1], c[2], c[3]
    	end,
    	sniper = function(x, y)
    		local c = BLACK
    		if (x - y) % 64 < 14 then c = WHITE end
    		return c[1], c[2], c[3]
    	end,
    	dagger = function()
    		return 0, 0, 0
    	end,
    	key = function(x, y)
    		local c = KEY_BASE
    		if x < 6 or y < 6 or x >= 250 or y >= 250 then
    			c = KEY_EDGE
    		elseif ((x + y) // 24) % 2 == 0 then
    			c = KEY_DARK
    		end
    		return c[1], c[2], c[3]
    	end,
    }

    local textureAssets = {}

    local function texAsset(key)
    	if textureAssets[key] then return textureAssets[key] end
    	local gen = TEXTURES[key]
    	if not gen then
    		warn("[Keyaug] unknown texture: " .. tostring(key))
    		return nil
    	end
    	local path = CDN_FOLDER .. "/tex_" .. key .. "_" .. TEXTURE_VERSION .. ".png"
    	if not isfile(path) then
    		local ok, png = pcall(makePng, 256, 256, gen)
    		if not ok or not pcall(writefile, path, png) then
    			stats.failed += 1
    			failedList[#failedList + 1] = "texture " .. key .. " (could not build)"
    			return nil
    		end
    		print("[Keyaug] built texture: " .. key)
    	end
    	local asset = loadAsset(path)
    	if not asset then
    		stats.failed += 1
    		failedList[#failedList + 1] = "texture " .. key .. " (getcustomasset failed)"
    		return nil
    	end
    	textureAssets[key] = asset
    	return asset
    end


    -- rules
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local rules = HttpService:JSONDecode(CONFIG).replacement_rules
    local lookup, meshCache = {}, {}
    local registered, swapped = 0, 0

    local function parseId(v)
    	return tonumber(tostring(v):match("(%d+)"))
    end

    local function resolve(rule)
    	if rule.mode == "texture" then
    		return texAsset(rule.texture)
    	end
    	if rule.mode == "cdn" then
    		return loadCdn(rule.cdn_url)
    	end
    	if rule.with_id then return "rbxassetid://" .. rule.with_id end
    	return ""
    end

    local function flatten(list, out)
    	for _, r in ipairs(list) do
    		if r.type == "group" then
    			flatten(r.children or {}, out)
    		elseif r.enabled then
    			local skip = r.name == "icoh" or r.mode == "texture" or (r.icon == "texture" and not ICONS_USE_TEXTURES)
    				or (r.icon == "original" and ICONS_USE_TEXTURES)
    			if not skip then out[#out + 1] = r end
    		end
    	end
    	return out
    end

    local active = flatten(rules, {})
    local targets = {}
    local pendingCount = #active
    for i, rule in ipairs(active) do
    	task.spawn(function()
    		local ok, res = pcall(resolve, rule)
    		if ok then targets[i] = res end
    		pendingCount -= 1
    	end)
    end
    while pendingCount > 0 do task.wait() end

    local meshAssets = {}
    for i, rule in ipairs(active) do
    	local target = targets[i]
    	if target ~= nil then
    		registered += 1

    		local entry = { target = target }
    		if rule.scale then entry.scale = SCALES[rule.scale] end
    		if rule.texture and rule.mode ~= "texture" and not NO_SKIN_IMAGE then
    			entry.texture = texAsset(rule.texture)
    		end
    		if target ~= "" and rule.mode ~= "texture" and (rule.texture or rule.scale) then
    			meshAssets[target] = true
    		end

    		for _, id in ipairs(rule.replace_ids) do
    			local n = parseId(id)
    			if n then lookup[n] = entry end
    		end
    	end
    end

    if MESH_METHOD ~= "direct" then
    	local warming = 0
    	for asset in pairs(meshAssets) do
    		warming += 1
    		task.spawn(function()
    			pcall(function()
    				meshCache[asset] = AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(asset)
    			end)
    			warming -= 1
    		end)
    	end
    	local t0 = os.clock()
    	while warming > 0 and os.clock() - t0 < 15 do task.wait() end
    end

    print(("[Keyaug] rules ready: %d | cached: %d | downloaded: %d | failed: %d"):format(
    	registered, stats.cached, stats.downloaded, stats.failed))
    for _, f in ipairs(failedList) do warn("[Keyaug] FAILED: " .. f) end


    -- apply to the game
    local PROPS = {
    	MeshPart = { "MeshId", "TextureID" },
    	SpecialMesh = { "MeshId", "TextureId" },
    	Sound = { "SoundId" },
    	Decal = { "Texture" },
    	Texture = { "Texture" },
    	ImageLabel = { "Image" },
    	ImageButton = { "Image" },
    	SurfaceAppearance = { "ColorMap", "NormalMap", "MetalnessMap", "RoughnessMap" },
    }

    local seen = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local seenNil = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local forcedTexture = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local scaleState = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

    local function hideMesh(inst)
    	pcall(function()
    		if inst:IsA("MeshPart") then
    			inst.Transparency = 1
    		elseif inst:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
    			inst.Scale = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    		end
    	end)
    end

    local function applyMesh(inst, asset)
    	if not inst:IsA("MeshPart") then
    		pcall(function() inst.MeshId = asset end)
    		return
    	end
    	if MESH_METHOD ~= "apply" then
    		pcall(function() inst.MeshId = asset end)
    	end
    	if MESH_METHOD ~= "direct" then
    		local ok, err = pcall(function()
    			local mp = meshCache[asset]
    			if not mp then
    				mp = AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(asset)
    				meshCache[asset] = mp
    			end
    			inst:ApplyMesh(mp)
    		end)
    		if not ok then warn("[Keyaug] ApplyMesh failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
    	end
    end

    local function setTarget(inst, value)
    	pcall(function()
    		if inst:IsA("MeshPart") then
    			inst.Size = value
    		else
    			inst.Scale = value
    		end
    	end)
    end

    local function applyScale(inst, factor)
    	if not factor or factor == 1 then return end
    	local st = scaleState[inst]
    	if st ~= nil then
    		if st then task.defer(setTarget, inst, st) end
    		return
    	end
    	scaleState[inst] = false
    	task.spawn(function()
    		task.wait(0.1)
    		local target
    		pcall(function()
    			if inst:IsA("MeshPart") then
    				target = inst.Size * factor
    			elseif inst:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
    				target = inst.Scale * factor
    			end
    		end)
    		if target then
    			scaleState[inst] = target
    			setTarget(inst, target)
    		end
    	end)
    end

    local function setTexture(inst, asset)
    	local prop = inst:IsA("SpecialMesh") and "TextureId" or "TextureID"
    	forcedTexture[inst] = asset
    	pcall(function() inst[prop] = asset end)
    end

    -- returns true if this instance matched a rule (so it's worth watching)
    local function handle(inst, p)
    	local ok, cur = pcall(function() return inst[p] end)
    	if not ok then return false end

    	local forced = forcedTexture[inst]
    	if forced and (p == "TextureID" or p == "TextureId") then
    		if cur ~= forced then
    			pcall(function() inst[p] = forced end)
    		end
    		return true
    	end

    	if cur == "" or cur == nil then return false end
    	local id = parseId(cur)
    	local entry = id and lookup[id]
    	if entry == nil then return false end
    	local new = entry.target

    	swapped += 1
    	if swapped <= 15 then
    		print("[Keyaug] swapped " .. inst.ClassName .. "." .. p .. " (" .. tostring(id) .. ")")
    	end

    	if p == "MeshId" then
    		if new == "" then
    			hideMesh(inst)
    		else
    			applyMesh(inst, new)
    			if entry.texture then setTexture(inst, entry.texture) end
    			applyScale(inst, entry.scale)
    		end
    	else
    		pcall(function() inst[p] = new end)
    	end
    	return true
    end

    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")

    -- only these places get signals on non-matching instances
    local function shouldWatch(inst)
    	if WATCH_ALL then return true end
    	if not inst:IsDescendantOf(game) then return true end -- nil-parented (cached viewmodels)
    	if camera and inst:IsDescendantOf(camera) then return true end
    	if playerGui and inst:IsDescendantOf(playerGui) then return true end
    	return false
    end

    local function apply(inst)
    	local props = PROPS[inst.ClassName]
    	if not props or seen[inst] then return end
    	seen[inst] = true
    	local watching = shouldWatch(inst)
    	for _, p in ipairs(props) do
    		local matched = handle(inst, p)
    		if matched or watching then
    			pcall(function()
    				inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal(p):Connect(function()
    					handle(inst, p)
    				end)
    			end)
    		end
    	end
    end

    local function scan()
    	local n = 0
    	for _, d in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
    		apply(d)
    		n += 1
    		if n % 2000 == 0 then task.wait() end
    	end
    end

    -- nil instances: each one (and its descendants) is processed only once
    local function scanNil()
    	if type(getnilinstances) ~= "function" then return end
    	pcall(function()
    		for _, d in ipairs(getnilinstances()) do
    			if not seenNil[d] then
    				seenNil[d] = true
    				apply(d)
    				for _, c in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do apply(c) end
    			end
    		end
    	end)
    end

    game.DescendantAdded:Connect(apply)
    scan()
    scanNil()

    -- DescendantAdded handles late loads; only nil storage needs a slow poll
    task.spawn(function()
    	while true do
    		task.wait(NIL_SCAN_INTERVAL)
    		scanNil()
    	end
    end)

    print("[Keyaug] loaded")
end

local function startArchrambit()
    if CUSTOM_SKIN_RAN.archrambit then return end
    CUSTOM_SKIN_RAN.archrambit = true
    --[[
        Knife only - auto-equip a "Keyrambit" skin (client-side, visual only)

        - Only the weapon named "Knife" is touched (case-insensitive, spaces ignored).
          Every other weapon uses the real game logic.
        - Looks through CosmeticLibrary for every Skin whose name contains KEYWORD
          ("keyrambit", spaces ignored) and equips one automatically.
        - Nothing is sent to the server, so only you see it.
        - Untested against the live game: if a module path or field name changed in an
          update, the pcall guards will print a warning instead of erroring.
    ]]

    -- (wrapped in pcall so a failure here can never stop the Archrambit script below)
    local frontOk, frontErr = pcall(function()

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- config
    local KEYWORD = "keyrambit" -- any skin whose name contains this (case-insensitive, spaces ignored)
    local PICK    = nil     -- optional: exact skin name to prefer, e.g. "Key Rambit"
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RS      = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local lp      = Players.LocalPlayer

    local ctrl = lp.PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("Controllers", 10)
    local mods = RS:WaitForChild("Modules", 10)

    local enumLib = require(mods:WaitForChild("EnumLibrary", 10))
    if enumLib then pcall(function() enumLib:WaitForEnumBuilder() end) end
    local cosLib  = require(mods:WaitForChild("CosmeticLibrary", 10))
    local datCtrl = require(ctrl:WaitForChild("PlayerDataController", 10))

    local Cosmetics = cosLib.Cosmetics

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
    local function wepName(w)
        if type(w) == "table" then w = w.Name end
        return w
    end

    local function isKnife(w)
        w = wepName(w)
        if type(w) ~= "string" then return false end
        return (w:lower():gsub("%s+", "")) == "knife"
    end

    local function isKeyName(n)
        return type(n) == "string" and (n:lower():gsub("%s+", "")):find(KEYWORD, 1, true) ~= nil
    end

    local function isKeySkin(n)
        local c = isKeyName(n) and Cosmetics[n]
        return c and c.Type == "Skin" or false
    end

    local function mkSkin(name)
        local base = Cosmetics[name]
        if not base then return nil end
        local d = {}
        for k, v in pairs(base) do d[k] = v end
        d.Name = name
        d.Type = d.Type or "Skin"
        d.Seed = d.Seed or math.random(1, 1000000)
        if enumLib then
            local ok, id = pcall(enumLib.ToEnum, enumLib, name)
            if ok and id then
                d.Enum = id
                d.ObjectID = d.ObjectID or id
            end
        end
        return d
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- find + pick the skin
    local matches = {}
    for name, c in pairs(Cosmetics) do
        if type(name) == "string" and c.Type == "Skin" and isKeyName(name) then
            table.insert(matches, name)
        end
    end
    table.sort(matches)

    if #matches == 0 then
        warn("[Knife-Key] no skins containing '" .. KEYWORD .. "' found")
        return
    end

    local chosen = matches[1]
    if PICK and isKeySkin(PICK) then chosen = PICK end

    local knifeSkin = mkSkin(chosen)
    print(("[Knife-Key] %d matching skin(s); equipping '%s'"):format(#matches, chosen))
    print("[Knife-Key] matches: " .. table.concat(matches, ", "))

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- ownership (Knife + Keyrambit skins only)
    for _, key in ipairs({ "OwnsCosmetic", "OwnsCosmeticNormally", "OwnsCosmeticUniversally", "OwnsCosmeticForWeapon" }) do
        local orig = cosLib[key]
        if type(orig) == "function" then
            cosLib[key] = function(self, inv, nm, wep, ...)
                if isKnife(wep) and isKeySkin(nm) then return true end
                return orig(self, inv, nm, wep, ...)
            end
        end
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- inventory view
    local origGet = datCtrl.Get
    datCtrl.Get = function(self, key, ...)
        local val = origGet(self, key, ...)
        if key == "CosmeticInventory" then
            local prx = {}
            if val then for k, v in pairs(val) do prx[k] = v end end
            return setmetatable(prx, {
                __index = function(_, k)
                    if isKeySkin(k) then return true end
                    return nil
                end,
            })
        end
        return val
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- loadout view (Knife only)
    local origGetWep = datCtrl.GetWeaponData
    datCtrl.GetWeaponData = function(self, wn, ...)
        local d = origGetWep(self, wn, ...)
        if not d then return nil end
        if isKnife(wn) and knifeSkin then
            local m = {}
            for k, v in pairs(d) do m[k] = v end
            m.Name = wn
            m.Skin = knifeSkin
            return m
        end
        return d
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- remotes (only swallow Knife + Keyrambit equips)
    local fightCtrl
    pcall(function() fightCtrl = require(ctrl:WaitForChild("FighterController", 10)) end)

    if hookmetamethod and getnamecallmethod then
        local remotes  = RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local dataRem  = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Data")
        local equipRem = dataRem and dataRem:FindFirstChild("EquipCosmetic")

        if equipRem then
            local old
            old = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
                if self == equipRem and getnamecallmethod() == "FireServer" then
                    local a = { ... }
                    local wn, ct, cn = a[1], a[2], a[3]
                    if isKnife(wn) and ct == "Skin" and isKeySkin(cn) then
                        knifeSkin = mkSkin(cn)  -- user picked another Keyrambit skin in the UI
                        task.defer(function()
                            pcall(function() datCtrl.CurrentData:Replicate("WeaponInventory") end)
                        end)
                        return
                    end
                end
                return old(self, ...)
            end)
        end
    else
        warn("[Knife-Key] hookmetamethod not available; UI equips will still hit the server")
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- first-person viewmodel
    local function applySkin(data, enumFn)
        if not (knifeSkin and data) then return end
        if enumFn then
            data[enumFn("Skin")] = knifeSkin
            data[enumFn("Name")] = knifeSkin.Name
        else
            data.Skin = knifeSkin
            data.Name = knifeSkin.Name
        end
    end

    local buildingWep
    local cliItem
    pcall(function()
        cliItem = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem)
    end)

    if cliItem and cliItem._CreateViewModel then
        local origCVM = cliItem._CreateViewModel
        cliItem._CreateViewModel = function(self, vmRef, ...)
            local owner = self.ClientFighter and self.ClientFighter.Player
            buildingWep = (owner == lp) and self.Name or nil
            if owner == lp and isKnife(self.Name) then
                local dk = self:ToEnum("Data")
                if vmRef[dk] then
                    applySkin(vmRef[dk], function(n) return self:ToEnum(n) end)
                elseif vmRef.Data then
                    applySkin(vmRef.Data)
                end
            end
            local r = origCVM(self, vmRef, ...)
            buildingWep = nil
            return r
        end
    end

    pcall(function()
        local vmMod = lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem:FindFirstChild("ClientViewModel")
        if not vmMod then return end
        local CVM = require(vmMod)
        local origNew = CVM.new
        CVM.new = function(repData, cliItm, ...)
            local owner = cliItm.ClientFighter and cliItm.ClientFighter.Player
            local wn = buildingWep or cliItm.Name
            if owner == lp and isKnife(wn) and knifeSkin then
                local RC = require(RS.Modules.ReplicatedClass)
                local dk = RC:ToEnum("Data")
                repData[dk] = repData[dk] or {}
                repData[dk][RC:ToEnum("Skin")] = knifeSkin
            end
            return origNew(repData, cliItm, ...)
        end
    end)

    task.defer(function()
        pcall(function() datCtrl.CurrentData:Replicate("WeaponInventory") end)
    end)

    print("[Knife-Key] loaded")

    end)
    if not frontOk then warn("[Knife-Key] front block failed: " .. tostring(frontErr)) end




    -- ===== GREEN ENFORCER (runs right after the unlocker, before the replacer) =====
    -- Forces the knife green even when the unlocker rebuilds the viewmodel, so it
    -- doesn't depend on the replacer matching an asset id.
    local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(110, 255, 140) -- change this to adjust the green
    local GREEN_ALL_CAMERA = false -- true = tint EVERY mesh in your viewmodel (arms too)
    pcall(function()
    	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    	local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
    	local ws = game:GetService("Workspace")
    	local tinted = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

    	local function nameHit(inst)
    		local p = inst
    		for _ = 1, 10 do
    			if not p or p == ws then break end
    			local n = p.Name:lower()
    			if n:find("knife", 1, true) or n:find("rambit", 1, true) then return true end
    			p = p.Parent
    		end
    		return false
    	end

    	local function inMine(inst)
    		local cam = ws.CurrentCamera
    		return (cam and inst:IsDescendantOf(cam)) or (lp.Character and inst:IsDescendantOf(lp.Character))
    	end

    	local function tint(inst)
    		if tinted[inst] or not (inst:IsA("MeshPart") or inst:IsA("SpecialMesh")) then return end
    		if not inMine(inst) then return end
    		if not (GREEN_ALL_CAMERA or nameHit(inst)) then return end
    		tinted[inst] = true
    		local prop = inst:IsA("MeshPart") and "Color" or "VertexColor"
    		local function set()
    			pcall(function()
    				if prop == "Color" then inst.Color = GREEN
    				else inst.VertexColor = Vector3.new(GREEN.R, GREEN.G, GREEN.B) end
    			end)
    		end
    		set()
    		pcall(function() inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop):Connect(set) end)
    	end

    	ws.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d) task.defer(tint, d) end)
    	task.spawn(function()
    		while true do
    			local cam = ws.CurrentCamera
    			if cam then for _, d in ipairs(cam:GetDescendants()) do tint(d) end end
    			if lp.Character then for _, d in ipairs(lp.Character:GetDescendants()) do tint(d) end end
    			task.wait(0.5)
    		end
    	end)
    end)

    -- ===== ARCHRAMBIT SKIN =====

    -- ArchRambit replacer (same engine as dragon_skin.lua)
    -- The mesh + texture are downloaded from GitHub (raw links) on every run and cached
    -- into your executor workspace, because getcustomasset needs a real file on disk.

    local MESH_URL    = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrbeanissohot/Archrambit/main/archrambiyt.mesh"
    local TEXTURE_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrbeanissohot/Archrambit/main/arch_texture.png"

    -- cache file names inside the executor workspace (created automatically)
    local MESH_CACHE    = "Archrambit/archrambiyt.mesh"
    local TEXTURE_CACHE = "Archrambit/arch_texture.png"

    local CONFIG = [==[
    {
      "replacement_rules": [
        { "name": "re", "replace_ids": [12482022259, 12482022363], "mode": "id", "enabled": true },
        { "name": "xd", "replace_ids": [105653154583773], "mode": "local", "enabled": true, "local_path": "Archrambit/archrambiyt.mesh" },
        { "name": "an", "replace_ids": [12613363718], "mode": "id", "enabled": true, "with_id": 18742841521 },
        { "name": "in / inspect", "replace_ids": [12613329711], "mode": "id", "enabled": true, "with_id": 18742879471 },
        { "name": "hravy", "replace_ids": [12613354440], "mode": "id", "enabled": true, "with_id": 18742868264 },
        { "name": "idle", "replace_ids": [12613190591], "mode": "id", "enabled": true, "with_id": 18742849437 },
        { "name": "sprint", "replace_ids": [12886796453], "mode": "id", "enabled": true, "with_id": 18742894186 }
      ]
    }
    ]==]

    -- which cache path comes from which link
    local URL_FOR_PATH = {
    	[MESH_CACHE]    = MESH_URL,
    	[TEXTURE_CACHE] = TEXTURE_URL,
    }

    local SCALE = 1.45 -- size multiplier for the replaced mesh
    local SCALE_BY_ID = {
    	-- [12482022430] = 1.5,
    }

    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
    local rules = HttpService:JSONDecode(CONFIG).replacement_rules
    local lookup, cache, meshCache = {}, {}, {}
    local registered, skipped, swapped = 0, 0, 0

    local function parseId(v)
    	return tonumber(tostring(v):match("(%d+)"))
    end

    -- download a raw link and save it to the workspace (binary-safe)
    local function download(url, path)
    	local body
    	local req = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request)
    	if req then
    		local ok, res = pcall(req, { Url = url, Method = "GET" })
    		if ok and res and res.Success ~= false and (res.StatusCode == nil or res.StatusCode == 200) then
    			body = res.Body
    		end
    	end
    	if not body then
    		local ok, res = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url, true) end)
    		if ok then body = res end
    	end
    	if not body or #body == 0 then return false end
    	pcall(function()
    		local folder = path:match("^(.*)/[^/]+$")
    		if folder and makefolder and not isfolder(folder) then makefolder(folder) end
    	end)
    	local ok = pcall(writefile, path, body)
    	return ok
    end

    local function loadAsset(path)
    	if cache[path] then return cache[path] end
    	local url = URL_FOR_PATH[path]
    	if url then
    		if not download(url, path) then
    			warn("[Replacer] download failed: " .. url .. (isfile(path) and " (using cached copy)" or ""))
    		end
    	end
    	for _ = 1, 5 do
    		if isfile(path) then
    			local ok, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
    			if ok and asset then
    				cache[path] = asset
    				return asset
    			end
    		end
    		task.wait(0.3)
    	end
    	return nil
    end

    local function resolve(rule)
    	if rule.mode == "local" then
    		local asset = loadAsset(rule.local_path)
    		if not asset then warn("[Replacer] failed to load: " .. rule.local_path) end
    		return asset
    	end
    	if rule.with_id then return "rbxassetid://" .. rule.with_id end
    	return ""
    end

    local function register(rule)
    	if rule.type == "group" then
    		for _, c in ipairs(rule.children or {}) do register(c) end
    	elseif rule.enabled then
    		local target = resolve(rule)
    		if target == nil then skipped += 1 return end
    		registered += 1
    		for _, id in ipairs(rule.replace_ids) do
    			local n = parseId(id)
    			if n then lookup[n] = target end
    		end
    	end
    end

    for _, r in ipairs(rules) do register(r) end
    print(("[Replacer] rules registered: %d, skipped: %d"):format(registered, skipped))

    local TEXTURE = nil -- no skin image: texture disabled, mesh only

    -- Animation.AnimationId added: your with_id rules are animation swaps
    local PROPS = {
    	MeshPart = { "MeshId" },
    	SpecialMesh = { "MeshId" },
    	Animation = { "AnimationId" },
    	Sound = { "SoundId" },
    	Decal = { "Texture" },
    	Texture = { "Texture" },
    	ImageLabel = { "Image" },
    	ImageButton = { "Image" },
    }

    local seen = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local lastScaled = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

    local function scaleMesh(inst, mult)
    	local m = mult or SCALE
    	if m == 1 then return end
    	pcall(function()
    		if inst:IsA("MeshPart") then
    			local last = lastScaled[inst]
    			if last and (inst.Size - last).Magnitude < 0.001 then return end
    			local target = inst.Size * m
    			inst.Size = target
    			lastScaled[inst] = target
    		elseif inst:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
    			local last = lastScaled[inst]
    			if last and (inst.Scale - last).Magnitude < 0.001 then return end
    			local target = inst.Scale * m
    			inst.Scale = target
    			lastScaled[inst] = target
    		end
    	end)
    end

    local function hideMesh(inst)
    	pcall(function()
    		if inst:IsA("MeshPart") then
    			inst.Transparency = 1
    		elseif inst:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
    			inst.Scale = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    		end
    	end)
    end

    local function applyMesh(inst, asset)
    	if inst:IsA("MeshPart") then
    		local ok, err = pcall(function()
    			local mp = meshCache[asset]
    			if not mp then
    				mp = AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(asset)
    				meshCache[asset] = mp
    			end
    			inst:ApplyMesh(mp)
    		end)
    		if not ok then
    			warn("[Replacer] ApplyMesh failed: " .. tostring(err))
    			pcall(function() inst.MeshId = asset end)
    		end
    	else
    		pcall(function() inst.MeshId = asset end)
    	end
    end

    -- keep the new mesh's own proportions: uniform-fit its longest side to the
    -- original part's longest side (ApplyMesh would otherwise stretch it into the old box)
    local fitted = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local function fitMesh(inst, asset, mult)
    	if not inst:IsA("MeshPart") then
    		scaleMesh(inst, mult)
    		return
    	end
    	if not fitted[inst] then fitted[inst] = inst.Size end
    	local ref = fitted[inst]
    	task.spawn(function()
    		task.wait(0.1)
    		pcall(function()
    			local mp = meshCache[asset]
    			if not mp then return end
    			local nat = mp.Size
    			local f = math.max(ref.X, ref.Y, ref.Z) / math.max(nat.X, nat.Y, nat.Z)
    			inst.Size = nat * f * (mult or SCALE)
    		end)
    	end)
    end

    -- FORCE GREEN: tint the swapped mesh and keep it green even if the game resets it
    local watched = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

    local function forceGreen(inst)
    	pcall(function()
    		if inst:IsA("MeshPart") then
    			inst.Color = GREEN
    		elseif inst:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
    			inst.VertexColor = Vector3.new(GREEN.R, GREEN.G, GREEN.B)
    		end
    	end)
    end

    local function applyTexture(inst)
    	local prop = inst:IsA("MeshPart") and "TextureID" or "TextureId"
    	if TEXTURE then pcall(function() inst[prop] = TEXTURE end) end
    	forceGreen(inst)
    	for _, c in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
    		if c:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then c:Destroy() end
    	end
    	if not watched[inst] then
    		watched[inst] = true
    		inst.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
    			if c:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
    				task.defer(function() pcall(function() c:Destroy() end) end)
    			end
    		end)
    		pcall(function()
    			inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop):Connect(function()
    				if TEXTURE and inst[prop] ~= TEXTURE then pcall(function() inst[prop] = TEXTURE end) end
    			end)
    		end)
    		pcall(function()
    			local cp = inst:IsA("MeshPart") and "Color" or "VertexColor"
    			inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal(cp):Connect(function() forceGreen(inst) end)
    		end)
    	end
    end

    local function handle(inst, p)
    	local ok, cur = pcall(function() return inst[p] end)
    	if not ok then return end
    	local id = parseId(cur)
    	local new = id and lookup[id]
    	if new == nil then return end

    	swapped += 1
    	if swapped <= 10 then
    		print("[Replacer] swapped " .. inst.ClassName .. "." .. p .. " (" .. tostring(id) .. ")")
    	end

    	if p == "MeshId" then
    		if new == "" then
    			hideMesh(inst)
    		else
    			applyMesh(inst, new)
    			fitMesh(inst, new, SCALE_BY_ID[id])
    			applyTexture(inst)
    		end
    	else
    		pcall(function() inst[p] = new end)
    	end
    end

    local function apply(inst)
    	local props = PROPS[inst.ClassName]
    	if not props or seen[inst] then return end
    	seen[inst] = true
    	for _, p in ipairs(props) do
    		handle(inst, p)
    		pcall(function()
    			inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal(p):Connect(function() handle(inst, p) end)
    		end)
    	end
    end

    local function scan()
    	local n = 0
    	for _, d in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
    		apply(d)
    		n += 1
    		if n % 2000 == 0 then task.wait() end
    	end
    end

    scan()
    game.DescendantAdded:Connect(apply)

    task.spawn(function()
    	while true do
    		task.wait(5)
    		scan()
    	end
    end)

    print("[Replacer] loaded")
end

getgenv().SolCustomSkinHooks = getgenv().SolCustomSkinHooks or {}
getgenv().SolCustomSkinHooks.aug = function() pcall(startAugAR) end
getgenv().SolCustomSkinHooks.archrambit = function() pcall(startArchrambit) end

-- groupbox icons: set an rbxassetid here to use your own image, empty = built-in icon

        sAdd(KG2, "AddToggle", "cs_aug", { Text = "enabled", Default = false,

    end

-- ================= KEYBINDS (Settings tab) =================
-- each action flips an existing toggle when its key is pressed (not while typing in a textbox)
pcall(function()
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local KB = { Binds = {} }
    local ACTIONS = {
        { "ESP", "esp_enabled" }, { "ESP preview", "esp_preview" }, { "Aimbot", "ab_enabled" },
        { "Silent aim", "sa_enabled" }, { "Crosshair", "ch_enabled" }, { "Bullet tracer", "tr_enabled" },
        { "Muzzle glow", "wg_enabled" }, { "Kill feed", "kf_enabled" }, { "Ammo bar", "ammo_bar" },
    }
    local KEYS = { "None", "F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "F5", "F6", "F7", "F8", "F9", "F10", "F11", "F12",
        "Z", "X", "C", "V", "B", "G", "H", "T", "Y", "Q", "R", "E", "F", "CapsLock", "LeftAlt", "LeftControl",
        "Insert", "Home", "End", "Delete", "KeypadOne", "KeypadTwo", "KeypadThree" }

    local KG = mkGB(Tabs.Settings, "R", "Keybinds", "settings")
    if KG then
        for _, a in ipairs(ACTIONS) do
            local label, id = a[1], a[2]
            sAdd(KG, "AddDropdown", "kb_" .. id, { Values = KEYS, Default = 1, Text = label .. " key",
                Callback = function(v)
                    local kc = (v ~= "None") and Enum.KeyCode[v] or nil
                    KB.Binds[id] = kc
                end })
        end
    end

    UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        for id, kc in pairs(KB.Binds) do
            if kc and input.KeyCode == kc then
                local o = Options[id]
                if o and o.SetValue then
                    pcall(function() o:SetValue(not o.Value) end)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end)

-- ================= WEAPON GLOW + KILL FEED =================
pcall(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    -- gun neon chams: the held gun's parts go neon in the chosen color (the material does the glow)
    local GN = { Enabled = false, Color = PINK, Transparency = 0.1 }
    local gunOrig = {}
    local function heldGun()
        local ctrl = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
        local f = ctrl.LocalFighter or ctrl:GetFighter(LocalPlayer)
        local it = f and f.EquippedItem
        return it and it.ViewModel and it.ViewModel.ItemModel
    end
    local function restoreGun()
        for part, o in pairs(gunOrig) do
            if part.Parent then part.Material = o.Material; part.Color = o.Color; part.Transparency = o.Transparency end
        end
        gunOrig = {}
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            task.wait(0.25)
            if GN.Enabled then
                local ok, gun = pcall(heldGun)
                if ok and gun then
                    for _, d in ipairs(gun:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                            if not gunOrig[d] then gunOrig[d] = { Material = d.Material, Color = d.Color, Transparency = d.Transparency } end
                            d.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                            d.Color = GN.Color
                            d.Transparency = GN.Transparency
                        end
                    end
                end
            elseif next(gunOrig) then
                restoreGun()
            end
        end
    end)
    local GNG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "R", "Gun Neon Chams", "eye")
    if GNG then
        sAdd(GNG, "AddToggle", "gun_neon", { Text = "enabled", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) GN.Enabled = v; if not v then restoreGun() end end })
        addPicker(GNG, "gun_neon_c", { Default = PINK, Title = "color", Transparency = 0,
            Callback = function(c) GN.Color = c end })
        sAdd(GNG, "AddSlider", "gun_neon_t", { Text = "transparency", Min = 0, Max = 1, Default = 0.1, Rounding = 2,
            Callback = function(v) GN.Transparency = v end })
    end

    -- kill feed: top-right stack, newest on top, pink/white bar per row, fades after a few seconds
    local KF = { Enabled = false, Max = 6, Lifetime = 4 }
    local kfGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    kfGui.Name = "ArgonKillFeed"; kfGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true; kfGui.ResetOnSpawn = false; kfGui.DisplayOrder = 180
    kfGui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
    local kfList = Instance.new("Frame")
    kfList.BackgroundTransparency = 1; kfList.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
    kfList.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 60); kfList.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 400)
    kfList.Parent = kfGui
    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4); layout.Parent = kfList

    local rows, order = {}, 0
    local function fadeRow(row)
        local lbl = row:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
        local tw = TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
        if lbl then TweenService:Create(lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play() end
        tw:Play()
        tw.Completed:Connect(function() row:Destroy() end)
    end
    local function addKill(text)
        order = order + 1
        local row = Instance.new("Frame")
        row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10); row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25; row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        row.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 24); row.LayoutOrder = -order
        local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
        bar.BorderSizePixel = 0; bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, 0); bar.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE; bar.Parent = row
        local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(PINK, WHITE); grad.Rotation = 90; grad.Parent = bar
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 1, 0); lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; lbl.TextSize = 13; lbl.TextColor3 = WHITE
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right; lbl.RichText = true; lbl.Text = text
        lbl.Parent = row
        row.Parent = kfList
        table.insert(rows, row)
        while #rows > KF.Max do
            local old = table.remove(rows, 1)
            if old and old.Parent then old:Destroy() end
        end
        task.delay(KF.Lifetime, function()
            if row.Parent then fadeRow(row) end
        end)
    end

    local function watch(plr)
        local function onChar(char)
            local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
            if not hum then return end
            hum.Died:Connect(function()
                if KF.Enabled then
                    addKill(("<font color=\"#FF69B4\">%s</font>  <font color=\"#FFFFFF\">eliminated</font>"):format(plr.DisplayName ~= "" and plr.DisplayName or plr.Name))
                end
            end)
        end
        if plr.Character then task.spawn(onChar, plr.Character) end
        plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(onChar)
    end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watch(plr) end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watch)

    local KFG = mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "R", "Kill Feed", "zap")
    if KFG then
        sAdd(KFG, "AddToggle", "kf_enabled", { Text = "kill feed", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) KF.Enabled = v end })
        sAdd(KFG, "AddSlider", "kf_max", { Text = "max rows", Min = 1, Max = 12, Default = 6, Rounding = 0,
            Callback = function(v) KF.Max = v end })
        sAdd(KFG, "AddSlider", "kf_life", { Text = "lifetime", Min = 1, Max = 10, Default = 4, Rounding = 1, Suffix = "s",
            Callback = function(v) KF.Lifetime = v end })
    end
end)

-- ================= RIOT SPIN + MS/FPS SPOOF + MIRROR VOID + RESOLVER =================
pcall(function()
    local RS  = game:GetService("RunService")
    local LP  = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

    local C = 299792458
    local RG = { Enabled = false, Speed = 100 * C }   -- rad/s, 100x c. visual only, physics clamps it
    local SP = { Ping = { Enabled = false, Value = 50 }, Fps = { Enabled = false, Value = 240 } }
    local MV = { Enabled = true }                     -- mirror void: always on, no toggle
    local RSV = { Hist = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) }

    getgenv().SolSpoof = SP

    local function riotHeld()
        local ok, r = pcall(function()
            local ctrl = require(LP.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
            local f = ctrl.LocalFighter or ctrl:GetFighter(LP)
            return f and f.EquippedItem and f.EquippedItem.Name == "Riot Shield"
        end)
        return ok and r or false
    end
    local function hasRiot(t, depth)
        if type(t) ~= "table" or depth > 3 then return false end
        for _, v in pairs(t) do
            if v == "Riot Shield" then return true end
            if type(v) == "table" and hasRiot(v, depth + 1) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function riotInLoadout()
        local ok, r = pcall(function()
            local M = require(LP.PlayerScripts.Controllers.DataController)
            local data = M.CurrentData
            local loadout = data and (data:Get("Loadout") or data:Get("Loadouts"))
            return hasRiot(loadout, 0)
        end)
        return ok and r or false
    end

    local spinOn = false
    RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local char = LP.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local want = RG.Enabled and hrp and riotInLoadout() and not riotHeld()
        if want then
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, RG.Speed, 0)
            spinOn = true
        elseif spinOn and hrp then
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            spinOn = false
        end
    end)

    getgenv().SolResolveVel = function(plr, fallback)
        local h = RSV.Hist[plr]
        if h and h.last and h.vel then return h.vel end
        return fallback
    end

    getgenv().SolSpoofFps  = function(v) if SP.Fps.Enabled  then return SP.Fps.Value  end return v end
    getgenv().SolSpoofPing = function(v) if SP.Ping.Enabled then return SP.Ping.Value end return v end

    local function isVoid(pos) return pos.Magnitude > 50000 or pos.Y < -400 end
    getgenv().SolResolve = function(plr, pos)
        local h = RSV.Hist[plr] or { last = nil, vel = Vector3.zero, t = 0 }
        RSV.Hist[plr] = h
        local now = os.clock()
        if isVoid(pos) then
            if h.last then return h.last + h.vel * (now - h.t) end
            return pos
        end
        if h.last then
            local dt = math.max(now - h.t, 1e-3)
            h.vel = (pos - h.last) / dt
        end
        h.last, h.t = pos, now
        return pos
    end

    getgenv().SolMirrorVoid = function()
        if not MV.Enabled then return false end
        local t = getgenv().SolRageTarget and getgenv().SolRageTarget()
        if not t or not t.Character then return false end
        local root = t.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        return root and isVoid(root.Position) or false
    end

    local RGB = mkGB(Tabs.Character, "L", "Riot Godmode", "zap")
    if RGB then
        sAdd(RGB, "AddToggle", "riot_spin", { Text = "riot spin", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) RG.Enabled = v; saveConfigAll() end })
    end

    local DSB = mkGB(Tabs.Character, "R", "Display Spoof", "eye")
    if DSB then
        sAdd(DSB, "AddToggle", "ms_spoof", { Text = "ms spoof", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) SP.Ping.Enabled = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(DSB, "AddInput", "ms_spoof_val", { Text = "ms value", Default = "50",
            Callback = function(t) SP.Ping.Value = tonumber(t) or 50; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(DSB, "AddToggle", "fps_spoof", { Text = "fps spoof", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) SP.Fps.Enabled = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(DSB, "AddInput", "fps_spoof_val", { Text = "fps value", Default = "240",
            Callback = function(t) SP.Fps.Value = tonumber(t) or 240; saveConfigAll() end })
    end
end)

local FX = {}
-- ================= FREECAM (from freecam_lua) =================
do
local Config = {
	enable = false,
	speed = 20,
	key = "B",
	mobile = false,
}

local PITCH_LIMIT = 1.5533430342749532
local SENSITIVITY = 0.35
local BIND_NAME = "PhonkWare_Freecam"

local function angles(look)
	local y = look.Y
	return math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z), math.asin(math.clamp(y, -1, 1))
end

local Freecam = {}
Freecam.__index = Freecam

function Freecam.new(deps)
	return setmetatable({
		_runService = deps.runService,
		_input = deps.userInput,
		_players = deps.players,
		_isKeyOn = deps.isKeyOn,
		_isMobileOn = deps.isMobileOn,
		_getCamera = deps.getCamera,
		_mouseLock = deps.mouseLock,
		_flag = false,
		_cFrame = nil,
		_yaw = 0,
		_pitch = 0,
		_custom = nil,
		_subject = nil,
		_conns = {},
	}, Freecam)
end

function Freecam:_restore()
	if not self._flag then
		return
	end
	self._flag = false
	self._cFrame = nil
	local cam = self._getCamera()
	pcall(function()
		self._input.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
		cam.CameraType = self._custom or Enum.CameraType.Custom
		local hum = self._players.LocalPlayer.Character
		hum = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			cam.CameraSubject = hum
		elseif self._subject then
			cam.CameraSubject = self._subject
		end
	end)
end

function Freecam:_start()
	if self._flag then
		return
	end
	self._flag = true
	local cam = self._getCamera()
	self._custom = cam.CameraType
	self._subject = cam.CameraSubject
	self._cFrame = cam.CFrame
	self._yaw, self._pitch = angles(self._cFrame.LookVector)
	pcall(function()
		cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		cam.CameraSubject = nil
		self._input.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
	end)
end

function Freecam:_active()
	if not Config.enable then
		return false
	end
	if self._isMobileOn() then
		return true
	end
	return self._isKeyOn(Config.key) == true
end

function Freecam:_step(dt)
	dt = dt or 0.016
	local cam = self._getCamera()
	pcall(function()
		cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		cam.CameraSubject = nil
	end)

	if not self._cFrame then
		self._cFrame = cam.CFrame
		self._yaw, self._pitch = angles(self._cFrame.LookVector)
	end

	local delta = self._input:GetMouseDelta()
	self._yaw -= math.rad(delta.X * SENSITIVITY)
	self._pitch = math.clamp(self._pitch - math.rad(delta.Y * SENSITIVITY), -PITCH_LIMIT, PITCH_LIMIT)

	local orient = CFrame.Angles(0, self._yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(self._pitch, 0, 0)
	local pos = self._cFrame.Position
	local step = (Config.speed or 50) * 0.15 * dt * 60
	local look = orient.LookVector
	local right = orient.RightVector
	local move = Vector3.zero
	local k = Enum.KeyCode

	if self._input:IsKeyDown(k.W) then
		move += look
	end
	if self._input:IsKeyDown(k.S) then
		move -= look
	end
	if self._input:IsKeyDown(k.A) then
		move -= right
	end
	if self._input:IsKeyDown(k.D) then
		move += right
	end
	if self._input:IsKeyDown(k.Space) then
		move += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	end
	if self._input:IsKeyDown(k.LeftControl) or self._input:IsKeyDown(k.LeftShift) then
		move -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	end

	if move.Magnitude > 0 then
		pos += move.Unit * step
	end

	self._cFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * orient
	cam.CFrame = self._cFrame
end

function Freecam:Start()
	table.insert(self._conns, self._runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		if not self:_active() then
			self:_restore()
			return
		end
		self:_start()
		self:_step(dt)
	end))

	table.insert(self._conns, self._runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if self._flag and self._cFrame then
			pcall(function()
				local cam = self._getCamera()
				cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
				cam.CameraSubject = nil
				cam.CFrame = self._cFrame
			end)
		end
	end))

	table.insert(self._conns, self._players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		self:_restore()
	end))

	pcall(function()
		self._runService:BindToRenderStep(BIND_NAME, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
			if self._flag and self._cFrame then
				pcall(function()
					local cam = self._getCamera()
					cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
					cam.CameraSubject = nil
					cam.CFrame = self._cFrame
				end)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

function Freecam:Stop()
	self:_restore()
	pcall(function()
		self._runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BIND_NAME)
	end)
	for _, c in self._conns do
		c:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._conns)
end

FX.FreecamCfg = Config
FX.FreecamNew = Freecam.new
end

-- ================= UE COUNTER (from ue_counter_lua) =================
do
local Config = {
	enable = false,
	key = "X",
	depth = 5.8,
	skyMin = 1000,
	skyRange = 1500,
	label = "PHONKWARE UE COUNTER",
	spacing = 20,
	textSize = 32,
}

local WEAPON_PATTERN = "^(.-) %- (.-) %-"
local KNIFE = "knife"

local UECounter = {}
UECounter.__index = UECounter

function UECounter.new(deps)
	return setmetatable({
		_runService = deps.runService,
		_players = deps.players,
		_getCamera = deps.getCamera,
		_viewModels = deps.getViewModels,
		_isKeyOn = deps.isKeyOn,
		_isMobileOn = deps.isMobileOn,
		_getFreecam = deps.getFreecamCFrame,
		_active = false,
		_storedPos = nil,
		_skyBase = nil,
		_skyPoint = nil,
		_lockedLook = nil,
		_mode = nil,
		_camPrev = nil,
		_weapons = {},
		_letters = {},
		_gui = nil,
		_conns = {},
	}, UECounter)
end

function UECounter:_gateOn()
	return self._isMobileOn() or Config.enable == true
end

function UECounter:_hrp()
	local char = self._players.LocalPlayer.Character
	return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

function UECounter:_setRoot(pos)
	local hrp = self:_hrp()
	if not hrp then
		return
	end
	local look = self._lockedLook
	local cf = (look and look.Magnitude > 0) and CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + look) or CFrame.new(pos)
	hrp.CFrame = cf
	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

function UECounter:_lockCamera(on)
	local cam = self._getCamera()
	if on then
		self._camPrev = cam.CameraType
		cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	else
		cam.CameraType = self._camPrev or Enum.CameraType.Custom
		self._camPrev = nil
	end
end

function UECounter:_refreshWeapons()
	table.clear(self._weapons)
	local vms = self._viewModels()
	if not vms then
		return
	end
	for _, m in vms:GetChildren() do
		local owner, weapon = m.Name:match(WEAPON_PATTERN)
		if owner and weapon then
			self._weapons[owner] = weapon -- owner, weapon from "<owner> - <weapon> - ..." (confirmed in Phonkware.txt)
		end
	end
end

function UECounter:_holdsKnife(p)
	local w = self._weapons[p.Name]
	return w ~= nil and w:lower() == KNIFE
end

function UECounter:_isEnemy(p)
	local me = self._players.LocalPlayer
	if p == me then
		return false
	end
	local char = p.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	return p:GetAttribute("TeamID") ~= me:GetAttribute("TeamID") -- TeamID attribute (confirmed in Phonkware.txt)
end

function UECounter:_nearestEnemy(origin)
	local best, bestDist
	for _, p in self._players:GetPlayers() do
		if self:_isEnemy(p) then
			local root = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local d = (root.Position - origin).Magnitude
				if not bestDist or d < bestDist then
					best, bestDist = p, d
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

function UECounter:_undergroundPos(stored)
	local depth = tonumber(Config.depth) or 5.8
	return stored - Vector3.new(0, depth, 0)
end

function UECounter:_skyPos()
	if not self._skyPoint then
		local base = self._skyBase
		local v = Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 2, math.random() * 0.85 + 0.15, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2)
		local dir = v.Magnitude < 0.05 and Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) or v.Unit
		local p = base + dir * (Config.skyMin + math.random() * Config.skyRange)
		local dx, dy, dz = p.X - base.X, p.Y - base.Y, p.Z - base.Z
		if math.abs(dx) < 1000 then dx = (dx >= 0 and 1 or -1) * (1000 + math.random() * 500) end
		if math.abs(dy) < 1000 then dy = 1000 + math.random() * 800 end
		if math.abs(dz) < 1000 then dz = (dz >= 0 and 1 or -1) * (1000 + math.random() * 500) end
		self._skyPoint = Vector3.new(base.X + dx, base.Y + dy, base.Z + dz)
	end
	return self._skyPoint
end

function UECounter:_buildLabel()
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "PhonkWareEUCounter"
	gui.DisplayOrder = 50
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.Enabled = false
	gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 68)
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, #Config.label * Config.spacing, 0, Config.textSize + 16)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.Parent = gui

	local letters = {}
	for i = 1, #Config.label do
		local ch = Config.label:sub(i, i)
		if ch ~= " " then
			local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, 0)
			lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, (i - 1) * Config.spacing, 0, 0)
			lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			lbl.TextSize = Config.textSize
			lbl.Text = ch
			lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
			lbl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
			lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
			lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			lbl.Parent = frame
			table.insert(letters, { label = lbl, i = i })
		end
	end

	self._gui = gui
	self._letters = letters
end

function UECounter:_tick()
	if not self:_gateOn() then
		self:_reset()
		return
	end

	local hrp = self:_hrp()
	if not hrp then
		return
	end

	if not self._active then
		self._active = true
		local fc = self._getFreecam and self._getFreecam()
		local base = fc and (fc.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)) or hrp.Position
		self._storedPos = base
		self._skyBase = base
		local look = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
		self._lockedLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
		self:_lockCamera(true)
	end

	self:_refreshWeapons()

	local stored = self._storedPos
	local nearest = self:_nearestEnemy(stored)
	local sky = nearest ~= nil and self:_holdsKnife(nearest)

	if sky then
		self._mode = "sky"
		self:_setRoot(self:_skyPos())
	else
		self._mode = "underground"
		self._skyPoint = nil
		self:_setRoot(self:_undergroundPos(stored))
	end

	if self._gui then
		self._gui.Enabled = true
	end
end

function UECounter:_reset()
	if self._gui then
		self._gui.Enabled = false
	end
	if not self._active then
		return
	end
	self._active = false

	local hrp = self:_hrp()
	if hrp and self._storedPos then
		hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(self._storedPos)
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end

	self._storedPos = nil
	self._skyBase = nil
	self._skyPoint = nil
	self._lockedLook = nil
	self._mode = nil
	self:_lockCamera(false)
end

function UECounter:_render()
	if not self._active then
		return
	end
	local hrp = self:_hrp()
	if hrp and self._storedPos and self._mode then
		local target = self._mode == "sky" and self._skyPoint or self._undergroundPos(self._storedPos)
		if target then
			local look = self._lockedLook
			if look and look.Magnitude > 0 then
				hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + look)
			end
		end
	end

	local cam = self._getCamera()
	if cam and cam.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
		cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local accent = (Library and Library.AccentColor) or Color3.fromRGB(196, 30, 58)
	for _, l in self._letters do
		l.label.Position = UDim2.new(0, (l.i - 1) * Config.spacing, 0, math.sin(now * 4 + l.i * 0.4) * 8)
		l.label.TextColor3 = accent
	end
end

function UECounter:Start()
	self:_buildLabel()

	table.insert(self._conns, self._runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		self:_tick()
	end))

	table.insert(self._conns, self._runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		self:_render()
	end))

	table.insert(self._conns, self._players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		self:_reset()
	end))
end

function UECounter:Stop()
	self:_reset()
	for _, c in self._conns do
		c:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._conns)
	if self._gui then
		self._gui:Destroy()
		self._gui = nil
	end
end

FX.UECfg = Config
FX.UECounterNew = UECounter.new
end

-- ================= FREECAM + UE COUNTER WIRING =================
do
    local FreecamNew = FX and FX.FreecamNew
    local UECounterNew = FX and FX.UECounterNew
    local FreecamCfg = (FX and FX.FreecamCfg) or { enable = false, speed = 20, key = "B", mobile = false }
    if FX then FX.FreecamCfg = FreecamCfg end

    local UIS = UserInputService

    local function keyOn(name)
        local kc = Enum.KeyCode[tostring(name or "")]
        return kc ~= nil and UIS:IsKeyDown(kc)
    end

    -- freecam wants GetMouseDelta on its input object; accumulate MouseMovement deltas
    local mouseAcc = Vector2.zero
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, gpe)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            mouseAcc += Vector2.new(input.Delta.X, input.Delta.Y)
        end
    end)
    local inputProxy = setmetatable({
        GetMouseDelta = function()
            local d = mouseAcc
            mouseAcc = Vector2.zero
            return d
        end,
        IsKeyDown = function(_, kc) return UIS:IsKeyDown(kc) end,
    }, {
        __index = function(_, k) return UIS[k] end,
        __newindex = function(_, k, v) UIS[k] = v end,
    })

    if type(FreecamNew) == "function" then
        FC_INST = FreecamNew({
            runService = RunService,
            userInput = inputProxy,
            players = Players,
            isKeyOn = keyOn,
            isMobileOn = function() return false end,
            getCamera = function() return Workspace.CurrentCamera end,
            mouseLock = nil,
        })
    else
        warn("[freecam] FreecamNew missing")
        FC_INST = nil
    end

    if type(UECounterNew) == "function" then
        UE_INST = UECounterNew({
            runService = RunService,
            players = Players,
            getCamera = function() return Workspace.CurrentCamera end,
            getViewModels = function()
                return Workspace.CurrentCamera:FindFirstChild("ViewModels") or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ViewModels")
            end,
            isKeyOn = keyOn,
            isMobileOn = function() return false end,
            getFreecamCFrame = function() return FC_INST and FC_INST._cFrame end,
        })
    else
        warn("[uecounter] UECounterNew missing")
        UE_INST = nil
    end

    -- freecam lives in Visuals
    local FCG = (not (UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled)) and mkGB(Tabs.Visuals, "L", "Freecam", "eye") or nil
    if FCG then
        sAdd(FCG, "AddToggle", "fc_enabled", { Text = "enabled", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) FreecamCfg.enable = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(FCG, "AddInput", "fc_key", { Text = "toggle key", Default = FreecamCfg.key,
            Callback = function(t) FreecamCfg.key = tostring(t or "B"); saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(FCG, "AddSlider", "fc_speed", { Text = "speed", Min = 1, Max = 200, Default = FreecamCfg.speed, Rounding = 0,
            Callback = function(v) FreecamCfg.speed = v; saveConfigAll() end })
        sAdd(FCG, "AddToggle", "fc_mobile", { Text = "mobile", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) FreecamCfg.mobile = v; saveConfigAll() end })
    end
    if FC_INST then pcall(function() FC_INST:Start() end) end

    -- ue counter goes behind attack method, above the underground positioning
    if UE_INST then pcall(function() UE_INST:Start() end) end
end

pcall(function()
    ThemeManager:SetLibrary(Library)
    SaveManager:SetLibrary(Library)
    SaveManager:IgnoreThemeSettings()
    SaveManager:SetIgnoreIndexes({ "MenuKey" })
    ThemeManager:SetFolder("ArgonLose")
    SaveManager:SetFolder("ArgonLose/configs")
    if Tabs.Settings then
        SaveManager:BuildConfigSection(Tabs.Settings)
        ThemeManager:ApplyToTab(Tabs.Settings)
    end
end)

        if Library.LoadingScreen and not Library.LoadingScreen.Closed then
            Library.LoadingScreen:Finish()
        end
    end)
end)
